article.articleHeadline: WHO minta Rusia menjelaskan teka-teki kematian pekerja di laboratorium penelitian pes di Siberia - Apa itu pes pneumonik dan bagaimana penyebarannya? - Tempo.co | tempo.co
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO asks Russia to explain the mystery of workers' deaths at a plague research laboratory in Siberia - What is pneumonic plague and how is it transmitted? - Tempo.co | tempo.co.
article.articleSummary: WHO has urged Russia to provide information after a worker died at a Siberian plague laboratory; investigations continue and contacts tested negative for pneumonic plague. Pneumonic plague is a severe lung infection caused by Yersinia pestis that can develop from bubonic or septicemic forms; it is the deadliest form but less common than bubonic. Symptoms include shortness of breath, chest pain, and coughing up blood. Globally, 1,000–3,000 cases occur yearly, with bubonic predominating in Central Africa; cases have been reported in Russia, India, China, and the United States. Reservoirs include about 200 rodent species. Transmission occurs via infected fleas or contact with infected animals; pneumonic plague spreads via respiratory droplets. Early antibiotics are effective; post-exposure prophylaxis and quarantine may follow exposure. Russia’s preliminary results found no microorganism linked to the patient’s professional activity.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがロシアに対し、シベリアのペスト研究所における作業員死亡の謎について説明を求める - 肺ペストとは何か、どのように感染するのか？
triage.triage_reason: WHOがロシアに公式説明を求めている点で社会的・国際的関心が高く、研究所での原因不明死という異常性があるため、続報確認とフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア・シベリアの研究所における作業員死亡事例であり、対象国リストに含まれない。中国・インド等は過去の症例発生国として背景情報的に言及されているのみで、本イベントの発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Trump dice que hablará "muy pronto" por teléfono con Putin sobre la peste neumónica rusa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trump says he will speak by phone with Putin very soon about the Russian pneumonic plague.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague outbreak under scrutiny in Russia's Irkutsk region, Siberia. A 28-year-old female employee of the Institute of Plague Research in Irkutsk and the Russian Far East died in a hospital in Shélejov, a satellite city of Irkutsk. Investigations consider two possible sources: infection in Thailand from which she recently returned, or an accidental laboratory exposure from a broken tube with pathogens at her workplace. The U.S. State Department says officials have been in contact with Moscow since last week, and President Trump said he will speak with Vladimir Putin very soon about the outbreak. Washington has issued a warning about a possible pneumonic plague in the area. Independent Russian outlet Liudi Baikala reports quarantines in several Irkutsk hospitals. The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control is monitoring, and the WHO calls the risk to Europe very low.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ大統領、ロシアの肺ペストについてプーチン大統領と『近日中に』電話会談すると発言
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクでの肺ペスト死亡例を巡り、米露間の外交的関与やWHO・ECDCの監視が確認されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的関心）に該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア・イルクーツク州での肺ペスト死亡例。タイは感染経路の可能性として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ratusan Pengunjung Restoran Korea 88 di Bandung Keracunan Makanan |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hundreds of visitors at Bandung's Korea 88 Restaurant suffer food poisoning
article.articleSummary: Food poisoning cases linked to Bandung's 88 Seoul restaurant (Paskal 23 Mall, Jalan Pasirkaliki, West Java) affecting hundreds of visitors. Affected individuals experienced vomiting and nausea and required hospital treatment. The incident circulated on social media; restaurant Marketing General Manager Sarah Merci stated that safety, quality, and customer comfort are priorities and that complaints are being addressed promptly. The report provides no laboratory confirmation, defined infection source, or details on imported/exported cases, and does not specify an official outbreak beyond illness reports from attendees. Operations are claimed to follow established standards while investigations or verifications are ongoing. Published date: 2026-10-07. Keywords: food poisoning, Bandung, 88 Seoul, Paskal 23 Mall, public health response.

article.articleHeadline: Quênia registra primeira morte por ebola este ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records first Ebola death this year.
article.articleSummary: Kenya records its first Ebola death in 2026. The patient was hospitalized in Nairobi and had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, which is facing an outbreak with more than 8,000 confirmed cases and over 4,000 deaths. From there, the man traveled to Uganda, which has also reported Ebola cases, before returning to Kenya. Health authorities are monitoring those who had contact with him and have placed them under observation.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで今年初のエボラ出血熱による死亡例を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRCで8,000例以上・4,000人以上の死亡者を出すエボラ流行が進行中で、ウガンダを経てケニアへ越境拡大した死亡例が確認されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの死亡例だが、根本的な大規模流行はDRCで発生しており、ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境拡大が確認されている。ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。DRCの流行規模（8,000例超、4,000人超の死亡）と国境を越えた感染拡大は重大な公衆衛生上の懸念であり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: புதுச்சேரியில் 637 பேருக்கு டெங்கு பாதிப்பு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 637 people infected with dengue in Puducherry
article.articleSummary: As of 7 October 2026, Puducherry has reported 637 dengue fever cases this year, with no fatalities. Health authorities launched a dengue and chikungunya awareness drive using auto-rickshaws, inaugurated by Deputy Director (Public Health) Umashankar. The campaign, under the Puducherry Health and Family Welfare Department, targets primary health centers, community welfare centers, and urban health centers in rural areas. Awareness messages are also broadcast via FM radio, cinemas, and cable TV. The event was attended by Assistant Director (National Mosquito and Vector-borne Diseases) Murugan and Malaria Technical Division officers. Arrangements were coordinated by Ragunathan, Deputy Director (News, Education and Follow-up).

triage.headline_ja: プドゥチェリーでデング熱に637人が感染
triage.triage_reason: 死亡例のない季節性デング熱の流行であり、当局が啓発活動を実施中。重篤化や異常な拡大の兆候はないが、症例数を継続的に注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: デング熱は毎年流行する媒介蚊感染症であり、死亡例なし、地元保健当局が独自に啓発キャンペーンを実施していることから管理可能と判断。続報での症例数推移を注視。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تسجل أول وفاة بفيروس "إيبولا" على أراضيها
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records its first Ebola virus death within its borders.
article.articleSummary: Kenya records its first laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease death within its borders. A Kenyan citizen who had been living in the Democratic Republic of Congo arrived in Nairobi last Saturday and soon developed a high fever and severe bleeding under the skin, dying on Monday. Officials say medications may have masked symptoms. Health authorities are tracing roughly 28 contacts, including relatives and health workers. The case is linked to the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, making Kenya the third country to report a linked infection. The development underscores cross-border transmission risk and the importance of rapid surveillance, contact tracing, and infection prevention measures to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで初のエボラウイルスによる死亡例を確認
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国での進行中のエボラ流行に関連した越境感染がケニアで確認され、死亡例・接触者追跡が発生しており、国際的拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تسجل أول وفاة بفيروس إيبولا على أراضيها - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records its first Ebola virus death on its soil.
article.articleSummary: Kenya records its first Ebola virus death on its soil as of 07 Oct 2026. In Nairobi, the Health Minister confirmed the first laboratory-confirmed Ebola death in the country: a Kenyan national who had been living in the Democratic Republic of Congo and arrived in Nairobi last Saturday. The patient developed high fever and severe bleeding under the skin after arrival and died on Monday; officials said medicines may have masked symptoms earlier. Authorities are tracing about 28 close contacts, including family members and health workers. This case is linked to the Ebola strain circulating in the DRC, making Kenya the third country to report a case associated with the DRC outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで国内初のエボラウイルスによる死亡例を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行株に関連したケニア初の確認例であり、接触者追跡中（約28名）で国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるため。

article.articleHeadline: L'OMS soutient la riposte du Kenya après un premier cas importé d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO backs Kenya's response after the first imported Ebola case.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first imported Bundibugyo virus disease (Ebola) case; the patient, a Kenyan national who had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo for seven years, died in a Nairobi hospital. The World Health Organization is collaborating with the Kenyan government to intensify the response, including case investigations, contact tracing, and entry screening at high-risk points, with risk communication and community engagement at the core. Isolation units are designated in 27 high-risk counties, with trained case-management staff and updated Ebola surveillance tools. WHO and partners have conducted simulation exercises and established a national rapid-response trainer group, delivering about 1,000 Ebola tests and 1,000 PPE kits to high-risk counties. Current guidance does not recommend travel or trade restrictions to the DRC, Uganda, or Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがケニアの初の輸入エボラ症例後の対応を支援
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで初の輸入エボラ（ブンディブギョ型）症例が確認され死亡、DRCとの越境感染リンクがあり、IHR基準で複数該当（重大な公衆衛生影響・異常事態・国際拡大リスク）するため。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）に7年間居住していたケニア国籍者で、ナイロビの病院で死亡。記事はケニアでの対応が主題だが、感染源としてDRCが明示的に言及されているため含めた。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: OMS apoya respuesta de Kenia a ébola tras primer caso importado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO backs Kenya's Ebola response after the first imported case.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first imported case of Ebola virus disease caused by the Bundibugyo strain, in a Kenyan national who had resided in the Democratic Republic of Congo for seven years; the patient died in a Nairobi hospital. The World Health Organization says it is working closely with the Kenyan government to intensify containment, case investigation, and contact tracing for expanded surveillance. Response priorities include reviewing high-risk entry points, clear risk communication, and community engagement. WHO Africa regional director Mohamed Janabi noted that Kenya has implemented strong control measures and stressed rapid detection of additional cases to prevent spread. The agency and partners have supported simulation exercises and trained a national rapid-response team; isolation facilities have been identified in 27 high-risk districts, with trained case managers and updated surveillance tools. About 1,000 Ebola tests and 1,000 PPE have been provided; no travel or trade restrictions are advised with DR Congo, Uganda, or Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがケニアの初の輸入エボラ症例への対応を支援

article.articleHeadline: Peste neumónica en Siberia: Trump hablará con Putin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumonic Plague in Siberia: Trump Will Speak with Putin.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague is being investigated in Russia's Irkutsk region, Siberia, after the death of a 28-year-old laboratorian at the Irkutsk and Far East Pest Institute near Irkutsk. The World Health Organization activated International Health Regulations procedures to track the case, with the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control monitoring; WHO says Europe’s risk is very low. The death occurred October 2 in a hospital in Shélejov, where the worker conducted research on dangerous pathogens. Two exposure scenarios are under review: a laboratory accident after a broken tube of potentially infectious material, or infection during a recent trip to Thailand. About 200 contacts are reportedly under medical surveillance in Irkutsk hospitals. Investigations aim to confirm Yersinia pestis, determine transmission, and assess additional cases. Separately, US President Trump plans a forthcoming call with President Putin about the possible outbreak; more information is expected on Wednesday.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアで肺ペスト発生：トランプ大統領がプーチン大統領と協議へ
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストによる死亡例が確認され、WHOがIHR手続きを発動し国際的関心（米露首脳の電話会談）も高いため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Viral Dugaan Keracunan Makanan di Restoran Korea Paskal Bandung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Viral Allegation of Food Poisoning at the Paskal Bandung Korean Restaurant.
article.articleSummary: Suspected food poisoning at the 88 Seoul 23 Paskal Bandung restaurant in Bandung, West Java, Indonesia, emerged online after reports of illness during 2–4 October 2026, with some posts citing 3 October. Reported counts are unconfirmed, but claims of hundreds affected circulated. Symptoms described include severe diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, high fever, and chills. A Threads post recounted illness in a husband and wife after dining on 3 October; the husband developed fever >39°C requiring IV fluids, while the wife is pregnant in the first trimester and experienced diarrhea and nausea/vomiting. Additional users reported similar symptoms after eating there on the same date. The restaurant issued a statement via Instagram Stories expressing concern. The article notes no laboratory confirmation, no identified infection source, and no details on imported or exported cases; no public health findings or investigation results are provided.

triage.triage_reason: 単一レストランでの食中毒疑いで感染症（病原体）起因か不明であり、実験室確認や原因特定もされていないため、続報を注視する段階である。

article.articleHeadline: 俄羅斯實驗室鼠疫疑雲，發生什麼事？｜天下雜誌
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russian Laboratory Plague Mystery: What Happened? | CommonWealth Magazine
article.articleSummary: Russia’s laboratory plague incident prompted medical observation of nearly 200 contacts; the hospital treating the patient was quarantined, and nearby facilities imposed restrictions. No plague cases have been confirmed among the contacts, and local epidemiology is stable. Questions remain about how exposure to Yersinia pestis could have occurred. Plague is caused by Yersinia pestis, cycling between rodents, fleas, and animals; humans are infected by flea bites or contact with infected animals. Pneumonic plague can spread via respiratory droplets and is the only form that transmits person-to-person. Globally, plague persists in wildlife across Africa, Asia, and the Americas. From 2019-2025, 3,847 cases and 423 deaths were reported, mainly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Madagascar; occasional cases occur in the United States. Pneumonic plague progresses rapidly; incubation 1-3 days; early antibiotics are effective, and close contacts may receive 7 days prophylaxis. WHO monitors; public risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの実験室ペスト疑惑、一体何が起きたのか？｜天下雑誌
triage.triage_reason: ロシアの研究施設でのペスト曝露疑惑により約200人が経過観察中だが、接触者に感染確認例はなく、現地疫学は安定している。異常な事案ではあるが重大な公衆衛生上の影響は現時点で確認されておらず、続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシアの実験室関連ペスト疑惑事案であり、DRC・マダガスカルは2019-2025年の世界的なペスト発生状況の背景情報として言及されているのみで、今回のイベント発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。対象国リストに該当する発生国はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Kenia confirma primer caso de ébola tras contagio importado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya confirms first case of Ebola after imported contagion.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first Ebola case, imported from the Democratic Republic of Congo, detected in Nairobi. The patient, a Kenyan citizen who had lived in DRC for seven years, developed symptoms about a month ago after seeking care in Congolese hospitals, then traveled by land to Kampala, Uganda, and flew to Nairobi. He arrived at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport on October 3 and was promptly isolated at a private hospital after public-health screening. Clinical features included fever, chills, severe fatigue, weakness, muscle pain, sore throat, throat irritation, and subcutaneous hemorrhages at injection sites. Laboratory testing identified the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, for which there is no specific treatment or vaccine, and the patient died despite supportive care. Authorities are tracing 23 fellow passengers and four crew, and have identified 28 contacts, including family and healthcare workers, with safe burial protocols under way.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、輸入感染によるエボラ出血熱の初症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCで感染しケニアに渡航後に死亡した輸入エボラ症例であり、国際的な人の移動（空路・陸路）と多数の接触者（乗客・乗員・家族・医療従事者）が関与するため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCに7年居住し同国で発症、コンゴの病院を受診後、陸路でウガンダ・カンパラを経由し空路でケニア・ナイロビへ渡航。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外したが、感染源・発症地としてDRCが主題に深く関わるため含めた。Bundibugyo株はワクチン・特異的治療法が存在せず、患者は死亡。23名の同乗者と4名の乗務員の追跡、28名の接触者特定、安全な埋葬対応が進行中であり、国際的な公衆衛生対応が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết trở nặng sau ba ngày tự điều trị tại nhà
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever worsens after three days of self-treatment at home.
article.articleSummary: In Hanoi, a 58-year-old woman with hypertension contracted dengue fever and worsened after three days of self-treatment at home with intravenous fluids and albumin. She was admitted in critical condition to Tam Anh General Hospital Hanoi; a dengue diagnosis was confirmed. Platelets dropped from 16 × 10^9/L to 5 × 10^9/L by day 6, with plasma leakage causing ascites and pleural effusion and severe dyspnea requiring oxygen. She received intravenous fluids, platelet transfusions, antibiotics, and high-molecular-weight colloids to sustain intravascular volume; crystalloids alone were inadequate. Between days 4–7, rapid thrombocytopenia with capillary leak increased shock risk. After stabilization, fluid reabsorption occurred, and diuretics facilitated recovery before discharge. Dr. Tra My warns against home-use of IV fluids or albumin without medical indication, stressing monitoring of blood pressure, heart rate, urine output, hematocrit, and signs of leakage, particularly in patients with cardiovascular disease or hypertension. Seek prompt medical evaluation for dengue symptoms and follow-up.

article.articleHeadline: 俄鼠疫疑雲引美國警戒！昔武器研究釀炭疽疫情 真相13年後才曝光
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia's plague scare triggers U.S. alert! Former weapons research spurred an anthrax outbreak; the truth was revealed only after 13 years.
article.articleSummary: Suspected pneumonic plague outbreak in Siberia triggers U.S. pressure on Moscow; U.S. officials say Washington lodged a formal diplomatic démarche and is monitoring closely. A 28-year-old Daria Shipilova, at Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute of Siberia and Far East, reportedly died days after breaking a vial containing the pneumonic plague pathogen in late September; Russia has not confirmed plague infection or disclosed a death cause. Under the 2005 International Health Regulations, countries must report to WHO within 24 hours; Moscow has supplied some information but has not answered basic questions about tests conducted. WHO assessed cross-border risk as very low, though nearby Central Asian states tightened border and airport surveillance. The article notes U.S. concerns about Russia retaining Soviet-era bioweapons programs, ongoing development, and past secrecy around the Sverdlovsk anthrax outbreak (1979). The Irkutsk institute, established in 1934, recently conducted joint drills with China on outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアのペスト疑惑が米国を警戒させる！かつての兵器研究が招いた炭疽疫病、真相は13年後に明らかに
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・シベリアでの肺ペスト疑い事例と研究所職員の死亡が報告されているが、感染確定や詳細情報が不明であり、対象国（中国等）での発生は確認されていないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 事件はロシア（シベリア、イルクーツク）およびスヴェルドロフスクで発生しており、対象国リストに含まれるのは中国のみだが、記事では中国はイルクーツク研究所との過去の合同訓練に言及されているのみで、発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。ロシアの感染確定情報が未発表であり、WHOはリスクを「非常に低い」と評価している点にも留意。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Case of avian influenza confirmed in a municipality in Northern Rio Grande do Sul - Jornal O Sul.
article.articleSummary: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) detected in backyard poultry in Selbach, Alto Jacuí, Northern Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. Diagnosis confirmed by the Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense (LFDA) in Campinas, with samples sent to the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE) reference laboratory. Notification received on Oct 1; the SVO-RS and the Department of Animal Health Vigilance (DDA) of Seapi will survey 68 properties within a 3 km radius and conduct sanitary education. Seapi notes no risk in consuming meat or eggs, as the virus is not transmitted this way. HPAI primarily affects birds; mammalian infections can occur but are rare in humans. Under OIE guidelines, backyard cases do not alter Brazil’s status as a country free of avian influenza; exports remain protected unless the virus reaches commercial farms. Advisories: avoid approaching or aiding injured animals; report respiratory/neurological signs or sudden high mortality to the nearest Inspectorate or via WhatsApp (51) 98445-2033. Previous July outbreak in Coqueiros do Sul; a suspected zoo case in Sapucaia do Sul (botulism ruled out).

triage.headline_ja: ガウーショ北部の自治体で鳥インフルエンザの症例が確認される - Jornal O Sul
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル南部の裏庭養鶏場でHPAIが確認されたが、人への感染はなく、商業養鶏場にも影響なし。ブラジルの鳥インフルエンザ清浄国ステータスも維持されており、国際的な影響は限定的。
triage.notes: 裏庭養鶏での発生であり、人間への感染報告なし。過去にも同地域で発生歴あり（2026年7月Coqueiros do Sul）。当局は3km圏内の68施設を調査中で、国内対応能力の範囲内と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Trump hablará con Putin sobre peste neumónica en Rusia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trump will talk with Putin about pneumonic plague in Russia.
article.articleSummary: Donald Trump announced a forthcoming call with Vladimir Putin to discuss the pneumonic plague outbreak in Russia. The focus is Siberia, centered on Irkutsk and its satellite city Shelekhov. A 28-year-old employee of the Institute of Plague Research in Irkutsk and the Far East died in a hospital in Shelekhov, with the incident likely occurring Oct 1–2. Investigations present two scenarios: infection in Thailand after return, or an accidental laboratory spill of Yersinia pestis at the worksite. The United States has issued a health alert about a possible pneumonic plague outbreak and says US officials, including health experts, have been in contact with Moscow since last week; Secretary of State Marco Rubio urged transparency. The ECDC is monitoring; the WHO says Europe risk is very low, while Russian authorities reportedly quarantined several Irkutsk hospitals.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ氏、ロシアの肺ペストについてプーチン氏と電話会談へ
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクでのペスト研究所職員の死亡、米国・WHO・ECDCが注視するなど国際的関心が高く、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（イルクーツク州）であり対象国リストに含まれない。タイは感染経路の仮説として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 肯尼亞出現首宗外地傳入伊波拉個案　當局隔離多人(周凱勁報道)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records its first imported Ebola case; authorities quarantine several people (Reported by Zhou Kai-jin).
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first imported Ebola virus disease (EVD) case. A Kenyan citizen who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo for seven years fell ill about a month ago, was treated in several Congolese hospitals, and died on Oct 5, 2026. He had entered Kenya by air from Uganda after traveling by land from DRC and, on arrival, underwent border screening before being taken to a Nairobi hospital. Laboratory testing identified Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Kenya quarantined eight close family members and 21 health workers who had contact with the patient, and is tracing 27 passengers and crew from the same flight. Officials cited possible symptom relief from medication as a reason border checks may have missed entry. The DRC outbreak since May has caused over 4,000 deaths; Uganda has closed two borders with DRC since May, while Ugandan officials say there are no local Ebola cases.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで初の輸入エボラ症例確認、当局が複数人を隔離
triage.triage_reason: DRCで続くエボラ流行（5月以降死者4000人超）がウガンダ経由でケニアへ国際的に拡大した初の輸入症例であり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大・渡航制限）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 主題はケニアでの輸入症例だが、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは5月以降継続中の大規模エボラ流行の発生源として記事の中核的事実であり対象国として含めた。

article.articleHeadline: ಎಚ್‌ಐವಿ ಸೋಂಕು; ಜಾಗೃತಿಯೇ ಮದ್ದು ಎಂದು ಹಿರಿಯ ಸಿವಿಲ್ ನ್ಯಾಯಾಧೀಶ ಈಶ್ವರ್ ಸಲಹೆ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HIV infection; caution itself is the medicine, says Senior Civil Judge Ishwar.
article.articleSummary: HIV infection awareness emphasized in Chamrajnagar, Karnataka, where Senior Civil Judge Ishwar urged that caution and safe practices are the best defense against HIV spread. Speaking at a Red Ribbon Run organized by the State AIDS Control Society and multiple district agencies (administration, health, police, legal services, and AIDS control unit), he urged dispelling social myths about HIV. He clarified that HIV does not spread through talking, sitting with, or touching an HIV-positive person; transmission occurs only if infected blood enters a healthy body, underscoring the need to avoid unsafe sexual contact. Stigmatization should be avoided, and infected individuals should not be ostracized. The event, with hundreds of students and the public, highlighted the importance of widespread awareness about preventive measures. HIV weakens immunity and raises risk from other diseases, reinforcing the need for accurate information and precautions. Route traced through city landmarks, ending at the district administration building.

triage.headline_ja: HIV感染症；注意こそが薬と、上級民事裁判官イシュワル氏が助言
triage.triage_reason: HIV啓発イベントに関する通常の広報活動であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・カルナータカ州でのHIV啓発イベント（Red Ribbon Run）に関する内容であり、具体的な感染拡大事例や異常事態の報告ではないため、対象国リストに該当する国があっても発生イベントとしては計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Konfirmasi Kasus Ebola Pertama, Pasien Meninggal Sepulang dari Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya Confirms First Ebola Case, Patient Dies After Returning from the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first Ebola case after a Kenyan who had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo for about seven years died in Nairobi. The patient, ill for about a month, traveled overland to Kampala, Uganda, then flew to Nairobi on 3 October 2026 and was isolated on arrival. Tests at the National Virology Reference Laboratory and Kenya Medical Research Institute identified Bundibugyo virus, a strain of Ebola. The patient died on 5 October and was buried on 6 October per Ebola burial protocols. Kenya reported the case to the WHO on 6 October. WHO says Kenya is the fourth country to confirm Bundibugyo Ebola. Authorities are tracing contacts and have quarantined at least eight family members and 21 healthcare workers; 28 contacts identified, including 23 passengers and 4 cabin crew on the Uganda–Kenya leg, to enter a 21-day isolation.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアが初のエボラ出血熱症例を確認、コンゴから帰国後に患者死亡
triage.triage_reason: ケニア初のエボラ確定例で患者が死亡し、国境を越えた渡航歴・接触者追跡（飛行機の同乗者含む）があるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴ民主共和国に約7年居住していたが、確定症例および死亡はケニアで発生。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれず、DRCは発生地域というより発症前の居住地として言及されているため、対象国としての明確な発生確認はないと判断しverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: കെനിയയില്‍ എബോള ബാധിച്ച് ഒരാള്‍ മരിച്ചു; രാജ്യത്ത് രോഗബാധ സ്ഥിരീകരിക്കുന്നത് ഇതാദ്യം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One person dies of Ebola in Kenya; this is the country's first confirmed case of the disease.
article.articleSummary: On 7 October 2026, Kenya reports its first confirmed Ebola case after a Kenyan citizen who had traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo died in Nairobi. The patient had lived in DRC for about seven years, fell ill for roughly a month, then traveled by road to Kampala, Uganda, and flew to Nairobi, where he died. Health officials said the case was confirmed and President William Ruto ordered containment to prevent spread. Eight family members and 21 health workers are quarantined; 28 contacts identified, including family and health workers. Tracing is under way for 23 other passengers and four crew members from the Uganda-bound flight. Contacts must endure a 21-day isolation, with release on negative tests. Uganda earlier reported 20 Ebola cases and 2 deaths; was declared Ebola-free in August, while other government figures cite over 4,000 deaths and 8,300 cases across seven provinces. WHO is monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ感染により1人死亡、国内初の感染確認例
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）由来のエボラ患者がウガンダ経由でケニアに入国し死亡、ケニア初の確定例となった。国境を越えた感染拡大と航空機内接触者追跡が発生しており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアおよびウガンダでの感染事例だが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であるDRCでの継続的なエボラ流行（4,000人超の死亡、8,300例超）が背景にあり、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。国境を越えた患者移動と航空機内接触者追跡が進行中で、WHOも監視している。

article.articleHeadline: ब्रिटिश भविष्यवक्ता ने दी नई महामारी की चेतावनी, अब रूस में वैज्ञानिक की प्लेग से मौत से मचा हड़कंप
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: British forecaster warns of a new pandemic; now in Russia, a scientist's death from plague has sparked panic.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague death of 28-year-old Darya Shipilova at a Siberian anti-plague institute near Irkutsk sparks panic as a live bacteria test tube reportedly broke during work, with Shipilova dying on October 1. About 60 colleagues are confined inside the institute and roughly 200 people are under medical surveillance; five major hospitals in the Irkutsk region are placed on outbreak mode and sealed for three weeks. Local doctors whisper about the spread of plague. In the UK, Craig Hamilton-Parker, who calls himself the Prophet of Doom, had warned on September 24 of a dangerous lung-targeting bacterial pandemic, claiming Tibetan monks provided hidden information; there is no conclusive evidence linking his warning to the Russian incident. He suggests ancient Tibetan texts hold a cure and that AI could help control the disease. U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio says monitoring is ongoing but recommends no panic.

triage.headline_ja: 英国の予言者が新たなパンデミックを警告、ロシアで科学者がペストで死亡し騒動に
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの抗ペスト研究所で研究者が肺ペストにより死亡し、約60人が施設内に隔離、約200人が医学的監視下に置かれ、複数の病院が封鎖されるなど深刻かつ異常な事態であり、IHR基準を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価に進めるべき。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州の研究所であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。Tibet自治区への言及は予言者の発言内でのみ登場し、実際の発生地ではないため除外。研究所内での実験管理下の感染であり、現時点で市中感染や国際拡大の証拠はないが、ラボ由来の肺ペストは人-人感染リスクがあり続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Trump to speak to Putin over Russia plague lab death. Should India be worried?- Moneycontrol.com
article.articleSummary: 28-year-old Darya Shipilova died at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute in Irkutsk, Siberia; authorities say the death was due to pneumonia, with no microorganisms linked to her work found in samples, and around 200 people were initially placed under medical observation. Russia denies a confirmed plague outbreak, and the World Health Organization reports no confirmed plague cases in Irkutsk; contacts have been identified and tested with no dangerous pathogens detected. Plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, includes the pneumonic form, which spreads via respiratory particles and can be fatal without timely antibiotics; currently the risk is assessed as moderate to low. U.S. President Donald Trump said he would speak with Vladimir Putin 'very soon' and offered help if needed. For India, there is no direct threat indicated; the key question is human-to-human transmission and broader exposure.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ大統領、ロシアのペスト研究所での死亡事案についてプーチン大統領と協議へ。インドは懸念すべきか？－Moneycontrol.com
triage.triage_reason: ロシアの抗ペスト研究所関係者の死亡を巡り、米露首脳が協議するなど国際的な政治的関心が高まっているが、WHOはペスト確定例なしと報告しており、実態は不明な点が多い。
triage.notes: イベントの実際の発生地はロシア（イルクーツク）であり、対象国リストに含まれない。インドは見出しで言及されているが、記事内でも『直接的な脅威は示されていない』とされ、実際の発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تدعم كينيا في احتواء إيبولا عقب تسجيل أول حالة مستوردة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization supports Kenya in containing Ebola after the first imported case was recorded.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus: Kenya confirms its first imported Ebola case in Nairobi; the patient, a Kenyan citizen who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo for seven years, died in hospital on Monday night. As of 7 October 2026, WHO Africa Region reports Kenya is intensifying response with rapid case detection, contact tracing, entry-point screening, risk communication, and community engagement. WHO supports simulations, rapid-response training, and isolation units in 27 high-risk counties, with about 1,000 Ebola tests and 1,000 PPE kits delivered. No travel or trade restrictions are advised for the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, or Kenya based on current information. Emphasis remains on quick detection of additional cases to prevent wider transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、初の輸入エボラ症例確認後にケニアのエボラ封じ込めを支援
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで初の輸入エボラ症例が確認され死亡、WHOが緊急支援を実施しており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの初輸入エボラ症例（患者はDRC在住歴あり）。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRC・ウガンダは渡航歴・隣国として言及されているのみで、現地での発生拡大を示す記述がないため verified_locations には含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak leaves 4.148 dead in the Democratic Republic of Congo
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak has reached 4,148 deaths and over 8,600 cases since mid-May. In the latest updates, 59 new infections and 34 deaths were reported, with a case-fatality rate of 48.2%. 896 people are hospitalized or in isolation, and 2,235 have recovered. Contact tracing stands at 79.7%, but has been trending downward. Ituri province remains the epicenter, accounting for about 75% of detected cases, with other affected areas including North Kivu, South Kivu, Upper and Lower Uélé, Tshopo, and South Ubangi. UNICEF warns more than 1,900 children have lost one or both parents or caregivers, primarily in Ituri; as of Sept 29, 2,076 children diagnosed and 1,162 deaths among them. Separately, Kenya confirmed its first imported Ebola case: a Kenyan citizen who had lived in DRC and traveled via Uganda, arriving in Nairobi on Oct 3 and subsequently died; 28 contacts, including family and health workers, are quarantined.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで4,148人死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ大規模流行（8,600例超・死者4,148人）に加え、ケニアへの国際的な輸入症例が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: ケニアで輸入症例が確認されているが、対象国リストにケニアが含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ウガンダも対象国リスト外。接触者追跡率の低下（79.7%、下降傾向）は管理可能性への懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola deja 4.148 muertos en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak leaves 4,148 dead in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 4,148 deaths and more than 8,600 laboratory-confirmed cases since it was declared in mid-May. In the latest period, 59 new infections and 34 deaths were reported, for a case-fatality rate of 48.2%. About 896 people are hospitalized or in isolation, and 2,235 have recovered. Contact tracing stands at 79.7%, dipping in recent days. Ituri Province remains the epicenter, about 75% of cases; other affected regions include North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Bas-Uélé, Tshopo, and Ubangi-Sud. UNICEF notes more than 1,900 children have lost a parent or caregiver, or been separated, mostly in Ituri; as of Sept 29, 2,076 children with Ebola, including 1,162 deaths. Kenya reports its first imported case: a Kenyan citizen resident in DRC traveled via Uganda to Nairobi on Oct 3 and died; 28 contacts were identified and quarantined.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行により4,148人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行（死者4,148人、致死率48.2%）に加え、ケニアへの国際的な感染拡大（輸入症例）が確認されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC国内（特にIturi州が中心、約75%の症例）での大規模流行を主題としている。ケニアおよびウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。接触者追跡率の低下（79.7%から減少傾向）は感染拡大リスクを示唆し、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Act with speed to avert spread of Ebola
article.articleSummary: Kenya has registered its first Ebola case, with the patient dying on Saturday last week. Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale confirmed the imported case, who traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC)—a country that has reported about 4,000 Ebola deaths—by road to Uganda and then by air to Kenya, reportedly clearing JKIA port health screening without red flags. Kenya must seek clarification from DRC and Uganda on the patient’s treatment and why he was allowed to proceed if Ebola was known. Twenty-eight contacts have been identified; authorities must widen tracing and isolate additional contacts to avert further spread. Kenya has prepared with 23 Ebola isolation and treatment centres nationwide, though resource and personnel sufficiency remains under scrutiny. Public health measures urged: handwashing, alcohol-based sanitizers, avoidance of contact with blood/body fluids, and heightened transparency and accountability to prevent a national disaster.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの拡大を防ぐため迅速な対応を
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続するエボラ流行がウガンダ経由でケニアへ国際的に拡大し死亡例も発生しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで継続するエボラ流行の越境拡大（ウガンダ経由ケニアへの輸入症例）。ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。渡航・貿易制限に関する言及はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola patient's journey to Nairobi exposes airport screening gaps
article.articleSummary: An Ebola case in Kenya involved the Ebola Bundibugyo virus detected in a patient who died in Nairobi after arriving from DRC. The man, who had lived in DRC for seven years, arrived in Nairobi via Jambojet JM 8523 on Oct 3; he died about 11:30 pm on Oct 5. Samples tested positive for Ebola Bundibugyo at Kemri and National Virology Reference Laboratory. Delays in suspecting haemorrhagic fever and obtaining travel history contributed to exposure risk; hospital staff were advised to quarantine for 21 days. The ministry identified 28 contacts and traced 23 passengers plus 4 crew aboard the flight; all monitored or quarantined for 21 days. JKIA uses thermal scanners; officials caution screening is not perfect and call for broader investigations. Since May, 652,584 travellers have been screened; 267 samples tested; this was the only positive. Kenya’s preparedness plans faced protests and court orders around a proposed quarantine facility.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者のナイロビまでの移動がJKIA空港における検疫体制の不備を露呈
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）感染者がケニアに渡航し死亡、接触者追跡・隔離が行われており国際的拡大リスクと重症度が高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCに7年間居住しており、感染源はDRCである可能性が高い。ケニア（ナイロビ）は対象国リストに含まれないため、発生地域としてはDRCのみを計上した。空港スクリーニングの不備や接触者追跡の詳細、検疫施設を巡る抗議活動など社会的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Bé trai co giật, nói sảng do cúm A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Boy with seizures and delirious speech due to Influenza A.
article.articleSummary: Published 2026-10-07, in Ho Chi Minh City, a 10-year-old boy, Trung, presented with five days of high fever, cough and vomiting, then suddenly had a seizure with delirious speech. At Tam Anh General Hospital, labs showed hyponatremia (128 mmol/L) and hypocalcemia, and chest X-ray indicated bronchopneumonia. He was diagnosed with Influenza A with a non-specific seizure; clinicians warned that influenza-associated seizures can precede neurological complications such as encephalitis or acute necrotizing encephalopathy, potentially progressing from altered consciousness and seizures to coma, with risk of brain edema and lasting deficits or death in severe cases. After five days of treatment, Trung recovered, became alert, fever resolved, and was discharged. Influenza A and B viruses cause seasonal illness; A subtypes include H1N1 and H3N2, and can mutate, allowing reinfection. Vaccination is advised from 6 months, with annual boosters; emphasize hand hygiene and covering coughs/sneezes, especially when children return to school in Sep–Oct.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAによりけいれん・せん妄状態となった男児
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAによる単発小児症例の報告であり、患者は回復・退院している。アウトブレイクやクラスター発生の情報はなく、公衆衛生上の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 単一症例の医療啓発記事であり、季節性インフルエンザの合併症（けいれん、脳症リスク）について一般向けに注意喚起する内容。患者は5日間の治療後に回復している。

article.articleHeadline: 俄研究員離奇死「中俄1個月前才演練鼠疫」！八炯：極度詭異
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russian researcher dies mysteriously: "China and Russia held a plague drill just one month ago"! Ba Jiong: Extremely bizarre.
article.articleSummary: In Irkutsk, Russia, 28-year-old technician Daria Shipilova of the Irkutsk-Siberia and Far East Anti-Plague Research Institute died Oct 2 from unknown pneumonia. Russian authorities say no evidence links her death to any pathogen or laboratory accident at her institute; no plague confirmed among her contacts, who are under medical surveillance and some hospitals have isolation measures. WHO reports Russia has no confirmed pneumonic plague cases in Irkutsk, and that risk is currently low. Separately, on Aug 24–27, 2026, China and Russia conducted a cross-border infectious disease emergency drill in Fuyuan, Heilongjiang, simulating imported plague response; Sergey Balakhonov, the institute’s director, attended. A social media post highlighted the coincidence; however, there is no proof of a connection. The US urges transparency; experts emphasize low immediate global risk; pneumonic plague is treatable with antibiotics if diagnosed early.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人研究員が原因不明の急死「中露は1ヶ月前にペスト対応訓練を実施していた」！八炯氏：極めて不可解
triage.triage_reason: ロシア人研究所職員が原因不明の肺炎で死亡したが、ペスト菌との関連やヒト-ヒト感染は未確認で、WHOもリスクは低いと評価している。ただしSNS上で中露合同演習との偶然の一致が話題となり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア・イルクーツク州での研究員の原因不明死であり、中国黒竜江省は過去の合同演習の文脈でのみ言及されている（実際の発生地ではない）ため、対象国リストに該当する発生国はなし。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Laporkan Kematian Pertama akibat Virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya Reports First Death Due to Ebola Virus
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) death, a Kenyan man who had lived seven years in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), the outbreak’s epicenter. He fell ill about a month earlier, was treated in the DRC, then traveled by road to Kampala, Uganda, before flying to Nairobi on Oct 3, 2026. He exhibited fever, chills, severe fatigue, weakness, muscle pain, sore throat, painful swallowing, and subcutaneous bleeding at injection sites, and was confirmed Ebola positive; he died on Oct 5, 2026. Kenya, previously Ebola-free, has identified 28 contacts for quarantine and is tracing 23 passengers plus four crew from the same flight. Burial is planned Oct 7 under health protocols. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, with no approved vaccine or treatment; WHO cites over 8,400 cases and more than 4,000 deaths since May 2026, with a surge in North Kivu, DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラウイルスによる初の死亡例を報告
triage.triage_reason: DRCを震源とする大規模エボラ流行（8,400例超、死者4,000人超）が国際便を介してウガンダ経由でケニアに波及し初の死亡例が確認されたため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はケニア・ウガンダでの感染拡大を主題としているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため、震源地であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。国際便による接触者追跡（乗客23名・乗務員4名）が進行中で、さらなる国際拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Pekerja Lab Rusia Dikabarkan Meninggal karena Pes, Ini Kata Kemenkes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russian lab workers reportedly died of the plague, according to the Ministry of Health.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 October 2026, Russian authorities have not confirmed a plague infection in a laboratory worker in Irkutsk, with the death attributed to pneumonia of unknown cause. About 200 people who had contact with the deceased were quarantined as a precaution. The patient, a woman in her late 20s who had recently visited the Buryatia region near the Mongolia border, died and authorities have not established a transmission link or sustained human-to-human spread. No confirmed plague cases have been reported in Indonesia in 2026, per the Indonesian Ministry of Health. Global attention includes U.S. officials—President Trump saying Washington is monitoring the situation and offering help; Secretary of State Marco Rubio noting concern about potential pneumonic plague spread but saying there is no reason for alarm.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの研究所職員がペストで死亡と報じられる、インドネシア保健省の見解
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの検査室職員が原因不明の肺炎（ペスト疑い）で死亡し、約200人が隔離されるなど異常性が高く、米国高官も懸念を表明するなど国際的関心が高いため、フルリスク評価に進めるべきと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア語メディアによる報道だが、インドネシア国内での感染事例ではなく、ロシア・イルクーツク/ブリヤート地方での事例。ロシア・モンゴルは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。インドネシア保健省は自国内でのペスト確定例はないと明言している。

article.articleHeadline: 俄研究員離奇死　中俄1個月前才演練鼠疫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russian researcher dies mysteriously; China and Russia had only just conducted a plague drill a month ago.
article.articleSummary: A 28-year-old technician, Daria Shipilova, at the Irkutsk Siberia and Far East Anti-Plague Research Institute, died on October 2 in Irkutsk from an unknown pneumonia. Investigations found no evidence linking her death to laboratory pathogens or a lab incident; authorities monitored contacts and some hospitals implemented isolation. Anna Popova, head of Russia's consumer rights protection agency, personally visited the site, fueling public scrutiny. More than a month earlier, from August 24–27, China’s Heilongjiang province hosted the 2026 China–Russia Cross-Border Infectious Disease Emergency Drill in Fuyuan, simulating imported pneumonic plague; the institute's director Sergey Balakhonov attended and spoke. There is no evidence of a connection between the drill and the death. WHO says no confirmed plague cases in Irkutsk and overall risk remains low; pneumonic plague is transmissible via droplets and is treatable with antibiotics if diagnosed early.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人研究員が原因不明で死亡、中露は1か月前にペスト演習を実施していた
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの抗ペスト研究所職員が原因不明の肺炎で死亡したが、WHOは確定ペスト症例なしとし、実験室由来の証拠もないため、現時点では続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 死亡事例はロシア・イルクーツクで発生し対象国リストに含まれない。中国黒龍江省は1か月前に演習を実施したのみで、実際の感染症発生は報告されていないため、verified_locationsは空とした。WHOは確定ペスト症例なしと発表しており、全体リスクは低いとされる。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS exige explicaciones a Rusia tras la muerte de una técnica en un laboratorio de peste
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO demands explanations from Russia after the death of a laboratory technician in a plague laboratory.
article.articleSummary: On 7 October 2026, the WHO demanded explanations from Russia after the death of a laboratory technician at a Siberian plague research center. There is no confirmation that pneumonic plague caused the death; Russian authorities report no positive tests among contacts and say no microorganism linked to the patient’s work was found, leaving the cause unclear. Pneumonic plague is the most aggressive form, affecting the lungs; bubonic and septicemic forms affect lymph nodes or the bloodstream. Globally, 1,000–3,000 plague cases are reported annually, mainly bubonic in Central Africa, with infections also reported in Russia, India, China, and the United States. The bacterium Yersinia pestis persists in rodent reservoirs and can spread via fleas or animal contact. Experts stress that studying dangerous pathogens aids diagnostics, vaccines, and surveillance; antibiotics are effective if given early. The United States is monitoring the case, with Trump saying it is under review and Rubio downplaying alarm.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、ロシアのペスト研究所における技師死亡を受けて説明を要求
triage.triage_reason: ロシアのペスト研究施設での技師死亡に対してWHOが説明を求め、米国も注視するなど国際的・政治的関心が高いため、情報は限定的だがフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア・シベリアのペスト研究施設での技師死亡であり、対象国リストに該当する国（インド・中国など）は世界的な発生状況の説明として言及されているのみで、記事の主題国はロシア（対象国リスト外）。そのためverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: 167 Kasus Baru HIV Ditemukan di Buleleng, Termasuk 8 Remaja
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 167 new HIV cases found in Buleleng, including 8 teenagers.
article.articleSummary: 167 new HIV cases recorded in Buleleng, Bali, Indonesia, from January through August 2026, with surveillance updated on September 8, 2026. Age distribution shows the 20–29 group leading with 58 cases, followed by 40–49 (36), 30–39 (33), 50–59 (24); teenagers 15–19 account for 8 cases, and older groups: 60+ (5), 1–4 (2), 5–14 (1). Cumulatively, new HIV cases through August 2026 remain below 2025’s total of 231. Transmission is predominantly heterosexual (126 cases, 75.4%), with MSM 20, others 16, bisexual 4, and perinatal 1; no new cases linked to injecting drug use or tattoos. Of the 167 cases, 106 are male and 61 female. As of August 2026, 1,633 people with HIV (ODHIV) are on antiretroviral therapy. Estimated total ODHIV is 2,613, with 2,029 (78%) aware of their status, in line with 95-95-95 targets.

triage.headline_ja: ブレレンで167件の新規HIV症例、10代8人を含む
triage.triage_reason: 既知の地域流行性感染症（HIV）の定期サーベイランス報告であり、前年より件数も減少しているため、国際的拡大や緊急対応の必要性は認められない。
triage.notes: HIVは既に地域内で確立された流行性感染症であり、本記事は通常の月次/年次サーベイランス報告に該当する。新規症例数は前年（231件）より少なく、異常な増加は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Quênia confirma primeiro caso de ebola; homem morreu após tratamento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya confirms first case of Ebola; man dies after treatment.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first Ebola virus disease (EVD) case, imported from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), where the patient had lived for seven years and developed symptoms about a month earlier. The Kenyan national arrived in Nairobi on Oct 3, was isolated after seeking care, and died on Oct 5 despite supportive treatment. Symptoms included fever, chills, severe fatigue, weakness, myalgia, sore throat, subcutaneous bleeding, and bleeding at venous access sites. Laboratory confirmation for Ebola was obtained at Kenya’s National Reference Virology Laboratory and at the Kenya Medical Research Institute. At least 28 contacts—family members and health workers—are being traced; 23 passengers and 4 crew from the same flight are being sought for quarantine. WHO notified under International Health Regulations; safe and dignified burial planned today. Since the Congo outbreak began in May, Kenya has screened 652,584 travelers and tested 267 samples, with this being the sole positive.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアが初のエボラ症例を確認、男性は治療後に死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行に関連し、ケニアで初の輸入症例が確認され死亡、接触者・同乗者の追跡とWHOへのIHR通知が行われており、国際的拡大・渡航制限のリスクを伴う深刻な公衆衛生事案である。
triage.notes: ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。患者はDRCで7年居住し発症、同国で継続中のエボラ流行（5月開始）からの輸出例であるためDRCを発生国として記載。ケニア国内での感染拡大の有無は続報待ち。

article.articleHeadline: China Breaks Silence on Plague, Says It's in Contact With Russia | Today News
article.articleSummary: Suspected pneumonic plague case in Siberia’s Irkutsk region, Russia, with a 28-year-old laboratory worker dying after developing severe pneumonia; unconfirmed local reports say exposure may have occurred when a test tube broke. Nearly 200 contacts are being observed as health authorities monitor potential spread. The case remains unconfirmed as plague; Beijing says China and Russia are in close communication and cooperation on infectious diseases, including the plague, with remarks from Foreign Ministry spokesman Guo Jiakun on Tuesday. The Irkutsk region lies north of Mongolia and does not border China, though its capital is a major transport hub linked to Chinese cities, underscoring cross-border surveillance. The incident follows an emergency response exercise between Russia and China on outbreak handling. Plague is rare today and can usually be treated with antibiotics; no laboratory confirmation reported in the article.

triage.headline_ja: 中国がペストについて沈黙を破り、ロシアと連絡を取り合っていると発表
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州で肺ペスト疑い例による死亡が確認され、約200人の接触者が監視下にあることから、公衆衛生上の深刻性・異常性・越境拡大リスクのIHR基準複数が該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストに含まれない。中国は外交的な協力表明のみで、実際の症例発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。確定診断（検査室確認）はまだ報告されていない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تسجل أول وفاة بفيروس "إيبولا" على أراضيها | القاهرة الاخبارية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records its first Ebola virus death within its borders | Cairo News
article.articleSummary: A Kenyan citizen who had resided in the Democratic Republic of Congo returned to Nairobi last Saturday and subsequently died on Monday, marking Kenya's first Ebola virus disease death within its borders. He presented with high fever and extensive bleeding under the skin; health authorities note that prior medication may have masked early symptoms. Authorities are tracing about 28 contacts, including family members and healthcare workers, for monitoring and preventive measures. The case follows an ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, raising cross-border transmission concerns given regional travel; Kenya is the third country to report a case linked to the Congo outbreak. Ebola is a highly contagious viral illness transmitted through contact with blood or bodily fluids, with early symptoms of fever, fatigue, muscle pain, and headache that can progress to bleeding and life-threatening complications.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで初のエボラウイルス感染による死亡例を記録
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で続くエボラアウトブレイクに関連し、ケニアで初の死亡例が発生、国境を越えた感染拡大の懸念があるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニアでの死亡例はDRCでの既存アウトブレイクからの輸入症例であり、根本的な発生国はDRCであるためDRCのみを対象国として記載。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Mongolia to launch first homegrown FMD vaccine doses in November
article.articleSummary: Mongolia will roll out the first homegrown foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) vaccine doses in November 2026, after field trials planned for October 2026. Minister of Food, Agriculture and Light Industry Iderbat Tsagaankhuu instructed Biocombinat to accelerate production, boost efficiency, and expand domestic vaccine manufacturing. Between 2021 and 2025, Mongolia spent over 70 billion tugriks importing vaccines for major livestock diseases, including FMD, peste des petits ruminants, and lumpy skin disease. To strengthen self-sufficiency, Biocombinat is localizing production technologies and establishing facilities for blending and packaging FMD vaccines. Collaborations with leading laboratories in Russia and China aim to deliver the first batch in November following October field trials. Emphasis on timely production and strict quality standards aligned with market demand. Biocombinat, founded in 1923, upgraded in 1973 with Hungarian assistance, became state-owned in 2020, employs 198, produces 46 veterinary/diagnostic products, with annual capacity of 135,000 liters of liquid vaccines and 31 million doses of freeze-dried vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: モンゴル、11月に国産口蹄疫ワクチンを初導入へ
triage.triage_reason: 動物の家畜疾病に関するワクチン自給体制強化のニュースであり、ヒトへの公衆衛生影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。対象国（中国等）も記事の主題ではなくモンゴルの家畜ワクチン生産体制の話であるため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 記事は動物疾病（口蹄疫等）に対するモンゴルのワクチン国産化政策に関する内容であり、ヒトの感染症イベントではない。発生地域に中国・ロシア・ハンガリーが含まれるが、いずれも技術協力先として言及されているのみで、実際の疾病発生国はモンゴル（対象国リスト外）。

article.articleHeadline: Entenda como São Paulo monitora a situação epidemiológica do sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Understand how São Paulo monitors the epidemiological situation of measles.
article.articleSummary: Measles transmission chains identified in São Paulo state since June are under active monitoring, with vaccination actions maintained and local chains partially interrupted. First-dose coverage rose from 86.56% in April to 93.24% in July; second-dose from 72.72% to 78.37%. Of 41 confirmed measles cases in 2026, 37 are in the capital, two in São Bernardo do Campo, one in Guarulhos, and one in Santo André; none have died. Chains are tracked by epidemiological and laboratory criteria to guide active case finding, contact tracing, and vaccination. In Guarulhos and São Bernardo do Campo, authorities assess whether transmission has ceased. A chain is considered closed after 12 weeks without new related cases from the onset of exanthema. The first chain (March–April) linked to two imported cases has closed; others (June–August) remain under monitoring. Laboratory confirmation involves IAL; Fiocruz conducts viral sequencing.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州における麻疹の疫学的状況の監視方法について
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の伝播チェーンがサンパウロ州で継続監視されているが、死亡例はなく、ワクチン接種率も改善傾向にあり、既に管理下にあるため緊急性は低いが、ブラジルの麻疹排除状況への影響として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルは過去に麻疹排除認定を受けており、今回の伝播チェーン（3月〜8月）は輸入例に起因するが、死亡例なく、ワクチン接種率上昇や接触者追跡により一部チェーンは既に終息。現時点では新たな緊急シグナルというより、排除状況維持のための継続監視対象と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya records first Ebola case and death
article.articleSummary: Ebola confirmed in Kenya: Kenya records its first official Ebola case and the first Ebola-related death. The patient is a Kenyan citizen who had been living in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and contracted the virus there before road travel to Kampala, Uganda, and a flight to Nairobi. After arrival, the patient’s condition deteriorated with high fever, severe weakness and subcutaneous bleeding, leading to immediate isolation; the patient died in hospital despite medical care. Kenya’s Ministry of Health identified more than 50 contacts—family members, healthcare workers and fellow passengers on the same flight—and placed them under mandatory 21-day quarantine. Laboratory confirmation prompted swift public health actions. The infection source is linked to exposure in the DRC, representing an imported Ebola case into Kenya, with ongoing tracing and monitoring to prevent further spread within Kenya and the region.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで初のエボラ出血熱症例および死亡例を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの感染に起因するエボラ出血熱の輸入症例がケニアで確認され死亡者が発生、複数国にまたがる接触者追跡が行われており、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCでエボラウイルスに感染し、ウガンダ経由でケニアに渡航後発症・死亡。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外し、感染源国であるDRCのみを検証済み発生地域とした。DRC国内での進行中のアウトブレイク状況については記事に具体的記載がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: 又爆食物中毒？延平中學傳21生午餐後上吐下瀉　蔣萬安回應曝光
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another food poisoning outbreak? Yanping High School reports 21 students vomiting and diarrhea after lunch; Chiang Wan-an responds.
article.articleSummary: Taipei's Yanping Middle School reported 21 students with vomiting and diarrhea after lunch, with some hospitalized. The Taipei City Education Bureau promptly visited the school, and the Health Bureau will send lunch samples for laboratory testing; the exact cause remains unconfirmed and could be food poisoning or norovirus. Investigators are examining whether the midday meal, including seafood ingredients, contributed to illness. The school has notified the Health Bureau. Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an, speaking after visiting a Kunming anti-drug center, acknowledged the suspected case and said authorities will continue testing to confirm the diagnosis. No final determination has been made as of 2026-10-07.

triage.headline_ja: また食中毒発生か？延平中学で21人の生徒が昼食後に嘔吐・下痢、蔣萬安市長が対応を表明
triage.triage_reason: 台湾の一学校における限定的な食中毒疑い事案であり、原因未確定・小規模で国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。対象国（台湾は対象外）にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 発生地域に中国（雲南省）が含まれているが、記事は台北市の学校での食中毒疑い事案であり、雲南省は市長の別件訪問先として言及されているのみ。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تسجل أول وفاة بإيبولا وسط تحركات عاجلة لاحتواء تفشي المرض - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records first Ebola death amid urgent efforts to contain the outbreak - Shorouk Gate
article.articleSummary: Kenya records its first Ebola case and first death in the current outbreak, involving a Kenyan man who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo for seven years and returned to Nairobi over the weekend. He contracted Ebola about a month earlier in Congo, sought treatment at several hospitals, then traveled by road to Kampala, Uganda, and flew to Nairobi, arriving Saturday afternoon. He was isolated and treated at a Nairobi hospital, where laboratory tests confirmed Ebola; he died late Monday. Kenyan authorities raised border-crossing surveillance and are tracing contacts to contain potential transmission. Ebola is highly contagious and spreads through contact with body fluids and contaminated surfaces. The outbreak was declared in mid-May in eastern Congo, with about 8,400 cases and over 4,000 deaths, making it the fastest-growing Ebola epidemic in history.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで初のエボラ死亡例、感染拡大阻止へ緊急対応
triage.triage_reason: DRC発の大規模エボラ流行（8,400症例超、4,000人超死亡）がウガンダ経由でケニアに越境し初の死亡例を記録。国際的拡大・渡航制限の懸念が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの輸入症例による初死亡だが、エボラ流行の発生源はDRC東部であり史上最速拡大の流行とされる。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Hybrid Forecasting Model Sharpens Predictions of Seasonal Influenza Waves
article.articleSummary: Hybrid forecasting model applied to influenza A and B in Jiande, Zhejiang, China. Six years of hospital-based, laboratory-confirmed counts (January 2019–December 2024) from the Jiande Branch of the Second Affiliated Hospital of Zhejiang University School of Medicine are used, reflecting care-seeking individuals rather than broader community incidence. The data exhibit winter–spring peaks. The study builds a hybrid SARIMA-LSTM framework: SARIMA(1,0,1)(2,1,1) for influenza A and SARIMA(3,0,0)(2,1,1) for influenza B, with a seasonal period of four. The LSTM learns nonlinear residuals after SARIMA, and the two components are recombined to produce refined forecasts. Implemented in MATLAB R2024a, with core code shared for reproducibility. Validation used 2024 data as out-of-sample test to assess forecast improvements.

triage.headline_ja: ハイブリッド予測モデルが中国における季節性インフルエンザ流行の予測精度を向上
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は季節性インフルエンザの予測モデルに関する学術研究であり、新規の異常な感染症イベントや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は季節性インフルエンザの統計的予測モデル（SARIMA-LSTM）に関する研究報告であり、実際の流行発生や異常事態の報告ではないため、対象国として計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Como é transmitida a peste pneumônica, grave infecção pulmonar associada à morte de uma cientista na Rússia?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How is pneumonic plague transmitted, a severe pulmonary infection associated with the death of a female scientist in Russia?
article.articleSummary: As of 7 October 2026, 28-year-old Daria Shipilova’s death at the Irkutsk Institute of Plague Research in Siberia triggered quarantine for about 200 people. She died of pneumonia of unknown origin; investigations consider pneumonic plague caused by Yersinia pestis. Russian authorities say the link to work is unlikely, while international bodies monitor. The U.S. State Department, CDC, WHO, and ECDC are in touch with Russian health authorities; WHO notes the public-health risk appears low. Pneumonic plague is highly contagious via respiratory droplets and is a zoonosis involving small mammals and fleas. Humans can be infected by flea bites, contact with infected fluids or contaminated materials, or inhalation; symptoms begin 1–4 days after exposure. Europe has had no pneumonic plague cases in over 50 years, while sporadic outbreaks occur in Africa (e.g., DRC, Madagascar).

article.articleSummary: Kenya has recorded its first confirmed imported Ebola infection and its first Ebola-related death, linked to a Kenyan citizen who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo to Nairobi. The patient’s death marks the first Ebola fatality in Kenya. Health authorities immediately launched urgent contact tracing and elevated the alert level at border crossings to curb potential spread as part of containment efforts. The development highlights the risk of cross-border transmission from the Democratic Republic of Congo and underscores the need for heightened surveillance at entry points. The report, published 7 October 2026, indicates that the outbreak is prompting rapid public health actions within Kenya, with authorities focusing on identifying contacts and preventing further cases while monitoring for new infections.

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo's Ebola Response Costs Jump Fivefold to $1.3 Billion, France Pledges More Support
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola response costs have escalated to $1.3 billion over 180 days, fivefold the initial $240 million plan. The outbreak remains active in seven provinces, with 8,067 cases and 3,901 deaths reported through September 28 (CFR 48.4%). Ituri is the hardest hit; North Kivu reported 567 cases in the 21 days to September 23; 63 health zones are affected. The Bundibugyo strain complicates control, as no vaccine or treatment is approved; vaccines are in clinical trials with ongoing supply constraints. Security conditions in eastern DRC hinder response operations. The revised multisectoral plan funds surveillance, contact tracing, patient care, logistics, and outreach, with external partners bearing most costs. Total commitments exceed $2 billion, including $267 million from the United States (to $887 million directly) and contributions from the World Bank, UK, Germany, South Korea, Italy, UAE, Japan, and Australia; France allocated €13.4 million Jan–Jul and plans additional humanitarian funding. Uganda remains at risk with cross-border transmission concerns.

article.articleSummary: On 2 October in Irkutsk Oblast, Russia, a 28-year-old female laboratory technician died of severe pneumonia. Russia reports no laboratory pathogen leakage; Rospotrebnadzor confirms no job-related microbe detected. WHO says public health risk to the general population is low. About 4 close contacts were hospitalized and tested; two had COVID-19, two had rhinovirus; no other pathogens detected; community respiratory illnesses remain within seasonal norms. Taiwan's CDC is monitoring the case via IHR and has queried Russia and WHO; authorities also tightened fever screening at airports and seaports. Global plague data (2019–2025) show 3860 suspected cases, 2646 confirmed, and 423 deaths, with about 98% of confirmed in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Madagascar; China and Mongolia reported 19 and 17 confirmed cases. Taiwan stresses that plague is a Class I infectious disease requiring rapid notification, isolation, and antibiotic treatment, with reinforced emergency plans and cross-hospital pathogen centers.

article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) has reached Kenya with the first confirmed infection and death in Nairobi. A Kenyan citizen who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo for about seven years became ill about a month ago, was treated in Congo, then traveled by road to Kampala, Uganda, before flying to Nairobi. He arrived Saturday, was hospitalized, isolated, and tested positive for Ebola; he died late Monday. Kenyan health authorities raised border screening and initiated extensive contact tracing to curb potential spread. Ebola transmits through direct contact with bodily fluids and contaminated surfaces. The Congo outbreak began in mid-May, with more than 8,400 cases and over 4,000 deaths. This case is an imported infection into Kenya, with ongoing surveillance of contacts and potential additional cases across border points.

article.articleHeadline: Kenya confirms first case of ebola as patient dies
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first Ebola case linked to the Congo outbreak after a Kenyan citizen who had lived in Congo for seven years died in Nairobi. The Congo epidemic, driven by the Bundibugyo strain and the second largest on record with more than 8,000 cases and over 4,000 deaths, has seen Kenya become the fourth country with a linked case. The patient, ill for about a month, traveled by road from Congo to Kampala and then flew to Nairobi, where he arrived with fever, chills and bleeding beneath the skin, was isolated, and died late Monday. Eight family members and 21 healthcare workers who treated him were quarantined; authorities are tracing 23 passengers and four crew on his Jambojet flight. Kenya has trained nearly 5,000 health workers; Africa CDC is deploying a high-level team; WHO supports and advises against travel restrictions. Earlier, Uganda reported 20 cases and two deaths and was declared Ebola-free in August; a doctor who returned to France tested positive but there was no further spread.

article.articleHeadline: Apa Itu Pes Pneumonik yang Bikin Geger Rusia? Bagaimana Penyebarannya?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What Is the Pneumonic Plague That Has Russia Buzzing? How Does It Spread?
article.articleSummary: WHO has asked Russia for more information after the death of a laboratory worker in Irkutsk, Siberia, linked to pneumonic plague research. The cause of illness is not yet confirmed, and contacts tested negative for pneumonic plague. Pneumonic plague is the most severe form of plague, though less common than bubonic or septicemic forms, and it can develop after infection with the others. Symptoms include shortness of breath, chest pain, and coughing up blood. Globally, plague causes about 1,000–3,000 cases annually, predominantly bubonic in Central Africa; cases also occur in Russia, India, China, and the United States. The bacterium Yersinia pestis persists in animal reservoirs; transmission via infected fleas or contact with animals, and human-to-human spread through respiratory droplets is possible. Incubation can be as short as 24 hours; early antibiotic treatment is effective, and post-exposure prophylaxis may be used. In Russia, a pneumonic plague diagnosis has not been confirmed.

article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms the first Ebola virus disease case in the country, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The patient, a Kenyan citizen who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo, sought care at several facilities there and then flew to Nairobi. Upon arrival he was immediately isolated at a Nairobi hospital, and laboratory testing confirmed Bundibugyo ebolavirus. He died in the night of October 5. Kenyan authorities have identified 28 contacts, including relatives and healthcare workers, and are seeking 23 passengers and four crew members from the flight he took. Kenya is the fourth country to confirm an Ebola case. The Democratic Republic of Congo continues to face an ongoing outbreak; cases have also been reported in Uganda and France, with Uganda's infections largely linked to travel to Congo. Since May, Kenya has maintained heightened readiness and trained about 5,000 health workers in Ebola prevention and care.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Kenyans urged to stop public gatherings, handshakes and hugs
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first imported case of Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease. The patient traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo to Uganda by road, then flew to Nairobi on Jambojet flight 8523, arriving at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport on October 3, 2026 around 1:00 pm. The case was laboratory-confirmed and announced on October 6, 2026, placing Kenya in the response phase. The patient was immediately isolated at Nairobi Hospital, initially in the Accident and Emergency area and then in the East Wing isolation facility. Health authorities have intensified surveillance to trace movements and identify contacts. Health officials urged reduced physical contact to limit transmission, recommending non-contact greetings such as waving and advising avoidance of large gatherings, including political and family events, as investigations continue.
