article.articleSummary: China says it maintains close exchanges and cooperation with Russia on the possible outbreak of pneumonic plague in Siberia. Spokesperson Guo Jiakun noted ongoing cross-border collaboration in disease prevention and control, including plague. A 28-year-old employee at Irkutsk's Institute of Plague Research and the Far East died in a hospital in Shélejov; authorities are examining whether infection was pneumonic plague caused by Yersinia pestis contracted in Thailand, or the result of an accidental laboratory incident involving a pathogen tube. The United States issued a health alert about a possible pneumonic plague outbreak in the region; Russian outlet Liudi Baikala reports quarantines at several Irkutsk hospitals. President Trump plans to discuss the outbreak with Putin; the ECDC is monitoring, and the WHO says Europe’s regional risk is very low. The situation remains under investigation and unconfirmed as of 2026-10-07.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、ロシアとの間でペストの可能な発生について『緊密な交流』を維持していると表明
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクでペスト研究所職員が肺ペストの疑いで死亡し、病院での隔離措置や米国の健康警報、米露首脳間での協議が報じられるなど、国際的関心と拡大リスクが高いためフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 主たる発生地はロシア（イルクーツク）であり対象国リストには含まれないため除外。タイは感染源として調査対象に挙がっているが確定情報ではないため、参考情報として含めた。中国は外交的言及のみで発生国ではないため除外。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Cúm A tăng nhanh, các tỉnh phía Bắc có nguy cơ bước vào đợt gia tăng mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A is rising rapidly; the northern provinces are at risk of entering a new wave.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A is rising rapidly in northern Vietnam, with Hanoi and surrounding provinces at risk of a new wave. Data from the National Pediatric Hospital (Bệnh viện Nhi Trung ương) show pediatric influenza A positives climbing from 106 cases in week 35 to 779 in week 40 of 2026, with admissions increasing from 18 to 124 over the same period. The five-week surge indicates an accelerating trend, though hospital-based data do not reflect community-wide incidence. As a leading tertiary pediatric center, the hospital’s rising numbers serve as an early warning for Hanoi and northern provinces amid autumnal weather shifts that favor respiratory transmission. In 2025, peak weeks 40–47 exceeded 2,400 cases/week; 2026’s week-40 level approaches 800 and may continue rising. WHO regional surveillance (West Pacific) reports predominance of influenza A(H3), with A(H1N1) and B also detected; drivers include antigenic drift, immunity gaps, and relatively low uptake of seasonal influenza vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAが急増、北部各省で新たな流行波のリスク
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA(H3)の小児症例増加を報告しているが、例年の季節的変動の範囲内であり、現時点で深刻な公衆衛生インパクトや国際的拡大の兆候は確認されない。続報の推移を注視する。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の秋季増加パターンに類似しており、2025年のピーク（週40-47で2400件超/週）と比較すると2026年の週40時点（約800件）はまだ低水準。病院ベースのデータであり地域全体の罹患率を反映していない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya records first confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola case as patient dies in Nairobi
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first Bundibugyo Ebola case on Oct 6, 2026, in a Kenyan citizen who had lived in DRC and died at Nairobi Hospital. Illness began about a month earlier; he traveled by road via Uganda and boarded JamboJet 8523 to Nairobi on Oct 3, was screened at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport and placed in isolation. Lab analyses at the National Virology Reference Laboratory and KEMRI confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola, a rare Orthoebolavirus previously seen in Uganda and DRC. The patient died Monday night; this was the region’s only positive test among 652,000 travelers screened. 28 close contacts have been identified, with 23 passengers and four crew from the same flight under monitoring. Bundibugyo Ebola is thought to reside in fruit bats; no vaccine or specific treatment exists; control relies on rapid detection, isolation, contact tracing, infection prevention, and safe burials. Public guidance emphasizes hand hygiene and avoiding casual contact.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、ナイロビで患者死亡し初のブンディブギョ型エボラ確定症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: ケニア初の確定エボラ症例（国際便搭乗者、死亡例）であり、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限の可能性があるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 患者はDRC在住歴がありウガンダ経由でケニアに入国したが、記事の主題はケニア国内での初確定例であり発症地が明確にDRCとは特定されていないため、対象国リストへの該当地域はなしと判断した。国際便乗客・乗員の接触者監視が進行中であり、続報（接触者の発症有無、感染源特定）に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ผวา 'พิษสุนัขบ้า' ประกาศกักพื้นที่บ้านทับทิมสยาม03 ห้ามย้ายสุนัขเด็ดขาด ฝ่าฝืนคุก 2 ปี
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies panic: Tubtim Siam 03 housing estate declares area lockdown; no dogs may be moved; violators face two years in prison.
article.articleSummary: Rabies outbreak declared in Ban Thap Tim Siam 03, Moo 9, Tambon Thap Thai, Tha Phraya District, Sa Kaeo Province, Thailand, after dogs in the area were observed sick and dying from rabies. The Tha Phraya District Livestock Office issued a temporary rabies outbreak zone covering Ban Thap Tim Siam 03, Moo 9, with borders to the north/east adjacent to Ta Phraya National Park, to the south with Moo 1–3 of Tambon Thap Thai, and to the west with Moo 1–3 and 13 of Tambon Tap Ratch. Movement of dogs or dog carcasses into, out of, or within the zone is prohibited without written permission from the district veterinarian. The order is in effect from 6 October 2569 to 5 November 2569 (2026). Penalties under the Rabies in Animals Act B.E. 2558 include up to 2 years’ imprisonment or fines up to 40,000 baht for violations.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病パニック：タプティムサイアム03住宅地で地域封鎖を宣言、犬の移動を一切禁止、違反者は懲役2年
triage.triage_reason: タイ・サケオ県の特定住宅地で犬における狂犬病発生が確認され、地域限定の移動制限措置が取られているが、人への感染報告はなく、地方当局により管理されている事例であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。
triage.notes: 動物（犬）における狂犬病の発生であり、人への感染事例は報告されていない。地方の家畜局が地域封鎖措置を実施し、既に管理下にある事案。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Red Cross warns Kenyans against claiming Ebola case is fictitious
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms an Ebola case first reported at Nairobi Hospital and warns social-media claims that the disease is fictitious threaten outbreak containment. The case has been tested in two laboratories that meet international standards—Cambridge Labs and the National Reference Lab—bolstering its credibility. Kenya Red Cross Secretary General Ahmed Idris urged Kenyans to take the situation seriously and cooperate with health authorities to break transmission. He linked denial of the disease to difficulties controlling outbreaks, citing Congo and Uganda where communities have resisted cooperating, complicating control efforts. The Congolese Red Cross reports 11–12 workers been attacked, with a Ugandan Red Cross ambulance driver killed recently, underscoring risks to first responders. The appeal emphasizes responsible social-media use and protection for healthcare workers as the Nairobi case is managed.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア赤十字社、エボラ症例を『フェイク』と主張する動きに警鐘
triage.triage_reason: ナイロビでエボラ症例が確認され、国際標準検査機関2か所で陽性が裏付けられており、さらにコンゴ・ウガンダでの地域社会の抵抗による対応困難も指摘されているため、国際的拡大・公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が懸念される。
triage.notes: 主要な報道事象はケニア（ナイロビ）での確定症例だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事中でコンゴの既存アウトブレイク（地域社会の協力拒否や医療従事者への攻撃）が言及されており、実際の発生国として扱いDRCのみを計上。ウガンダも言及があるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Health Ministry Reveals How Ebola Patient May Have Passed JKIA Screening Undetected
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first imported Ebola case, lab-confirmed Bundibugyo ebolavirus in a Kenyan national returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo via Uganda. The patient passed JKIA screening, masking symptoms with medications, then was transported by relatives to Nairobi Hospital. He arrived severely ill with fever, chills, fatigue, muscle pain, painful swallowing, sore throat and bleeding under the skin at an injection site. Tests at the hospital confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola virus; he died around 11:30 PM on Monday in the East Wing isolation unit. Kenya activated isolation protocols across public and private facilities. Contacts will be quarantined for up to 21 days—the Ebola incubation period—with testing at 21 days; any developing symptoms will be treated as an active case in an Ebola Treatment Unit. Public guidance emphasizes hygiene and ongoing surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、エコバ患者がJKIAの検疫をどうくぐり抜けたか症状を隠していた経緯を明らかに
triage.triage_reason: ケニア初の輸入エボラ症例（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス）で患者が空港検疫をすり抜け死亡しており、国際的拡大リスクと重症度が高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴ民主共和国からウガンダ経由でケニアに入国し、ナイロビの病院で死亡が確認された。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源と考えられるDRCを発生地域として記載。接触者は21日間の隔離・経過観察の対象となっており、続報（他国への拡大、接触者の発症状況）の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya reports first-ever Ebola death
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first-ever Ebola virus disease (EVD) death linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) outbreak in May, driven by the Bundibugyo strain in Ituri province’s Bunia. The 17th DRC Ebola outbreak has a history of severe mortality in Africa, with the disease having killed more than 15,000 people there over 50 years. The patient was a Kenyan man, about 40, who had been living in the DRC; he fell ill about a month ago and died after returning to Kenya. He traveled overland to Kampala, Uganda, and then flew to Nairobi on Oct 3. Kenya’s health minister announced the death on Oct 7. Africa CDC will dispatch a team to Kenya, with its director-general Jean Kaseya visiting in the coming days. Uganda previously reported 20 cases and two deaths before being declared Ebola-free in August. The case marks Kenya’s imported exposure to the ongoing DRC outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、史上初のエボラ死亡例を報告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで続くエボラ流行由来の患者がウガンダ経由でケニアに渡航し死亡した初の越境事例であり、国際的拡大と公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められるため。
triage.notes: 患者はDRC在住のケニア人男性で、発症後ウガンダ・カンパラ経由で10月3日にナイロビへ到着し死亡。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外したが、感染源であるDRCの進行中アウトブレイクが事件の本質的背景であるため含めた。Africa CDCが対応チームを派遣予定。

article.articleHeadline: China dice que mantiene "estrechos intercambios" con Rusia sobre el posible brote de peste
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China says it is maintaining close exchanges with Russia on the possible plague outbreak.
article.articleSummary: China says it is maintaining close exchanges with Russia on the possible plague outbreak. A 28-year-old female employee of the Institute of Plague Research in Irkutsk and the Far East died in a hospital in Shelejov, a satellite city of the regional capital, during the night of Oct 1–2. Two scenarios are under study: infection with pneumonic plague (Yersinia pestis) contracted in Thailand after a recent return, or an accidental lab incident involving a pathogen tube at her workplace. The United States issued a warning about a possible pneumonic plague outbreak in the Siberian region, and the independent Russian channel Liudi Baikala reports that several Irkutsk hospitals have been quarantined. U.S. President Trump said a call with Putin was planned soon and that Washington could report on the talks by Wednesday. The ECDC is monitoring; WHO regards the risk to Europe as very low.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、ロシアとペスト感染の可能性について『緊密な交流』を維持していると発表
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクで肺ペストの疑いによる死亡例が発生し、病院の検疫や米露首脳間のやり取り、ECDCの監視など国際的関心・対応が急速に高まっているため。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア・イルクーツク州（対象国リスト外）。タイでの感染経路は仮説段階であり、タイでの実発生は確認されていない。中国は情報共有・監視の立場であり発生国ではないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya cases on the rise in Thiruvananthapuram
article.articleSummary: Nine chikungunya cases reported in Thiruvananthapuram in the first five days of October 2026, with 70 cases in September and 66 in August. Hotspots are Vattiyoorkaavu, Rajaji Nagar, Nanthancode, Thrikkanapuram, and Nemom. Chikungunya is transmitted by daytime-biting Aedes aegypti mosquitoes and tends to rise during monsoon/post-monsoon seasons in cyclical patterns, first outbreak in 2006. Most patients recover in a few days, but joint pain can persist for months or years; mortality is low. Health authorities will intensify preventive measures and have formed district-collector led coordination committees to bolster local control of dengue and chikungunya. Emphasis remains on eliminating stagnant water to curb mosquito breeding.

triage.headline_ja: ティルヴァナンタプラムでチクングニア熱の症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の流行で死亡率も低く、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、継続的な症例増加と媒介蚊対策の必要性からモニタリングを継続する。
triage.notes: 毎年繰り返される季節性流行であり、地方自治体レベルで対応中。重症例・死亡例の報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Why govt has not released details of Kenya's first Ebola patient
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first imported Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease case, a Kenyan citizen who travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo via Uganda and died on October 5, 2026, at Nairobi Hospital after initial isolation. Public Health Director-General Dr. Patrick Amoth said details, including the patient's identity, will not be released without the immediate family's consent, citing privacy. Authorities identified 28 contacts—family members and healthcare workers—and are tracing 23 passengers and four crew from Jambojet flight 8523 that carried the patient from Kampala to Nairobi on October 3, landing at JKIA around 1 pm. Contacts will be monitored for 21 days, with testing for those showing symptoms. Screening at entry may be imperfect if medications suppress fever; Nairobi health officials are tightening surveillance, contact tracing, and containment to prevent further transmission of the imported case.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア初のエボラ患者の詳細を政府が公表しない理由
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで初の輸入エボラ（ブンディブギョ型）症例が確認され、患者が死亡。国際便搭乗者を含む濃厚接触者の追跡が進行中で、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCから発症しウガンダ経由でケニアに入国・死亡した輸入症例。発生地域リストにDRC・ウガンダ・ケニアが含まれるが、対象国リストにはDRC(203312)のみ該当する。ただし記事の主題はケニアでの輸入症例確認であり、DRC国内でのアウトブレイク発生を報じるものではないため、DRCはverified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 俄罗斯传鼠疫案例 中方：中俄就传染病防控保持密切合作
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia reports a plague case; China says Sino-Russian cooperation on infectious disease prevention and control remains close.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 October 2026, a female employee at the Siberia and Far East Anti-Plague Research Institute in Irkutsk Oblast, Russia, died after a suspected pneumonic plague infection linked to bacteria from a ruptured culture vial. About 200 contacts were quarantined; authorities said none contracted plague or other illness. Irkutsk Governor Igor Kobzev said the woman died of pneumonia of unknown cause, and no new infections were reported among institute staff days later. China said Sino-Russian cooperation on infectious disease prevention and control remains close. The incident follows a cross-border infectious disease emergency drill in China (Aug 24–27) in Fuyuan, Heilongjiang, attended by Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute Director Sergey Balakhonov. Irkutsk is north of Mongolia and a major transport hub with frequent links to Chinese cities. Pneumonic plague spreads via respiratory routes and can be fatal within 1–6 days if untreated; antibiotics are effective when detected early.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでペスト感染例、中国は中露の感染症予防対策協力は緊密であると発表
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの研究施設で肺ペストとみられる感染による死亡例が発生し、致死性の高い病原体かつ異常事態であるため、IHR基準を複数満たす。国境を越えた交通の要衝であることも拡大リスクとして言及されている。
triage.notes: 本事例はロシア・イルクーツク州の抗ペスト研究所内での実験室関連感染とみられ、接触者約200名は隔離され新規感染なしと報告されている。中国は本件に関して外交的コメントを発表したのみで、国内での発生は確認されていないため、対象国リストにおける verified_locations は該当なし（ロシア・モンゴルは対象国リスト外）。

article.articleHeadline: 肯亞首度確認伊波拉病例　患者自剛果返國後於奈洛比病逝
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya confirms its first Ebola case; patient dies in Nairobi after returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first Ebola virus disease case on Oct 6, 2026, in a Kenyan man who had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo for seven years and returned from DRC via Uganda, arriving in Nairobi on Oct 3. He developed fever, chills, fatigue, muscle pain, swallowing pain, and subcutaneous bleeding; Bundibugyo ebolavirus was laboratory-confirmed. The patient died in a Nairobi hospital on Oct 5. Twenty-eight contacts, including family members and healthcare workers, are in isolation, and authorities are tracing 23 passengers and 4 crew from the same flight, with a 21-day quarantine. Kenya has elevated alert and strengthened surveillance at airports and borders, with support from WHO and Africa CDC. The DRC outbreak has exceeded 8,300 cases and 4,000 deaths; Uganda reported 20 cases and 2 deaths but has declared the outbreak over. WHO warns the outbreak is not over; no travel or trade restrictions are advised.

triage.headline_ja: 肯亜（ケニア）で初のエボラ症例確認　患者はコンゴ民主共和国から帰国後ナイロビで死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中の大規模エボラ流行（8,300例超、4,000人超死亡）からケニアへの国際的な感染拡大が初めて確認され、空港・国境での警戒強化や接触者隔離など公衆衛生対応が必要とされているため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの輸入例（ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外）。ただし感染源であるDRCの大規模流行が記事の中心的背景として詳述されているため、DRCを verified_locations に含めた。WHOは流行終息を否定し、渡航・貿易制限は現時点で推奨されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Deretan Gejala yang Dialami Pelanggan Dugaan Keracunan di 88 Seoul Bandung, Diare hingga Demam Tinggi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Range of Symptoms Experienced by Customers Suspected of Poisoning at 88 Seoul Bandung, from Diarrhea to High Fever
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 7, 2026, Bandung, Indonesia, reports point to suspected food poisoning at 88 Seoul, a Korean restaurant at 23 Paskal Bandung, linked to meals on Oct 2–3, 2026. Posts describe diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, high fever and chills; a pregnant woman in her first trimester reports diarrhea with nausea and vomiting, and her husband required medical care for fever above 39°C with IV fluids. Other customers report repeated diarrhea and fever; one account notes fever and up to 15 diarrhea episodes after dining on Oct 3. Families, including children, are affected. Although chatter suggests hundreds could be affected, there is no laboratory confirmation or official case count, and no confirmed infection source or outbreak details.

triage.headline_ja: 88ソウル・バンドンでの食中毒疑いの客が経験した症状の数々、下痢から高熱まで
triage.triage_reason: 単一レストランに関連した食中毒疑いで複数人が症状を呈しているが、検査確定や公式な症例数が無く、情報不足のため続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 食中毒疑いで感染症ではない可能性が高い。検査結果や公式発表待ちの状態。

article.articleHeadline: Una supuesta peste rusa pone en alerta al mundo tras un contagio en uno de los países más opacos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An alleged Russian plague puts the world on alert after an infection in one of the world's most opaque countries.
article.articleSummary: An alleged Russian plague outbreak in Irkutsk, Siberia, following infection in a laboratory researcher (Darya Shipilova, 28) prompted confinement of about 200 people and partial cordoning of Shelekhov hospital where she died. Initially reported as pneumonic plague, officials deny any plague cases and describe the death as pneumonia of unknown origin; no high-risk pathogens found among contacts. The World Health Organization has asked Russia for details; based on available unofficial information, public health risk to the general population seems low. Interfax cited two COVID-19 and two rhinovirus positives among close contacts. Rospotrebnadzor also stated pneumonia of unknown origin and denied a lockdown. The debate centers on possible pneumonic plague, the most virulent form, which requires rapid antibiotics; other forms include bubonic and septicemic. EU and US monitor; Europe reports few travel-linked cases historically, with DRC and Madagascar accounting for most recent global cases; data gaps persist.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア発のペストとされる疑いが世界に警戒を促す、不透明な国の一つでの感染を受けて
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストの疑いで研究者が死亡し約200人が隔離されるなど異常事態が発生、WHOがロシアに詳細を照会しており国際的関心が高いため、フルリスク評価に進めるべきシグナルと判断した。
triage.notes: 事象の発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。DRC・マダガスカルは過去の世界的ペスト症例の文脈で言及されているのみで、本イベントの発生地ではない。ロシア当局はペスト症例を否定し『原因不明の肺炎』としており、確定情報が不足しているため一部項目は不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: 不只俄国肺鼠疫！伊波拉传出跨国扩散　极罕病种无药可医惹关注
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Not just Russia's pneumonic plague! Ebola spreads across borders; extremely rare diseases with no cure have drawn attention.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugy o ebolavirus spreads beyond the Democratic Republic of Congo as a Kenyan resident, who had lived in DRC for seven years, dies in Nairobi after returning home. He developed fever, difficulty swallowing, muscle pains, and subcutaneous bleeding; died; 28 close contacts, including relatives and health workers, are quarantined. The Congo outbreak has surpassed 8,000 confirmed cases and more than 4,000 deaths this year, making it the second-largest on record. Bundibugyo ebolavirus currently has no approved vaccine or therapy, and transmission via bodily fluids poses a high risk of cross-border spread, prompting global health authorities to stay on high alert. Separately, Russian pneumonic plague concerns have been investigated, but official statements deny a direct link, and the WHO assesses overall public health risk as low.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの肺ペストだけでなく、エボラも国境を越えて拡大──極めて稀な疾患に治療薬なく懸念高まる

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تسجل أول وفاة بفايروس إيبولا وسط تحركات لاحتواء التفشي

All identified contacts will be monitored for 21 days to detect potential infections early and prevent further transmission. Kenya intensifies monitoring, contact tracing, and entry-point screening to contain possible spread.

article.articleHeadline: Peste negra: entenda os riscos, sintomas e o cenário atual da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Black Death: Understand the Risks, Symptoms, and the Current State of the Disease
article.articleSummary: Plague (Yersinia pestis) remains a public health concern in specific contexts despite rarity. It presents in three forms: bubonic plague with painful swollen lymph nodes (buboes) near the bite site; septicemic plague with rapid bloodstream infection causing tissue necrosis; and pneumonic plague, the most dangerous form, affecting the lungs and transmissible between people via respiratory droplets, requiring immediate hospital isolation. Diagnosis relies on clinician suspicion and exposure history; laboratory confirmation uses blood, sputum, or lymph node biopsy to detect the bacteria. Treatments include gentamicin, streptomycin, or doxycycline, with outcomes markedly improved when therapy starts within 48 hours; delays can lead to irreversible complications or death within 24 hours after deterioration. In Brazil, surveillance is ongoing; Bahia, Ceará, and Rio de Janeiro record the last post-2000 cases. Prevention emphasizes rodent control, waste reduction, repellents, and regular antiparasitic care for pets; awareness and prompt care remain crucial.

triage.headline_ja: 黒死病（ペスト）：リスク、症状、現在の病状を理解する

article.articleHeadline: WHO Issues Ebola Lockdown Warning as Ruto Convenes Emergency Meeting
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) case; the patient, who had lived and worked in the Democratic Republic of Congo for seven years, fell ill about a month ago and died after travelling from DRC through Uganda to Nairobi. The imported case triggers Kenya’s emergency response; President William Ruto convened the National Security Council Committee to trace exposures, including the deceased’s family, healthcare workers, and fellow passengers. Eight family members and 21 healthcare workers are under quarantine; contact tracing also covers 27 flight passengers identified and contacted. WHO advises against travel or trade restrictions while continuing to support Kenya, Uganda, and the DRC in contact tracing, surveillance, screening, and other measures. Kenya has screened 652,584 travellers and tested 267 samples across five laboratories, with one positive and no further cases detected; authorities pledge strengthened surveillance and treatment.

article.articleHeadline: 俄罗斯鼠疫疑云 香港18区鼠患榜出炉 大埔区最少老鼠 两区重灾
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspicions about plague in Russia; Hong Kong’s 18-district rat infestation ranking released; Tai Po District has the fewest rats; Two districts hit hardest.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague suspected death in Russia prompts global attention; Russian authorities say no special pathogen detected, WHO deems cross-border public health risk as low. A female technician at Irkutsk’s plague research institute died of severe pneumonia; nearly 200 quarantined staff tested negative. Pneumonic plague is highly lethal and can spread through droplets, with a 1–4 day incubation; rapid isolation and antibiotics are essential to prevent death. In Hong Kong, the FEHD reports a 2026 H1 no-rat rate of 96.4% and ongoing improvements from AI-powered infrared heat-imaging pest control launched in 2024. Among 44 active sites, about 89% improved in 2026 H1; 29 sites exceed 90% no-rat rate. Kowloon City (92.8%) and Wan Chai (93.4%) show the most rat activity, while Tai Po (99.5%), Southern District (99.2%), and Tuen Mun (99.2%) record best control; Tsuen Wan and Kwai Tsing are around 94.6%, Sham Shui Po 95.0%. Public urged to curb rodent-borne risk via food security, cleanliness, flea prevention, DEET-use, and permethrin on clothing (not skin); hotline 3188 2064.

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Bali Temukan 9 Kasus Influenza A hingga September 2026, Ini Gejalanya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bali Health Office Finds 9 Influenza A Cases Through September 2026; Here Are the Symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases in Bali total nine through September 2026, according to Bali Health Office (Dinas Kesehatan Provinsi Bali). Nine cases were identified from 113 samples collected via influenza surveillance at multiple health facilities in Bali between January and September 2026. Officials say there is no surge in Influenza A cases; surveillance is ongoing year-round to monitor influenza conditions. Samples were taken from patients presenting acute respiratory infection symptoms: fever of 38°C or higher, cough, and, for more severe cases, shortness of breath; samples are also tested for possible COVID-19. All nine patients recovered: mild cases treated at primary care facilities, and hospitalized patients were discharged after recovery. Laboratory confirmation occurs at the national reference laboratory, so initial visits may not yield immediate results. Transmission is via droplets when infected individuals cough or sneeze. Among the nine, both productive-age adults and toddlers were affected.

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Konfirmasi Kasus Ebola Pertama, Pasien Meninggal di Nairobi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya Confirms First Ebola Case, Patient Dies in Nairobi.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first Ebola virus disease case, with the patient dying in Nairobi after returning from DRC. article.articleHeadline: كينيا تؤكد وفاة أول حالة إصابة وافدة بفيورس إيبولا - Radio Tamazuj
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya confirms the death of the first imported case of Ebola virus infection.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed the first imported Ebola death after a Kenyan man who had spent seven years in the Democratic Republic of Congo died in Nairobi. Ill for about a month, he received care in several Congolese hospitals before traveling by land to Uganda and then by air to Nairobi. He arrived Saturday, passed routine airport screening, and was placed in isolation; laboratory tests confirmed Ebola infection of the Bundibugyo strain. He died late Monday and was buried Tuesday under public health protocols. Kenyan authorities traced 28 contacts (relatives and healthcare workers) and followed 23 passengers and 4 crew members from the same flight. Surveillance at airports and borders was intensified. The Congo outbreak, declared in May, has thousands of cases and deaths; Uganda reported cases but was declared free in August. Ebola transmits via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids; Bundibugyo is a rarer strain with fewer treatments.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアが輸入エボラウイルス感染による初の死亡例を確認
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクに由来する輸入症例がケニアで死亡し、国際的な伝播・渡航関連リスクが確認されたため。IHR基準を複数満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Vĩnh Long: Khẩn trương triển khai các biện pháp khoanh vùng, xử lý ổ dịch tả lợn châu Phi tại xã Phú Quới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vĩnh Long Province: Urgently implementing containment and control measures for the African swine fever outbreak in Phú Quới Commune.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) outbreak triggers urgent containment in Phú Quới Commune, Vĩnh Long Province, as of October 7, 2026. After a report on October 5 of pigs dying unexpectedly at the Đặng Văn Sáu household in ấp Hòa Thạnh 1, local authorities and veterinary services verified the situation and began containment, biosecurity tightening, and area surveillance, prohibiting pig movements. In An Giang Province, 54 pigs tested positive for ASF; by October 6, 48 fattening pigs in a 2,640 kg herd were infected since October 2, with 21 deaths (October 5–6). The herd had not been vaccinated against ASF; sanitation and disinfection were used, and samples were sent to Region VII for testing. Officials recommended immediate culling of the entire herd if tests confirm ASF to prevent wider spread and protect livelihoods.

triage.headline_ja: ヴィンロン省:プークオイ社でのアフリカ豚熱(ASF)発生に対し緊急の封じ込め対策を実施

article.articleHeadline: UNICEF: Demokratik Kongo'da Ebola'dan 1162 çocuk öldü - ensonhaber.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNICEF: 1,162 children died from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: UNICEF reported that in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, as of September 29, 2026, 2,076 children have lab-confirmed Ebola infections and 1,162 have died. Since the outbreak was declared in May, more than 1,900 children have lost parents or caregivers or been separated from them. Children account for just over a quarter of confirmed cases and about one-third of deaths, with the highest fatality among under-fives. The outbreak is ongoing in Ituri and North Kivu, which host about 4.4 million internally displaced people. UNICEF says $113.4 million is needed for the DRC Ebola response, with a bit more than a third funded to date. The Bundibugyo variant circulating has no approved treatment or vaccine. Ebola was first identified in 1976 in Nzara, Sudan and Yambuku, DRC; the 2014-2017 West Africa outbreak infected about 30,000 and killed over 11,000.

triage.headline_ja: UNICEF：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラにより1,162人の子どもが死亡

article.articleHeadline: ケニアで初のエボラ感染確認、コンゴから帰国の男性死亡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya confirms first Ebola infection; man who returned from Congo dies.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first case of Ebola virus disease after a Kenyan man who had returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo died in Nairobi. The DRC outbreak has surpassed 8,000 cases and 4,000 deaths, the second-largest on record. The man had lived in eastern DRC for about seven years, fell ill about a month earlier, moved by road to Kampala, Uganda, then flew to Nairobi on Oct 3; he passed airport screening but developed fever and bleeding and was hospitalized and isolated, dying on Oct 5. His family (eight people) and 21 health workers were quarantined, and authorities are tracing 23 passengers and four crew from the same flight. Officials say symptoms may have been suppressed by medicine and that crossing the Congo–Uganda border, closed since May, is unclear. Africa CDC dispatched a support team; WHO urges no travel restrictions and backs Kenya and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで初のエボラ感染確認、コンゴから帰国の男性死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで拡大中のエボラ流行（8000例超、4000人死亡）が国境を越えてケニアに到達し、空港検疫をすり抜けた症例が発生、濃厚接触者・同乗者の追跡が進行中であり、国際的拡大リスクが極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC由来のエボラ流行とそのケニアへの越境伝播。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。WHOは渡航制限に反対しつつも、国境管理や航空機乗客追跡など国際的対応が求められている点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Strict protocol at Lang'ata as Kenya conducts first Ebola burial
article.articleSummary: Kenya conducted its first Ebola burial at Lang\'ata Cemetery in Nairobi under stringent health measures to prevent transmission. The deceased arrived around 2:30 pm from Jomo Kenyatta International Airport and was taken to Nairobi Hospital before interment in the Islamic section. Mourners wore masks and kept distance; only a small group witnessed. A hazmat team disinfected the vehicle and areas contacting the body, with materials that touched the body destroyed on site. The body was cleaned, wrapped in multiple protective layers, and buried within 24 hours in a grave at least six feet deep. Family attendance was limited and viewing was not allowed. Health Services Director-General Patrick Amoth urged a Safe and Dignified Burial (SDB) per WHO guidance; cultural practices are acknowledged, but viewing remains prohibited. The report references burial challenges noted in DRC outbreaks and Bundibugyo virus discussions.

triage.headline_ja: ランガタ地区での厳格なプロトコル―ケニアで初のエボラ埋葬が実施

triage.notes: 本事例はケニア（ナイロビ）で発生した輸入エボラ症例に関するものであり、対象国リストにケニアは含まれない。DRCは過去のアウトブレイク事例として言及されているのみで、本記事の主題となる発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: What is Ebola virus disease?
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) case confirmed in Kenya, first reported on October 6, 2026, following the death of a patient who recently arrived from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The individual entered Kenya on October 3, was admitted to a hospital, and died on October 5. EVD is a severe, often fatal illness; infected individuals are not infectious until symptoms develop. Transmission occurs by direct contact with blood or body fluids of an infected person, contact with contaminated surfaces or materials, and exposure to infected animals or wildlife products. This case represents an imported case from DRC; no ongoing outbreak data beyond this case is provided. The context emphasizes travel-related import risk and the need for precautions upon symptom onset.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病とは何か？
triage.triage_reason: DRCから渡航した感染者がケニアで死亡した輸入症例であり、エボラという重篤感染症の国境を越えた伝播事例としてIHR基準に複数該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Ruto orders enhanced Ebola response as Kenya traces 27 passengers
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first confirmed imported Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) case from the Democratic Republic of Congo; the patient died after testing positive. President William Ruto has directed the National Security Council Committee to assess the Ebola situation and recommend further measures. Surveillance, contact tracing, testing and other public health actions have been intensified. Eight family members and 21 healthcare workers linked to the patient are quarantined and monitored daily. Contact tracing has expanded to passengers from the same flight; 27 contacts identified. As of Oct 6, 2026, 652,584 travellers were screened and 267 samples tested across five laboratories (including the National Virology Reference Laboratory and KEMRI facilities in Nairobi and Kisumu) plus two mobile labs at Busia and Lwakhakha; only the deceased tested positive. No additional cases detected. Designated facilities include KNH (8 beds), Moi (50), National Police Hospital (49), The Nairobi Hospital (143); county isolation centres to be expanded. Public urged to maintain hand hygiene and report exposures; MOH to issue additional guidelines. Surveillance and rapid response teams deployed.

triage.headline_ja: ルト大統領、ケニアが27人の乗客を追跡する中でエボラ対応強化を指示
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでDRCからの輸入エボラ確定例（死亡）が発生し、大統領が国家安全保障会議に対応強化を指示するなど社会的・政治的関心が高く、IHR基準も複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: DRCは患者の渡航元として言及されているが、記事の主題はケニア国内での輸入症例対応であり、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Counties to work with MoH to contain Ebola spread, equip isolation centres -- CoG
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) in Kenya: Kenya confirms its first imported Ebola case, a Kenyan who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo and died after testing positive. Counties will partner with the Ministry of Health to bolster preparedness, equip isolation centres, and enforce basic infection prevention and control to curb transmission. As of Oct 6, eight family members of the deceased are under daily monitoring, 21 healthcare workers who treated the patient are quarantined, and 27 passengers linked to the same flight are traced. A total of 652,584 travellers were screened and 267 samples tested across five laboratories, with only one positive result (the deceased). Designated facilities include Kenyatta National Hospital, Moi Teaching and Referral Hospital, National Police Hospital, The Nairobi Hospital, and county isolation centres; capacity will be expanded as needed. Some 4,971 health workers have been trained; emphasis on hand hygiene and ongoing surveillance and contact tracing.

article.articleHeadline: 俄罗斯爆鼠疫恐慌 泰神婆去年底就预言：现致命瘟疫 或尸横遍野 | 中國報 China Press
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia erupts in plague panic as a Thai fortune-teller predicted by the end of last year that a deadly plague is now here, with bodies littering the streets | China Press
article.articleSummary: Russia erupts in plague panic as nearly 200 people are placed under urgent quarantine amid reports of a bubonic plague outbreak. Thai clairvoyant Mor Plai, a famous fortune-teller, had predicted in December 2025 that a deadly plague would arrive in 2026, describing it as a multi-symptom disaster with two keywords: tuberculosis and the Black Death. She explained these terms stood for tuberculosis and the Black Death rather than a single disease, and warned the catastrophe could produce deaths 'as plentiful as leaves.' Mor Plai suggested a possible link to a laboratory, including lab-made or modified ancient viruses, and named two potential origin regions: the Arab world and Russia. The report notes no laboratory confirmation or official cause; the outbreak status relies on quarantine measures and public concern in Russia, tied to the prophecy about 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでペスト流行の恐怖：タイの占い師が昨年末に予言「致命的な疫病が到来し、死体が通りに溢れる」
triage.triage_reason: 記事はタイの占い師の予言に基づくオカルト的な内容であり、公式な検査確認や科学的根拠がないため、信頼性の高い感染症シグナルとは言えない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシアでの検疫隔離（約200人）に関するものだが、ロシアは評価対象国リストに含まれていない。タイは予言者の出身地として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。公式な病原体確認やラボ検査の情報はなく、占星術・予言に基づく憶測記事であるため信頼性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Πανώλη: Οι τελευταίες καταγραφές της νόσου
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Plague: The latest records of the disease.
article.articleSummary: Yersinia pestis, a Gram-negative bacterium causing plague, circulates mainly in rodents and their fleas. Transmission to humans occurs by bite of infected fleas or contact with contaminated animal tissues or fluids; human-to-human spread is possible in the pneumonic form via respiratory droplets. Historical European foci include Corsica and Italy in 1945 and Kaliningrad in 1947; a 2025 plague case was diagnosed in Arizona. Globally, 2019–2025 reports total 3,847 cases (about 550 per year), with the highest burden in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Madagascar. After a 1–7 day incubation, symptoms include abrupt fever, chills, headache, and extreme weakness. Bubonic plague causes painful swollen lymph nodes; pneumonic plague causes cough, dyspnea and sometimes hemoptysis; septicemic plague leads to shock, bleeding, necrosis and multiorgan failure. Gentamicin, fluoroquinolones, or doxycycline, given early with supportive care, can cure; untreated mortality is 30–60% in bubonic and nearly 100% in pneumonic or septicemic forms.

triage.headline_ja: ペスト：その病気の最新の記録
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はペストの歴史的・疫学的背景を解説する教育的記事であり、特定の新規発生イベントを報じるものではないため、トリアージ対象のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はYersinia pestisの一般的な疫学・臨床情報と過去の発生事例（1945年コルシカ・イタリア、1947年カリーニングラード、2025年アリゾナ）を紹介する解説記事。DRCとマダガスカルは世界的に負担が大きい地域として言及されているが、具体的な新規発生イベントの報告ではないため、対象国としての特定イベントは確認できず。

article.articleHeadline: কেনিয়ায় ইবোলায় প্রথম মৃত্যু, একই ফ্লাইটের ২৩ যাত্রীকে খুঁজছে কর্তৃপক্ষ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya reports first Ebola death, authorities are searching for 23 passengers on the same flight.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first Ebola death as a Kenyan citizen who had lived in Congo contracted Bundibugyo Ebola virus and died in Nairobi on Monday after returning from Uganda via Nairobi; infection confirmed in hospital. The patient, who arrived Saturday, was isolated upon arrival at a Nairobi facility. Health authorities identified 28 contacts (family and healthcare workers) and will monitor them for 21 days, releasing those with negative tests. Officials are also tracing 23 fellow passengers who traveled on the same Uganda–to–Kenya flight. Border controls have been heightened. The outbreak is due to Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which no licensed vaccine or treatment exists; Congo is conducting tests. Uganda has 20 cases and France 1; Kenya becomes the fourth affected country. WHO warns the outbreak could become the deadliest if not controlled; authorities plan burial within 24 hours per rules.

article.articleHeadline: China diz estar a cooperar com Rússia face a suspeitas de surto de peste pneumónica na Sibéria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China says it is cooperating with Russia amid suspicions of a pneumonic plague outbreak in Siberia.
article.articleSummary: A Chinese spokesperson said Beijing is maintaining close exchanges and cooperation with Russia on infectious disease prevention and control, including plague. In Russia, a 28-year-old employee of the Irkutsk and Far East plague research institute died in a Shelekhov hospital on Oct 1–2. Investigators are examining two hypotheses: she contracted pneumonic plague (Yersinia pestis) in Thailand, where she had recently returned, or the illness resulted from an accidental lab release at her workplace. The United States issued a warning about a possible pneumonic plague outbreak in Siberia, and Russian sources reported quarantines at several Irkutsk hospitals. U.S. President Trump said he would speak with President Putin soon to discuss the matter. The EU's ECDC is monitoring, and the WHO assessed the regional health risk in Europe as very low after the incident.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、シベリアでの肺ペスト流行疑惑を受けロシアと協力していると発表

article.articleHeadline: 肺鼠疫預言︱俄羅斯爆疑肺鼠疫女研究員亡　泰國神婆Mor Plai精準預言「黑死病再現」人為釋放病毒與實驗室有關|香港經濟日報 TOPick
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumonic Plague Prophecy | Russia reports the death of a female researcher suspected of pneumonic plague; Thai fortune-teller Mor Plai accurately predicts "The Black Death Reappears" — a man-made release of the virus linked to a laboratory | Hong Kong Economic Daily TOPick
article.articleSummary: In Irkutsk, Siberia, a 27-year-old technician at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute died after an incident breaking a vial of Yersinia pestis. She developed severe pneumonia two days later and died within three days, in late September to early October 2026. Russian authorities say the death is due to an unknown pneumonia with initial tests negative for plague and no confirmed lab leak. About 197 close contacts, including medical staff and relatives, have been quarantined; several hospitals are under restricted visitation and public events were canceled. US CDC and State Department are monitoring; WHO notes the risk to the general public is limited given containment. The report references ongoing biosecurity concerns and a debate over the infection source. Separately, Thai fortune-teller Mor Plai warned of a 2026-2030 global pneumonic plague–like outbreak linked to a laboratory and spread by air travel, suggesting imported cases from Arab regions or Russia, with masking urged.

triage.headline_ja: 肺鼠疫預言︱俄羅斯爆疑肺鼠疫女研究員亡　泰國神婆Mor Plai精準預言「黑死病再現」人為釋放病毒與實驗室有關

article.articleHeadline: Titokzatos, halálos vírus szabadulhatott el Oroszországban: a Kreml mindent tagad, de óriási a para - tényleg ez lehet az új Covid?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mysterious, deadly virus could have escaped in Russia: the Kremlin denies everything, but the panic is huge — could this really be the new COVID?
article.articleSummary: An ill worker at a Siberian plague research institute died after pneumonia, prompting questions whether a dangerous pathogen escaped from the facility. Russian authorities deny plague involvement and say the source remains unknown, though conflicting reports describe pneumonic plague or unknown pneumonia. Epidemiologist Adam Kucharski warned that an unidentified pneumonia capable of spreading between people would be more alarming than plague, though there is no evidence yet. Officials say no plague microbe has been found in the deceased or in people he contacted. The case fuels ongoing questions about laboratory safety, vaccination, antibiotic access, and travel restrictions. WHO data (2019–2025) show ten countries reported 3,860 suspected plague cases, with 423 confirmed deaths; most confirmed cases occurred in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Madagascar. The episode highlights the risk of lab accidents and the difficulty of early identification of novel respiratory threats, but does not confirm a new pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: 謎の致死性ウイルスがロシアで流出した可能性：クレムリンは全面否定するもパニックは甚大 ― これは本当に新たなCOVIDなのか？

article.articleHeadline: 遭狗咬为省钱不打狂犬病疫苗　男约1个半月后病发逝世 | 世界万象
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dog bite: man dies about a month and a half later after not getting the rabies vaccine to save money
article.articleSummary: Rabies case in China: A man in Yanxi Town, Liuyang City, Hunan Province, was bitten by a dog on August 10. He declined rabies vaccination due to about 2,000 yuan cost and did not inform his family. About 1.5 months later, on September 26, he developed symptoms and died. His daughter posted a video urging others to vaccinate promptly after animal bites. Local authorities confirmed the dog bite fatality and are investigating the dog. The Liuyang CDC notes ongoing rabies prevention education and urges immediate post-exposure vaccination after dog bites. Rabies is caused by the rabies virus and causes acute viral encephalomyelitis; incubation is typically 1–3 months but varies, and once symptoms appear, mortality is extremely high. This case highlights cost barriers delaying vaccination and the public health imperative of rapid treatment after exposure.

article.articleHeadline: 中俄才防疫演練！川普憂心肺鼠疫急找普廷談 八炯驚揭1巧合

Pneumonic plague is transmitted through respiratory droplets and is typically severe; the CDC notes it differs from pneumonia and can be highly lethal, raising worries about treatment challenges and antimicrobial resistance. The report also references an August cross-border epidemic-prevention drill between China and Russia near Heilongjiang, attended by the institute’s director, Sergey Balakhonov, suggesting regional biosecurity links. The coverage implies heightened vigilance amid ongoing geopolitical maneuvering and public health preparedness, without confirming laboratory results for the patient.

article.articleHeadline: Kenya's first Ebola patient buried under tight security
article.articleSummary: Kenya buried its first Ebola patient, a 40-year-old man, at Langata Cemetery in Nairobi on Oct 6, 2026, under tight security after the Ministry of Health disclosed the case. The body was transported from JKIA to Nairobi Hospital, where he died. The patient had travelled from Buta, northwestern DRC, by bus to Beni, DRC, then to Uganda, boarding a Jumbo Jet at Entebbe International Airport on Oct 3 at 11:31, arriving at JKIA at 13:04, six minutes ahead of schedule. Burial procedures included disinfection, wrapping in protective material, and fumigation with a hazmat-suited official; the red Toyota Fielder used for transport was disinfected. Security kept media from the burial site; officials and relatives attended in limited numbers. This Ebola case linked to DRC-Uganda travel underscores ongoing regional transmission risks.

article.articleHeadline: طاعون چطور منتقل می شود و چه علائمی دارد؟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How is the plague transmitted and what are its symptoms?
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-07, a suspected pneumonic plague case in Siberia, Russia, has renewed attention to plague. Plague is a bacterial disease caused by Yersinia pestis, transmitted to humans mainly by fleas that infest rodents, including rabbits, cats, prairie dogs, and squirrels. Today plague still exists but is no longer the widespread threat of medieval Europe; human cases continue in several countries, with most recent activity concentrated in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Madagascar. With rapid diagnosis and antibiotic treatment, the disease is curable. The World Health Organization notes ongoing human infections in multiple countries, underscoring the need for surveillance, vector control, and public health vigilance to prevent imported or exported cases.

article.articleHeadline: Mash: Россиянка заразилась опасной лихорадкой во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mash: A Russian woman contracted a dangerous fever in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: 7 October 2026 — a Russian tourist from Lyubertsy, Ekaterina, was hospitalized in Da Nang, Vietnam, after contracting dengue fever, per Mash Telegram channel. She developed a sudden high fever during a Danang visit, with temperatures reaching 39–40°C and rapid clinical deterioration; antipyretics were ineffective. One version suggests a bite by a yellow fever mosquito entering the room through an open window, with infection likely at night. Dengue is not spread via airborne droplets or through ordinary contact with an ill person. The illness can take a severe course after defervescence, including bleeding, shock, and organ damage. Vulnerable groups include children, the elderly, and those with prior dengue infection. The article notes the report from Mash and provides no lab-confirmation details.

triage.headline_ja: Mash：ロシア人女性がベトナムで危険な熱病に感染

article.articleHeadline: Китай съобщи, че води разговори с Русия относно подозренията за чума
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China said it is in talks with Russia regarding suspicions of plague.
article.articleSummary: China and Russia are in talks over a suspected pneumonic plague case in Siberia as Beijing confirms cooperation with Moscow on prevention and control of infectious diseases, including plague. The incident follows the death of a 28-year-old laboratory worker in the Irkutsk region from severe pneumonia; unconfirmed local reports suggest infection with Yersinia pestis after a broken tube. About 200 close contacts are under monitoring. Irkutsk is north of Mongolia and a transport hub with frequent flights and rail links to Chinese cities. Mongolia’s health ministry called the risk low and said border surveillance would continue in coordination with relevant services. Russia and China recently conducted a joint emergency-response drill for outbreaks and discussed cross-border monitoring. U.S. President Donald Trump said he would speak with Vladimir Putin soon and that the United States would have additional information on the matter.

article.articleHeadline: Union Health Minister JP Nadda to lead national launch of JOSH Teams for TB elimination tomorrow
article.articleSummary: Launch of JOSH (Joint Squad for Health) Teams on October 8, 2026, at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, led by Union Health Minister JP Nadda, aims to intensify youth-led community mobilisation for TB Mukt Bharat. In collaboration with the Ministries of Youth Affairs & Sports and Defence, the first phase will roll out in 55 districts across 11 States. JOSH Teams blend Class-I Officers, MY Bharat Volunteers and NCC Cadets to extend TB awareness and action at Block/Ward and community levels, promoting symptom awareness, prevention, timely diagnosis, treatment completion, myth-busting, stigma reduction, and active public participation. Khushi Avatar, an AI-powered chatbot, will support awareness efforts. The initiative builds on Jan Bhagidari and follows 2025 recognition of 67,933 Panchayats across 697 districts as TB Mukt. The programme exemplifies a whole-of-government approach to TB elimination.
