article.articleHeadline: Kenya Records First Ebola Death
article.articleSummary: Kenya records its first confirmed Ebola death after a Kenyan citizen who had been living in the Democratic Republic of the Congo arrived in Nairobi last Saturday. The patient developed a high fever and severe bleeding under the skin and died on Monday, with officials noting that medication may have masked symptoms beforehand. Health authorities have begun tracing about 28 people who had contact with the patient, including family members and healthcare workers. The case represents Kenya's first Ebola death and highlights the risk of imported infections from the Congo region. Ongoing surveillance and investigations are under way to confirm the infection source, assess whether additional linked cases exist, and prevent further transmission through careful monitoring of contacts.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで初のエボラ死亡例を記録
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国から来た患者がケニアで死亡し、国境を越えた感染拡大の可能性と約28人の接触者追跡が必要な事例であり、IHR基準の複数(深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク)に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCに居住していたとされるが、記事はケニア国内での初のエボラ確定死亡例を主題としており、DRCでの発生自体は記事の主題ではないため、対象国リストに基づきverified_locationsは空とした。感染源・接触者調査の継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تسجل أول إصابة مؤكدة بإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records its first confirmed case of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first Ebola virus disease case, an imported infection from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The Kenyan patient, infected in Congo, traveled to Kampala, Uganda, and then Nairobi, arriving October 2, and died October 6 after fever, fatigue, myalgia, and subcutaneous bleeding. Laboratory tests confirmed the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. Health authorities identified 28 close contacts, plus 23 airline passengers and four crew aboard the flight he took, with quarantine arrangements for those at highest risk. By October 6, the Ministry of Health had screened 652,584 travelers and tested 267 samples, with one positive result. The case underscores ongoing Ebola concerns in Africa, including continued transmission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Nigeria’s heightened preparedness for potential importation.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、初のエボラ出血熱確定症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国からの輸入例によるケニア初のエボラ出血熱症例が死亡に至り、国境を越えた拡大リスクと大規模な接触者追跡・渡航者スクリーニングが実施されているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 症例自体はケニアで発生・死亡したが、ケニアとウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であり継続的な感染拡大が報告されているDRCのみ対象国として計上した。ナイジェリアの警戒強化についても言及があるが、実際の発生事例ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Россиянка подхватила опасную лихорадку во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Russian woman contracted a dangerous fever in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-07, a Russian tourist from Lyubertsy contracted dengue fever while vacationing in Da Nang, Vietnam, and was hospitalized. According to Mash Telegram channel, she developed a fever of 39–40°C and severe body pains; antipyretics were ineffective, and condition deteriorated until hospital evaluation confirmed dengue. Dengue spread is primarily via mosquito bites and is not transmitted through ordinary person-to-person contact. The report warns that severe dengue can develop after the fever subsides, with alarming signs including severe abdominal pain, repeated vomiting, bleeding, and marked weakness; in severe cases, shock and internal bleeding may occur, requiring urgent medical care. The article notes that Russians traveling to Thailand have previously been warned about hepatitis and gastrointestinal infections linked to rat fever. This case highlights travel-related dengue exposure in Southeast Asia and the need for vigilance for fever after mosquito exposure.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人女性、ベトナムで危険な熱病に感染
triage.triage_reason: 単一の渡航者感染例であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められず、デング熱は当該地域で流行性疾患として既知であるため、通常のトラベルヘルスニュースの範疇にとどまる。
triage.notes: 単一の個人渡航者症例の報道であり、デング熱はベトナム・東南アジアで既知の流行病。現地当局による大規模アウトブレイク報告ではない。タイでの肝炎・レプトスピラ症（鼠咬熱）への言及は本記事の主題ではなく、過去の別件として触れられているのみのため評価対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Россиянка на "райском отдыхе" заразилась страшной лихорадкой из-за комара
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Russian woman on a "paradise vacation" contracted a terrifying fever from a mosquito.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Da Nang, Vietnam: Ekaterina, a Russian tourist from Lyubertsy (Moscow region), contracted dengue during a stay in Da Nang. She developed a high fever up to 40°C and severe body pains, and was urgently hospitalized. The night-time mosquito bite through an open window is suspected, with doctors allegedly confirming the dengue diagnosis per Mash, a Telegram channel. Dengue is a mosquito-borne illness; no further laboratory details or patient outcome are provided in the report. The article highlights travel-related health risks for Russian travelers abroad. Publication date: 2026-10-07.

triage.headline_ja: 「楽園の休暇」中にロシア人女性が蚊による恐ろしい熱病に感染
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ダナンに渡航した個人（ロシア人観光客）のデング熱単発症例報告であり、同国はデング熱流行地域として既知。公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は個人の渡航関連健康リスクに関する人間的関心記事であり、集団発生や公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報は含まれていない。ロシア（モスクワ）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: السلطات الكينية تسجل أول إصابة مؤكدة بفيروس إيبولا في البلاد | مصراوي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenyan authorities record the first confirmed case of the Ebola virus in the country | Masrawy
article.articleSummary: First confirmed Ebola case in Kenya: a Kenyan man who died after returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo, where he contracted Ebola Bundibugyo strain. Symptoms: fever, chills, fatigue, weakness, muscle pains, painful swallowing, sore throat, and subcutaneous bleeding at injection sites. Lab confirmation: positive in Kenya's National Virus Reference Laboratory and the Kenya Medical Research Institute. He traveled by road from DRC to Kampala, then flew to Nairobi on Oct 2 and died on Monday. Contact tracing identified 28 contacts, including family and health workers; 23 passengers and 4 crew from the flight are being quarantined or monitored. Kenya has screened 652,584 travelers as of Oct 6; 267 samples tested across five labs, with one positive. WHO was notified. Health workers trained: 4,971. In DRC, over 8,000 confirmed cases and about 4,000 deaths across 63 districts; Nigeria raised preparedness; concerns over spread to areas near the South Sudan border.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア当局、国内初のエボラウイルス確定感染例を記録
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでDRC由来のエボラ輸入症例が確認され死亡、接触者・航空機搭乗者の追跡が行われており、IHR基準の複数該当と国際的拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ケニアでの初症例は輸入例であり、原発生地はDRCの既存アウトブレイク（8,000例超、死亡約4,000例）。ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。WHOへの通知済みで、航空機乗客・乗員の隔離・追跡が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Europa monitorizează un posibil focar de ciumă în Rusia: Ce spun medicii despre riscul de răspândire
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Europe is monitoring a possible plague outbreak in Russia: What doctors say about the risk of spread.
article.articleSummary: Russia's Irkutsk region reports a suspected pneumonic plague case after a lab worker died when a test tube broke at a plague institute; authorities say no evidence the infection came from pathogens they handle. About 200 contacts are under medical observation; several regional hospitals were closed and quarantined. ECDC is monitoring and in touch with WHO; no secondary transmissions reported; travel between Irkutsk and EU/EEA is limited. Experts caution pneumonic plague remains endemic in rodent populations in Africa, Asia and the Americas, and human cases occur annually. Transmission is via respiratory droplets; incubation about 24 hours. Symptoms include severe respiratory distress and coughing. Untreated pneumonic plague can be 30–100% fatal; early diagnosis and antibiotics are effective; isolation and contact treatment are required. WHO does not recommend routine vaccination except for high-risk groups; Europe has not seen plague in over 50 years, while Africa's DR Congo and Madagascar report human cases.

triage.headline_ja: ヨーロッパがロシアでのペスト発生疑いを監視:拡散リスクについて医師が語る
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの研究所で肺ペストによる死亡例が発生し、約200名の接触者が観察下に置かれ、病院が隔離されるなど公衆衛生上重大な事案であり、ECDC・WHOも監視している点でIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 本事例はロシア・イルクーツク州の研究所内事故に起因する肺ペスト疑い例であり、対象国リストに含まれるDRC・マダガスカルの言及は背景情報（ペストの常在地域としての言及）に過ぎず、記事の主題ではないためverified_locationsには含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: ケニアで初のエボラ熱死者　感染拡大のコンゴから帰国：時事ドットコム
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya's first Ebola death, returning from Congo where the outbreak is spreading
article.articleSummary: As of 7 October 2026, Kenya reports its first Ebola-related death after a Kenyan man who had returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak is spreading, died in Nairobi on 5 October. The patient fell ill about a month earlier and received treatment in Congo, traveled to Kenya by air via Uganda on 3 October, and died two days later. Contacts identified include 28 people—family members and healthcare workers—who have been monitored, with all tests to date returning negative for Ebola. Health Minister Duare said all measures are in place to contain the outbreak and urged calm. The case marks Kenya’s first Ebola fatality linked to cross-border movement with Congo; no confirmed secondary transmission yet. Surveillance and contact tracing continue to prevent further spread across the region.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで初のエボラ熱死者　感染拡大のコンゴから帰国：時事ドットコム
triage.triage_reason: DRCで拡大中のエボラ熱がケニアへの越境移動により死亡例を発生させ、国際的拡大とIHR基準の複数該当が確認されるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 死亡例はケニアで発生したが、感染源はDRCでの流行であり、DRCが主要な発生国として扱われる。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。28名の接触者は現時点で陰性だが、二次感染のリスク監視が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Inside the final journey of Kenya's first imported Ebola patient
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first imported Ebola case, with KTN reconstructing the patient’s journey from the Democratic Republic of Congo to Nairobi. The patient travelled from the DRC, where he sought treatment at several health facilities, before continuing to Kenya. In Kenya, he was admitted at multiple facilities as his condition deteriorated, later being transferred to Nairobi Hospital, where he died despite medical efforts. The reconstruction outlines the key stages, the facilities visited, and the events surrounding the confirmation of Kenya’s first imported Ebola case. The report highlights the journey from the DRC into Kenya and the fatal outcome in Nairobi Hospital. No further clinical details, including laboratory confirmation or specific symptoms, are provided in the article beyond noting the imported Ebola case and the patient’s death.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア初の輸入エボラ患者、最期の軌跡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで感染したとみられる患者がケニアへ渡航し複数の医療機関を受診後に死亡した輸入エボラ症例であり、越境感染・院内曝露のリスクが高く、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCで複数の医療施設を受診後にケニアへ渡航し、ナイロビの病院で死亡。感染源地はDRCと推測されるが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。接触者追跡や院内感染対策の状況など続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Roche liefert Laborausrüstung für Ebola-Tests in den Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Roche supplies laboratory equipment for Ebola tests in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Roche supplies two molecular-testing devices to the Democratic Republic of Congo's National Institute for Public Health (INSP) for Ebola testing, to be deployed after training in Bunia. A Roche-developed PCR test for Bundibugyo ebolavirus will be evaluated on-site, capable of detecting viral RNA in samples; the test is currently for research purposes and not yet approved for diagnostics. If the evaluation succeeds, Roche will provide additional tests and devices to expand previously inadequate Congo testing capacity. The Ebola outbreak declared in May is the largest yet recorded in Congo; by end-September, nearly 8,000 infections and about 3,800 deaths across 63 health districts in seven provinces, with Ituri Province hardest hit. The WHO considers the Congo outbreak’s overall risk as very high.

triage.headline_ja: ロシュ、コンゴでのエボラ検査用に実験装置を供給
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で記録上最大規模のエボラ流行が継続中（約8000感染、約3800死亡）であり、WHOはリスクを「非常に高い」と評価している。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事は主にロシュによる検査機器供給に関する内容だが、背景として記録上最大のコンゴエボラ流行（7州63保健区、約8000例・3800死亡）とWHOによる「非常に高いリスク」評価が明記されており、既知の継続的大規模アウトブレイクとしてPICKUPと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Confirms First Ebola Death, Traces 27 on Flight
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first Ebola case and death from Bundibugyo virus in Nairobi, tracing transmission to a Kenyan citizen who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where Bundibugyo has circulated in Ituri and North Kivu since May 2026. The patient fell ill about a month before and traveled via Beni, Congo to Kampala, Uganda on Oct 2, then flew to Nairobi (Jambojet 8523) on Oct 3, arriving at 13:10. He died on Oct 5 and was reported Oct 6; eight relatives and 21 health workers who treated him are in quarantine. Twenty-seven people from the flight—23 passengers and 4 crew—were identified for contact tracing. Kenya has screened 652,584 travellers and tested 267 samples in five laboratories, with a single positive result. Treatment hospitals: Kenyatta National Hospital (8 beds) and The Nairobi Hospital (143 beds). Bundibugyo virus lacks an approved vaccine; WHO lists Kenya as the fourth country to report Bundibugyo virus disease.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、初のエボラ死亡例を確認、飛行機搭乗者27人を追跡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で続く Bundibugyo エボラウイルス流行がウガンダ経由でケニアに越境し、死亡例・航空機内接触者追跡が発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な国際的拡大事例。
triage.notes: 記事の主題であるケニア、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。アウトブレイクの発生源であるDRC（イトゥリ州・北キブ州）のみ対象国として記載。

article.articleHeadline: Россиянка подхватила опасную лихорадку во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Russian woman contracted a dangerous fever in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-07, a Russian tourist was hospitalized with dengue fever in Da Nang, Vietnam. She was bitten by an infected mosquito at night while asleep. Dengue is mosquito-borne and not transmitted via air or direct contact. The woman developed high fever (39–40°C) and severe body aches, took antipyretics, but her condition worsened, leading to hospital admission. Laboratory tests confirmed dengue infection, and she is receiving treatment. The report also notes a prior case of a Ryazan resident who contracted dengue in Vietnam after a mosquito bite during an excursion. Additionally, Florida is experiencing a rise in dengue cases. Dengue remains a travel-associated risk in Southeast Asia, with imported cases possible when travelers return home.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人女性がベトナムで危険な熱病に感染
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおけるデング熱は流行地域での既知の旅行関連感染であり、個別の輸入症例報告に留まるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれも該当せず社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナム・東南アジアで流行期に見られる風土病であり、個別の旅行者感染事例であるため新規性・異常性は低い。フロリダ、ロシア（リャザン）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 【時事金掃描】「肺鼠疫」爆發中國三市最危險 巴西大選大翻天 | 俄羅斯 | 疫情 | 川普
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Current Affairs Golden Scan] "Pneumonic plague" outbreak makes three Chinese cities the most dangerous; Brazil's election turns the tables | Russia | Pandemic | Trump
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague outbreak linked to Yersinia pestis has emerged in Irkutsk, western Siberia, Russia, after a laboratory accident at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute involving a vial of live plague bacteria. A laboratory technician Shipilova developed severe illness and died on Oct 2; five medical centers—including a children’s hospital and a regional obstetrics hospital—were placed under strict quarantine. Russia deployed the biowarfare defense unit (RKhBZ); a large aluminum plant issued a mask mandate; about 200 people with exposure were quarantined. Authorities have downplayed the incident, claiming no related microorganisms were detected. If Shipilova was contagious before hospitalization, roughly 40 flights from Irkutsk to Moscow, Beijing, Bangkok, Phuket and other cities since Sept 26 could have facilitated spread. WHO warns pneumonic plague is airborne and can be nearly 100% fatal without treatment within 24 hours; neighboring Mongolia, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, and Kyrgyzstan have stepped up border health checks.

triage.headline_ja: 【時事金掃描】「肺ペスト」発生で中国三都市が最も危険に　ブラジル大統領選で大逆転 | ロシア | 疫病 | トランプ
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの研究所事故に起因する肺ペスト（Yersinia pestis）感染者の死亡例が確認され、空気感染・高致死率・複数都市への航空便を通じた国際拡散リスク、周辺国の国境検疫強化など、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 実際の発生地はロシア・イルクーツク（対象国リスト外）であり、中国・タイ等は『感染者が渡航した可能性がある都市』として言及されているのみで、現地での発症・発生事例は記事内で確認できないため verified_locations には含めなかった。ロシア当局は病原体検出を否定しているが、死亡例・隔離措置・近隣国の国境強化など懸念材料が多く、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes Tingkatkan Kewaspadaan Imbas Dugaan Pes di Rusia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Heightens Vigilance Following Suspected Plague in Russia
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Ministry of Health heightens vigilance after a laboratory worker in Irkutsk, Siberia, Russia dies from a suspected plague caused by Yersinia pestis, typically transmitted by fleas from rodents. No confirmed plague cases or travel restrictions have been detected in Indonesia as of 5 October 2026. There has been no notification via the International Health Regulations (IHR) NFP or WHO Event Information Site about a special alert. The Ministry urges Balai Karantina Kesehatan, hospitals, Labkesmas, and health offices to boost preparedness, while traveler surveillance continues through the All Indonesia-SSHP health declaration and symptom screening (fever, cough, shortness of breath). If a symptomatic traveler from affected areas is identified, they will be referred to an infectious disease referral hospital. Bali’s international airports and seaports apply risk-based assessments for cargo, and surveillance of rats and fleas at entry points. Public should monitor developments and maintain hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア保健省、ロシアでのペスト疑い例を受け警戒態勢を強化
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクでの検査技師の疑いペスト死亡例を受け、インドネシア保健省が予防的警戒を強化したのみで、インドネシア国内での確定例や人への伝播は確認されていない。情報が限定的なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 実際のペスト疑い症例はロシア・イルクーツク州で発生しており、対象国リストに含まれない。インドネシアでは確定例なく、空港・港湾での監視強化などの予防的措置のみが報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: تسجيل أول إصابة ووفيتين بسبب فيروس إيبولا في كينيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First Ebola case and two deaths recorded in Kenya
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EBOV) marked as first case in Kenya after a Kenyan patient, infected in the Democratic Republic of Congo, died upon returning to Nairobi. The patient traveled via Kampala and arrived at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport on Oct 2, developed fever, chills, fatigue, muscle pains, and dysphagia, and was placed in medical isolation at a Nairobi hospital. Laboratory confirmation identified the Bundibugyo strain; the patient died on Oct 6. Kenya has traced 28 contacts (family and health workers) and is monitoring 23 airline passengers plus 4 crew from the flight, with quarantine protocols for suspected cases. The health ministry reports ongoing high preparedness: 652,584 travelers screened to Oct 6, 267 tests across five labs, with one positive result. The DRC outbreak persists (over 8,000 cases and ~4,000 deaths across 63 regions); Nigeria has heightened readiness, and cross-border concerns loom from the DonGo region toward South Sudan, with Kampala referenced in travel history.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで初のエボラ症例と2名の死亡を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラアウトブレイク（8000例超、4000人死亡）に関連した国境を越えた症例・死亡が発生し、国際的拡大の懸念と複数国の警戒強化が報告されているため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの輸入初症例（ケニアは対象国リスト外のため除外）。感染源であるDRCの進行中アウトブレイク（8000例超、4000人死亡、63地域）が背景として言及されており、対象国リストに含まれるためDRCを計上。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・南スーダンも対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: SUA cer clarificări după moartea suspectă a unei angajate a Institutului Anti-Ciumă din Irkutsk. Teama de o nouă epidemie impune controale la granițe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. seeks clarifications after the suspected death of an employee of the Anti-Plague Institute in Irkutsk. Fear of a new epidemic imposes border controls.
article.articleSummary: Death of a 28-year-old employee at Irkutsk's Anti-Plague Institute under investigation for possible exposure to the plague agent; she was admitted Sept 29 with severe pneumonia and died Oct 2. Russian officials attribute death to pneumonia only; independent sources allege a broken vial containing plague agent prior to death. About 200 contacts were quarantined; all tests negative; WHO assesses low public health risk. Russia states no pneumonic plague cases in Irkutsk, with authorities urging calm and reliance on official statements. U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio called for full transparency and offered assistance, signaling ongoing international scrutiny. Border controls tightened in Central Asia (Kazakhstan reintroducing sanitary/quarantine checks; Kyrgyzstan alert; Uzbekistan preparedness) and Indonesia heightened entry-point checks at Bali to prevent potential imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、イルクーツクの抗ペスト研究所職員の不審死後に説明を要求。新たな流行への懸念から国境管理が強化
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクのペスト研究所職員の原因不明死亡を巡り、国際的な透明性要求と複数国での国境検査強化が生じており、IHR4基準すべてに該当する可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 発生国であるロシア（イルクーツク）、カザフスタン、キルギスは対象国リストに含まれない。インドネシア（バリ）は入国時の水際対策強化のみで、実際の発生事例は報告されていないため verified_locations から除外した。WHOは現時点で公衆衛生リスクを低いと評価しているが、ロシア政府の公式発表と独立情報源の主張（ワクチン瓶破損説）に食い違いがあり、情報の不確実性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Duale: We don't have Ebola outbreak, only an imported case
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports an imported Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease case, not a national outbreak. The patient contracted the infection in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC)—originating in Buri, then Kisangani, Beni and Kinshasa—before traveling via Uganda to Nairobi, arriving Oct 2, 2026, and dying Oct 5, 2026 around 11:30 pm. He exhibited high fever, chills and difficulty swallowing; thermal screening at JKIA failed to detect him due to his medication. Laboratory confirmation began at the National Virology Laboratory, with a Nairobi facility, and final confirmation by 9 pm on Oct 7, 2026 after CDC verification. Immediate contact tracing spans Kenya, Uganda, DRC and WHO. Eleven family members (including his mother and wife) and 23 healthcare workers were quarantined; four crew members from the Kampala–Nairobi flight and other airport staff are being followed. Kenya has screened about 650,000 travelers at 15 entry points and trained 4,900 healthcare workers; 276 suspected cases tested negative previously.

triage.headline_ja: デュアレ氏：アウトブレイクではなく輸入症例のみ
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）感染者がウガンダ経由でケニアに入国後死亡し、国際的な接触者追跡とWHO/CDCの関与が発生しているため、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで発生したエボラウイルス病（ブンディブギョ株）がウガンダ経由でケニアへ輸入された症例。ケニアとウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、国際的拡大リスクの評価には重要な情報。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Highly pathogenic avian influenza as a systemic risk - implications for control and preparedness - npj Veterinary Sciences
article.articleSummary: Highly pathogenic avian influenza virus (HPAIV) H5N1 is a systemic, global risk, sustained in wild waterbirds and domestic production systems with ongoing re-introduction pressure at the wildlife–poultry interface. Since the 1990s, shifts in East and Southeast Asia poultry production have coincided with expanded cross-species circulation and mammalian infections. The autumn 2025 period marked a tipping point: laboratory-confirmed HPAIV detections in wild birds across 29 European countries between September and November 2025, with mortality pronounced in common cranes (Grus grus). Combined with detections in captive and domestic birds, 2,896 HPAI outbreaks were notified, a six-fold increase vs 2024 and twelve-fold vs 2023, exceeding the 2021–2022 peak. Outside Europe, activity remained geographically expansive in Africa, Asia, the Americas, and Antarctica, with mammalian cases including dairy cattle in the USA. The outbreak reflects an established panzootic status with overlapping migration networks.

triage.headline_ja: 高病原性鳥インフルエンザはシステミックリスクである－制御と備えへの含意－npj Veterinary Sciences
triage.triage_reason: H5N1 HPAIVが世界的なパンゾーティック状態に達し、哺乳類（乳牛等）への種間伝播が拡大していることから、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術誌（npj Veterinary Sciences）に掲載されたレビュー/総説論文であり、特定国における新規アウトブレイク報告ではない。欧州・アフリカ・アジア・南北アメリカ・南極を含む世界的なH5N1パンゾーティックの総括であり、対象国（中国・上海含む）が記事の主題として具体的に取り上げられているわけではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。グローバルな動向把握のため継続監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Roche liefert Laborausrüstung für Ebola-Tests in den Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Roche supplies laboratory equipment for Ebola tests in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Roche supplies laboratory equipment for Ebola testing in the Democratic Republic of Congo, providing INSP with two molecular-testing devices to be deployed in Bunia after local staff training. A Roche-developed PCR assay for Bundibugyo ebolavirus will be tested on site to detect viral genetic material; the test is currently for research use and not yet approved for diagnostics. If the evaluation is successful, Roche will supply additional tests and, if needed, more devices to expand the country’s limited testing capacity. The May outbreak is the largest Ebola outbreak recorded in the Congo. By end-September, nearly 8,000 infections and about 3,800 deaths had been confirmed across 63 health districts in seven provinces, with Ituri province particularly affected. The WHO classifies the outbreak risk in Congo as very high.

triage.headline_ja: ロシュ、コンゴでのエボラ検査用ラボ機器を提供
triage.triage_reason: DRCで記録上最大規模のエボラ流行が継続中（約8000感染、約3800死亡、7州63保健地区に拡大）であり、WHOがリスクを「非常に高い」と評価していることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はロシュによる検査機器支援に関するものだが、背景としてDRCの大規模エボラ流行（記録上最大、致死率約48%）が記載されており、フルリスク評価の対象とすべき。国際的拡大・渡航貿易制限の有無は記事内で言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: China says it's talking to Russia on suspected plague case
article.articleSummary: On Oct 6 China said it is cooperating with Russia over a suspected pneumonic plague case in Siberia after a 28-year-old laboratory worker at an Irkutsk anti-plague institute died from severe pneumonia. Unconfirmed reports suggested exposure from a broken test tube; nearly 200 contacts have been placed under observation. Irkutsk region lies north of Mongolia and its capital is a transport hub with frequent flights and rail links to Chinese cities. Mongolia’s Ministry of Health on Oct 7 assessed the risk as low and said border surveillance will continue in cooperation with relevant agencies. China and Russia had concluded a joint emergency response drill on infectious disease outbreaks about a month earlier. The case has limited coverage in Chinese media; US President Trump said he would discuss it with Putin soon.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、ロシアでの疑わしいペスト症例について協議していると発表
triage.triage_reason: シベリアでの肺ペスト疑い症例による死亡例があり、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクのある病原体であること、約200人の接触者が観察下に置かれていること、トランプ米大統領も言及するなど国際的な政治的関心が高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストに含まれない。中国は外交的に協議に関与しているのみで、発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。モンゴルも発生地ではなく対象国リスト外。続報でロシア国内の感染拡大状況や中国・モンゴルへの越境リスクの変化を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: KMPDU demands answers on how Ebola entered Kenya
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms an imported Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease case, with the patient dying at Nairobi Hospital; 1 case and 1 death reported. The Kenyan citizen, who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo for seven years, fell ill about a month before returning to Kenya, travelled by road to Kampala, Uganda, then flew to Nairobi on Oct 3 aboard Jambojet JM8523. He arrived at JKIA around 1:10 pm and was taken to Nairobi Hospital, presenting fever, chills, severe fatigue, weakness, muscle pain, painful swallowing, sore throat and bleeding under the skin at injection sites. Lab confirmation of Bundibugyo Ebola occurred at the National Virology Reference Laboratory and at KEMRI. Contact tracing is underway. The Kenya Medical Practitioners, Pharmacists and Dentists Union (KMPDU) urges immediate PPE, infection-prevention measures, training, rigorous contact tracing, transparent communication, and readiness of isolation units, with healthcare workers included in response and guaranteed medical coverage. Government action must be urgent, transparent, and accountable.

triage.headline_ja: KMPDU、エボラがどのようにケニアに侵入したかについて説明を要求
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで輸入エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）による死亡例が確認され、国際便搭乗や接触者追跡が進行中であり、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準・社会的関心（医療従事者組合の声明）も高いため。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCに7年間居住し発症後ケニアに帰国した輸入症例。記事の主題はケニア国内での発生・対応であり、ケニア自体は対象国リストに含まれないため、DRCも現時点では感染源としての言及のみでDRC国内での流行拡大は確認されておらず、verified_locationsは空配列とした。続報でDRC国内の関連発生が確認された場合は再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تسجل أول وفاة بـ إيبولا . السلطات تكثف جهودها لاحتواء تفشي الفيروس
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records its first Ebola death. Authorities intensify efforts to contain the virus outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Kenya records its first confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) case and its first Ebola death. The deceased was a Kenyan national who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo for seven years and contracted the disease about a month earlier. After treatment in several hospitals, he traveled by road to Kampala, Uganda, and then flew to Nairobi, arriving on Saturday. He was isolated on arrival and transferred to a Nairobi hospital where laboratory tests confirmed EVD; his condition deteriorated and he died on October 5, 2026. Kenyan health authorities intensified contact tracing and surveillance to prevent further spread. The World Health Organization had, in May, described the outbreak situation in DRC and Uganda as a public health risk. The case is imported to Kenya from the DRC, highlighting cross-border transmission concerns.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで初のエボラ死亡例を記録、当局はウイルスの封じ込めに向けた取り組みを強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）由来のエボラ患者がウガンダ経由でケニアに入国後死亡し、国境を越えた感染拡大の懸念が顕在化しているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの輸入症例による初の死亡例だが、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であるDRCは対象国リストに含まれるため記載。WHOは5月にDRC・ウガンダでの発生を公衆衛生リスクと表明しており、越境感染の継続的リスクが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: NCDC raises Ebola alert over imported case in Kenya
article.articleSummary: Imported Bundibugyo Ebola virus case in Kenya triggers Nigeria's NCDC alert. The Kenyan patient, a citizen formerly based in the Democratic Republic of Congo, traveled by road to Kampala, Uganda, then flew to Nairobi where he was isolated and tested positive, and subsequently died. Nigeria reports no confirmed Ebola case as of Tuesday, but the risk of international importation via travel has risen. NCDC is reviewing and strengthening Nigeria's preparedness with emphasis on early detection, isolation, laboratory diagnosis, infection prevention and control, contact tracing, risk communication, and protection of healthcare workers. A National Ebola Preparedness tabletop exercise was conducted to identify response gaps. Nigerians are advised to maintain hand hygiene, avoid contact with blood or body fluids of the ill, and not handle bodies of unknown illnesses; travelers should monitor 21 days after exposure and report symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアNCDC、ケニアでの輸入エボラ症例を受けて警戒レベルを引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の輸入症例がケニアで確認され死亡、国境を越えた拡大リスクからナイジェリアが警戒を強化しており、IHR基準の複数該当が認められる。
triage.notes: 本事例の発症・死亡はケニアで発生し、感染経路はDRC→ウガンダ→ケニアとされるが、DRCは患者の『以前の居住地』として言及されているのみで、同国内での発生事例であることは記事から確認できない。ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアはいずれも対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تسجل أول وفاة بإيبولا وسط تحركات لاحتواء التفشي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records its first Ebola death amid efforts to contain the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) case and the first Ebola-related death in the country, involving a Kenyan citizen who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo and arrived in Nairobi. Public health authorities have initiated rapid contact tracing and raised preparedness at border crossings to detect any further infections and curb spread. The case is imported from the DRC, and the response centers on monitoring contacts, isolating suspected cases, and tightening cross-border surveillance. No additional case counts are provided in the report. Symptoms were not specified in the briefing. The development underscores ongoing risk of cross-border transmission and highlights Kenya’s containment efforts as part of wider regional vigilance as of 7 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、感染拡大抑制の取り組みの中でエボラによる初の死亡例を記録
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでエボラウイルス病による初の確定症例・死亡例が報告され、DRCからの越境感染である点でIHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。症例はDRCでの進行中のエボラ流行に由来する輸入例であり、DRCを発生地域として記録。続報で症例数・渡航制限の有無を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تسجل أول وفاة بـ"إيبولا"... السلطات تكثف جهودها لاحتواء تفشي الفيروس
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records its first Ebola death... Authorities intensify efforts to contain the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first confirmed Ebola case and its first Ebola-related death. The deceased is a Kenyan citizen who had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo for seven years and contracted the virus about a month ago, receiving treatment at several hospitals before traveling by road to Kampala, Uganda, and then taking a flight to Nairobi, arriving Saturday afternoon. Authorities categorize the case as imported from the DRC and have intensified contact tracing and surveillance to prevent further transmission. Health Minister Aden Duale announced the details, with a focus on tracing contacts, monitoring arrivals, and reinforcing infection-control measures at points of entry as investigations continue.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで初のエボラ死亡例を記録…当局はウイルスの封じ込めに向け対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで初のエボラ輸入症例による死亡が確認され、DRCからウガンダを経由した国境を越える感染拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準3項目・WPRO基準5項目に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCに7年間居住し感染したとされ、ウガンダ(カンパラ)を経由してケニア(ナイロビ)へ渡航した輸入症例。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外し、感染源とされるDRCのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: Kenia confirma su primer caso de ébola importado desde el Congo - Diario La R
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya confirms its first imported Ebola case from the Congo - Diario La R.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first imported Ebola case linked to the Congo outbreak. A Kenyan citizen who had lived seven years in the Democratic Republic of Congo died in Nairobi after falling ill about a month earlier. Symptoms included high fever, extreme fatigue, muscle pains, and bleeding. He traveled by land to Kampala, Uganda, and flew to Nairobi on October 3. Lab tests confirmed infection with the Bundibugyo Ebola strain; he died despite intensive care. Authorities identified 28 close contacts, with 23 passengers and four crew from the same flight under 21‑day surveillance. The Congo outbreak, declared in May 2026 in Ituri, has spread to at least seven provinces with over 8,600 cases and more than 4,100 deaths (≈48% fatality). WHO and Africa CDC warn of cross-border risk; Kenya tightens border and airport controls and reinforces surveillance. There is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、コンゴ由来の輸入エボラ出血熱症例を初確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべてに該当し、コンゴ(DRC)のエボラ流行が国境を越えてケニアへ拡大した事例であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として緊急のリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 症例はケニアで確認されたが、発端となる流行自体はDRC（イトゥリ州）で発生・拡大しているため、対象国リストに基づきDRCのみをverified_locationsに計上。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため除外。WHO・Africa CDCが越境リスクを警告しており、ワクチン・特効薬が存在しないブンディブギョ株である点も重大。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death recorded in Kenya after victim travelled from DRC
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first Ebola case and death after a Kenyan national who had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) for years died in Nairobi on Oct 6, 2026. He had travelled by road from DRC to Uganda, then by air to Nairobi, undergoing airport screening but not flagged. He tested positive for the Bundibugyo strain, which at the time had no specialized treatment or vaccine (human trials started in July; three other candidates in pipeline). Eight family members and 21 healthcare workers are quarantined; 23 passengers and four crew from the Nairobi-bound flight are being traced; 21-day isolation for contacts. The DRC outbreak since May tallies over 8,300 cases and more than 4,000 deaths, making it the deadliest, with WHO warnings of surpassing the 2014-2016 regional epidemic. Kenya enhances airport screening and urges rapid contact tracing, isolation, testing, and strict infection control.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでDRC渡航後のエボラ死亡例を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模エボラ流行（8300症例超、4000死亡超）がケニアへ越境し初の死亡例が確認された。国際拡大・公衆衛生上の深刻性・渡航制限対応がいずれも該当し、WHOも警戒を強めている。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの初のエボラ死亡例だが、感染源・継続流行地はDRCであり、DRCのアウトブレイク状況（8300症例超、4000死亡超、2014-2016年流行を超える可能性）が詳述されている。KenyaとUgandaは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。治療法・ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo株である点、周辺国（ウガンダ、ケニア）への越境拡大が既に発生している点から国際的リスクは極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Govt to strengthen youth-led community mobilisation for tuberculosis elimination
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) elimination drive in India expands with the launch of Joint Squad for Health (JOSH) teams across 55 districts in 11 states. Led by Union Health Minister J. P. Nadda at Bharat Mandapam, the initiative pools Health Ministry, Youth Affairs and Sports, and Defence Ministry resources, enlisting Class-I officers, MY Bharat volunteers, and NCC cadets to drive youth-led community mobilisation. In the first phase, teams will operate at block, ward, and community levels to disseminate TB information on symptoms, prevention, timely diagnosis, and completion of treatment, while addressing myths, reducing stigma, and encouraging community participation in the national TB elimination campaign. The plan builds on Jan Bhagidari and strengthens grassroots engagement toward a TB Mukt Bharat. In 2025, 67,933 panchayats across 697 districts were recognised as TB-free, reflecting ongoing nationwide efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 結核撲滅に向け、政府が若者主導の地域動員を強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核撲滅に向けた政策・啓発キャンペーンの発表であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: これは既存の国家結核撲滅プログラムの拡充・啓発活動に関する政策発表記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態を報じるものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Typhons, épidémies, inondations et canicule mondiale: voici ce qu'El Niño nous réserve pour ces prochains mois
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Typhoons, epidemics, floods and a global heatwave: here's what El Niño has in store for us in the coming months.
article.articleSummary: El Niño 2026, exceptionally strong in the tropical Pacific, moves warm water from Indonesia to Peru, shifting atmospheric circulation east. Typhoons are expected in October as sea-surface temperatures rise, with storms tracking toward Asia; Atlantic hurricanes have not formed this year, a historic lull. As El Niño intensifies into autumn, southern Ethiopia, Kenya, and Somalia could face floods, while Malawi, Zambia, and Zimbabwe may see their lowest rainfall in 75 years, threatening crops and food security and raising famine risk in East Africa and the Sudan region. January–April floods and landslides could contaminate drinking water, boosting cholera and leptospirosis risks; malaria may rise with stagnant waters. In Peru, coastal El Niño floods have killed about 52 people this year. By early 2027, heavy rains threaten the Americas and the United States. Coral bleaching risk rises globally, with May 2027 a potential peak; 2027 could be the hottest year on record.

triage.headline_ja: 台風、感染症流行、洪水、世界的な熱波——エルニーニョが今後数ヶ月にもたらすもの
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はエルニーニョ現象に関する将来予測・気候科学の一般解説記事であり、実際に発生した感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。コレラ・レプトスピラ症・マラリアのリスク上昇は仮定的・将来的な言及に留まる。
triage.notes: 記事は気候変動・エルニーニョ現象の将来的影響に関する一般科学記事であり、具体的な感染症発生の確定報告ではない。Zambiaは干ばつによる食料危機とコレラ・レプトスピラ症リスクの文脈で言及されているが、実際の症例報告は含まれない。Indonesiaはエルニーニョの発生起点として言及されているのみで疾病事象の主体ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Another Covid? Donald Trump Ready to Talk to Putin as Suspected Case of Plague in Russia Raises New Health Scare, Should Indians Worry
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague case in Russia’s Siberia linked to the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute; a laboratory worker infected and another lab worker, a 28-year-old, died after severe pneumonia; about 200 people quarantined due to exposure. The incident sparks a forthcoming Trump–Putin discussion, with the US requesting more information and transparency. WHO is monitoring and assesses international risk as very low given current data. Pneumonic plague is bacterial and treatable with antibiotics if detected early, and can spread through coughs and sneezes, prompting contact tracing and isolation. As of 2026-10-07, there is no evidence of a global outbreak. For India, no immediate panic risk is indicated by available information, though investigations continue to determine whether this is isolated or may require broader public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: 再びコロナ禍？ロシアでのペスト疑い症例を受けトランプ氏がプーチン氏との対話準備、インドは懸念すべきか
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペスト事例はロシア（イルクーツク）の研究所関連感染であり、対象国（インド等）での発生ではない。インドへの言及は懸念の有無を問う文脈のみで実際の発生事例ではなく、WHOも国際リスクを非常に低いと評価しているため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 発生国はロシア（対象国リスト外）。インドは記事中で懸念の有無を問われているのみで、実際の発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。対象国に関連する実発生事例がないため、SOP上の監視対象としてはDISMISS相当と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Nairobi Hospital says Ebola patient was isolated from main facility
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first imported Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease case; a patient died at Nairobi Hospital two days after admission to an isolated unit. The Ebola isolation facility is separate from the main hospital, with a dedicated entrance; the main hospital’s emergency, maternity, theatres, wards and outpatient services remain normal. Infection prevention and control measures are in place, with staff wearing full PPE and under supervision. All identified contacts are monitored for 21 days in coordination with the Ministry of Health. Health authorities are intensifying contact tracing, including healthcare workers and passengers who traveled on the same flight. The patient had spent time in the Democratic Republic of Congo, then Uganda, before arriving in Nairobi. The hospital reassures the public that operations are safe, open, and fully operational while response measures continue.

triage.headline_ja: ナイロビ病院、エボラ患者は主要施設から隔離されていたと発表
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで初の輸入エボラ（ブンディブギョ型）症例が確認され患者が死亡しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大イベントのためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニア（ナイロビ）での輸入エボラ症例であり、対象国リストにケニアは含まれない。患者はDRC・ウガンダを経由したと記載されているが、これらの国での発生が明示的に述べられているわけではないため、ルールに従いverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: "Moartea Neagră" nu a dispărut. Bacteria care provoacă ciuma pneumonică există și astăzi și poate fi fatală
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Black Death" has not disappeared. The bacteria that cause pneumonic plague still exist today and can be fatal.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, remains present in animal reservoirs and can be fatal; the World Health Organization has requested more data from Russia after the death of a laboratory worker in Siberia. Russian authorities say those in contact with the patient tested negative for pneumonic plague and that available tests showed no microorganisms linked to the professional activity, leaving the exact cause unclear. The disease has three forms—bubonic, septicemic, and pneumonic—with pneumonic being the most virulent and capable of rapid progression. Symptoms include shortness of breath, chest pain, and coughing up blood. Transmission is typically via fleas and infected animals, but pneumonic plague can spread between people through respiratory droplets in close contact. Globally, about 1,000–3,000 cases occur annually, with cases in Africa, the Americas, and Eurasia, including Russia, India, China, and the United States. Lab research supports diagnostics, vaccines, and antibiotic resistance monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: 「黒死病」は消えていない。肺ペストを引き起こす細菌は今も存在し、致命的となり得る
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はペストの歴史・生物学に関する一般解説記事であり、具体的な発生地（ロシア・シベリアの検査技師死亡）は対象国リストに含まれない。中国・インド等への言及も世界的な年間症例数の一般統計としての記述に過ぎず、対象国での具体的な発生事例ではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はロシア・シベリアでの検査技師の死亡事例であり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に該当しない。中国・インド・タイなどはペストの世界的分布に関する一般的な言及のみで、具体的な発生情報ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Majomhimlős betegeket azonosítottak Magyarországon
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox patients identified in Hungary.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox identified in Hungary: Komárom-Esztergom County and Pest County each reported one case. A 45-year-old man in Komárom-Esztergom and a 27-year-old man in Pest were not vaccinated against monkeypox. The National Public Health Center’s 39th week epidemiological report (Sept 21–27, 2026) notes monkeypox as a zoonosis with a 7–14 day incubation (up to 21 days). Initial symptoms include fever, headache, muscle and back pains, lymphadenopathy, chills and fatigue, followed 1–3 days later by the rash typical of monkeypox. Recovery typically lasts 2–4 weeks; complications can include pneumonia, encephalitis and conjunctival infection. Separately, a mass gastroenteritis outbreak occurred in a Veszprém County elementary school, affecting 204 people (200 students, 4 staff) with diarrhea, vomiting and fever; calicivirus was detected in three cases, suggesting a foodborne source. Additionally, a 31-year-old man from Veszprém tested positive for Dengue virus, infection acquired in India. Mosquito-borne diseases are noted in Hungary.

triage.headline_ja: ハンガリーでサル痘（エムポックス）患者が確認される
triage.triage_reason: 対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン等）における発生ではなく、ハンガリー国内の散発例とインド渡航歴のある輸入デング熱例であり、重症度・国際的拡大の兆候も見られないため、現時点でピックアップ対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はハンガリー国内の複数の公衆衛生事象（サル痘2例、学校での集団胃腸炎、インド渡航歴のあるデング熱輸入例）を報告しているが、いずれも対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）での発生事象とは言えないため、verified_locationsは空とした。インドは感染地として言及されているが、発生国としての事象ではなく渡航歴に過ぎない。

article.articleHeadline: રોગચાળા જેવી સ્થિતિ વચ્ચે AMCની આંકડાની રમત! 3 દિવસમાં લોહી...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In an outbreak-like situation, AMC's numbers game! Blood in 3 days...
article.articleSummary: Ahmedabad, India: The Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation’s health department is accused of inflating dengue and malaria testing figures to project control over a looming outbreak. Officials claim that in three days they collected 89,000 blood samples and 6,000 serum samples, a sharp jump from 48,446 blood and 10,168 serum samples reported by Sept 27, and then 183,000 blood and 162,900 serum samples by Sept 30. Critics question how so many samples could be gathered in three days and allege data manipulation to showcase administrative efficiency without a corresponding rise in cases. Past September figures show over 200,000 blood samples last year, and this year up to Sept 27 only about half that volume, yet month-end totals purportedly matched the previous year. September counts: dengue 756; malaria 137 (mild) and 41 (severe); chikungunya 10; typhoid 266.

triage.headline_ja: パンデミックのような状況下でのAMCの数字操作疑惑！3日間で血液サンプル8万9千件採取と主張
triage.triage_reason: デング・マラリア等の季節性感染症の症例は報告されているが、行政のデータ操作疑惑が主題であり、重大な公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクを示す情報は乏しい。
triage.notes: 記事はデング・マラリア等の症例数そのものよりも、行政によるデータ操作疑惑を中心に報じている。症例数は季節性の範囲内と見られ、重症度や異常性についての明確な記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: सिलसिला तोड़ें: भारत में कुष्ठ रोग
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Break the chain: Leprosy in India
article.articleSummary: Leprosy (Hansen’s disease) in India remains a public health challenge despite declines in overall cases and Grade-2 disabilities. After near-elimination in 2005, integration of leprosy surveillance into general health services undermined monitoring, sustaining transmission in several regions. In 2025–26, high-burden areas screened over 700 million people, identifying 24,367 cases; ASHA workers flagged about 4 million suspected cases, with 48,027 confirmed. Contact tracing covered 1.69 million people, of whom 91.1% received post-exposure prophylaxis (single-dose rifampicin). The government has implemented digital surveillance and is considering the MIP vaccine to hasten pathogen clearance in highly infectious patients. Ongoing barriers include stigma leading to nerve damage before treatment, misdiagnosis by clinicians, and uneven district performance. The 2025–26 report shows total cases higher than estimates (+41%), child cases (+91.6%), and Grade-2 disabilities (+34%). Only 148 of ~300 districts achieved infection-control targets; emphasis remains on Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Odisha, Maharashtra and intensified 2026–27 investments.

triage.headline_ja: 鎖を断て:インドにおけるハンセン病
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病はインドにおける慢性的な公衆衛生課題であり、症例数増加が報告されているが、急性の国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限の懸念はなく、社会的関心の急激な高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: ハンセン病は長期的・慢性的な感染症であり急性の公衆衛生上の緊急事態ではないが、症例数の増加（特に小児症例やGrade-2障害の増加）や地域サーベイランス体制の不備は継続的な監視が必要。政府によるワクチン導入検討や集中投資計画あり。

article.articleHeadline: 肯尼亚现埃博拉死亡病例 曾辗转三国搭客机
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya reports Ebola death case, patient had transited through three countries on a passenger plane.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first imported Bundibugyo strain Ebola virus case. A Kenyan citizen who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo for seven years fell ill there, travelled via Uganda and arrived in Nairobi by air, dying on Oct 5. Authorities identified 28 contacts (family and healthcare workers); 23 passengers and 4 crew on the same Jambojet flight are being traced and potentially quarantined. WHO says Kenya is the fourth country to report Bundibugyo Ebola; the DRC outbreak remains severe, with over 8,000 cases and more than 4,000 deaths; Uganda earlier had 20 cases and 2 deaths but ended its outbreak in August. Screenings at Entebbe and Nairobi were initially normal; officials believe symptoms may have emerged after arrival. Lab confirmation by the Kenya Virus Reference Laboratory and KEMRI. There is no licensed Ebola vaccine yet; Uganda has begun a Bundibugyo vaccine trial (Oxford candidate), with Serum Institute of India providing 3,000 doses and CEPI funding five candidates.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ死亡例、患者は旅客機で3カ国を経由
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクの3つが該当し、DRCでの大規模アウトブレイク（8000例超・4000死亡超）を背景にケニアへの輸入症例が発生、航空機同乗者の追跡・隔離が進行中であるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダ・インドは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。インドはSerum Institute of Indiaによるワクチン供給国として言及されているのみで発生国ではない。DRCは記事の主題であるBundibugyo株エボラの大規模アウトブレイク（8000例超）の発生源として言及されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Gia tăng nhanh trẻ em mắc cúm A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rapid rise in children infected with influenza A.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-07, Vietnamese pediatric influenza A cases at Hanoi-based National Children's Hospital are rising rapidly. Lab-confirmed influenza A detections increased from 106 in week 35 to 779 in week 40 of 2026, with admissions climbing from 18 to 124—an ongoing, steep upward trend. National surveillance also notes rising seasonal flu activity in parts of the country. Experts attribute the surge to ongoing antigenic drift and low influenza vaccine uptake, with the North (Hanoi and surrounding areas) showing multiple peaks and May–October activity, occasionally extending into winter. Public health guidance emphasizes annual vaccination and eight preventive measures: proper masking in health facilities and crowded places, covering coughs/sneezes, hand hygiene, routine cleaning and ventilation, minimizing close contact, healthy living, and cautious antiviral use. High-risk groups include people aged 65+, children under 5, pregnant/postpartum women, and those with chronic illnesses.

triage.headline_ja: 小児のA型インフルエンザ感染が急増
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの流行拡大であり、ヒト-ヒト感染の継続と医療機関の負荷増加が見られるが、国際的な影響や異常性は低く、フルRRAへ進めるほどの緊急性は不明。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザAの通常の流行パターンの一部とみられ、特に新規株や重症化の異常性は報告されていない。国家サーベイランスによる経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Duale: Ebola patient did not declare illness on health declaration form
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms an imported Ebola case. Health CS Aden Duale said the patient, travelling from the Democratic Republic of Congo, did not declare illness on a mandatory health self-declaration form, complicating screening at entries. The patient originated in Buri, DRC, and travelled Kisangani, Beni, Kinshasa before boarding a Kenya-bound flight Oct 2, 2026. Arriving in Kenya on medication, he may have had a lowered fever, hindering thermal scanning at JKIA. He was taken to Nairobi Hospital; symptoms included fever, chills, and difficulty swallowing. Blood tests at National Virology Laboratory and Nairobi lab were positive, with CDC confirmation later. Diagnosis was confirmed around 9 pm; he died about 11:30 pm on Oct 5, 2026. Contact tracing led to 11 family members and healthcare workers quarantined. Kenya says this is an imported Ebola incident, not an outbreak; 650,000 passengers have been screened at 15 entry points, 4,900 healthcare workers trained.

triage.headline_ja: デュアレ大臣：エボラ患者は健康申告書に病状を申告していなかった
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ患者がケニアに輸入され死亡、接触者隔離・検疫すり抜けの問題が発生しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・越境拡大・渡航制限リスク）に該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 患者はDRC（Buri出身、Kisangani・Beni・Kinshasa経由）で感染したとみられ、ケニアへの渡航後に発症・死亡した輸入症例。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず、感染起源国であるDRCのみを記載した。健康申告書の虚偽記載や検疫（サーマルスキャン）のすり抜けが指摘されており、入国管理体制の課題が浮き彫りになっている。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉病毒｜肯雅錄得首宗死亡個案 患者由剛果民主共和國返國後病逝 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus | Kenya records its first death; patient dies after returning home from the Democratic Republic of the Congo | am730
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first Ebola case on Oct 6, involving a man who had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and contracted Bundibugyo ebolavirus after returning to Kenya via Uganda; he died in a Nairobi hospital on Oct 5. The patient developed fever, chills, extreme fatigue, muscle and throat pain, and subcutaneous bleeding about a month after exposure in DRC, arriving in Nairobi on Oct 3 after travel through Kampala. Kenya's MOH says 28 close contacts—family and healthcare workers—will be isolated for 21 days, and authorities are tracing 23 fellow passengers and 4 flight crew. The outbreak source is the DRC, where confirmed cases exceed 8,300 with over 4,000 deaths; Uganda reported 20 cases and 2 deaths but ended in Aug. WHO cautions the outbreak is far from over, with no travel restrictions recommended. Kenya has heightened border and airport surveillance; WHO and Africa CDC are assisting.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス｜ケニアで初の死亡例を記録 患者はコンゴ民主共和国から帰国後に死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がケニアに越境し初の死亡例が発生。DRCでは8,300例超・死者4,000人超の大規模アウトブレイクが継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの輸入症例・初死亡だが、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。発生源であるDRCのみを対象国として記載。WHOは渡航制限を推奨していないと明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Penyakit Campak dan Risiko Komplikasi yang Membayanginya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beware of Measles and the Risk of Complications That Accompany It
article.articleSummary: Measles emergency declared in New York State on Oct 5, 2026, expected to last until Nov 4, 2026, as the outbreak nears 4,000 cases and crosses into Pennsylvania. Governor Kathy Hochul links spread to vaccination hesitancy among Amish populations in New York, Pennsylvania, and Ohio, and expands healthcare vaccination/testing capacity. In the United States, the CDC notes the worst measles year since 1991, with about 3,900 cases; measles is highly contagious and can lead to severe complications such as pneumonia, meningitis, and encephalitis. WHO data remind that measles can cause high fever, cough, runny nose, red eyes, and a spreading rash; historically, pre-vaccine epidemics caused ~2.6 million deaths, and 2024 global deaths were ~95,000, with vaccination dramatically reducing mortality (780,000 in 2000 to 95,000 in 2024). Indonesia reports 8,224 suspected cases in early 2026 (through week 7), 572 lab-confirmed, 4 deaths, and 21 outbreaks; prior year saw higher totals. Complications include pneumonia, ear infections, diarrhea, and brain inflammation.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹と それに伴う合併症リスクに注意
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで2026年初頭までに8,224件の疑い例、572件の検査確定例、4名の死亡、21件のアウトブレイクが報告されており、麻疹は高い感染力と重篤な合併症（肺炎、脳炎等）を伴うため、WPRO基準（重症度・持続曝露・流行しやすさ）に該当し、社会的関心も高いと判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は米国（ニューヨーク州等）の麻疹非常事態宣言とインドネシアの麻疹流行状況を併記しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはインドネシアのみ。米国各州（Ohio, New York, Pennsylvania）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Parasite Protein SporoAMA1 Emerges as Key Switch Linking Chronic Toxoplasma
article.articleSummary: sporoAMA1, a sporozoite-specific apical membrane antigen 1 of Toxoplasma gondii, emerges as a central switch linking persistence and transmission. In a China-based study (Guangxi University; China Agricultural University; Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences), researchers found sporoAMA1 transcripts by RT-PCR across bradyzoites, cat intestinal sexual stages, and oocysts, with endogenous tagging failing to visualize protein. Deleting sporoAMA1 had no effect on tachyzoites, but markedly impaired brain and muscle tissue cyst formation, reducing chronic infection reservoirs. In the feline sexual cycle, loss of sporoAMA1 decreased oocyst production and sporulation efficiency, key bottlenecks for environmental transmission. Distinct isoforms across stages imply stage-specific processing. The findings in Parasites & Vectors imply sporoAMA1 is essential for long-term persistence and for transmission via oocysts, influencing food- and waterborne toxoplasmosis.

triage.headline_ja: 寄生虫タンパク質SporoAMA1、慢性トキソプラズマ感染と伝播をつなぐ重要なスイッチとして浮上
triage.triage_reason: これは基礎研究（分子生物学的研究）に関する記事であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は研究室での遺伝子機能解析（sporoAMA1遺伝子欠失実験）を報告する学術論文の紹介であり、実際の症例発生や流行を報告するものではないため、トリアージ対象外とする。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya has no Ebola outbreak, Duale says after imported case confirmed
article.articleSummary: Kenya has no Ebola outbreak; Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale calls the confirmed case an imported infection involving a traveler from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Since May 2026, when WHO and Africa CDC confirmed the DRC outbreak, Kenya has prepared with about 650,000 passengers screened at 15 entry points and 4,900 healthcare workers trained to manage Ebola. A total of 276 suspected cases have tested negative. Authorities traced the patient’s movements from northwestern Congo to Kisangani, Beni, Kinshasa, Kampala, and Kenya, classifying it as imported. The patient may have evaded detection at JKIA due to medications. Surveillance and contact tracing continue. Nairobi has intensified preparedness: 923 health workers and 1,598 community health promoters trained, over 60 laboratory officers trained, and Rapid Response Teams activated across all 17 sub-counties, with the Emergency Operations Centre coordinating surveillance, reporting and interventions. Governor Sakaja urged vigilance, calm, and cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアにエボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクはない、ドゥアレ氏が輸入症例確定後に発言
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関連し、ケニアへの輸入症例が確認されたため、国際的拡大のリスクがありIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアへの輸入症例だが、実際のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクはDRCで発生中（2026年5月よりWHO・Africa CDCが確認）。ケニア自体ではアウトブレイクなしと当局が明言しているため、ケニアは対象国リストにも該当せず除外。DRCの状況が本質的なシグナルソース。

article.articleHeadline: Duale: Kenya has imported Ebola case, no outbreak
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports an imported Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease case in Nairobi, with no outbreak. The patient, a Kenyan who had lived in the DRC for seven years, contracted the virus there, then traveled to Uganda and arrived in Kenya on October 3. He was screened at JKIA but was on medication, which may have suppressed symptoms. He presented at Nairobi Hospital with fever, fatigue, chills, muscle pain, sore throat, and skin bleeding, and was isolated. National Virology Reference Laboratory and KEMRI tested positive for Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease, with international confirmation subsequently obtained by 9 pm. The patient died on October 5. Contact tracing covers 28 contacts (family and healthcare workers) and 23 passengers plus 4 crew from Jambojet JM8523 Kampala–Nairobi; 21-day monitoring planned. Kenya has screened 652,584 travellers at 15 entry points and tested 267 samples in five laboratories, with one positive. 4,971 health workers trained; WHO notified; public urged to practice hand hygiene and avoid recent travelers with illness.

triage.headline_ja: デュアレ氏：ケニアで輸入エボラ症例を確認、アウトブレイクではない
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の国境を越えた輸入症例であり、死亡例・濃厚接触者多数・航空機乗客への追跡調査を伴うため、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCに7年間居住し感染、その後ウガンダ経由でケニアに渡航し発症・死亡。ケニアおよびウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは感染源国として明記されているため含めた。アウトブレイクの有無や渡航制限の可能性は続報待ち。

article.articleHeadline: Amoth: Avoid gatherings, hugging, handshake to combat Ebola
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first imported Ebola case as of 2026-10-07. Health Ministry Director General Patrick Amoth urged Kenyans to avoid large gatherings, handshakes and hugs, recommending waving as a safer greeting during the response phase to curb transmission. He stated that political meetings, family events, church services, concerts and other social gatherings all pose contact risks and should be avoided. Authorities emphasized infection-prevention measures, including regular handwashing with soap and water and the continued use of hand sanitizers. People with symptoms are advised to seek medical attention and report to a health facility promptly. The patient is a Kenyan citizen who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo for seven years, fell ill about a month ago, and received treatment; health officials will release further case details.

triage.headline_ja: アモス氏：エボラ対策のため集会・抱擁・握手を避けるよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでDRC由来の輸入エボラ症例が確認され、国境を越えた感染拡大が示唆される。重症度が高く、公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念があるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 確定症例はケニアで発生しているが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。患者はDRCに7年間居住しており、同国で感染した可能性が高く、DRCにおけるエボラ流行の継続を示唆するためDRCを含めた。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تسجل أول وفاة بإيبولا وسط تحركات لاحتواء التفشي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records first Ebola death amid efforts to contain the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first Ebola virus disease case and the first death linked to an outbreak, authorities said on 7 October 2026. The patient, who had recently returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo, had lived in Congo for seven years and fell ill about a month ago. After treatment in several hospitals, he traveled by road to Kampala, Uganda, and then flew to Nairobi. Health authorities initiated rapid contact tracing and heightened border surveillance to detect additional cases and curb transmission. The development underscores cross-border risks in East Africa and the need for vigilant screening at points of entry—efforts aimed at preventing further spread. No further cases are reported yet, but ongoing monitoring and rapid response measures are in place as governments coordinate to contain the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで初のエボラ死亡例、アウトブレイク封じ込めに向けた対応進む
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱による死亡例が新たな国（ケニア）で確認され、国境を越えた移動歴があり国際的拡大リスクが高いため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCに7年居住し同地で発症、ウガンダ経由でケニアに移動後に死亡が確認された。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外し、感染源とされるDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。国境を越えた移動を伴う症例であり、東アフリカ地域全体での監視強化が報じられている。
