article.articleHeadline: இலங்கைக்கு காசநோய் எதிர்ப்பு மருந்துகளை வழங்கியது இந்தியா
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India supplied anti-plague medicines to Sri Lanka.
article.articleSummary: On 7 October 2026, India donated approximately 3 tonnes of essential anti-tuberculosis (TB) medicines to Sri Lanka to ensure a continuous supply of first-line TB drugs. The package, including more than 1.5 million tablets, is valued at about 5.2 crore Sri Lankan rupees and was formally handed over by the Indian High Commissioner to Sri Lanka to Sri Lanka’s Health and Mass Media Minister and Deputy Minister of Health. The aid aligns with ongoing India–Sri Lanka health cooperation, supported by India's Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, and targets uninterrupted TB treatment nationwide. In August, India also donated 500 litres of technical malathion for dengue control, illustrating broader emergency and health-support collaboration. The partnership encompasses hospital construction and modernization, provision of medicines and equipment, and capacity-building, reflecting a people-centered development approach and timely assistance for essential health needs.

triage.headline_ja: インドがスリランカに結核治療薬を提供
triage.triage_reason: 感染症の発生・流行に関する内容ではなく、インドからスリランカへの結核治療薬の人道支援に関する報道であるため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: スリランカは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。インドも医薬品提供国としての言及のみで、インド国内の感染症発生情報ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Sugiono dan Menkes Bahas Percepatan Program CGK hingga Penanganan TB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sugiono and the Health Minister Discuss Accelerating the CGK Program and Tuberculosis Treatment
article.articleSummary: Jakarta, 7 October 2026 — Coordinating Minister for Human Development and Culture Sugiono and Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin outlined plans to accelerate the integrated Free Health Check Program (CKG), spanning prevention through follow-up medical care. The discussion also prioritized tuberculosis (TB) control, expanding capacity and infrastructure at regional public hospitals (RSUD), and reforming the education and placement system for medical specialists to strengthen health workforce distribution nationwide. Key conditions include precise budgeting aligned with identified needs, clear, measurable targets, and sustainability to ensure continuous delivery of services. The session also addressed financing reforms for the National Health Insurance (JKN) and finalization of a health master plan, with a focus on transparency and tighter synchronization between central and regional governments to avoid funding bottlenecks affecting frontline care. Consolidating budgets and reinforcing a cross‑sector health ecosystem aim to deliver inclusive, equitable health protection and support Indonesia’s human-resource goals.

triage.headline_ja: スギオノ調整相と保健相、CGKプログラム加速と結核対策について協議
triage.triage_reason: 既知の慢性疾患である結核に関する政策・予算協議の記事であり、新規の異常発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の新規アウトブレイクではなく、政府の医療政策・予算に関する会議報告であるため、シグナルとしては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Why Kenya stands a better chance of preventing Ebola spread
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo confirmed in Kenya after a patient ill in Uganda traveled to Nairobi, arriving Oct 3; case confirmed at Nairobi Hospital. Kenya traced 27 contacts (family and healthcare workers) and is isolating them, with 23 passengers and 4 crew from the flight under tracing. The outbreak source is linked to DRC’s Bundibugyo outbreak reported since May. Kenya’s preparedness includes strong lab capacity (NVRL, KEMRI Nairobi & Kisumu) with two mobile labs at Busia and Lwakhakha borders; since Oct 6, screening 652,584 travellers and testing 267 samples; 4,971 health workers trained. Public measures: hand hygiene, avoiding close contact, hotline numbers 719 and 0700719719; strict transport/burial protocols; ambulance used for deceased fumigated and reserved for Ebola. President Ruto directed the National Security Council to assess and guide response.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアがエボラ拡散を防げる可能性が高い理由
triage.triage_reason: DRCのブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関連し、ウガンダ経由でケニアに越境感染が確認された事例であり、国際的拡大のリスクが現実化しているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本事例の主な舞台はケニア（発症確認地）とウガンダ（感染者渡航元）だが、両国は対象国リストに含まれない。感染源とされるDRCのブンディブギョ型エボラアウトブレイク（5月以降継続中）が対象国リストに該当するため、これのみverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: चाकसू में लम्पी का खतरा, स्कूल के पास खुले में मिले संक्रमित बताए जा रहे गोवंश
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chaksu Faces Risk of Lumpy Skin Disease; Infected Cattle Reportedly Found in the Open Near a School.
article.articleSummary: Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) concerns resurfaced in Rajasthan after suspected LSD-affected cattle were seen grazing near a government school in Brijpura village under Kothoon Gram Panchayat, Chaksu rural area, Jaipur district. Infected animals were roaming openly near a school, raising fears of rapid transmission to nearby cattle and potential risk to children. Residents are demanding urgent veterinary action: identify symptomatic cattle, isolate them, and deploy field veterinary teams to inspect livestock in homes and enclosures to break the transmission chain. Experts stress rapid vaccination and sanitation as critical control measures. If authorities delay, livestock owners could incur substantial economic and emotional losses. The report does not provide specific case counts or fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: チャクスーでランピースキン病の危機、学校付近の野外で感染牛が見つかったとされる
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（ランピースキン病）であり人獣共通感染症ではなく人への直接的な公衆衛生リスクは低いが、家畜への感染拡大や経済的影響が懸念され、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ランピースキン病は牛の感染症であり人には感染しない。家畜経済への影響と地域住民の懸念が報じられているが、具体的な症例数・死亡数は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Alerte sanitaire: premier cas d'Ebola au Kenya, le CDC Afrique appelle à la vigilance , H24info
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health alert: first Ebola case in Kenya, Africa CDC urges vigilance, H24info
article.articleSummary: First Ebola case confirmed in Kenya as of 7 October 2026. A Nairobi patient, originating in the Democratic Republic of Congo and transiting through Uganda, marks Kenya’s initial Ebola case and underscores regional cross-border risk. The Kenyan Health Ministry announced the confirmed infection, while Africa CDC deployed a high-level multidisciplinary team to Kenya to support surveillance, cross-border information sharing, laboratory preparedness, rapid response capacity, and infection prevention and control measures. CDC Africa urged sustained vigilance across the region, calling on member states to strengthen border surveillance, information exchange, laboratory readiness, rapid-response teams, and strict infection control. The agency emphasized ongoing collaboration with DR Congo, Kenya, and partners to interrupt transmission chains and end the outbreak. Community transmission in DR Congo continues to drive the regional response.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生警報：ケニアで初のエボラ症例、アフリカCDCが警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目に該当し、DRCでのコミュニティ感染継続と越境伝播によりケニアで初症例が確認されたため、国際的拡大リスクの高い重大シグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ケニアおよびウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただしDRCでのコミュニティ感染継続が本事例の起源かつ地域拡大の中心であるため含めた。続報でケニア国内の伝播状況や渡航制限措置の有無を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Roche-Aktie höher: Konzern liefert Laborausrüstung für Ebola-Tests in den Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Roche shares rise: Group supplies lab equipment for Ebola tests in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Roche is aiding the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo by providing two molecular-testing devices to the national institute INSP. After training local laboratory staff in Bunia, the equipment will be used to field-test a Roche-developed PCR assay for Bundibugyo ebolavirus on site. The assay detects viral RNA and is currently intended for research purposes and not yet approved for clinical diagnostics. If the on-site evaluation demonstrates reliability, Roche will supply additional tests and devices to bolster testing capacity. The ongoing outbreak, first reported in May, is the largest Ebola outbreak on record in the DRC, with nearly 8,000 infections and about 3,800 deaths reported by the end of September. The epidemic spans 63 health zones across seven provinces, with Ituri province among the hardest hit. The World Health Organization classifies the overall outbreak risk as very high.

triage.headline_ja: ロシュ株価上昇:同社がコンゴのエボラ検査用ラボ機器を提供
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行（感染者約8000人、死亡約3800人）が継続中で、WHOがアウトブレイクリスクを「非常に高い」と分類しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 本記事は製薬企業の検査機器供与に関する報道だが、背景として記載されているエボラ流行自体がDRC史上最大規模であり、既にWHOが高リスクと評価していることから、継続中のアウトブレイク状況として評価した。

article.articleHeadline: 'จีน' เผยครั้งแรก กำลังประสานงานกับ 'รัสเซีย' เรื่องกาฬโรค อย่างใกล้ชิด
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China reveals for the first time that it is coordinating closely with Russia on the plague.
article.articleSummary: China coordinates with Russia on plague response after a 28-year-old laboratory worker died of severe pneumonia. Mongolia’s health ministry says the risk along the Mongolia–Russia border is low and border security and health surveillance will continue in cooperation with relevant agencies. Irkutsk region sits along Mongolia’s northern border and connects to China by air and rail, with its capital as a transport hub; the Chinese consulate in Irkutsk has not commented. Local media alleged the deceased may have contracted Yersinia pestis (plague) following a laboratory incident, but Russian public health authorities report no lab accidents involving dangerous microbes and that detailed testing of the woman’s samples found no microbes linked to her work. The update underscores cross-border health monitoring and cooperation while authorities investigate the infection source and whether any imported or exported cases are involved; no plague confirmation has been established in the report.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、ロシアとペストについて緊密に連携していることを初めて明らかに
triage.triage_reason: 疑いのあるペスト（Yersinia pestis）による死亡例が発生し、ロシア・モンゴル・中国国境地域での越境監視・外交的対応が行われているため、国際的拡大リスクの観点からフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 事例発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州（対象国外）。中国は外交的連携・監視協力の立場であり、実際の感染発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。ペスト確定診断は未確定（検査では病原体検出なしと報告）。

article.articleHeadline: Sudinkes Jaktim waspadai kasus DBD saat peralihan musim
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East Jakarta Health Office warns of dengue fever cases during the seasonal transition.
article.articleSummary: East Jakarta (Jakarta Timur) reports dengue fever transmission amid the dry-to-rainy-season transition. In August 2026, 48 dengue cases were recorded with 11 hospitalizations (20–26 August). January–August 2026 saw five dengue deaths: Pulogadung (2), Cakung (1), Ciracas (1), Matraman (1). Cakung district has the highest case count at 360; Matraman exhibits the highest incidence rate at 141.68 per 100,000 with 259 cases. Age distribution centers on 20–44 years (~33%), with school-age groups (5–19) also substantially affected. Seasonal patterns show increases early in the year with peaks around May–June; 2025 peaked in July; 2026 rose January–March, then declined April–May, with a downturn in July–August. Environmental factors—abundant mosquito breeding sites, climate, rainfall—coupled with high population density and mobility drive transmission. Public health messages emphasize reducing standing water and mosquito breeding around homes and activity areas.

triage.headline_ja: 東ジャカルタ保健局、季節の変わり目におけるデング熱（DBD）症例に警戒
triage.triage_reason: 東ジャカルタで季節性のデング熱流行が報告されているが、これはインドネシアにおける例年の季節変動の範囲内であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。ただし媒介蚊の存在と人口密度の高さから継続的な感染拡大の可能性があり、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドネシアの風土病であり、季節性の増加は例年見られるパターン。今回の報告も行政区レベルの定例的な公衆衛生広報であり、特段の異常事態を示す情報はない。今後の症例数・死亡者数の推移を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Eerste ebola-dode in Kenia, slachtoffer mogelijk niet opgemerkt bij screening op luchthaven
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First Ebola death in Kenya, victim possibly not detected at airport screening.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first Ebola death; the victim who fell ill about a month after being in the Democratic Republic of Congo traveled overland to Kampala, Uganda, with the border closed since May and the crossing method unclear. From Uganda he flew to Nairobi, Kenya, where a relative brought him to hospital. Laboratory tests confirmed Ebola virus disease; he presented with fever, subcutaneous bleeding, and muscle pain and was placed in isolation. The case represents an imported Ebola infection in Kenya, illustrating cross border transmission from DRC through Uganda to Kenya and highlighting potential gaps in airport screening if an outbreak traveler is not detected. Kenyan authorities are monitoring contacts and coordinating public health measures as the response continues.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで初のエボラ死亡例、空港検疫で見逃された可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国由来のエボラ感染者がウガンダを経由してケニアに入国し死亡した越境感染事例であり、空港検疫の限界が示されたため、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 本事例はケニアで発生した輸入エボラ症例であり、感染経路はDRC→ウガンダ→ケニア。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれず、DRCは感染者の出国元であり発生地ではないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。空港スクリーニングの限界が指摘されており、国際的な拡大リスクへの懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ucraina, nuovi raid russi su Kyiv. Sotto osservazione il caso di peste in Siberia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ukraine, new Russian raids on Kyiv. A case of plague in Siberia is under observation.
article.articleSummary: Two deaths in Kyiv after a renewed Russian attack, with 161 missiles and drones neutralized and strikes across at least 18 localities; Pryluky reports 2 dead and 7 wounded. Russia claims hits on cruise-missile production/storage and drone infrastructure, plus port facilities in Odessa. Ukraine counters with an operation; Moscow says it intercepted 311 drones over several regions and waters. A drone attack on a tanker off Sochi sparked a fire; all 23 crew rescued; Kyiv did not claim that operation. North Korea’s Kim Jong Un renewed support for Russia, pledging deeper cooperation and criticizing US aid to Kyiv and arms sales to Taiwan. A Guardian investigation alleges about 176,000 tons of fuel transferred from South Korea to Russia’s Far East in July–August, not clearly violating sanctions. In Irkutsk, Siberia, a suspected pneumonic plague case remains under observation; US seeks clarifications; Trump to discuss with Putin; China in contact; no outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ウクライナ、キーウへのロシアの新たな空爆。シベリアでのペスト疑い症例を観察中
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はウクライナ戦争に関する軍事情勢であり、言及されているシベリア（ロシア）での肺ペスト疑い症例は対象国リストに含まれず、かつ「アウトブレイクなし」と明記されているため見送りとする。
triage.notes: シベリア（ロシア）での肺ペスト疑い症例は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事自体も地政学・軍事情勢が主題であり、感染症イベントとしての詳細情報（症例数、感染経路、対応状況等）はほぼ不明。続報があれば再評価を検討。

article.articleHeadline: العالم من حولنا - وفاة أول حالة مصابة بفيروس الإيبولا في كينيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The World Around Us - Death of Kenya's first case of Ebola virus infection.
article.articleSummary: On 7 October 2026, Kenya confirms its first imported case of Ebola virus disease (EVD) in a Kenyan citizen who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo and arrived in Nairobi last Saturday. The patient presented with fever, chills, and bleeding under the skin, was rapidly isolated in hospital, but died several days later from Ebola infection. Health Minister Aden Douali announced the confirmed case and Kenya’s first EVD death. WHO and partners are reinforcing Kenya’s preparedness and response capacity. In neighboring DRC, UN OCHA reports ongoing UN and partner support to broaden the outbreak response, with Ituri and North Kivu provinces together accounting for more than 94% of new cases in the country. No laboratory specifics or vaccination details are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: 私たちの周りの世界 - ケニアで初のエボラウイルス感染者が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ流行に由来する国際的な感染拡大（ケニアへの輸入症例・死亡）が確認されており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただし記事の主題はDRCで継続中のエボラ流行とその越境拡大であり、DRC（特にIturiおよび北キブ州）の状況が実質的な発生地域として含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: US Embassy issues Ebola alert as Kenya traces 28 contacts
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first imported Bundibugyo virus disease case on Oct 6; the patient, a Kenyan citizen who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo, traveled by road to Uganda and arrived in Nairobi Oct 3, where they were isolated after testing positive at the National Virology Reference Laboratory and the Kenya Medical Research Institute. The patient died Oct 5 and was buried Oct 6 per Ebola burial protocol. Health authorities have identified 28 contacts, including family and healthcare workers, and are tracing 23 passengers and four crew members from the Uganda–Nairobi flight JM8523. WHO notes strengthened surveillance, with more than 652,000 travellers screened, 267 suspected samples tested, and about 5,000 health workers trained; 27 high‑risk counties have isolation units. No approved vaccines or treatments exist; candidate products are in trials. US Embassy issued guidance urging exposure-informed care seeking and 21‑day monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: 米国大使館がエボラ警報を発令、ケニアは28人の接触者を追跡
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで輸入エボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス病）の確定症例が死亡し、国際的な接触者追跡（航空機乗客含む）が行われているため、IHR基準を複数満たすシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 確定・死亡例はケニアで発生しているが、ケニアは対象国リスト外のため除外。患者はDRCに居住しており、現行のDRCにおけるエボラ（ブンディブギョウ株）アウトブレイクに由来する可能性が高いためDRCを検証済み地域とした。ウガンダ・ケニアでの詳細な感染拡大状況は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, primo morto in Kenya: l'Oms rafforza la risposta, parte il trial del vaccino contro Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: first death in Kenya; WHO strengthens the response as Bundibugyo vaccine trial begins.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first Ebola Bundibugyo virus case, resulting in death, with 6 Oct IHR notification and contact tracing for 28 contacts plus 23 passengers and 4 crew on the Kampala–Nairobi flight. The patient, a Kenyan citizen living in the DRC, fell ill there, traveled via Kampala to Nairobi, and was hospitalized and isolated; laboratory tests at Kenya’s National Virology Reference Laboratory and KEMRI confirmed Bundibugyo virus. The patient died on 5 Oct and was buried on 6 Oct. Kenya has intensified response activities: over 652,000 travelers screened, 267 suspected samples analyzed, about 5,000 health workers trained, isolation units in 27 counties, and 1,000 diagnostic tests alongside 1,000 PPE kits delivered; preparedness index rose from 66% to 82% (May–July). WHO and Africa CDC advise no travel or trade restrictions; cross-border surveillance and lab capacity are being reinforced. In DRC, 8,603 cases and 4,148 deaths (Ituri 6,450/2,968; North Kivu 1,729/1,005) with community transmission >70%. On 6 Oct, Uganda’s Masaka hosts the ChAdOx1 BDBV vaccine trial, enrolling initial African participants.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ケニアで初の死亡例、WHOが対応強化、ブンディブギョ株ワクチン治験開始
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで初のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）死亡例が確認され、国境を越えた渡航者接触歴があり、DRCでは大規模流行が継続中であるためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 主要発生国はDRC（進行中の大規模流行、感染者8,603人・死者4,148人）。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外したが、国際拡大の文脈として重要。

article.articleHeadline: Ruto ordena reforzar la respuesta contra el ébola tras detectarse el primer caso en Kenia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ruto orders bolstering of the Ebola response after the first case was detected in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first imported Ebola case, a 40-year-old Kenyan who died in Nairobi after traveling from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) via Uganda. President William Ruto ordered a strengthened Ebola response, with the National Security Council (NSCC) meeting to boost surveillance, contact tracing, and public-health measures. Eight relatives and twenty-one healthcare workers are under quarantine; 27 passengers from the same flight (Jambojet, from Kampala) have been identified for contact tracing. The patient was buried in Langata Cemetery under strict protocols. Kenya has screened 652,584 travelers and tested 267 samples since the DRC outbreak began in May, with one positive result—the deceased. The DRC outbreak has 8,544 cases and 4,114 deaths across seven provinces: Ituri, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, North Kivu, South Kivu, and South Ubangi. Uganda’s linked outbreak ended Aug 26 with 20 cases and 2 deaths. Symptoms include fever, severe headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, and unexplained bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: ルト大統領、ケニアで初のエボラ症例確認を受けエボラ対応の強化を指示
triage.triage_reason: DRCの大規模エボラアウトブレイク（8,544症例、4,114死亡）が国境を越えてケニアに輸入症例として到達し、国際的拡大と重大な公衆衛生インパクトが確認されたため。
triage.notes: ケニアおよびウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCの進行中のアウトブレイクが主要な感染源であり、国際的な波及（ウガンダ経由ケニアへの輸入例）が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Health Ministry to Launch JOSH Teams for TB Elimination on 8 October 2026
article.articleSummary: India's Ministry of Health and Family Welfare will launch JOSH Teams (Joint Squad for Health) in New Delhi on 8 October 2026 to advance TB elimination under the TB Mukt Bharat campaign. The initiative, unveiled by Union Health Minister J. P. Nadda, mobilizes youth to enhance TB awareness, community mobilisation, early symptom identification, timely diagnosis, treatment completion, and stigma reduction, bringing health messages to grassroots levels. In its first phase, JOSH will operate in 55 districts across 11 states, with emphasis on block- and community-level outreach and youth-led mobilisation beyond health facilities. Participants include MY Bharat Volunteers and NCC Cadets who will disseminate information on TB symptoms, prevention, testing, and adherence. TB Mukt Bharat aims to improve awareness, screening, diagnosis, treatment access and adherence through strengthened community participation.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、2026年10月8日にTB撲滅のためのJOSHチームを発足
triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核対策プログラムの広報・啓発活動に関する政策発表であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威や異常な発生を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 政府主導の既存のTB撲滅キャンペーン（TB Mukt Bharat）の一環としての啓発プログラム発足であり、感染症アウトブレイクの検知情報ではないため対象国リストへの計上は不要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Challenges for the effectiveness of infectious disease interventions during global change - Communications Health
article.articleSummary: Global change undermines infectious disease interventions by altering the fundamental transmission dynamics. Interventions act as ecological suppressors that reduce contact rate (c) or transmission probability (p) to keep the reproduction number below unity, but changes in global drivers can raise Rt. Novel transmission pathways, climate and land-use shifts, and disrupted deployment can all erode effectiveness. Tick-borne disease risk may rise as climate/land-use expand host availability and geographic ranges. In Brazil, malaria prevalence has increased among garimpo miners lacking education and resources. Vaccine and antibiotic effectiveness may shift with environmental factors; poliovirus vaccine responses can depend on temperature, complicating population immunity. Antimicrobial resistance accelerates under warming during mass drug administration due to horizontal gene transfer. Disruptions from cyclones, droughts, or conflict raise logistics costs, impair cold chains, and hinder immunizations and surveillance, with potential for backward bifurcation in TB and undetected outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: グローバルな環境変化における感染症対策の有効性に対する課題 - Communications Health
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生事象ではなく、気候変動・環境変化が感染症対策に与える影響を論じた総説的な学術記事であり、個別の公衆衛生緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: ブラジルのガリンポ鉱夫におけるマラリア増加に言及しているが、これは事例として引用されたものであり、記事全体は学術的な総説（レビュー論文）であるため、個別の感染症発生イベントとしてのトリアージ対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Roche Boosts Ebola Testing In Congo Region With Molecular Equipment As Outbreak Spreads
article.articleSummary: Roche Diagnostics provided two molecular testing instruments to the Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to bolster the Ebola response to Bundibugyo virus. The setup includes the LightCycler System for PCR amplification and detection and the MagNA Pure system for automated nucleic acid purification, with deployment to Bunia for validation testing by trained local technicians. The June-announced Research Use Only (RUO) molecular PCR test targeting Bundibugyo virus is not approved for diagnostics; following local validation, Roche expects to ship additional tests and deploy more instruments in the DRC. United Nations figures show 8,067 confirmed cases and 3,901 deaths across seven provinces as of September 28. Challenges include insecurity, population movement, and transport bottlenecks for samples. Bundibugyo virus, an Ebola virus species, spreads via contact with infected people, bodily fluids, or contaminated materials.

triage.headline_ja: ロシュ、コンゴ地域でのエボラ検査体制を分子機器で強化、感染拡大が続く中
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）アウトブレイクが拡大中で、確定8,067例・死亡3,901例と深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当する。
triage.notes: WHO・国連データでDRC全7州にわたる大規模アウトブレイクと確認。人口移動や治安悪化がさらなる拡大リスクを高めており、Rocheなど国際的な支援が既に動員されている。フルリスク評価が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: OMS cere Rusiei informații despre moartea unei cercetătoare din Siberia. Ce este ciuma pneumonică și cât de periculoasă este - Știrile ProTV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO asks Russia for information about the death of a female researcher from Siberia. What is pneumonic plague and how dangerous is it - ProTV News
article.articleSummary: Death of a female researcher from Siberia prompts scrutiny over pneumonic plague. Russian authorities say the cause of death is under investigation and all contacts tested negative for pneumonic plague, while the WHO requests information. Pneumonic plague, the most acute form of plague, causes severe pneumonia with fever, chest pain, and coughing blood; it can arise from bubonic or septicemic forms. Globally, 1,000–3,000 plague cases are estimated annually, predominantly bubonic in Central Africa, but cases occur in Russia, India, China, and the United States. The Yersinia pestis bacterium persists in animal reservoirs; transmission to humans can occur via infected fleas, and pneumonic plague enables human-to-human spread through respiratory droplets, with incubation as short as 24 hours. Without prompt diagnosis and antibiotic treatment, pneumonic plague is almost always fatal, though timely antibiotics improve outcomes. U.S. travel advisories caution Americans about travel to Russia amid safety concerns.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがロシアに対し、シベリアの女性研究者の死亡に関する情報提供を要請。肺ペストとは何か、その危険性は
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストは致死率が高く人―人感染のリスクもある重篤な感染症であり、WHOがロシアに情報提供を求めるなど社会的・国際的関心が高まっているため、フルリスク評価に進むべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 死亡事例はロシア・シベリアで発生しており、対象国リスト（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ、ガーナ、DRC、ブラジル、インドネシア、中国、ミャンマー、ベトナム、インド）には該当しない。記事中で言及される中国・インドは一般的な世界的ペスト発生状況の文脈であり、今回のイベントの発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。接触者の検査は陰性であり、現時点で国際的拡大の証拠はない。

article.articleHeadline: Температура под 40 и сильная ломота: Россиянка заболела денге на отдыхе во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever below 40°C and severe body aches: Russian woman contracted dengue while on vacation in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: A Russian tourist from Lyubertsy was hospitalized in Da Nang, Vietnam with dengue fever. The patient presented with fever up to 39–40°C and severe body aches; antipyretics failed to help, and infection was confirmed by tests. Dengue is transmitted by mosquito bites, not via air or casual contact; the exact bite time is unknown, and symptoms typically appear 4–10 days after the bite. A febrile phase lowering does not guarantee recovery; after fever subsides, severe dengue signs may develop, including intense abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, rapid breathing, and bleeding, requiring urgent medical care. Re-infection raises the risk of severe disease. In Russia, 127 imported dengue cases were recorded January–May 2026, all among travelers from dengue-endemic countries. Travelers are advised to protect against mosquito bites and ensure bed nets are in place at accommodations.

triage.headline_ja: 40度近い高熱と激しい関節痛:ベトナム旅行中にデング熱に罹患したロシア人女性
triage.triage_reason: 単一の輸入症例報告であり、ベトナムにおけるデング熱は地域の風土病として既知であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当せず特段の社会的関心の高まりも見られない。
triage.notes: 記事は個別のロシア人旅行者の輸入症例を報じたもので、ベトナム国内での流行拡大や異常事態を示す情報は含まれていない。ロシア（Lyubertsy, Moscow Oblast）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 泰国现非洲猪瘟病例　猪农促保护本地养猪业　禁从疫情国进口猪肉|光华网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thailand reports African swine fever cases; pig farmers call for safeguarding the local pig-raising industry; ban pork imports from outbreak-affected countries | Guanghua Net
article.articleSummary: Thailand has ongoing African swine fever (ASF) outbreaks, including new cases reported in August after several years of activity; floods worsen risk. In Penang, Malaysia, pig-farmers fear introduction of ASF via imported chilled pork from outbreak countries and urge a government ban on such imports. Penang Pig Farmers Association chairman Wang Fusheng said the Ping An Village area hosts about 63 pig farms, part of over 100 farms in the state, with production returning to roughly 70–80% of pre-ASF levels. Local prices have fallen from about RM17.50 per kg in April to about RM12.50–13.00 per kg. The industry stresses that the policy should target imports from ASF-affected countries rather than wholesale prohibition; four licensed importers currently bring in chilled Thai pork, under a compartment approach. Advisor Chen Mingfu argues for stronger biosecurity and diversifying to non-ASF sources; Vietnam has already imposed bans, and Sarawak supplies the peninsula.

triage.headline_ja: タイで非洲豚熱（ASF）感染確認、養豚業者が地元養豚業保護を要求し、流行国からの豚肉輸入禁止を求める
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）は動物感染症でありヒトへの感染性はないため公衆衛生上の直接的脅威とは言えないが、タイでの継続的流行と地域貿易・バイオセキュリティへの影響があり、今後の拡大動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ASFはヒトに感染しない動物疾病であり、本記事は主にマレーシア・ペナン州の養豚業者による経済的懸念と輸入規制の要望を扱っている。タイでの実際の発生が確認されているが、マレーシア・ベトナムは輸入禁止措置等の対応に留まり、対象国リストに含まれるベトナムでの発生は確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: UNICEF warns Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC leaves nearly 2,000 children orphaned as Kenya records first case
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has orphaned nearly 2,000 children and left many more without caregivers, with the epidemic declared in May. More than 1,900 boys and girls have lost one or both parents; 1,581 of them are in North Kivu, the outbreak’s epicentre. UNICEF notes children make up just over a quarter of confirmed Ebola cases but about one-third of deaths, with under-fives facing about a seven-in-ten fatality rate. As of 29 September, at least 2,017 children were confirmed with Ebola in the DRC and 1,062 had died. UNICEF operates 12 nurseries in Ituri and North Kivu to provide food, care, and rapid pediatric monitoring, and urges similar facilities at every Ebola treatment centre. Kenya confirmed its first imported Ebola case and death, likely from the DRC, with WHO teams assisting authorities.

triage.headline_ja: ユニセフ、DRC東部でのエボラ流行により約2,000人の子どもが孤児になったと警告、ケニアでも初の感染例を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部のエボラ流行が継続・拡大しており、国境を越えてケニアに初の輸入症例・死亡例が確認されたため、国際的拡大のリスクが現実化している。
triage.notes: ケニアでの輸入症例確認はDRCにおける流行の国際拡大リスクを示す重要な兆候だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。WHOチームがケニア当局を支援中との記述があり、国際的な懸念・対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Plućna kuga: Smrt laboratorijske radnice u Rusiji otvorila pitanja - kako se prenosi kuga i koji su simptomi?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumonic plague: The death of a female laboratory technician in Russia has raised questions — how is the plague transmitted and what are the symptoms?
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, is the dangerous form and spreads via droplets in close contact. A female laboratory technician at a plague institute in Irkutsk has died; authorities report pneumonia of unknown origin and have not confirmed plague as the cause. WHO, October 2026, deems Russia’s outbreak risk low and Europe’s low. Transmission includes fleas and contact with infected animal tissues, but human-to-human spread occurs through coughing. Symptoms typically appear within 1–3 days and include fever, headache, weakness, cough, shortness of breath, chest pain, and watery or blood-tinged sputum. Early antibiotics within 24 hours are crucial; regimens typically run 10–14 days with ciprofloxacin or gentamicin. Post-exposure prophylaxis for contacts is common (~7 days). Vaccination is not routine; some high-risk groups may be immunized; vaccines are not yet available in the US. Prevention emphasizes flea/rodent control, protecting pets, isolation, and contact surveillance. 2019–2025 cases occurred in DRC and Madagascar.

triage.headline_ja: 肺ペスト：ロシアの研究所職員の女性の死亡がペストの感染経路や症状についての疑問を呼んでいる
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクのペスト研究所職員の死亡事例だが、当局は死因（ペストかどうか）を確認しておらず、WHOもロシア・欧州のアウトブレイクリスクを低いと評価している。対象国（DRC等）は過去の症例として言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではないため情報不足として経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア（イルクーツク）での研究所職員の死亡事例であり、死因は未確定（肺炎の可能性）。DRCやマダガスカルは2019〜2025年の過去の症例として言及されているのみで、本記事の現発生国ではないため対象国リストには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Belgian virologist highlights ongoing plague cases in Africa | WTX News
article.articleSummary: Belgian virologist Marc Van Ranst notes that plague remains an ongoing issue in Africa, with annual cases reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Madagascar, challenging the view of plague as a medieval relic. He says the recently discussed Siberia plague outbreak is an isolated incident, but a laboratory link makes this case a little more serious. Van Ranst emphasizes that annual plague activity in the DRC and Madagascar signals persistent endemic risk. He also commented on COVID-19's impact this winter, stating the virus has returned in a milder form and that he does not expect a winter like 2020 or 2021.

triage.headline_ja: ベルギーの ウイルス学者、アフリカで続くペスト発生事例を指摘 | WTX News
triage.triage_reason: DRCおよびマダガスカルでの年次流行は既知のエンデミック状況であり、新規性・異常性がない専門家コメント記事。社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事はベルギー人専門家によるコメント・解説記事であり、DRC・マダガスカルでの年次ペスト発生は既知のエンデミック現象。シベリアの事例は孤立例かつ対象国リスト外（ロシア）。COVID-19に関する言及も軽症化傾向を示すのみで新規性なし。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تسجل أول وفاة بإيبولا وسط تحركات لاحتواء التفشي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records its first Ebola death amid efforts to contain the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 October 2026, Kenya reports its first Ebola virus disease (EVD) case and its first death, involving a man who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The patient had lived in the DRC for seven years and was infected about a month prior, receiving treatment at several hospitals before traveling by land to Kampala, Uganda, and then by air to Nairobi, Kenya. Kenyan health authorities launched urgent contact tracing and raised border screening to curb further transmission. The event is an imported case linked to the ongoing DRC outbreak region, prompting cross-border surveillance as Kenya works to contain the outbreak and prevent additional cases.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラによる初の死亡例を記録 ― アウトブレイク封じ込めに向けた動き
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラアウトブレイクに関連する患者がウガンダ経由でケニアに越境入国し死亡した初の症例であり、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大・渡航制限）を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本件の感染源はDRCで継続中のエボラアウトブレイクであり、患者はウガンダ（カンパラ）を経由してケニア（ナイロビ）に入国後に死亡が確認された。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、国境を越えた拡大事例として監視強化が必要。

article.articleHeadline: "Возможен летальный исход": тюменцы привезли из отпуска опасные инфекции
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Fatal outcome possible": Tyumen residents brought dangerous infections back from vacation.
article.articleSummary: Since the start of the year, residents of Tyumen Oblast have imported malaria and dengue from overseas, with infections traced to travelers returning from South Africa and Thailand. The regional Rospotrebnadzor reports no exact case count publicly disclosed. Malaria is transmitted by infected female Anopheles mosquitoes, with symptoms typically appearing 7–15 days after a bite, including fever, chills, headache, nausea, and in severe cases seizures and cough; without timely treatment, malaria can progress to life-threatening disease. Dengue fever, also mosquito-borne, is common in tropical and subtropical climates such as Southeast Asia and Africa. Initial dengue symptoms include high fever, followed by body aches, joint pain, nausea, vomiting, rash and itching. The article underscores the risk of imported infections and the potential for fatal outcomes if malaria is not treated promptly. No laboratory confirmation details are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: 「死亡例もあり得る」：チュメニ住民が休暇先から危険な感染症を持ち帰る
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・チュメニ州在住者が海外（南アフリカ・タイ）渡航後にマラリア・デング熱の輸入症例を発生させたという内容で、対象国での発生事例ではなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクも確認できない。
triage.notes: 本事例はロシア（チュメニ州）での輸入症例報告であり、感染発生国として言及される南アフリカ・タイは対象国リストに含まれる（タイのみ）が、タイ国内で発生したイベントではなく、ロシア人旅行者の渡航先として言及されているに過ぎないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Pharmacists told to heighten vigilance as Kenya confirms imported Ebola case
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first imported Ebola case, Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease, from the DRC. The patient traveled from DRC to Kampala by road and flew to Kenya on Oct 3 and died after confirmation. 27 contacts (family, healthcare workers) traced and isolated; 23 passengers and 4 crew from Uganda-Kenya flight traced. As of Oct 6, screening 652,584 travellers and 267 samples tested across five laboratories. Pharmacists urged to heighten vigilance: Recognise. Protect. Refer. Report. Maintain suspicion for fever or fatigue, ascertain travel/exposure history, minimize contact, avoid invasive procedures, ensure PPE, hand hygiene, environmental cleaning, waste handling. Do not direct suspected cases to move between sites; separate as safely practicable and refer to public health pathways. Toll-free line 719 for information; confidentiality must be protected. The government has said it had maintained a high level of alert since the current Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak was reported in the DRC in May.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアが輸入エボラ症例を確認、薬剤師に警戒強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち3項目（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大）に該当し、DRCで継続中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクがウガンダ経由でケニアに越境し死亡例も発生しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアでの輸入症例対応だが、感染源である流行はDRCで5月から継続中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクであるため、実際の発生国としてDRCを採用した。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: China y EEUU se mantienen alerta sobre el supuesto caso de peste pulmonar en Rusia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China and the United States remain on alert over the suspected case of pneumonic plague in Russia.
article.articleSummary: Possible pneumonic plague case in Russia's Siberia—Irkutsk region—sparks cross-border alerts. A 28-year-old female employee of the Institute of Plague Research in Irkutsk and the Far East died last week in Shélejov; authorities are evaluating whether she contracted Yersinia pestis in Thailand or via a lab accident involving a broken test tube. Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor describes the illness as pneumonia of undetermined etiology and reports no infections among contacts; the regional epidemiological situation is labeled stable after emergency measures. China says it maintains close cooperation with Russia on disease prevention and control. The United States CDC and the State Department are monitoring developments; the CDC says pneumonic plague is treatable with antibiotics if detected promptly and can spread through droplets, stressing rapid identification and contact tracing. The ECDC notes transmission generally requires close, prolonged contact; no sustained transmission evidence yet.

triage.headline_ja: 中国と米国、ロシアにおける肺ペスト疑い症例について警戒を継続
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州でペスト研究所職員が死亡し、原因病原体（Yersinia pestis）の可能性が示唆されており、中国・米国が警戒を続けていることから、重大性と異常性の両方でIHR基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 実際の発症・死亡はロシア（イルクーツク州）で発生しており、対象国リストに含まれない。タイでの感染経路は未確定の推測であり、発生地域として確認されていないため、verified_locationsには含めない。中国・米国は監視・協力の立場であり、発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Po smrti ruske laborantke sum na pljučno kugo: kako nevarna je? - Svet24.si
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After the death of a Russian lab technician, suspicion of pneumonic plague: how dangerous is it?
article.articleSummary: In Irkutsk, Russia, 28-year-old Daria Šipilova, staff at the Irkutsk Institute of Plague Research, died on October 2 from severe pneumonia of unknown origin. Authorities placed about 200 contacts under health surveillance amid speculation of pneumonic plague, which can spread person-to-person. No laboratory confirmation of Yersinia pestis or plague has been made; Russian authorities told WHO Irkutsk had not confirmed a plague case, and WHO says public risk is low. Pneumonic plague is highly dangerous and transmits via respiratory droplets; rapid isolation and early antibiotics are critical for close contacts. Symptoms may include abrupt fever, weakness, cough, chest pain, and bloody sputum, with incubation possibly as short as 24 hours and untreated mortality in 18–24 hours. Plague persists globally, with more cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Madagascar; natural reservoirs exist in Asia and elsewhere.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人検査技師の死亡後、肺ペストの疑い：その危険性は？
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究所職員が原因不明の重症肺炎で死亡し、約200人が健康観察下に置かれるなど異常性が高く、確定診断前ながら国際的関心（WHOへの報告）も見られるためフルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア・イルクーツクであり対象国リストに含まれない。DRC・マダガスカルは記事中で『世界的にペストが依然存在する』という背景情報としてのみ言及されており、本事例の発生地ではないため除外した。ラボ検体のYersinia pestis確認は未了でWHOはリスクを低いとしている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: NCDC raises alert after Kenya confirms imported case
article.articleSummary: Ebola caused by Bundibugyo virus has been confirmed in Kenya, linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak. A Kenyan citizen who lived in DRC travelled from Kampala to Nairobi, where he was isolated and tested positive; he died. The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC) says there is no Ebola case in Nigeria as of October 6, 2026, but heightens vigilance over importation via travel and movement. The Kenyan case underscores evolving regional transmission and prompts Nigeria to review and strengthen preparedness, including early detection, isolation, laboratory diagnosis, infection prevention and control, contact tracing, and risk communication; a tabletop exercise has been conducted. Healthcare workers should maintain high suspicion for Ebola with compatible symptoms within 21 days of travel, isolate suspected cases, and use PPE. Public guidance emphasizes hand hygiene, avoiding contact with blood or body fluids and bushmeat, and prompt care if unwell after travel.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ケニアが輸入症例を確認し、ナイジェリアCDCが警戒レベルを引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで continuingのエボラ流行がケニアへ越境し死亡例が発生、国際的拡大が確認されたためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでの進行中の流行が国際的に拡大した事例として評価。続報でケニア国内の二次感染有無・渡航制限措置の有無を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Кения с първи смъртен случай от ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya reports its first Ebola death.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first Ebola death: a 40-year-old Kenyan businessman who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo fell ill and died in Nairobi on 6 October 2026 at 23:30 local time. He had been ill for about a month, was treated in the DRC, and traveled by land to Kampala, Uganda, before boarding a flight to Nairobi on 3 October. Symptoms included fever, chills, severe fatigue, weakness, muscle pains, painful swallowing, sore throat and subcutaneous bleeding at injection sites. The DRC declared its 17th Ebola outbreak in May. Uganda reported 20 cases and two deaths before being declared Ebola-free in August. Kenya has identified 28 contacts; none tested positive. Authorities are tracing 23 passengers and four crew from the same flight and considering quarantine for those at risk. Africa CDC is sending a team; Director-General Jean Kaseya will visit, and a safe, dignified burial is planned for later Tuesday.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱による初の死亡例
triage.triage_reason: DRCの第17次エボラ流行に関連した輸入症例がケニアで死亡し、国境を越えた渡航者・乗務員の接触者追跡が行われていることから、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 本事例はケニアで発生した死亡例だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であるDRCの第17次エボラ流行が直接関連する主題であるため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。ウガンダも経由地として言及されるが対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: How COVID-19 May Open the Door to a Dangerous Gut Infection
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 and Clostridioides difficile infection (CDI), the leading cause of antibiotic-associated diarrhea and healthcare-associated colitis, are linked through treatment-related and direct viral effects. A mini-review from Brazil’s Federal University of Ceará and the University of Virginia synthesizes evidence that SARS-CoV-2 infection and related care—broad-spectrum antibiotics, corticosteroids, and prolonged ICU stays—may create a gut environment conducive to CDI. Three scenarios are distinguished: co-infection with active C. difficile toxin, CDI developing during hospitalization for COVID-19, and delayed or recurrent CDI after recovery. Antibiotics remain the strongest CDI risk factor by depleting colonization resistance and disrupting bile acid metabolism; primary bile acids promote spore germination, while secondary bile acids suppress growth. SARS-CoV-2 may perturb the gut directly via intestinal ACE2, altering barrier integrity and microbiome; ACE2 loss shifts renin-angiotensin signaling, increasing angiotensin II/AT1R–driven inflammation, permeability, and mucosal damage. Inflammatory cascades (NF-κB, MAPK, IL-6) and nutritional vulnerability are also highlighted as contributors.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19がどのように危険な腸管感染症への扉を開く可能性があるか
triage.triage_reason: 学術的な総説論文であり、特定の国・地域における公衆衛生上の緊急事態や新規アウトブレイクを報じるものではないため、トリアージ対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル連邦セアラ大学と米国バージニア大学の研究者によるミニレビュー論文を紹介する内容で、特定地域での実際の感染症発生事例を報告するものではない。ブラジル・米国は研究機関の所在地であり、発生地域ではないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Asian Hospital hosts two-day workshop on infectious diseases
article.articleSummary: Two-day Asian Combating Infections Workshop 2026 at Asian Institute of Medical Sciences, Faridabad, India, spotlights the rising threat of drug-resistant superbugs. The conference, attended by intensivists, infectious disease physicians, microbiologists, and others, featured 22 sessions on India's infection epidemiology, tropical infections such as dengue and typhoid, and laboratory biomarkers, plus tropical CNS infections. Critical focus centered on managing multi-drug resistant (MDR), extensively drug-resistant (XDR), and pan-drug resistant (PDR) Gram-negative and Gram-positive infections, post-transplant infections, neutropenic sepsis, cytokine storm management, novel antibiotics, and antimicrobial stewardship. The second day covered radiology in infection diagnosis, fungal infections in ICU, and complicated UTIs. The event culminated with the launch of the department’s Infectious Disease book, marking an academic milestone. Speakers including Dr N. K. Pandey and Dr Ramesh Chandna urged ongoing cross-disciplinary training to stay ahead of resistant infections in India.

triage.triage_reason: 本記事は学術ワークショップの開催報告であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクを報じるものではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: США призвали американцев покинуть Россию из-за сообщений о чуме, Трамп пообещал позвонить Путину, а ЕС собрался экстренно обсудить ситуацию
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States urged Americans to leave Russia over reports of plague, Trump promised to call Putin, and the EU planned to hold an emergency meeting to discuss the situation.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 October 2026, the United States warns Americans to immediately leave Russia amid reports of a possible pneumonic plague outbreak in Irkutsk Oblast. The death of Darya Shipilova, a staffer at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute, has been linked to pneumonia of unknown etiology while investigations continue. The US embassy cited concerns over quarantines and hospital closures in Irkutsk and advised avoiding travel to Russia due to safety risks. President Trump said he would call Vladimir Putin soon to discuss the case. The European Union planned an emergency discussion on the suspected plague outbreak at its Health Security Committee on 7 October. China’s foreign ministry spokesperson noted continued cooperation with Russia on plague prevention and control. The WHO notes investigations are ongoing; overall risk to Irkutsk and Russia is low, Europe very low. Central Asian states (Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, Kazakhstan) heightened border health checks.

triage.notes: イベントの主題はロシア・イルクーツク州での肺ペスト疑い事例であり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。中国は「協力継続」の言及のみで発生国ではないため除外した。WHOはイルクーツク・ロシアのリスクを低、欧州を非常に低いと評価しているが、国際的な政治的反応が大きいためPICKUPと判定した。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai : साथीच्या आजारांचा विळखा! चार महिन्यांत मलेरिया, डेंग्यूचा उद्रेक; डासांच्या ३० हजारांहून अधिक अळ्या सापडल्या
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mumbai: The grip of communicable diseases! Malaria and dengue outbreaks in four months; more than 30,000 mosquito larvae found.
article.articleSummary: Malaria 7,422; Dengue 2,941; Leptospirosis 286; Chikungunya 66; H1N1 504; Gastroenteritis 2,194 reported in Mumbai over four months (June–September). Aedes breeding sites: 23,405; Anopheles breeding sites: 6,310; total identified breeding sites 29,715, across 1,044,055 sites inspected. Leptospirosis hotspots include Santacruz-Vakola, Dahisar, Marol, Matunga, Wadala, and Sion, with higher counts in Andheri and Dahisar. Health authorities conducted regular surveys in municipal hospitals and health centers, carried out vector fogging, and targeted elimination of water-logging to reduce transmission. About 63,837 blood samples were sent to laboratories for testing. The report underscores Mumbai’s ongoing burden of vector-borne diseases during the monsoon and highlights intensified preventive measures to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイ：感染症の猛威！4か月でマラリア・デング熱が流行；蚊の幼虫3万匹以上発見
triage.triage_reason: ムンバイで例年のモンスーン期に見られる蚊媒介性疾患（マラリア・デング熱等）の季節的流行であり、行政による対策も継続実施中だが、症例数の規模から経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: ムンバイ市保健当局が自ら調査・対策（蚊の幼虫駆除、噴霧、血液検査等）を実施しており、モンスーン期の季節性疾患として毎年報告される内容。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola alert: NCDC issues warning after Kenya confirms imported case
article.articleSummary: Ebola alert: Nigeria’s NCDC warns as Kenya confirms an imported Bundibugyo virus case tied to an ongoing Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak. As of 6 October 2026, Nigeria has no confirmed Ebola cases, but surveillance and preparedness are being strengthened in collaboration with authorities and partners. Public health guidance emphasizes regular hand hygiene, avoiding contact with blood or body fluids of ill individuals, and not handling the body of someone who died from an unknown illness. People should refrain from handling sick or dead wild animals and from consuming raw or poorly cooked bushmeat. Seek prompt medical care for symptoms suggestive of Ebola or after potential exposure. Continued vigilance and early reporting are critical to detect and contain any potential cases, given the virus transmits primarily via direct contact with blood or body fluids.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報：ケニアが輸入症例を確認後、ナイジェリアNCDCが警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクに関連し、ケニアで国境を越えた輸入症例が確認され、国際的拡大の兆候がみられるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで進行中のエボラアウトブレイクであり、ケニア・ナイジェリアは輸入症例・警戒対応国として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでの発生状況の継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Red Alert! U.S. Embassy issues health advisory to Americans in Kenya after first Ebola case and death
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first Bundibugyo virus disease (Ebola) case and death. The patient, a 40-year-old Kenyan man who had lived in the DRC for seven years, traveled to Kenya via Uganda, arriving at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport on Oct 3 and dying Oct 5 after fever, fatigue, and bleeding under the skin. Kenyan health officials are tracing contacts; the case is imported from the DRC. The U.S. Embassy in Nairobi issued an Oct 7 health advisory urging Americans in Kenya to monitor health for 21 days after possible exposure, seek medical guidance if symptoms appear, and contact providers before visiting facilities. Travelers should continue malaria prophylaxis, as malaria symptoms can mimic Ebola. The alert follows Kenya’s Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale confirming the imported case and death.

triage.headline_ja: 緊急警報！米国大使館、ケニア初のエボラ症例・死亡を受けて在留米国人へ健康勧告を発令
triage.triage_reason: ケニア初のエボラ(ブンディブジョウイルス病)症例・死亡が確認され、国際空港経由での越境事例であり米大使館が健康勧告を出すなど社会的関心も高いため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCに7年居住歴があり同地で感染した可能性が高いが、サマリーはDRCでの発生状況自体を述べておらず、実際の発症・死亡はケニアで発生。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため、DRCも含め verified_locations は空配列とした。続報でDRC国内の流行状況が明らかになれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Lungenpest breitet sich per Tröpfchen aus - warum schnelle Diagnose überlebenswichtig ist
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumonic plague spreads via droplets — why rapid diagnosis is crucial for survival.
article.articleSummary: In Irkutsk, 28-year-old Daria Shipilova, an employee at an anti-plague research institute, died in the night of October 1–2 after a severe illness; reports indicate she may have broken a vial containing Yersinia pestis in September. Russian authorities say pneumonia of unknown origin is the reported cause and deny a lab accident; the United States says it is monitoring closely, and independent laboratory confirmation is pending. The article emphasizes pneumonic plague spreads via droplets and requires rapid diagnosis; close contacts receive seven days of antibiotic prophylaxis, and isolation is necessary. Pneumonic plague is lethal without timely antibiotics; initial symptoms include fever, chills, headache, cough, shortness of breath, chest pain, with rapid progression and possible bloody or frothy sputum. Globally, WHO cites 30–60% mortality for bubonic plague untreated, while pneumonic forms are always fatal without treatment. Historical context notes Germany’s last case in 1945; Europe views plague as largely historical. Madagascar and the DRC account for most cases (2013–2018), with the USA averaging about seven cases per year; 2026 data remain uncertain.

triage.headline_ja: 肺ペストは飛沫で拡散する ― なぜ迅速な診断が生死を分けるのか
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの抗ペスト研究所職員が肺ペストで死亡し、実験室事故の疑いがあるが当局は否定。米国も監視するなど国際的関心が高く、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の該当がある。

article.articleHeadline: Notizie internazionali: spionaggio, pena di morte, migranti ed ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: International News: Espionage, Death Penalty, Migrants and Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first Ebola death: a traveler returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo dies in a Nairobi hospital; containment procedures are in place and the WHO is monitoring the situation. Germany: August Hanning, former head of the foreign intelligence service, is charged with espionage for allegedly obtaining about 2,000 classified documents and using them in an analysis for Azerbaijan’s espionage service. Latvia: at least 20 migrants were forced toward the Latvian border by armed masked individuals from Belarus, illustrating tensions on the EU's eastern border. Tennessee: Christa Pike, condemned to death, survived two lethal injections, regaining consciousness after being declared dead and able to speak; the case fuels ongoing debate over the effectiveness and ethics of capital punishment in the United States.

triage.headline_ja: 国際ニュース：スパイ活動、死刑、移民、そしてエボラ出血熱
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでDRC由来のエボラ出血熱による初の死亡例が報告され、WHOが監視を行っている。国境を越えた感染拡大の実例であり、IHR基準の複数に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニアで確認された死亡例はDRCからの帰国者によるものであり、感染源はDRCでの進行中のエボラアウトブレイクと考えられる。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外し、感染源国であるDRCをverified_locationsとした。続報でケニア国内での二次感染有無やDRC国内の発生状況の詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: NCDC warns of importation risk after Kenya confirms first case
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues; Kenya reports its first imported case linked to the outbreak. The patient, a Kenyan citizen who had lived in the DRC, traveled from the DRC to Kampala, then Nairobi, where they developed symptoms and tested positive at Kenya’s National Virology Reference Laboratory and KEMRI; the patient died on 5 October and was buried under safe-burial protocol per WHO. Nigeria’s NCDC says there is no confirmed case in Nigeria as of 6 October and warns of international importation risk, prompting enhanced preparedness, including detection, isolation, lab diagnosis, IPC, contact tracing, and HCW protection. As of 23 September, the DRC had 7,890 confirmed cases and 3,799 deaths (CFR 48.1%), across 63 health zones in seven provinces; Uganda’s outbreak ended in August; France reported a travel-related case in June. Nigeria advises travellers to monitor 21 days and health workers to maintain vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ケニアで初症例確認を受け、ナイジェリアCDCが輸入リスクを警告

article.articleHeadline: Ce se ştie până acum despre "cazul de ciumă scăpată din laborator" în Siberia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is known so far about the 'lab-escaped plague case' in Siberia
article.articleSummary: Darya Shipilova, 28, an employee at the Institute of Plague Research in Irkutsk, Siberia, died on 2 October 2026 from an unknown pneumonia; authorities report no pathogens identified in her contacts and no confirmed plague case. Roughly 200 people were quarantined, with about 60% later released; none of the publicly available evidence confirms any lab leak, travel to Thailand, or border-area exposure as the source. The Russian health agency Rospotrebnadzor says no relevant pathogens were found; the WHO notes no plague cases in Irkutsk, and initial risk assessments place Europe as very low, Irkutsk region as moderate-to-low, and Russia as low. International reactions include offers of assistance from the United States and calls for more information. The Institute, founded in 1934, researches plague and other pathogens. Plague is caused by Yersinia pestis and is endemic in Siberia; most human cases in recent years have been in the DRC and Madagascar.

triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクのペスト研究所職員が原因不明の肺炎で死亡し、研究所流出説やWHO・米国の反応など国際的関心が高まっているが、ペスト確定例はなく情報が限定的なため経過観察とフルRRA評価の両面が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in West Bengal: দুর্গাপুজোর আগে ডেঙ্গি নিয়ে সতর্ক স্বাস্থ্য দফতর, ১০ দিনের বেশি জ্বর থাকলে জরুরি পদক্ষেপের পরামর্শ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue in West Bengal: Ahead of Durga Puja, health department on alert regarding dengue; advises urgent steps if fever lasts more than 10 days.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in West Bengal remains a concern ahead of Durga Puja, with dengue cases nearing 10,000 in the first week of October. The health department urges vigilance: if fever lasts more than 10 days, evaluate for co-infections such as enteric fever, typhoid, leptospirosis, malaria, and urinary tract infection, and check for hospital-acquired infections in inpatients. Although rare, Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis (HLH) should be considered in prolonged fevers. Monitor patients from day 1–3 after dengue diagnosis for warning signs and comorbidities to guide timely treatment; hospitalization is advised if warning signs or significant comorbidity are present. A virtual meeting at 4 PM on Wednesday will coordinate dengue and other vector-borne disease control across West Bengal ahead of the festival season, with district magistrates, medical college principals, and municipal officials from Kolkata, Howrah, Bidhannagar, Durgapur, Asansol, and nearby Dum Dum, South Dum Dum, North Dum Dum, Kamarhati, Panihati. Attendees include Health Minister Shardwata Mukhopadhyay, Health Minister (State) Sumana Sarkar, and Health Secretary Narayan Swaroop Nigam.

triage.headline_ja: 西ベンガル州のデング熱：ドゥルガー・プージャを前に保健当局が警戒、10日以上の発熱には緊急対応を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱流行で症例数は多いが、西ベンガル州内の既知の風土病的事象であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。当局が対策会議を開催しており動向を注視すべき。
triage.notes: デング熱症例が季節的に増加し約1万件に迫っているとの報告だが、重症度や死亡者数の具体的データは記事に記載なし。保健省が州内で会議を開き対策を協議している段階であり、インド国内の既知の年中行事的な公衆衛生対応の範疇。

article.articleHeadline: Worm infections are not just a childhood problem: What adults need to know about prevention and treatment
article.articleSummary: Adult worm infections persist where sanitation is poor or exposure to contaminated soil, food and water occurs. Soil-transmitted helminths—roundworm (Ascaris), whipworm (Trichuris) and hookworm—affect 1.5 billion people (WHO). Symptoms are non-specific: abdominal discomfort, altered bowel habits, bloating, nausea, loss of appetite and weakness; some infections are asymptomatic. Hookworm causes ongoing blood loss and may drive iron-deficiency anaemia, prompting evaluation of unexplained anaemia in adults. Taenia solium taeniasis from undercooked meat can cause cysticercosis; neurocysticercosis can trigger seizures. Strongyloides stercoralis can persist via autoinfection; risk of hyperinfection with immunosuppression makes exposure history vital before steroids or immunosuppressants. A Tamil Nadu study of 2,351 adults found 33% seropositive for Strongyloides, with associations to haemoglobin and eosinophils. Diagnosis relies on stool tests (variable sensitivity) and eosinophilia; treatment includes albendazole/mebendazole for many helminths and ivermectin for Strongyloides. Prevention centers on sanitation, footwear, hygiene, cooking; discussed at WGO/ISIG 2026 in New Delhi.

triage.headline_ja: 寄生虫感染症は子供だけの問題ではない：成人が知っておくべき予防と治療
triage.triage_reason: これは一般的な健康教育・啓発記事であり、特定の急性アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常な事象を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は寄生虫感染症（土壌伝播蠕虫、Taenia solium、Strongyloides等）に関する一般的な医学解説記事で、学会（WGO/ISIG 2026）での議論内容を紹介するもの。特定の国・地域でのアウトブレイクや異常増加を報告するものではないため、対象国の verified_locations は該当なしとした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Matiang'i calls for collective action as Kenya faces health crisis
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first imported case of Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease (EVD). The patient, a Kenyan citizen who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo, fell ill about a month before traveling to Kenya. He travelled by road to Kampala, then flew on Jambojet Flight 8523 to Nairobi, arriving October 3, and was isolated at Nairobi Hospital; a sample tested positive for Bundibugyo EVD. Kenya has intensified surveillance and contact tracing; nearly 5,000 health workers have been trained in Ebola prevention and management. Public health officials urge calm and promote frequent handwashing, alcohol-based hand rubs, and avoiding close contact with those arriving from areas with active transmission. Contacts include 23 passengers and 4 crew members from the Uganda–Nairobi flight, plus family members and healthcare workers under monitoring or isolation. Jubilee Party leader Fred Matiang’i called for national unity and a coordinated response, with Aden Duale and Dr Patrick Amoth supporting the effort.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：マティアンギ氏、ケニアが保健危機に直面する中で結束した対応を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで初の輸入エボラ（ブンディブギョ型）確定例が発生し、国際移動（DRC→ウガンダ→ケニア、航空便）を伴う越境伝播の実例であり、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の該当、社会的関心の高さからフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
