article.articleHeadline: Shot: Десятки россиян подхватили кишечную инфекцию в турецком отеле Bosphorus Sorgun
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shot: Dozens of Russians contracted a gastrointestinal infection at the Turkish hotel Bosphorus Sorgun.
article.articleSummary: Dozens of Russian tourists contracted a gastrointestinal infection at the Bosphorus Sorgun family hotel in Side, Turkey. A group of nine travelers saw seven develop vomiting and diarrhea after several days, with other guests with similar symptoms repeatedly visiting the hotel doctor. Suspected causes include poor food quality and unsanitary conditions, with reports that glasses at the beach bar are rinsed with water and reused. Similar complaints were reported in August. No laboratory confirmation or exact case counts are provided. Some vacationers reportedly had to cut their holidays short and return home. The report also notes broader travel-health concerns, including a COVID-19 surge in Thailand affecting Russians’ plans to vacation there.

triage.headline_ja: Shot：ロシア人数十人がトルコのホテル「Bosphorus Sorgun」で消化器感染症に罹患
triage.triage_reason: トルコのホテルでの非特定の胃腸炎集団発生であり、対象国（Thailand等）は本文中で主題として扱われておらず、病原体も未確認のため対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はトルコのホテルでの胃腸炎集団発生（病原体未確認）。タイでのCOVID-19増加は旅行計画への影響として軽く言及されるのみで、詳細情報がなく主題とは言えないため対象国リストから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Berkaca dari Kasus Viral Resto Korea, Ini Langkah Menangani Keracunan Makanan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Drawing on the viral case at a Korean restaurant, here are the steps to manage food poisoning.
article.articleSummary: Food poisoning linked to a Korean restaurant, 88 Seoul, in Bandung, West Java, Indonesia, has prompted 24 verified reports, with the investigation ongoing since Oct 6, 2026. The first alert came from a Threads post describing fever and diarrhea up to 15 times. Microbial contamination is cited as the primary cause, with risks from raw or undercooked foods, dairy, seafood, and cross-contamination. Pathogens mentioned include norovirus, hepatitis A, Salmonella, E. coli, and Toxoplasma. First aid emphasizes hydration with water or oral rehydration salts, and eating light, easily digestible foods such as rice, bananas, or crackers; avoid spicy, fatty, or caffeinated items. Rest and hygiene are advised, and seek hospital care if symptoms persist. The report underscores food-safety and outbreak-management considerations for public health.

triage.headline_ja: 韓国料理店をめぐるバイラル事例に学ぶ、食中毒への対処法
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・バンドンの単一レストランでの食中毒事例（24件報告）であり、現時点では重篤性・拡大リスクの情報が限定的だが、病原体未確定で続報を要する。
triage.notes: SNS(Threads)でバイラル化した単一レストラン由来の食中毒事例で、原因病原体は未確定（ノロウイルス、A型肝炎、サルモネラ、大腸菌、トキソプラズマが候補として言及）。韓国（ソウル）は店名の由来であり発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ケニアで初めてエボラ出血熱の感染確認、男性１人死亡...コンゴに渡航・薬で症状抑え保安検査通過か | ヨミドクター(読売新聞)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya reports first-ever case of Ebola virus disease; one man dies... He traveled to Congo, symptoms suppressed by medication, and may have cleared security screening
article.articleSummary: As of 7 October 2026, Kenya reports its first case of Ebola virus disease (EVD) in a Kenyan man who died on 5 October after returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The patient had traveled to the DRC during an ongoing outbreak and subsequently flew home via Uganda; authorities say he had taken medication that suppressed symptoms, potentially allowing him to pass airport screening. The Kenyan government quarantined the patient’s family and 28 healthcare workers, a total of 29 people, for isolation and monitoring. The World Health Organization notes the outbreak in the DRC has reached 8,544 cases and 4,114 deaths, with transmission extending to new areas; Uganda has declared outbreak end. Kenya becomes the third African country with confirmed EVD cases after DRC and Uganda, underscoring persistent cross-border transmission risk and the need for rapid surveillance and infection prevention.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで初めてエボラ出血熱の感染確認、男性1人死亡...コンゴに渡航・薬で症状抑え保安検査通過か
triage.triage_reason: DRCの大規模エボラ流行（8,544例・4,114死亡）に続き、ケニアで初の症例・死亡が確認され国境を越えた伝播リスクが顕在化しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の多くに該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCは進行中の大規模流行の発生源として記事の主題の一部であるため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Китай прокомментировал возможную вспышку чумы в России
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China commented on a possible outbreak of plague in Russia.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 7, 2026, China formally commented on reports of a possible pneumonic plague outbreak in Siberia, saying Beijing and Moscow maintain close cooperation in prevention and control of infectious diseases, including plague. Spokesperson Guo Jiakun cited ongoing bilateral collaboration. Reported death: a 28-year-old technician at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute; about 200 contacts were hospitalized for observation. Chinese state media coverage was limited. Irkutsk and China had recently run joint emergency-response drills, and researchers discussed cross-border surveillance. Irkutsk Oblast lies north of Mongolia and is a transport hub with links to Chinese cities. Mongolia called the risk low; Kremlin and Rospotrebnadzor deny a dangerous outbreak; some outlets cite a broken vial; official cause of death listed as pneumonia of unknown origin. Plague is Yersinia pestis; pneumonic plague is highly transmissible but treatable with antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、ロシアでのペスト発生の可能性についてコメント
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州で肺ペスト（Yersinia pestis）による死亡例が報告され、約200人の接触者が隔離されるなど、公衆衛生上の深刻性と異常性が認められるため、IHR基準を2つ以上満たしフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: イベントの発生地はロシア（イルクーツク州）であり、対象国リストには含まれない。中国は外交的コメントを発しているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。ただしイルクーツクは中国への交通ハブであり、越境拡大リスクの観点から監視継続が望ましい。ロシア当局は『危険な流行はない』と否定しており、情報の確度には不確実性が残る。

article.articleHeadline: Китай прокоментував ймовірний спалах чуми в Росії
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China commented on the probable outbreak of plague in Russia.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 October 2026, China publicly commented on a probable outbreak of plague in Russia's Irkutsk region, stating Beijing is cooperating with Moscow on surveillance and control of infectious diseases, including plague. A 28-year-old laboratory worker at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute reportedly died; local authorities said about 200 contacts were hospitalized for monitoring. Russia and official media have downplayed the presence of a dangerous disease, while unconfirmed reports circulated that a vial with Yersinia pestis may have been broken; the institute cites pneumonia of unknown origin as the cause of death. The illness is a form of plague with bubonic, septicemic, and pneumonic forms; pneumonic plague is highly transmissible via airborne droplets. Mongolia assessed the outbreak risk as low. The United States issued warnings and discussed calls with Russia; Ukraine’s Center for Public Health deems Ukraine’s risk very low and continues monitoring via WHO/IHR.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、ロシアでのペスト感染拡大疑惑についてコメント
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州でペスト研究所職員が死亡し約200人が隔離観察下に置かれるなど重篤な公衆衛生事案であり、肺ペストは人-人感染のリスクが高く、複数国（中国・モンゴル・米国・ウクライナ）が注視・コメントしていることから国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 事案の発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。中国は本件についてコメントしているのみで、発生国ではない点に留意。研究所由来の事故（Yersinia pestisバイアル破損）の可能性が示唆されており、続報でのWHO/IHR通報有無の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: UE suspende importações de carne da Namíbia devido à febre aftosa - O País - A verdade como notícia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: EU suspends meat imports from Namibia due to foot-and-mouth disease - O País - The truth as news
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease in Namibia prompted the EU to suspend meat imports. In September 2026, Namibia reported its first FMD outbreak in its main cattle zone in 60 years, triggering a nationwide ban on animal movement and meat exports. The EU halted entry of fresh beef, lamb, and goat meat; some processed products remain eligible under strict risk mitigation. The EU is Namibia's largest market, accounting for over 80% of beef exports (about 10 million kg annually) and potentially affecting about 25% of the 40,000 direct jobs tied to Europe-bound trade. FMD causes fever and blisters near hooves and mouths, hindering feeding and sometimes causing death. Since Sept 22, 2026, 11 farms have been infected. Botswana, Eswatini, Lesotho, Mozambique, South Africa, Zambia, and Zimbabwe have reported cases. Namibia's response includes intensified surveillance, tracing, testing, movement controls, veterinary blocks, and biosafety; spokesperson Romeo Muyunda.

triage.headline_ja: EU、口蹄疫によりナミビア産食肉の輸入を停止 - O País紙
triage.triage_reason: ナミビアで60年ぶりとなる口蹄疫の発生があり、複数国（ザンビアを含む）で症例が報告され、EUが輸入停止措置を取るなど国際貿易への影響が顕著であるため、フルRRAでの評価が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 本事例は家畜疾病（口蹄疫）であり人への直接的な公衆衛生影響は報告されていないが、EUによる輸入停止など国際貿易への影響が大きく、経済的・社会的関心が高い。主要発生国であるナミビアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはサマリーで症例報告国として明記されたZambiaのみを記載した。

article.articleHeadline: Mosquito ancestry shapes chikungunya and dengue risk across the
article.articleSummary: Ancestry of Aedes albopictus populations shapes chikungunya and dengue risk across the Mediterranean and Europe. In a Parasites & Vectors study, researchers from the University of Pavia and Institut Pasteur Paris show that genetically distinct Mediterranean mosquito populations differ markedly in vector competence for CHIKV and DENV, while neighboring populations with different ancestries differ despite proximity. They genotyped an ancestral Guangzhou reference and ten adventive populations across Southern Switzerland, Northern/Central Italy, the Balkans, and Greece using SSR markers, and inferred histories with STRUCTURE and DIYABC-RF, revealing discontinuous introductions and admixture via used tires. Experimental assays measured infection rate, dissemination efficiency, and transmission efficiency for CHIKV (strain 06.21), DENV-1, and ZIKV (strain PE243) at 7, 14, and 21 days post-infection. For CHIKV and DENV, ancestry and population identity significantly influenced all indices; ZIKV showed no predictors. Proximity does not predict risk; ancestry-based mapping refines European arboviral risk as of 2026-10-07.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊の系統がマーディテランエリアにおけるチクングニア熱・デング熱リスクを形成する
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は蚊（Aedes albopictus）の遺伝的系統とウイルス媒介能力に関する学術研究であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。広州は祖先系統の参照集団として言及されているのみで、中国での発生事例ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊媒介ウイルスの媒介能力に関する実験室研究（Parasites & Vectors誌掲載）であり、地中海・欧州地域（スイス、イタリア、バルカン、ギリシャ）における蚊集団の遺伝的系統解析が主題。広州は参照用祖先集団としての言及のみで、実際の感染症発生地域ではないため対象国に該当するものはなし。

article.articleHeadline: OMS cere Rusiei informații despre moartea unei cercetătoare din Siberia. Ce este ciuma pneumonică și cât de periculoasă este
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO requests information from Russia about the death of a researcher from Siberia. What is pneumonic plague and how dangerous is it?
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague is a severe pulmonary infection and the most virulent form of plague, alongside bubonic and septicemic forms. It can spread between people via respiratory droplets in its pneumonic form. The disease stems from Yersinia pestis persisting in animal reservoirs worldwide, with cases in Russia, Africa Central, India, China and the United States; overall about 1,000–3,000 cases annually across all forms, bubonic being most common. Incubation can be as short as 24 hours; without rapid diagnosis and antibiotics, it is nearly always fatal, though early antibiotic treatment is effective. The article notes the death of a researcher from Siberia; all contacts tested negative for pneumonic plague. WHO requests information from Russia about the death. U.S. officials—Trump and CDC—say no broader threat to the United States; State Department Level 4 travel advisory for Russia remains.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがロシアに対し、シベリアの研究者死亡に関する情報提供を要請。肺ペストとは何か、その危険性は
triage.triage_reason: シベリアで肺ペストによる研究者の死亡が発生しWHOがロシアに情報提供を要請しており、重篤性と異常性の観点からIHR基準を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 主たる発生国はロシア（シベリア）であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。インド・中国・米国等への言及は世界的なペストの背景情報であり、本事例の発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: MSF ramps up Ebola preparedness after Kenya's first case
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first Ebola case, followed by the patient's death in Nairobi, prompting MSF to ramp up preparedness. MSF coordinates with the Ministry of Health and response agencies while expanding activities across Kenya's counties. Since the regional outbreak in DRC and Uganda, MSF has strengthened readiness, opening a June 2026 Ebola simulation and training centre in Kajiado County to train health workers (355 professionals trained, including 84 Kenyan healthcare workers) on safe PPE use, infection prevention and control, and emergency response. A July training centre was established at Port Reitz Sub-County Hospital in Mombasa to bolster outbreak readiness. In Busia County near the Kenya-Uganda border, MSF supports isolation and management of suspected cases and IPC measures. The organisation cites more than 8,200 infections and 4,000 deaths in the DRC outbreak and emphasizes community engagement to counter fear and misinformation. Kenya will continue collaborations to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア初のエボラ症例確認を受け、国境なき医師団（MSF）が対応準備を強化
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで初のエボラ症例が確認され患者が死亡、DRC・ウガンダでの地域流行（感染8,200人超、死者4,000人超）と関連する越境拡大の可能性がありIHR基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの初症例だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは地域流行の発生源として具体的な感染・死亡者数とともに実質的に言及されているため verified_locations に含めた。ウガンダも対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: China apunta a "intercambios estrechos" con Rusia sobre el posible brote de peste en Irkutsk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China seeks closer exchanges with Russia over the possible plague outbreak in Irkutsk.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague is under scrutiny in Russia’s Irkutsk region after the death of a laboratory researcher in Shelejov suspected of a lab accident. Authorities told the World Health Organization that no high‑risk pathogens have been detected among contacts of the deceased. World Health Organization Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus noted that Russia informed the agency there have been no recently reported plague cases in Irkutsk. Russian authorities described the regional epidemiological situation as stable, even as emergency measures were activated in recent days following the death. Beijing and Moscow described close exchanges and cooperation on infectious disease prevention and control, including plague, in response to the case.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、イルクーツクでのペスト流行の可能性についてロシアとの「緊密なやり取り」を求める
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州で実験室関連と疑われる肺ペストによる死亡例が発生し、WHOへの通知や中露間の緊密な協力が報じられており、異常性・重症度の観点からシグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州（対象国リスト外）であり、中国は協力関係として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Kenya's response by the numbers
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first Ebola case on 2026-10-06 after a traveller from the Democratic Republic of Congo, who arrived on 2026-10-03, was hospitalised and died on 2026-10-05. Of 267 samples tested across five laboratories, only the deceased tested positive; no additional cases detected in Kenya. Kenya's response includes screening 652,584 travellers since May 2026 and training 4,971 health workers in Ebola prevention and case management. The Ministry of Health urges calm, continued hand hygiene, and avoidance of contact with individuals with viral-illness symptoms. Enhanced surveillance, health-worker preparedness, and public awareness aim to detect cases early, limit transmission, and prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ケニアの対応状況（数字で見る）
triage.triage_reason: DRCからの渡航者がケニアで発症・死亡し、越境感染事例として確認された。IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: ケニア（Kenya）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事はDRCからの輸入例を主題としており、DRCの流行状況が背景として重要であるため含めた。現時点でケニア国内での追加感染は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 猪价跌近三成还能承受　槟猪农最怕猪瘟随进口肉再袭
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pig prices fall nearly 30% but farmers can still endure; Penang pig farmers fear swine fever will strike again with imported meat.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) resurgence fears loom in Penang, Malaysia, as Thailand continues ASF cases, raising concerns that imported cold pork could carry the virus. Penang’s pig-farming association president Wang Fusheng says recovery from ASF has been slow but ongoing; about 63 of the state’s roughly 100 pig farms are in the Peace Village area, with production at roughly 70–80% of normal. Pig prices have fallen from around RM18/kg in April to RM12.50–13.00/kg. The government approved four importers to bring in cold-fresh pork to meet Lunar New Year demand, but farmers worry about imports from ASF-affected countries. They urge re-examination of compartment-based imports from Thailand and prefer sourcing from non-ASF countries; Sarawak supplies to the peninsula, mitigating risk. Notably, ASF-related losses could bankrupt farmers if another outbreak hits, given restarting costs and investment needs. Advisors advocate targeted safeguards rather than a blanket ban.

triage.headline_ja: 豚肉価格が3割近く下落も農家は耐えられる水準、ペナンの養豚業者は輸入肉に伴う豚コレラ（ASF）再流行を最も懸念
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）はヒトに感染しない動物疾病であり直接的な公衆衛生リスクは低いが、タイでの継続的な発生と輸入豚肉を通じた越境拡散への懸念が経済・貿易面で存在するため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: ASFはヒトに感染しない動物疾病のため、IHR基準の『公衆衛生への深刻な影響』には該当しないが、国際貿易・農業経済への影響があるため動物衛生モニタリングとして注視対象。マレーシア（ペナン、サラワク）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。タイは継続的なASF発生国として記事の主題に関連するため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: L'Ouganda reste exempt d'Ebola après qu'un cas confirmé a transité par le pays (ministère de la Santé)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda remains Ebola-free after a confirmed case transited through the country (Ministry of Health).
article.articleSummary: As of 7 October 2026, Uganda remains Ebola-free despite a confirmed case in neighboring Kenya who transited through Uganda. Uganda’s Health Ministry, via Charles Olaro, said preliminary investigations indicate the Kenyan case originated in the Democratic Republic of Congo, transited Uganda for less than 24 hours, and then traveled to Kenya, with a normal temperature at departure from Entebbe International Airport. Uganda is strengthening cross-border surveillance, information sharing, and timely detection/management of threats. Kenya has confirmed its first imported case of Ebola virus disease (EVD) caused by the Bundibugyo strain and reported a death in a Nairobi hospital. No Ugandan cases have been reported; the public is advised to follow official guidance and maintain public health precautions.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、確認されたエボラ症例が同国を通過した後も「エボラ非発生国」の状態を維持（保健省）
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）由来のエボラ症例がウガンダを経由しケニアで確認・死亡例が発生しており、国境を越えた感染拡大が現実に生じているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 確認された症例はケニアで報告され死亡例も発生しているが、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であるDRCでのエボラ流行が本イベントの実質的発生国と判断し、DRCのみをverified_locationsに計上した。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC exprime sa solidarité avec le pays et appelle à renforcer la préparation régionale face à Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa CDC expresses its solidarity with the country and calls for strengthening regional preparedness in the face of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: First imported case of Ebola virus disease, Bundibugyo strain, confirmed in Kenya; patient died. Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya expressed solidarity; a multidisciplinary team travels to Kenya to support the response. The patient travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo by road to Uganda before flying to Kenya; 28 contacts identified, including family and health workers, and 23 passengers/crew traced. Kenya remains vigilant, urging calm and adherence to official information; professionals urged to boost infection prevention and control. Africa CDC emphasizes regional preparedness through cross-border information sharing, laboratory readiness, rapid-response capacity, and community-focused surveillance. In DRC, community transmission remains a major challenge, with over 70% of new cases identified in the community among unlisted contacts; emphasis on village-centered case finding, daily contact follow-up, and stronger community engagement. About $2.9 billion mobilized; calls for transparency of funds. Africa CDC will continue collaboration with DRC, Kenya and partners to interrupt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、エボラ出血熱に直面する国への連帯を表明し、地域的な備えの強化を呼びかける
triage.triage_reason: DRCからウガンダ経由でケニアに越境した輸入エボラ症例が死亡し、国際的拡大・接触者多数・越境移動を伴う重大事例であり、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは感染源国かつコミュニティ感染継続中のため含める。Africa CDCによる地域支援・$29億動員の情報あり、国際的関心・支援ニーズが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Можливий спалах у Росії: що таке легенева чума і як вона поширюється
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Possible outbreak in Russia: What is pneumonic plague and how it spreads.
article.articleSummary: WHO has requested Russia provide more information after the death of a Siberian laboratory worker studying plague. Officials say analyses of contacts showed no evidence of pneumonic plague infection. Pneumonic plague is a severe lung infection and the most dangerous form of plague; bubonic and septicemic forms exist. Pneumonic plague can result from other forms and presents with shortness of breath, chest pain, and coughing up blood. Global plague cases are about 1,000–3,000, with most bubonic cases; outbreaks occur mainly in Central Africa, but cases have been reported in Russia, India, China and the United States. The causative bacterium, Yersinia pestis, persists in wildlife; transmission occurs via infected fleas or contact with infected animals, while person-to-person spread requires close contact. Early antibiotic treatment is effective; post-exposure prophylaxis or quarantine may be advised. Russia has not confirmed pneumonic infection; U.S. CDC says no broader threat and UK HSE notes low risk.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでの発生の可能性：肺ペストとは何か、どのように広がるのか
triage.triage_reason: ロシアの研究所員死亡例についてWHOが追加情報を要請しているが、接触者調査では感染の証拠がなく、肺ペスト感染は未確認のため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシアのシベリア研究所員の死亡事例であり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。中国・インド・米国は過去の一般的なペスト発生状況として言及されているのみで、本件イベントの発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Thái Lan phát cảnh báo khẩn cho trẻ nhỏ khi số ca mắc RSV tăng nhanh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thailand issues urgent warning for young children as RSV infections rise rapidly.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 6, 2026, Thailand reports more than 8,500 RSV cases this year, with about 75% in children under 5 and one death in a 2‑month‑old newborn. The Ministry of Public Health warns of a rapid RSV surge and urges enhanced protection for young children. RSV typically peaks during the rainy season and extends into winter, spreading via droplets or direct contact. Early symptoms resemble influenza (fever, cough, runny nose) but can progress to bronchiolitis, pneumonia, or respiratory failure in infants; chronic wheeze and asthma risk may follow early infection. No specific antiviral exists; treatment is supportive. Preventive measures include pregnant women receiving the RSV vaccine to pass antibodies to the fetus for the first six months of life. Parents should seek care for fast breathing, wheeze, poor feeding, or lethargy. CDC studies suggest nirsevimab is about 90% effective in preventing hospitalization in newborns with RSV.

triage.headline_ja: タイ、RSV感染急増で幼児への緊急警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: 季節性RSV流行の範囲内で異常事態とは言えないが、死亡例や重症化報告があり当局が緊急警告を発している点を踏まえ、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: RSVは季節性感染症であり毎年流行する点から異常性は低いが、年間8500例・乳児死亡例があり、タイ保健省が緊急警告を発している。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'épidémie s'étend au-delà des frontières
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the outbreak is spreading beyond borders.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is spreading at an alarmingly rapid pace, with North Kivu now accounting for roughly 40% of new confirmed cases (up from 24% in August) per Médecins sans frontières (MSF). The 17th DRC outbreak shows strained care capacity, with 8,440 confirmed cases and 4,080 deaths reported. The Bundibugyo strain remains in circulation. The outbreak has crossed borders: Kenya records its first imported Ebola death on Oct 5, 2026, in Nairobi—a Kenyan citizen who had lived in the DRC. He fell ill about a month earlier, was treated in several DRC hospitals, then traveled via road to Kampala and by air to Nairobi; Kenyan authorities identified about 50 contacts. Churches are adapting activities to reduce transmission, underscoring community disruption as the continent potentially nears Africa’s deadliest Ebola event.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：流行が国境を越えて拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模なエボラ流行が国境を越えてケニアに拡大し、死亡者が確認されたため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: ケニアでの輸入症例およびウガンダ経由の移動が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCが主たる発生地域として確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Το μυστήριο της πανώλης στη Σιβηρία: Τι συνέβη στο ινστιτούτο ερευνών και γιατί ανησυχούν οι ΗΠΑ και άλλες χώρες
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Mystery of the Plague in Siberia: What Happened at the Research Institute and Why the US and Other Countries Are Concerned
article.articleSummary: On October 2, 2026, a 28-year-old employee at the Center for Plague Research in Irkutsk, Siberia, died under undetermined conditions, prompting quarantine of about 200 people. Daria Sipilova reportedly died from an unknown pneumonia; authorities say no pathogens were found among contacts and plague has not been confirmed. Rumors of a lab spill or travel circulated but were denied. About 60% of those quarantined were released; initial reports of 200 quarantined were not confirmed. Plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, is transmitted by fleas, inhalation of droplets, or contaminated food; pneumonic plague is the most infectious form. The WHO stated no plague cases in Irkutsk; US officials urged more information. The institute, founded in 1934, has helped manage plague outbreaks in Siberia, Mongolia, and China and also worked on cholera and anthrax. Plague is endemic in Siberia and parts of Africa, the former USSR, the Americas, and Asia.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアのペストの謎：研究所で何が起きたのか、そしてなぜ米国や他国が懸念しているのか
triage.triage_reason: 事案はロシア・シベリアのイルクーツクで発生しており、監視対象国（中国含む）での現在の発生ではないため、対象外として見送り。
triage.notes: 記事内で中国・モンゴルは研究所が過去にペスト対応で協力した歴史的文脈として言及されているのみで、現時点での発生国ではない。実際の事案発生地はロシア（イルクーツク）であり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: China Says It Is In Contact With Russia Over Suspected Pneumonic Plague Case | Outlook India
article.articleSummary: China says it is in close exchanges with Russia over a suspected pneumonic plague case in the Irkutsk region following the death of a worker at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute. About 200 contacts are under medical observation. Russian authorities told the WHO that no plague cases have been recorded in Irkutsk and tests among contacts found no dangerous pathogens. The WHO has not confirmed pneumonic plague as the cause and assesses the regional risk as moderate to low in Irkutsk oblast, low for Russia, and very low for the wider European region. Beijing emphasizes cooperation, noting a recent emergency-response exercise with Chinese counterparts at the Irkutsk institute. Pneumonic plague spreads via respiratory droplets and can be treated effectively with antibiotics when promptly addressed. U.S. and European responses remain monitoring; no confirmed outbreak to date.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、ロシアでの肺ペスト疑い例についてロシア側と連絡を取り合っていると発表
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクでの肺ペスト疑い例が報告されているが、ロシア当局は正式なペスト症例を否認し、接触者の検査でも危険な病原体は検出されていない。WHOも確定診断はしておらず情報が不確実なため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストに含まれない。記事中で中国は外交的に連絡を取っているのみで、感染事例の発生地ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。ロシア当局とWHOは正式なペスト確定を否定しており、情報の不確実性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Reports First-Ever Ebola Death
article.articleSummary: Kenya reported its first-ever Ebola death on 7 October 2026, a 40-year-old Kenyan businessman who fell ill after returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). He had been living in the DRC, became ill about a month earlier, was treated there, then traveled overland to Kampala, Uganda, before flying to Nairobi on 3 October. Kenya had never recorded an Ebola case. The DRC is contending with its 17th Ebola outbreak, declared in May. Across Africa, Ebola has killed more than 15,000 people over the past 50 years. Uganda had 20 Ebola cases, almost all tied to travel from the DRC, with two deaths before Uganda was declared Ebola-free in August. The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention is sending a team to Kenya, with DG Jean Kaseya expected to visit in the coming days.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで初のエボラ死亡例を報告
triage.triage_reason: DRCの進行中アウトブレイクに関連し、ウガンダ経由でケニアに越境伝播した初のエボラ死亡例であり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大）に該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの初エボラ死亡例だが、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは進行中の第17次アウトブレイクの発生源として明記されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Kenya: Govt unveils fresh measures as taskforce meets
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first imported Ebola Virus Disease case, Bundibugyo strain, with intensified national response. The patient arrived at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport on Oct 3 after traveling from the Democratic Republic of Congo to Kampala by road, then by Jambojet flight to Nairobi; isolation followed at Nairobi Hospital and later transfer to an isolation facility. Kenya confirmed the case on Oct 6. On Oct 7, the National Ebola Virus Disease Taskforce met at Afya House to coordinate response, focusing on intensified contact tracing and monitoring, enhanced surveillance at entry points, and ensuring health facilities are ready to isolate and manage suspected cases. The response is being implemented in collaboration with county governments and partners. Principal Secretary Mary Muthoni urged Kenyans to remain calm and rely on official health communications.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱確認：政府がタスクフォース会合で新たな対策を発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで流行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がケニアに越境輸入され、国際的拡大と公衆衛生上の重大性が認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの初輸入エボラ症例だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であるDRCでのエボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株）が本事象の根本原因であり、国際拡大の観点からDRCを含めた。ウガンダは通過地点のみで感染発生の記述がないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Reviews Ebola Readiness After Kenya's Imported Case
article.articleSummary: Nigeria's NCDC is reviewing Ebola preparedness after Kenya confirmed an imported Bundibugyo virus disease case; as of Oct 6, 2026 Nigeria had no confirmed Ebola case. The Kenyan infection, linked to ongoing Bundibugyo virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, traveled via Uganda and arrived in Nairobi on Oct 3, dying Oct 5. WHO stated no travel or trade restrictions justified for Kenya, Uganda, or DRC. Nigeria's readiness includes lab testing, isolation/referral, infection control, and contact tracing; a national tabletop simulation identified gaps. Travellers from affected areas should monitor 21 days. Healthcare workers should consider travel/exposure histories and not wait for bleeding to suspect Ebola. Nigeria's preparedness plan began earlier (May 28 advisory) urging states to designate holding facilities and ensure reporting. No vaccines or specific treatments yet approved for Bundibugyo virus disease; candidates in trials.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、ケニアでの輸入症例を受けエボラ対応体制を見直し
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のブンディブギョウイルス病アウトブレイクに関連し、ケニアへの越境輸入例（死亡例）が発生、複数国（ケニア・ウガンダ・DRC）を巻き込む国際的拡大が確認されており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニア（輸入症例、死亡）とナイジェリア（準備態勢見直し）だが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であるDRCでの進行中アウトブレイクのみ対象国として計上。WHOは渡航・貿易制限は不要と表明している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : après le cas importé au Kenya, le Nigeria renforce sa surveillance et alerte les voyageurs
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: after the imported case in Kenya, Nigeria strengthens its surveillance and alerts travelers.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed on October 6, 2026 a case of Ebola caused by Bundibugyo virus linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak; the patient was a Kenyan national living in the DRC, travelled via Kampala by road to Uganda, then flew to Nairobi, where isolation and testing yielded a fatal result. Nigeria’s NCDC announced on October 7 that it has strengthened surveillance for potential importation, with no Nigerian cases detected. Preparations include enhanced early detection, isolation, case triage, laboratory diagnostics, contact tracing, infection prevention, risk communication, and health-worker protection, plus a national simulation exercise to test response. Nigeria re-evaluates its risk level and measures in light of the Kenya case. Travelers to/from affected areas should monitor health for 21 days after departure, seek care promptly if symptoms arise, and report travel/exposure; clinicians should consider Ebola with compatible symptoms and recent stay in affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ケニアでの輸入症例を受け、ナイジェリアはサーベイランスを強化し渡航者に注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス）アウトブレイクに関連した国際的な輸入症例（ケニアで死亡）が確認され、ナイジェリアも警戒を強化するなど国際的拡大の懸念がありIHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関連する国際的な輸入症例（ケニア）とナイジェリアの対応強化。ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: 英軍元司令官がコロナ初期の中国と重なると警鐘！シベリアのペスト疑惑で中央アジア諸国が国境検疫を強化、WHOは低リスクと評価
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Former British Army commander warns that it overlaps with China's early COVID-19 outbreak! Central Asian countries tighten border quarantines amid Siberian plague suspicions, WHO rates it as low risk.
article.articleSummary: An Irkutsk, Siberia case: a 28-year-old lab assistant at a plague research institute dies; Russia calls the death unknown pneumonia, but Western experts warn of pneumonic plague and draw parallels to the early COVID-19 outbreak. UK ex-CBRN commander Hamish de Bretton-Gordon says opaque reporting echoes Wuhan, noting about 4 million left Wuhan. Reading University's Simon Clarke questions Russian transparency; King's College London's biosafety expert Filippa Rentzos highlights denial of plague deaths and a lab accident. Former DoD official Andrew Weber warns pneumonic plague can spread quickly via droplets; London Public Health urges airport surveillance. Meduza notes antibiotics are effective if given within about 2 days; untreated pneumonic plague is highly lethal. No secondary infections among 197 identified contacts as of Oct 6. Border checks tightened by Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Uzbekistan; Mongolia vigilant. WHO risk: Irkutsk medium-low to low; Russia low; Europe very low; tests ongoing; cause unconfirmed. U.S. embassy monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: 英軍元司令官がコロナ初期の中国と重なると警鐘！シベリアのペスト疑惑で中央アジア諸国が国境検疫を強化、WHOは低リスクと評価
triage.triage_reason: シベリア・イルクーツクでの肺ペスト疑い死亡例を巡り、専門家が武漢初期のCOVID-19との類似性を指摘し複数国が国境検疫を強化するなど、国際的な懸念と渡航制限的対応が見られるためフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 事象の実際の発生地はロシア（シベリア・イルクーツク州）であり、中国（武漢）は過去のCOVID-19流行との比較対象として言及されているのみで、本事象の発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。対象国リストに該当する発生国は確認されなかった。

article.articleHeadline: Dopo la morte in Siberia: che cos'è la peste polmonare e come si trasmette
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After the death in Siberia: what pneumonic plague is and how it is transmitted.
article.articleSummary: Death in Siberia raises alert over pneumonic plague, the highly contagious respiratory form of Yersinia pestis. A 28-year-old laboratory technician, Darya Shipilova, died October 2 in Siberia after rapidly developing pneumonia of unknown origin; investigators suspect pneumonic plague following possible exposure to a broken vial, though unconfirmed. Pneumonic plague, transmitted via respiratory droplets, is the most transmissible form and can spread person-to-person. Without treatment, case fatality ranges from about 30% to 100%. The incubation period is roughly 24 hours to 3–4 days. Symptoms include sudden fever, chills, severe weakness, cough, chest pain, and blood-tinged sputum; rapid deterioration is common. Diagnosis must be timely, with effective antibiotic regimens (streptomycin, gentamicin, doxycycline). Isolation and contact tracing are essential. Russia has quarantined around 200 people; the WHO notes ongoing cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Madagascar, reflecting the bacterium's persistence in nature.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアでの死亡事例後：肺ペストとは何か、どのように感染するか
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストによる研究所技術者の死亡例とロシアでの約200人隔離という異常事態に加え、WHOがDRC・マダガスカルでの継続的な症例発生を指摘しており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を2つ満たすためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア（シベリア）での研究所技術者の死亡例であり、ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ただしWHOがDRCおよびマダガスカルでの継続的なペスト症例を指摘しており、DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため記載した。マダガスカルは対象国外のため除外。感染経路（事故による曝露の可能性）や人-人感染の実態については未確定情報が多く、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: A dead scientist, quarantines, and a plague lab: Here we go again?
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-07, a researcher at a Russian plague laboratory has died from an unknown infection, prompting quarantines and hospital closures. Dozens have reportedly been quarantined, and four hospitals have been shut down; three show direct evidence of contact tracing to the outbreak, while the fourth is under heightened security. Russian authorities say they had nothing to do with the incident, framing it as a normal illness managed as a precaution. The episode fuels fears of a plague-related outbreak and is described by commentators as echoing a Wuhan lab-leak scenario linked to COVID-19. The report provides no laboratory-confirmed pathogen, case counts, or infection source. It centers on uncertainty, the rationale for quarantine, and calls for transparency regarding the incident in Russia.

triage.headline_ja: 死亡した科学者、検疫、そしてペスト研究所：またか？
triage.triage_reason: ロシアのペスト研究所関連施設で研究者が原因不明の感染症で死亡し検疫が行われているが、病原体の確認や症例数など詳細情報が欠如しており、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアのペスト研究所関連施設での出来事を主題としており、武漢・COVID-19は陰謀論的な比較対象として言及されているのみ。対象国リストにロシアは含まれず、中国も記事の主題ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。情報源（theblaze.com）は論評色が強く、公式発表やWHO/CDC等の公的情報源での裏付けが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Primul deces provocat de Ebola. Autoritățile au identificat zeci de persoane care au intrat în contact cu victima
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The first Ebola-related death. Authorities have identified dozens of people who came into contact with the victim.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first Ebola case and its first Ebola-related death on its soil. A man from the Democratic Republic of Congo, ill for about a month, died in a Nairobi hospital after traveling from Congo via Kampala to Nairobi. He passed airport health screening, but his condition deteriorated; symptoms included fever, chills and subcutaneous bleeding. Kenya has identified 28 contacts within the country, including family and healthcare workers, and is tracing a further 27 people exposed on the Jambojet flight he took to Nairobi (23 passengers and 4 crew). The body will be buried under special Ebola protocols to minimize transmission. The case is linked to a wider outbreak in the DRC, driven by the Bundibugyo strain, which has caused thousands of infections and more than 4,000 deaths. Kenyan authorities have heightened surveillance and preparedness for additional cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラによる最初の死亡例。当局は被害者と接触した数十人を特定
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで初のエボラ輸入症例・死亡が確認され、DRCでの大規模流行（数千人感染・4000人超死亡）に関連。航空機搭乗者を含む接触者追跡が行われており、国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 本事例はケニアでの輸入症例・死亡だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事がDRCでの進行中のアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo株、数千人感染・4000人超死亡）を主要背景として言及しているため、DRCのみを検証済み発生地域とした。航空機搭乗者27名を含む接触者追跡が進行中であり、国際的拡大の懸念が強い。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Confirms First Ebola Case As Patient Returning From DRC Dies in Nairobi
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first Ebola case after a Kenyan man who had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo for seven years died in Nairobi. The patient’s infection was the Bundibugyo strain, detected after travel from the DRC to Kampala, Uganda, then by air to Nairobi, where he was isolated at Nairobi Hospital following a positive test; he died soon after. Authorities identified 28 contacts (family and health workers) and are tracing 23 passengers and 4 crew members from the Kampala–Nairobi flight. President William Ruto ordered quarantines for eight relatives and 21 health workers; contacts will remain in isolation for 21 days pending negative tests. The eastern DRC outbreak (the 17th) has caused over 4,000 deaths and about 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces since May 15; WHO warns the outbreak is far from over. Uganda reported 20 cases and two deaths earlier this year before being declared Ebola-free in August. Kenya has trained nearly 5,000 health workers for prevention and management, and there is no vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、初のエボラ症例を確認 ― DRCから帰国した患者がナイロビで死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模エボラ流行（17次、死者4000人超）を背景に、ウガンダ経由でケニアに越境感染が確認され初症例・死亡例が発生。国際的拡大・渡航制限リスクが高く、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで発生したエボラ（17次流行）が渡航者を介してウガンダ経由でケニアへ越境感染した事例。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しないBundibugyo株であり、WHOも流行継続を警告しており、国際的な監視・支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Dispangtan Sukoharjo Imbau Masyarakat Waspada Penyakit Antraks, Kenali Ciri-cirinya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sukoharjo's Dispangtan Urges the Public to Be Vigilant Against Anthrax, and to Recognize Its Signs.
article.articleSummary: Anthrax vigilance in Sukoharjo Regency, Indonesia, as the Dinas Pertanian dan Perikanan warns livestock keepers to heighten awareness of Bacillus anthracis, the agent of anthrax. Anthrax is a zoonosis that can transfer from infected livestock to humans via handling sick animals, carcasses, or processing and consuming meat from contaminated livestock. The agency urges farmers not to slaughter, move, or eat meat from animals showing signs of disease or sudden death. Suspected cases should be reported promptly to veterinary officers or nearby extension workers for rapid inspection and containment per procedures. Early reporting and precautionary action aim to prevent spread and protect livestock and public health in Sukoharjo. The article notes vaccination activity in Wonogiri as context, but the main call is vigilance and reporting in Sukoharjo.

triage.headline_ja: スコハルジョ県農業漁業局、炭疽病への警戒を呼びかけ、特徴を知るよう促す
triage.triage_reason: 実際の発症例報告ではなく、家畜飼育者向けの注意喚起・啓発記事であり、IHR基準・社会的関心ともに該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は確定症例の報告ではなく、地方自治体による予防的な注意喚起・啓発活動の内容。具体的な感染者数や死亡例の記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Mulai Merebak, Pakar ITS Ingatkan Warga Jangan Sembarangan Minum Antibiotik
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Begins to Spread, ITS Expert Reminds Residents Not to Take Antibiotics Indiscriminately
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases are increasingly observed in Surabaya, East Java, Indonesia, with ITS Surabaya internal medicine specialist Dr. Edwin Nugroho Njoto reporting rising community cases and noting influenza activity in his Eagles Head Medical Centre and Bhayangkara Hospital Surabaya practice. The influenza virus, not bacteria, drives symptoms, so antibiotics should not be used for initial illness. Antibiotics may be considered only if a secondary bacterial infection is diagnosed. Common influenza symptoms include respiratory signs such as runny nose, cough, fever, and sore throat; warning signs include loss of appetite and shortness of breath. Vulnerable groups—elderly, children, pregnant women, and patients with diabetes or kidney disease—require heightened vigilance. Influenza A spreads mainly via respiratory droplets and can surge during favorable weather, with the virus mutating readily and causing seasonal outbreaks. The report emphasizes avoiding unnecessary antibiotics and ensuring medical guidance for treatment.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型が拡大、ITS専門家が住民に抗生物質の不用意な服用を控えるよう注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの通常の流行に関する啓発記事であり、異常性や重篤性、国際的拡大の懸念を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザAの通常の流行報告であり、抗生物質乱用防止の啓発が主旨。重症度や死亡者数など具体的な公衆衛生インパクトに関する情報は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Sudinkes Jaktim dorong PSN rutin dan serentak cegah DBD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East Jakarta Health Office Urges Regular and Simultaneous Mosquito Fogging to Prevent Dengue Fever
article.articleSummary: East Jakarta’s Health Office (Sudinkes Jakarta Timur) urges residents to implement routine and simultaneous PSN 3M Plus to prevent dengue fever (DBD). Head Arief Wahyudhy says PSN should occur weekly, with broad community participation to eliminate Aedes breeding sites. The program promotes 'One House, One Jumantik' and the formation of Kampung Bebas Jentik under local health centers and Sudinkes oversight. Sudinkes conducts daily surveillance of hospital-reported DBD cases, plus epidemiological and entomological surveillance, with updates on the DKI Jakarta surveillance portal. When cases arise, health workers follow up with environmental checks and vector-control measures in the community. PSN monitoring takes place every Friday with government, health workers, cross-sector partners, and residents. Fogging is not the main strategy; emphasis remains on eliminating breeding habitats and preventing standing water. Early medical evaluation is advised for fever and suspected DBD symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 東ジャカルタ保健局、デング熱予防のため定期的・一斉のPSN（蚊の繁殖源対策）を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性デング熱予防啓発活動に関する行政広報であり、異常な発生増加や重症例急増等の情報はなく、既存の公衆衛生対応の枠内と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は東ジャカルタ保健局による定期的なデング熱予防啓発・サーベイランス活動の紹介であり、具体的な症例数増加や異常発生の記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: Swiss pharma giant Roche sends lab equipment to DRC to tackle Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Roche supplies two molecular testing devices to DRC's National Institute of Public Health in Bunia to tackle the Ebola outbreak. After preparing the equipment and training local staff, the Bundibugyo strain Ebola PCR test will be trialed there; the test detects viral genetic material but is currently for research use only and not approved for diagnostic use. If successful, Roche will provide additional tests and equipment to expand testing capacity. The relief aligns with WHO data showing the May-starting outbreak is the largest Ebola outbreak in the DRC to date, with nearly 8,000 cases and about 3,800 deaths confirmed by the end of September across 63 health zones in seven provinces; Ituri is among the hardest-hit areas. WHO classifies the DRC outbreak risk as very high.

triage.headline_ja: スイス製薬大手ロシュ、エボラ出血熱対策のためコンゴ民主共和国に検査機器を送付
triage.triage_reason: WHOが「非常に高い」リスクと分類する過去最大規模のDRCエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（約8000症例、約3800死亡）に関する継続報道であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 本記事はロシュによる検査機器支援に関する続報であり、既知の大規模アウトブレイク（5月発生、63健康区域・7州に拡大、WHOが最大規模と認定）に関するもの。既存のRRA対象イベントの可能性が高いため、重複確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Trung Quốc lần đầu lên tiếng về nghi vấn dịch hạch tại Nga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China speaks out for the first time on suspected plague in Russia
article.articleSummary: Plague is suspected in Russia after a 28-year-old female employee at Irkutsk’s Institute for Plague Control and Prevention died of severe pneumonia. On Oct 4, Russian officials and media reported preventive measures at an aluminum plant and several Irkutsk hospitals, following reports she may have been exposed to plague bacteria after breaking a vial during sampling; verification is pending. Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor said tests detected no microbial agents related to her work, and no laboratory incident involving dangerous pathogens was recorded. About a month earlier, the Irkutsk institute completed a joint emergency drill with China on outbreak response and cross-border surveillance. Irkutsk is north of Mongolia and a transport hub with frequent China air/rail links. Mongolia’s health ministry said the risk is low. The United States said it plans a call with Putin on the matter.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、ロシアでの疑わしいペスト（黒死病）流行について初めて見解を表明
triage.triage_reason: イルクーツクのペスト研究所職員が重症肺炎で死亡しペスト感染が疑われたが、ロシア当局の検査では関連する病原体は検出されず確定診断には至っていない。国際的な注目（米露間の協議等）はあるが、感染拡大や確定症例の証拠は現時点で不明なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 事件はロシア・イルクーツク州で発生した疑い事例であり、対象国リストに含まれない。中国・モンゴル・米国は本件についてコメントまたは懸念を表明しているに過ぎず、発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。ロシア当局は職員の業務関連病原体を検出せず、実験室事故の記録もないと発表しており、確定事例ではない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: The Black Death: Does Plague Still Occur Today? - Technology Org
article.articleSummary: In the Irkutsk region of Russia, 189 people are quarantined after contact with a woman who reportedly died from plague; she may have become infected handling plague samples, and authorities continue monitoring identified contacts, with none displaying symptoms and laboratory tests negative. Quarantine remains a precaution. Plague is caused by Yersinia pestis and persists in natural reservoirs worldwide, including Russia, Mongolia, China, Africa, and the western United States, with a few thousand cases reported annually. The Black Death pandemic (1347–1353) devastated Europe, killing tens of millions, but today antibiotics can treat plague if diagnosed early, aided by hygiene, public health measures, and rodent control. Still, cases occur yearly, most commonly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Madagascar; Russia also reports cases. Rodents carry bubonic plague, and urban rodent populations sustain ongoing risk.

triage.headline_ja: 黒死病：ペストは現在も発生しているのか？ - Technology Org
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はロシア・イルクーツクでの1件の死亡例（検査陰性、症状なし）を発端としたペストに関する一般的な解説記事であり、対象国における具体的な新規アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はペストの一般的な歴史・疫学解説であり、ロシアの1事例（検査陰性）が中心。DRCやマダガスカルは『例年発生する地域』として背景情報として言及されているのみで、具体的な現行アウトブレイクの主題ではないため、対象国としては計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya reports first Ebola death after traveler from Congo via Uganda dies in Nairobi
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first Ebola virus disease (EVD) case and its first Ebola death after a man who had lived in Congo for seven years traveled to Nairobi via Uganda. Ill for about a month, he sought care at several hospitals before traveling by road to Kampala and then by air to Nairobi. He arrived in the Kenyan capital on Saturday, was admitted to Nairobi Hospital, and isolated while testing positive for Ebola; he died late Monday. Kenyan authorities have placed border points on high alert and launched contact tracing to identify people who may have been exposed to the virus. The case appears to be imported from Congo, with investigations and tracing ongoing to assess exposure and risk.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、コンゴからウガンダ経由で入国した渡航者がナイロビで死亡し、初のエボラ症例・死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ(DRC)由来のエボラ感染者がウガンダ経由でケニアに入国し死亡した国際伝播事例であり、IHR4基準全てに該当する重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴ(DRC)に7年間居住していたとされ、同国での感染が背景にあると推測される。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsとした。DRCでの進行中のエボラ流行状況や、ケニア・ウガンダでの二次感染の有無について続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Trump Admin's Secret Scramble Over Putin's Plague Mystery Exposed
article.articleSummary: 28-year-old lab technician Darya Shipilova died at the Irkutsk Research Anti-Plague Institute of Siberia, with Russia offering few details on the pathogen. The Kremlin has not disclosed which deadly disease killed her, prompting U.S. officials to press for transparency amid fears the incident could involve pathogens studied at the facility, including pneumonic plague, brucellosis, cholera, and anthrax. Initial reports of a pneumonic plague spillover were later downplayed, and questions remain whether the agent was modified during research, complicating outbreak response. A local hospital quarantine has put nearly 200 people under observation. U.S. Secretary of State Rubio urged Russia to share information; Trump said he would discuss with Putin. Critics warn the secrecy could hinder accountability and biosafety, with a geostrategic parallel drawn to China’s COVID handling.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ政権、プーチンの『疫病』謎をめぐる秘密の動きが発覚
triage.triage_reason: ロシアの病原体研究所関連で原因不明の死亡者が出ており、約200人が検疫対象となっている。病原体の特定・改変の可能性や情報不透明性から国際的な政治的関心も高く、バイオセーフティ上の重大な懸念がある。
triage.notes: 事件はロシア・イルクーツク州の抗ペスト研究所で発生しており、対象国リスト（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ等）には該当しない。中国はCOVID対応との比較文脈でのみ言及されており、発生国ではないため除外。病原体はペスト、ブルセラ症、コレラ、炭疽菌のいずれかとされるが未確定。

article.articleHeadline: (影) 恐怖巧合？2019武漢演練新冠 今年中俄演習鼠疫 傳中「這些高官」不見了
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: (Video) Terrifying coincidence? The 2019 Wuhan drill on the novel coronavirus; This year's China–Russia joint drills feature plague; Reports in China say these officials have disappeared.
article.articleSummary: Aug 24–27, 2026: a China–Russia cross-border infectious disease emergency drill in Fuyuan, Heilongjiang, included an ‘imported plague and cross-border response’ scenario. Participants featured China CDC Emergency Response Office deputy director Chen Lei, Heilongjiang health officials Fang Qingwei, Jiamusi official He Dahai, and Sergei Balakhonov, head of the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute. Shortly after the exercise, an Irkutsk Region female employee of the anti-plague institute died; authorities describe the death as pneumonia of unknown cause, with plague not confirmed. Netizens note tightened measures despite government claims of plague controllability; the US monitors and seeks transparency. Chinese media largely silent. The report highlights a coincidental link to China’s 2019 Wuhan coronavirus emergency drill and notes public speculation about historical reenactment as events unfold.

triage.headline_ja: (動画) 恐怖の偶然？2019年武漢で新型コロナ演習、今年は中露でペスト演習――中国で『これら高官』が姿を消したとの報道
triage.triage_reason: 中露合同演習（ペスト想定）後にロシア側職員が原因不明の肺炎で死亡したが、ペストは未確認であり、記事自体も陰謀論的な推測・憶測が中心で確認された感染症アウトブレイクの事実は乏しい。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は中露合同演習（ペスト想定）と2019年武漢演習の『偶然の一致』を巡る陰謀論的な報道であり、ロシア・イルクーツクでの職員死亡は原因不明の肺炎としてペスト未確認。実際の感染症発生事実としての確度は低く、憶測・政治的関心に基づく内容が中心。

article.articleHeadline: 俄总统助理帕特鲁舍夫周四访华 北京：中俄在传染病防控领域保持密切交流合作
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russian presidential aide Patrushev to visit China on Thursday; Beijing: China-Russia maintain close exchanges and cooperation in infectious disease prevention and control.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-07, U.S. officials pressed Russia for information after a 28-year-old worker at the Siberia and Far East Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute died of pneumonia of unknown etiology. Russian regulators reported no plague cases among contacts; two colleagues tested positive for COVID-19 and one for rhinovirus. U.S. diplomats urged transparency and cautioned against premature conclusions about a plague outbreak. Separately, Beijing announced that Patrushev, the Russian presidential aide and chairman of the Maritime Committee, will visit China Oct 8–13 to meet Wang Yi, underscoring China–Russia cooperation in infectious disease prevention and control. Patrushev is a longtime security official who previously led the FSB and later served as secretary of the Security Council.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア大統領補佐官パトルシェフ氏、木曜日に訪中予定／北京:中露は感染症予防対策分野で緊密な交流・協力を継続
triage.triage_reason: シベリアの抗ペスト研究所職員が原因不明の肺炎で死亡し、ペスト疑いで米国が情報開示を求めている点は異常だが、ロシア当局はペスト感染を否定しており、対象国（中国含む）における実際の発生は確認されていないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 疾患発生の主体はロシア・イルクーツクの抗ペスト研究所職員の死亡事例であり、中国は外交協力（パトルシェフ氏訪中）の文脈でのみ言及されている。対象国リストにロシアは含まれず、中国についても実際の感染症発生地ではないため verified_locations は空とした。続報でペスト確定診断や感染拡大の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: OMS cere Rusiei clarificări după decesul unei laborante de la un institut de cercetare a ciumei - ipn.md
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO asks Russia for clarifications after the death of a laboratory technician at a plague research institute.
article.articleSummary: Plague research institute in Irkutsk, Russia, reports death of a 28-year-old laboratory technician on October 2. WHO seeks clarifications from Russia and has offered technical support as nearly 200 contacts are quarantined amid conflicting reports: Moscow attributes death to pneumonia, while Telegram channels speculate plague exposure after a possible lab spill, travel to Thailand, or crossings near Mongolia. Russian federal agency Rospotrebnadzor states no laboratory incidents and pneumonia was the diagnosed cause. Irkutsk hospitals are not confirmed to have a three-week quarantine; authorities deny such claims. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus emphasizes timely, complete, and transparent information to resolve discrepancies and assess risk. Moldova's National Public Health Agency says the domestic risk of plague is very low and surveillance is ongoing; last natural foci were around 1950. WHO notes plague is treatable with antibiotics today, reducing historic threat.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがロシアに対し、ペスト研究所の検査技師死亡についての説明を要求
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究所の検査技師が死亡し、約200人の接触者が隔離される中、WHOがロシアに説明と技術支援を申し出ており、情報の透明性欠如と国際的関心の高さからフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア・イルクーツク（対象国リスト外）。タイ渡航の可能性はTelegramでの憶測であり、確認された発生地ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。モスクワ当局は肺炎による死亡と主張し、実験室事故や検疫を否定しているが、WHOは透明性のある情報開示を求めている。続報及び公式確認情報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : un premier décès au Kenya lié à un cas importé de RDC - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the first death in Kenya linked to an imported case from the DRC - Mali Actu
article.articleSummary: First imported Ebola death in Kenya confirmed in Nairobi on October 5, 2026. The patient, a Kenyan citizen who had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo for seven years, fell ill about a month earlier and was treated in several DRC hospitals. He arrived in Nairobi on October 3 after traveling from DRC via Kampala, boarding Jambojet flight 8523 to Nairobi, arriving at 13:10. Kenyan authorities identified about 50 contacts. This marks the first imported Bundibugyo-strain Ebola case confirmed in Kenya. In the DRC, MSF warns of alarming spread, with North Kivu accounting for about 40% of new confirmed cases; the country reports 4,080 deaths and 8,440 confirmed cases. MSF cites limited care capacity, raising concerns the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak could become Africa’s deadliest. Some churches, including Jehovah’s Witnesses, have adapted gatherings to reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国からの輸入症例に関連し、ケニアで初の死亡例
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模アウトブレイク（死者4,080人、確定症例8,440人）がケニアへの国際的拡大（輸入症例・死亡）を引き起こしており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ケニアおよびウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。記事の主題はDRCで進行中のBundibugyo株エボラアウトブレイクであり、ケニアへの輸入症例はその波及として扱った。

article.articleHeadline: وفاة باحثة روسية والصحة العالمية تحقق.. هل يعود الطاعون الرئوي؟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death of a Russian researcher and WHO investigates... Will the pneumonic plague return?
article.articleSummary: Daria Shibelova, a 28-year-old researcher at Irkutsk's plague institute, died in a hospital in Shelekhov near Irkutsk on Friday as the WHO investigates a potential pneumonic plague link to a lab incident. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus noted Russia reported no recent plague cases in Irkutsk Oblast and called for rapid, transparent outbreak reporting, contact tracing, and surveillance of identified contacts. The United States cautioned that investigations must comply with International Health Regulations. China said it is cooperating with Russia to prevent and control communicable diseases, including pneumonic plague. Mongolia's health ministry assessed the immediate risk as low and said it would maintain border monitoring with Russia. Pneumonic plague is the most lethal form, spreads through respiratory droplets, and is treatable with antibiotics when diagnosed early; it has historical associations with the Black Death. Russian authorities have not confirmed a plague case.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの研究者死亡、WHOが調査…肺ペストは再来するのか？
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究所の研究者が死亡し、WHOが実験室由来の肺ペスト感染の可能性を調査しており、公衆衛生上の重大性と異常性が認められるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきと判断。
triage.notes: 事案はロシア・イルクーツク州のペスト研究所で発生した可能性のある実験室関連感染。対象国リスト（中国含む）に実際の発生国は含まれず、中国はロシアへの協力表明のみであるため verified_locations は空とした。ロシア当局は感染確定を発表していない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: 俄總統助理帕特魯舍夫周四訪華 北京：中俄在傳染病防控領域保持密切交流合作
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russian presidential aide Patrushev to visit China on Thursday; Beijing: China-Russia are maintaining close exchanges and cooperation in the field of infectious disease prevention and control.
article.articleSummary: On Oct 7, 2026, the United States formally requested information from Russia amid Donald Trump’s remarks calling pneumonic plague a terrible disease and offering aid as questions arise about a death at the Siberian and Far Eastern Anti-Plague Research Institute from pneumonia of unknown etiology. Russian regulators reported 28-year-old Darya Shipilova died; among those exposed, no plague cases were found, but 2 COVID-19 infections and 1 rhinovirus infection were detected. U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio urged Russia to disclose more information and avoid premature conclusions. Russia’s Patrushev, the presidential aide and former FSB director, is scheduled to visit China Oct 8–13, where Wang Yi will meet him; Beijing says China–Russia are maintaining close exchanges and cooperation in infectious-disease prevention and control.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア大統領補佐官パトルシェフ氏、木曜日に訪中予定；北京「中露は感染症予防管理分野で緊密な交流・協力を維持」
triage.triage_reason: ロシアの抗ペスト研究所関連施設での原因不明肺炎による死亡例を巡り、米国が情報開示を要求するなど国際的な政治的関心が高まっており、ペストの可能性も取り沙汰されているため注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Questions mount over Kenya's first Ebola case as Kalonzo demands transparency
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first Ebola case after a traveller who arrived from Uganda via Entebbe on Oct 3 was cleared at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport, later dying in Nairobi. Kalonzo Musyoka demanded a full, transparent account of the case, including the travel itinerary and actions by health authorities, and questioned why border screening did not detect the virus. Doctors at Nairobi Hospital reportedly identified the danger, not border controls. He called for an independent audit of airport and border screening and for adequate PPE and safety measures for frontline workers. Authorities were tracing 23 contacts three days after the traveller’s arrival. The deceased had been ill for about a month and had received treatment in the Democratic Republic of Congo; public calm and prompt reporting of suspected cases were urged.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア初のエボラ症例を巡り疑問噴出、カロンゾ氏が透明性を要求
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで初のエボラ出血熱症例が確認され、国境検疫の不備や接触者追跡（23名）など国際的拡大リスクが懸念されるため、IHR基準複数該当でフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 主症例はケニアで確認されたが、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。死亡した渡航者はDRCで治療歴があり、感染源としてDRCが示唆されるため含めた。続報で感染経路・接触者追跡結果の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda dice que sigue libre de ébola tras el paso por el país del caso detectado en Kenia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda says it remains Ebola-free after the case detected in Kenya passed through the country.
article.articleSummary: On Oct 7, 2026, Uganda says it remains Ebola-free after a Kenyan case, imported from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), passed through Uganda. Preliminary investigations indicate the Kenyan patient traveled from the DRC, spent less than 24 hours in Uganda, then continued to Kenya; he had a normal temperature at Entebbe International Airport near Kampala. Kenya confirmed its first imported Bundibugyo Ebola case, a Kenyan citizen who had lived in the DRC and died in Nairobi after treatment in Congo, traveling by road to Kampala and then by air to Nairobi on Oct 3. Kenyan authorities have identified dozens of contacts and are tracing passengers and crew of the relevant flight. The DRC’s Bundibugyo outbreak is the second-deadliest on record, with 8,544 cases and 4,114 deaths; Uganda’s outbreak ended per WHO, with 20 confirmed infections (15 imported) and two deaths. Bundibugyo has no specific treatments; vaccines are in early human trials.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、ケニアで検出された症例が自国を通過した後も『エボラフリー』を維持していると発表
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がケニアへ輸入され、ウガンダを経由して国際的に拡大した事例であり、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCで進行中のブンディブギョ・エボラ流行（史上2番目に致死的、8,544症例・4,114死亡）が感染源であり、同国を対象国として記載。ケニアでの輸入症例およびウガンダ通過の詳細は続報が必要。
