article.articleHeadline: Namibia Beef Exports Halted as FMD Closes Europe ESSFeed
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) reached Namibia's cattle region, inside recognised FMD-free zone, forcing a halt to beef exports to Europe. FMD was confirmed on a farm in Karasburg, ||Kharas region—the first outbreak there since 1964. On 22 September, 63 cattle showed signs; 11 samples were tested, 10 positive. Namibia activated its contingency plan, halting movements, slaughter, and trade of animals and suspending imports, exports, and transit of affected products. Meatco paused exports; authorities are reviewing consignments exported or in transit, including a shipment returned from Europe. Europe and the UK have suspended fresh-meat imports from Namibia; EU restrictions affect Namibian meat. In 2025, Namibia exported over 13,000 tonnes of beef, over 90% to Europe; the UK and Norway accounted for about 60% of earnings. Southern Africa reports FMD outbreaks in South Africa, Botswana, Zimbabwe, Zambia, Mozambique, and Lesotho. Recovery to FMD-free status typically takes months and depends on surveillance and vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 口蹄疫の発生によりナミビアの牛肉輸出が停止、欧州向け輸出が閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫は動物疾病でヒトへの直接的な公衆衛生影響は報告されていないが、南部アフリカ複数国での拡大と貿易制限が生じており、今後の状況を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事はナミビアにおける口蹄疫の発生と欧州・英国向け牛肉輸出停止が主題であり、ナミビアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。南部アフリカ地域の発生国として言及されたZambiaのみ対象国に該当するため記載。口蹄疫は動物疾病でありヒトへの重篤な健康影響は通常報告されないため、公衆衛生上の深刻性は低いと評価した。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Tightens JKIA Checks for Travellers From 10 Nations After Ebola Case
article.articleSummary: Kenya has recorded its first imported Ebola Bundibugyo virus case, triggering tightened screening at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport (JKIA). As of Oct 7, 2026, travellers arriving from 10 Ebola-affected or at-risk countries—DRC, Uganda, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Angola, Zambia, Rwanda, Burundi, South Sudan, and the Central African Republic—will be directed to Gate 16 for enhanced screening by Port Health officials and health declaration forms. The government has deployed screening facilities and personnel at Gate 16 and is expanding preparedness across public, private, and faith-based health facilities. Five facilities near the Uganda border have been designated as temporary isolation centres for suspected cases, including Malaba Health Centre, Busia Border, and Kocholia, with a Busia County district hospital renovations to serve as a first point of care; completion expected in 10–14 days. The Digital Health Agency and telecoms are upgrading the 719 toll-free hotline to support the response.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ症例確認後に10か国からの渡航者に対しJKIAでの検疫強化
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで輸入エボラ症例（ブンディブギョ株）が確認され、複数国からの渡航者に対する空港検疫強化措置が取られており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアでの輸入症例とそれに伴う空港検疫強化だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれない。DRC・ザンビアは『エボラ感染国/リスク国』として明示的に列挙されているため、対象国リストに該当するものとしてverified_locationsに含めた。他の列挙国（ウガンダ、タンザニア、エチオピア、アンゴラ、ルワンダ、ブルンジ、南スーダン、中央アフリカ）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 10 quarantined, 57 contacts identified as Health Ministry steps up response
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first Ebola case, an imported infection from the Democratic Republic of Congo, arriving in Kenya after a journey through Kampala. On October 7, 2026, 10 people have been quarantined and 57 contacts identified through contact tracing; authorities expect numbers to rise as follow-up continues. The case is not an outbreak but under management. Public Health Principal Secretary Mary Muthoni said the ministry is intensifying surveillance at 15 points of entry and activating treatment centers in counties bordering neighbouring countries. Health Director-General Patrick Amoth affirmed readiness to isolate or quarantine affected individuals, including makeshift facilities if needed. The patient developed fever, chills, intense fatigue and bleeding under the skin at an injection site, was treated at The Nairobi Hospital under infection-control measures, and died after samples were tested at the National Reference Laboratory. Ongoing response relies on surveillance, tracing and public communication, with county and faith-based facility collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: 10人を隔離、57人の濃厚接触者を特定、保健省が対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでDRC由来の輸入エボラ症例が確認され死亡、濃厚接触者57人を特定するなど公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念があり、IHR基準にも複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアにおける輸入エボラ症例であり、感染者の渡航経路としてDRC・ウガンダ（カンパラ）が言及されているが、これらは発生国ではないため対象国リストには該当しない。ケニア自体は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: 俄疑发生鼠疫，美国驻俄使馆发布警告：在俄公民立即离开_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia reports a suspected plague outbreak; U.S. Embassy in Russia issues warning: U.S. citizens in Russia should leave immediately.
article.articleSummary: Suspected pneumonic plague outbreak reported in Irkutsk region, Russia, after a 28-year-old laboratory worker at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute died. Russian authorities list the death as pneumonia of unknown origin; tests say no microorganism linked to the lab work was found, and no new infectious disease cases have appeared among staff in the past ten days. About 200 contacts are under medical observation and isolation, and authorities have closed some hospitals. As of 2026-10-07, no plague infection has been detected. The United States Embassy issued a health alert on Oct 6, advising U.S. citizens to leave Russia immediately and follow local guidance; the Level 4 travel advisory remains in effect. The WHO assessment places Irkutsk’s public health risk at mid-to-low, Russia at low, and Europe at extremely low; Irkutsk city reports no plague cases and contact tests are negative. China-Russia cooperation on cross-border infectious disease control noted.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでペスト疑いの発生、在ロシア米国大使館が警告：ロシア在住の米国人に即時退避を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの抗ペスト研究所職員の原因不明肺炎死を受けた疑い事例だが、ペスト菌は未検出でWHOもリスクを低～中程度と評価しており確定情報が不足している。対象国（中露協力の記述はあるが発生地は中国ではない）に該当しないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア（イルクーツク州）であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空。中国との国境感染症対策協力が言及されているが、中国国内での発生事例ではない。確定診断（ペスト菌検出）はなく、WHOはリスクを低～中程度と評価。米国大使館による渡航警告が発出されている点は注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 忧猪瘟随进口肉传入 槟猪农促禁泰冷鲜猪肉 - 地方 - 北马新闻
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concerns that African swine fever could be introduced via imported meat; Penang pig farmers urge ban on Thai chilled pork - Local - Northern Malaysia News
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) fears in Malaysia as Penang pig farmers urge ban on Thai chilled pork after Thai ASF outbreaks and recent flooding. The Penang Pig Farmers Association warns imported chilled meat could carry ASF and spark a wave of infections, threatening recovery of pig farming. In Peace Village, about 63 pig farms were affected when ASF hit last May; Penang as a whole has over 108 pig farms, with roughly 68 in Peace Village. After investment to resume production, local pig prices have fallen from about RM 17.50/kg in April to around RM 12.50–13.00/kg. The government approved four Thai exporters to ship chilled pork in February, prompting calls for tighter safeguards or a ban to reduce entry risk. ASF virus can survive long in the environment, so safe transport/handling is crucial; sourcing from ASF-free countries such as Denmark or Spain is suggested if imports are needed.

triage.headline_ja: 豚熱(ASF)流入を懸念、ペナンの養豚業者がタイ産冷蔵豚肉の禁止を要求
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱(ASF)は家畜疾病であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生影響はないため、IHR/WPRO基準（人の感染症監視）の対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 本記事はアフリカ豚熱（ASF）という動物疾病に関するもので、ヒトの公衆衛生リスクはない。主題はマレーシア(ペナン)の養豚業界がタイ産冷蔵豚肉の輸入禁止を求める経済・貿易上の懸念であるが、マレーシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。タイはASF発生国として言及されているため記載。人獣共通感染症ではないためEBSのヒト感染症シグナルとしては見送り対象。

article.articleHeadline: Fruktad variant av ebola hittad i nytt land | Sveriges Radio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A dreaded Ebola variant found in a new country.
article.articleSummary: Kenya, as of 2026-10-07, reports its first case of the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola virus disease (EBOV) in a Kenyan citizen who had traveled through neighboring countries. Earlier this year, Ebola outbreaks were recorded in neighboring areas, including Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with thousands of confirmed cases. With this case, Kenya becomes the fourth country to confirm Bundibugyo EBOV infections, according to the World Health Organization. The report underscores cross-border transmission risk and the need for surveillance and rapid public health response. No information on symptoms, diagnostic method, or infection source beyond travel within the region is provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: 恐れられていたエボラ変異株が新たな国で発見
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準が複数該当（深刻性、異常性、国際的拡大）し、コンゴ民主共和国で数千人規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが継続し、国境を越えた伝播が確認されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの新規症例だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。一方、感染源地域として言及されているコンゴ民主共和国（キンシャサ）では数千人規模の既存アウトブレイクがあり、対象国として該当するため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: US Embassy issues Ebola alert to Americans in Kenya
article.articleSummary: Kenya reported its first imported Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease case in Nairobi. The patient, ill for about a month, traveled from the DRC through Uganda by road to Kenya, arriving on Oct 3, 2026 via Entebbe–Nairobi (JKIA) and dying on Oct 5. The case is laboratory-confirmed as Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease (viral haemorrhagic fever). The U.S. Embassy in Nairobi issued a health alert on Oct 7, 2026, advising Americans exposed to monitor symptoms and adhere to a 21‑day post-travel surveillance. Kenyan authorities intensified contact tracing, identifying 28 contacts (family and healthcare workers) and tracing 23 passengers plus 4 crew members on the Entebbe–Nairobi flight. Quarantine arrangements are being prepared to curb transmission, while non-contact greetings are urged by Public Health Director‑General Dr Patrick Amoth to minimize spread.

triage.headline_ja: 米国大使館、ケニア在住米国人にエボラ出血熱に関する注意喚起を発出
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでBundibugyoエボラウイルス病の輸入症例（DRC由来、死亡）が確認され、航空機同乗者を含む接触者追跡が進行中であり、国際的拡大・渡航制限のリスクが高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCから発症し、ウガンダ経由でケニアに入国後死亡。発症・死亡地はケニア（対象国外）だが、感染源はDRC由来のBundibugyoエボラ株流行が示唆されるためDRCを計上。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: روس: طاعون کا شبہ، 200 افراد قرنطینہ، دنیا کی تشویش بڑھ گئی
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia: Suspected plague, 200 people quarantined, global concern grows.
article.articleSummary: In Siberia, Russia, about 200 people have been quarantined after a 28-year-old employee of an anti-plague research institute fell ill on Sept 30 and died two days later at a hospital in Shelkhov. Some reports suggest a laboratory incident involving a broken test tube, but officials have not confirmed this. Around 200 contacts are quarantined; parts of the hospital were restricted. Two contacts tested positive for COVID-19 and two for rhinovirus; no other infectious diseases were detected. Authorities say there is no evidence linking the death or illness to Yersinia pestis, the plague bacterium studied at the institute. The regional governor said the death was due to pneumonia of unknown cause; no other workers have shown similar illness. Plague remains present in parts of Siberia; globally 1,000–2,000 cases annually, with Congo and Madagascar reporting most new cases since 2019–2025. Experts note that lab exposure would warrant isolation and antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア：ペスト感染疑い、200人隔離、世界的な懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: ペスト菌（Yersinia pestis）との関連は当局により否定されており、死因は原因不明の肺炎とされている。確定診断や感染経路が不明なため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア（シベリア）における研究所関連の死亡例であり、対象国リストに含まれるDRC・マダガスカルは世界的なペスト発生状況の背景情報としてのみ言及されている（2019〜2025年の新規症例の多くを占める、という文脈）ため、verified_locationsには含めない。ペスト菌感染は確認されておらず、接触者の検査結果もCOVID-19やライノウイルスのみ陽性で、ペストは検出されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 28岁实验员打碎病原体试管后离世，近200人隔离，鼠疫疑云再起_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 28-year-old lab technician dies after breaking a vial containing a pathogen; nearly 200 people quarantined; suspicions of plague arise again.
article.articleSummary: 28-year-old laboratory technician at Irkutsk’s Anti-Plague Research Institute died after a vial containing a pathogen shattered on September 25. She was admitted with severe pneumonia on September 29 and died on October 3. Authorities quarantined 197 close contacts and the regional health chief flew to the site, with the institute sealed. Media speculated plague as the cause, citing a regional official, but Russia’s public health watchdog says the cause is unknown pneumonia; the patient’s samples did not test positive for a microbe linked to her work, and testing methods/results have not been disclosed. All quarantined individuals are asymptomatic and tests have been negative. The incident recalls Russia’s past plague events, including a 2016 bubonic plague case in Altai and a Mongolia incident where a Russian couple died after eating raw marmots. Tourists are advised to avoid marmots; plague is flea-transmitted and highly lethal if untreated. In China, risk remains very low but awareness is advised.

triage.headline_ja: 28歳の実験技師が病原体入りの試験管を割った後に死亡、約200人が隔離、ペスト（鼠疫）疑惑が再浮上
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの抗ペスト研究所の実験技師が原因不明の重症肺炎で死亡し、197人が隔離されるなど異常性・重大性が高く、IHR基準を2つ満たすためフルRRAでの精査が妥当と判断した。ただし発生地域は対象国リストに含まれない。
triage.notes: 事件発生地はロシア（イルクーツク）であり、モンゴルの過去事例や中国への波及懸念は言及されているが、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当国が含まれない。中国は『リスクは非常に低いが注意喚起』との言及のみで、事件の主題地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。公式には原因不明肺炎とされ、ペストとの関連は未確認。

article.articleHeadline: 俄羅斯鼠疫疫情成謎！4國加強邊境檢疫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia's plague outbreak remains a mystery! Four countries tighten border quarantine measures.
article.articleSummary: A 28-year-old female researcher at Irkutsk's plague research institute died of an unknown pneumonia, raising fears of pneumonic plague. About 200 contacts were traced and isolated; around 60 institute staff were quarantined and hospitals tightened preventive measures. At a local maternity clinic, pregnant women faced enhanced screening, masks, and two questionnaires, including one for suspected high-risk infectious disease plague with fever and chest pains. The first abnormal signal appeared Oct 2 when Irkutsk Governor Igor Kobzev said Rospotrebnadzor head Anna Popova convened an emergency meeting over a suspected case of a highly dangerous infectious disease; a neighboring official initially stated the woman died of plague, later amended to possible plague. No official confirmation yet; Russia’s handling is seen as opaque. Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, and Tajikistan have implemented border quarantine, while China has not taken additional measures.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアのペスト（鼠疫）流行が謎に包まれる！周辺4か国が国境検疫を強化
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクでのペスト研究所職員の原因不明肺炎死亡事例を受け、周辺複数国が国境検疫を強化しており、IHR基準（異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限）に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（イルクーツク）であり対象国リストに含まれない。中国は国境措置を取っていないと記載されるのみで、発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。ロシア当局による公式確認は未了で情報が不透明との指摘あり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Waspadai Ancaman Senyap Infeksi Parasit, Kalbe Animal Health Dorong Deteksi Dini Kesehatan Hewan Peliharaan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beware the Silent Threat of Parasitic Infections as Kalbe Animal Health Urges Early Detection of Pets' Health
article.articleSummary: On 7 October 2026, in Jakarta, Indonesia, Kalbe Farma's Kalbe Animal Health marked World Animal Day by urging pet owners to detect parasitic infections early. Pets may appear healthy while harboring ectoparasites (fleas, lice, ticks, mites) or endoparasites (tapeworms, roundworms, hookworms). Signs include reduced appetite, lethargy, and weight loss. Indoor pets are not exempt, as parasite eggs can be tracked indoors via footwear and ingestion during grooming. Improper flea control can spread eggs; most flea life cycles occur in the environment, so sanitation is crucial. Regular health checks are particularly important for senior animals. Kalbe promotes preventive products: Anthel Cat and Anthel Dog dewormers, and Liberator spot-on protection against fleas and ticks, aiming to lower parasite-borne disease risk and promote ongoing medical monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: 寄生虫感染という静かな脅威に注意、カルベ・アニマルヘルスがペットの健康早期発見を推進
triage.triage_reason: これは特定の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、企業による世界動物の日にちなんだペット寄生虫予防の啓発・製品宣伝記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 疾患発生報告ではなく、企業のペット向け寄生虫予防製品・早期検出啓発に関する広報記事。トリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Nairobi Hospital fully operational after Ebola patient death, management confirms
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Kenya: The Nairobi Hospital confirms it is fully operational after the death of an Ebola patient. A 39-year-old Kenyan man who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo for seven years traveled from Uganda to Kenya and was admitted to the isolation unit on October 3, dying on October 5. On admission he had fever, muscle aches, severe fatigue, bleeding under the skin at injection sites and sore throat; Ebola was laboratory-confirmed at the National Public Health Laboratory. The isolation unit is separate from the main facility, with dedicated staff and PPE; no shared clinical space. Contacts include 28 individuals in Nairobi and 27 people who traveled on the same flight from Uganda, monitored for 21 days. Nairobi County reports 22 suspected Ebola cases in 11 sub-counties since May 16, with three deaths (one confirmed); two deaths tested negative. Hotline 1508; surveillance remains in effect.

triage.headline_ja: ナイロビ病院、エボラ患者死亡後も通常運営を確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱による死亡例が確認され、国境を越えた移動歴と航空機同乗者を含む接触者追跡が発生しており、国際的拡大リスクが高い重大事案である。
triage.notes: 本事例の実際の発生国はケニア（ナイロビ）であり、患者はウガンダ経由で渡航、DRC居住歴があるが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれる発生国ではないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。DRCは患者の過去居住歴として言及されているのみで、感染発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 俄羅斯鼠疫病原外洩！民眾揭醫院不尋常問答 4國加強邊境檢疫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russian plague pathogen leak! Public reveals unusual hospital Q&A; four countries tighten border quarantine.
article.articleSummary: In Irkutsk, Siberia, Russia, a 28-year-old researcher at a plague-prevention institute, Darya Shipilova, died of unknown pneumonia on Oct 2, raising concerns about pneumonic plague. Authorities quarantined about 200 contacts and 60 institute staff, with hospitals implementing new epidemic-prevention measures. The maternity hospital in Irkutsk reportedly screened patients for plague-suspected symptoms via questionnaires labeled as an investigation of a 'highly dangerous infectious disease,' describing a new unknown virus to protect newborns. Official statements about the death were unclear: an adjacent republic leader initially claimed plague, later saying it was possible. Four Central Asian countries—Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, and Tajikistan—tightened border controls; Uzbekistan boosted readiness for highly fatal infectious diseases; China reportedly did not impose extra border measures. No laboratory confirmation of plague or transmission has been disclosed.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでペスト病原体流出か！住民が病院の不審な問診を暴露、4カ国が国境検疫を強化
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究所職員の原因不明肺炎死亡を受け、接触者約260人の隔離や周辺4カ国の国境強化など国際的対応が取られており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAに進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: 発生国はロシア（イルクーツク）であり、対象国リストに含まれない。中国は『追加の国境措置を取らなかった』という言及のみで発生国ではないため除外。中央アジア4カ国も国境強化対応国であり発生国ではない。ペストの検査室での確定診断は未公表で、公式見解も一貫していない点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Китай впервые заговорил о чуме в России и заявил о контактах с Москвой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China for the first time spoke about the plague in Russia and said it had contacts with Moscow.
article.articleSummary: China for the first time publicly commented on reports of a probable pneumonic plague case in Siberia, stating Beijing and Moscow maintain close communication and cooperation on infectious-disease prevention, including plague. In Irkutsk Oblast, a 28-year-old laboratory technician died after breaking a vial containing the plague pathogen, with hospitalization for severe pneumonia prior to death. Authorities imposed quarantines in several regional medical facilities. Russian officials downplayed the issue, urging trust in official information from Rospotrebnadzor. The World Health Organization urged Russia to provide full transparency regarding the possible death from pneumonic plague in Siberia. Separately, more than a month earlier Irkutsk hosted a joint exercise with China on emergency response to disease outbreaks; participants discussed monitoring and controlling cross-border spread in frontier regions.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、ロシアでのペスト発生について初めて言及し、モスクワとの連絡を表明
triage.triage_reason: シベリアでの肺ペストによる死亡例が発生し、WHOがロシアに透明性を求めるなど国際的関心が高まっており、国境地域での越境拡大リスクも指摘されているため。
triage.notes: 発生国はロシア（イルクーツク州）であり対象国リストには含まれない。中国は発生国ではなく、モスクワとの協力・コメントを行った立場であるため verified_locations からは除外した。WHOがロシアに透明性を求めている点、研究室由来の肺ペスト死亡例である点から高いリスクシグナルと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Yellow fever outbreak kills seven in Sissala East
article.articleSummary: Seven people have died in a confirmed Yellow Fever outbreak in the Sissala East Municipality, Upper West Region, with children and young people among the hardest hit. Health authorities report multiple deaths across several communities and have intensified containment efforts. The Sissala East Health Directorate confirms the outbreak and is actively identifying suspected cases, tracing contacts, and curbing transmission. A Fulani community leader described rapid deaths, noting the first known case was brought to hospital and died two days later, with bleeding from the nose and mouth observed. The death toll has risen to seven, elevating concern and prompting calls for investigation. Yellow Fever is a viral disease transmitted by mosquitoes and can cause fever, headache, muscle pain, nausea and vomiting; severe cases may lead to jaundice, bleeding, and organ failure. Early detection and response are critical.

triage.headline_ja: 黄熱病の流行、シサラ・イースト地区で7人死亡
triage.triage_reason: ガーナ・シサラ・イーストで黄熱病の確定アウトブレイクが発生し7人が死亡。黄熱病はIHR Annex2で即時通報対象疾患であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 黄熱病はワクチンで予防可能だが、蚊媒介性で重症化しやすく国際的にも注意喚起が必要な疾患。感染地域の拡大状況や接触者追跡の進捗など続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kenyan health workers demand protection after first Ebola death
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first Ebola death after a Kenyan national infected in the Democratic Republic of Congo dies in Nairobi. The 40-year-old contracted the Bundibugyo strain, became ill about a month ago, was treated in DRC, traveled overland to Kampala then flew to Nairobi on Oct 3, and died Oct 5 in the evening. Health authorities have identified 28 contacts, including family and healthcare workers; none have tested positive so far. Investigators are pursuing 23 passengers and four crew members from the same flight, with quarantine for at-risk individuals prepared. The Kenya Medical Practitioners, Pharmacists and Dentists Union urged urgent protection for health workers, calling for immediate monitoring, psychological support, and rigorous contact tracing alongside facility preparedness. Uganda had 20 cases and two deaths linked to the outbreak before being declared Ebola-free in August. Globally, as of Oct 2, WHO reported 4,082 deaths among 8,463 cases since the DRC outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアの医療従事者、エボラ熱による初の死亡例を受け保護を要求
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ出血熱患者がウガンダを経由してケニアへ渡航し死亡した事例で、国際的な感染拡大リスクと接触者調査が進行中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの初のエボラ死亡例だが、感染はDRCでの既存アウトブレイクに由来し、ウガンダ経由での国際移動が確認されている。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外し、感染源であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載した。

article.articleHeadline: بكين: نحافظ على اتصال وثيق مع موسكو بشأن "الطاعون الرئوي"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beijing: We are maintaining close contact with Moscow regarding the pneumonic plague.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 October 2026, China says it is maintaining close contact and cooperation with Russia to prevent and control infectious diseases, including pneumonic plague, over a suspected pneumonic plague case in Siberia. A worker at the Irkutsk plague research institute died last week, prompting about 200 people who had contact with the worker to be placed under monitoring. The incident follows a recent Russia–China emergency-response exercise conducted with the Irkutsk institute, with participants from both countries discussing cross-border disease surveillance near the border. Mongolia's Health Ministry stated the overall risk is low and will continue border security measures and health monitoring in coordination with relevant agencies.

triage.headline_ja: 北京:「肺ペスト」に関してモスクワと緊密に連絡を取り合っている
triage.triage_reason: シベリア(イルクーツク)のペスト研究所職員が肺ペストで死亡し、約200人が接触者として監視下に置かれるなど、重篤な感染症の国境を越えた拡大リスクが懸念されるため。
triage.notes: 事象はロシア(イルクーツク)で発生しており、中国は外交的・技術的協力の立場で言及されているのみで実際の発生国ではないため、対象国リストには該当なし。モンゴル・ロシアは対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS pide a Rusia que aclare si un segundo trabajador del laboratorio que investigaba la peste ha caído enfermo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO asks Russia to clarify whether a second laboratory worker who was investigating the plague has fallen ill.
article.articleSummary: As of 07 October 2026, the World Health Organization asks Russia to clarify reports that a second worker at the Irkutsk–Far East Institute of Plague Research has fallen ill with respiratory symptoms, amid concerns about pneumonic plague. The WHO seeks official confirmation of laboratory technician Darya Shipilova’s death from pneumonia of undetermined cause and the rationale for confining up to 200 contacts in hospitals in Shelekov and Irkutsk. Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor says postmortem tissues show no Yersinia pestis and denies working with the bacterium; authorities have not confirmed plague as the cause. Plague is endemic in Siberia and Central Asia; human spillover from fleas is rare there, with the last natural case in Mongolia six years ago after marmot exposure. A travel link to Thailand has been considered. The United States issued an alert; the EU’s ECDC and WHO monitor, with the WHO assessing very low risk to Europe.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、ペスト研究所の2人目の作業員が発病した可能性についてロシアに説明を求める
triage.triage_reason: ロシアのペスト研究所で作業員が死亡し、さらに2人目が呼吸器症状を呈した疑いがあり、WHOが説明を求めている。国際的な監視（ECDC・米国の警戒発令）も行われており、IHR基準の複数該当が見込まれる。
triage.notes: 発生国はロシア（イルクーツク）とモンゴルで、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない。タイへの渡航歴は「検討されている」との記述のみで、実際の発生地としては確認されていないため、対象国リストに該当する verified_locations はなし。ロシア当局はペスト菌（Yersinia pestis）を否定しており、WHOは欧州へのリスクを非常に低いと評価している点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil reforça vacinação contra sarampo após avanço da doença nas Américas - Diário News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil strengthens measles vaccination after the disease's spread in the Americas - Diário News
article.articleSummary: Measles vaccination in Brazil has been intensified as the Americas confront a broader spread of measles, marked by the United States’ largest outbreak in over 35 years. By Oct 5, 2026 Brazil had 52 measles cases in 2026 (41 in São Paulo, 10 in Amazonas, 1 in Rio de Janeiro). The Health Ministry expanded active case finding, epidemiologic investigation, contact tracing, and vaccination blocks in public spaces to prevent imported cases from triggering transmission. Brazil remains free of endemic measles circulation; certification was lost in 2019 and reinstated by PAHO in Nov 2024. From 2023–2025, 85 cases were confirmed with no deaths. Internationally, PAHO notes the Americas had the most measles cases in 22 years, with >95% in the United States, Guatemala, Mexico, Peru, and Canada. In the US, Pennsylvania exceeded 1,000 cases and five deaths; New York declared an emergency after 108 cases. Brazil targets vaccination in São Paulo, Guarulhos, São Bernardo do Campo, Santo André, and the tri-border area with Colombia and Peru; dose zero is used for some children aged 6–11 months. First-dose MMR coverage was 93.10% in Brazil, 94.39% in São Paulo, and 89.54% in Amazonas in 2025; SUS provides free measles vaccine, and high coverage plus surveillance aim to prevent imported transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、アメリカ大陸における麻疹拡大を受けワクチン接種を強化 - Diário News
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち「異常性」と「国際的拡大リスク」の2項目に該当し、ブラジルでも輸入症例によるアウトブレイクリスクが指摘されているためフルRRAでの評価が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルにおける麻疹対応を中心に報じており、米国・グアテマラ・メキシコ・ペルー・カナダは文脈として言及されているのみで対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。ブラジルは麻疹排除国としての認証を維持しているが輸入症例によるリスクが懸念されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO pledges intensified support as Kenya records first imported Bundibugyo virus case
article.articleSummary: As of 7 October 2026, Kenya reports its first imported Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) case after a Kenyan national who had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo for seven years died at a Nairobi hospital. The World Health Organization is intensifying support to bolster surveillance, contact tracing and protective supplies, coordinating strengthened response measures to prevent further spread. Key efforts include screening at high-risk entry points, risk communication and community engagement, with 27 high-risk counties having identified isolation units, trained case managers, and updated Ebola-surveillance tools. WHO and partners have delivered roughly 1,000 Ebola test kits and a matching number of PPE kits to the identified high-risk counties. Authorities are monitoring contacts for enhanced surveillance. WHO advises against travel or trade restrictions with the DRC, Uganda or Kenya based on available information.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがケニアで初の輸入性ブンディブギョウイルス感染確認を受け、支援強化を表明
triage.triage_reason: 致死例を伴う輸入エボラ関連ウイルス（ブンディブギョウウイルス）感染がケニアで確認され、DRCからの越境感染の可能性があり、WHOが緊急支援を展開しているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニアおよびウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは患者が7年間居住していた国として言及されており、感染源である可能性が高いため含めた。詳細な感染経路・発生地の特定情報は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Embajada de Estados Unidos advierte a sus ciudadanos sobre posible brote de peste en Rusia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. Embassy warns its citizens about a possible plague outbreak in Russia.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague potential outbreak in Russia’s Irkutsk region prompts a U.S. Embassy advisory urging Americans to leave Russia immediately, as reports of a death of a 28-year-old employee at Irkutsk’s Institute of Plague Research and the Far East trigger quarantines and hospital closures in Shelekhov. Investigations consider infection contracted in Thailand or an accidental laboratory exposure, though authorities deny a lab incident. Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor says the deceased died of pneumonia of unknown etiology and that no plague pathogens were detected at the institute; Kremlin officials dispute reports of quarantines. The United States notes limited consular assistance outside Moscow; President Trump plans to call Putin to discuss the situation. ECDC monitors the event, while the WHO characterizes Europe’s risk as very low. Ongoing verification and sources remain under investigation.

triage.headline_ja: 米国大使館、ロシアでのペスト発生の可能性について自国民に警告
triage.triage_reason: 米大使館が国外退避を勧告するなど渡航制限相当の動きがあり、肺ペスト疑いという異常事態かつ国際的関心（大統領間電話協議）も高く、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき案件。
triage.notes: 発生地域として付与されたロシア（イルクーツク州）および米国・タイは本トリアージの対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。ロシア当局はペスト病原体の検出を否定し死因をペスト以外としているが、米大使館は警戒を継続しており、情報の真偽・病原体確定は続報待ち。

article.articleHeadline: Abuja Airport Enforces Health Declaration Forms Amid Ebola Alert
article.articleSummary: Abuja's Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport enforces health declaration forms for eligible arriving passengers as Nigeria raises Ebola alert after the DRC outbreak, now linked to Kenya. The Kenyan national who had lived in the DRC for seven years travelled via Uganda to Nairobi; he developed fever, chills and bleeding under the skin and was isolated upon hospitalisation. Kenya confirmed an imported Bundibugyo virus case connected to the DRC outbreak. Nigeria's FAAN and the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) are boosting screening, contact tracing and post-travel follow-up, with declarations required for passengers from countries with active transmission. The NCDC warned Nigerians and reviewed preparedness accordingly. Global outbreak data through Sept 20, 2026: 7,672 confirmed cases and 3,699 deaths in the DRC; 886 in isolation, 1,879 recovered; 58 new cases and 23 deaths since Sept 19. Ituri leads new cases (38), followed by North Kivu (14), Haut-Uélé (5), Tshopo (1).

triage.headline_ja: アブジャ空港、エボラ警戒の中で健康申告書の提出を義務化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）アウトブレイクが継続し、国際的にケニアへの輸出症例が確認され、ナイジェリアが渡航制限的措置（健康申告義務化）を講じるなど、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCでのエボラアウトブレイクであり、ケニア・ナイジェリアは輸入症例・対応措置の文脈で言及されているが、両国とも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Вероятная смерть от чумы в России: насколько реальна угроза эпидемии
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Probable death from the plague in Russia: how real is the threat of an epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Probable death from pneumonic plague in Irkutsk Oblast, Russia, raises questions about epidemic risk. A laboratory worker died; infection suspected to be pneumonic plague, not yet officially confirmed. WHO says it is in contact with Russian authorities to determine circumstances and obtain lab results. Ukraine’s Public Health Center monitors the Irkutsk region; the US State Department and Embassy have asked for more data and advised Americans to leave Russia due to possible outbreak and quarantines. Pneumonic plague transmits via respiratory droplets but is not highly contagious; current case appears to be a single occupational exposure with no confirmed secondary spread. Globally, plague is rare (about 1,000 cases annually) and endemic in some areas of Russia, China, and the United States. Darya Shipilova, 28, died Oct 2 after admission for severe pneumonia; authorities say no evidence of a laboratory accident; contacts were isolated and quarantines implemented in several facilities.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでペストによる死亡の疑い：流行の脅威はどれほど現実的か
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストによる死亡例が発生し、WHOがロシア当局と連絡を取り合い、米国が自国民に退避勧告を出すなど国際的関心が高まっているため、IHR基準が複数該当する。
triage.notes: 事例はロシア・イルクーツク州の検査室作業員1名の死亡であり、対象国リスト（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ、ガーナ、DRC、ブラジル、インドネシア、中国、ミャンマー、ベトナム、インド）には該当しない。中国は一般的なペスト常在地域として言及されているのみで、本事例の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

locations.name: Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

article.articleHeadline: இலங்கைக்கு காசநோய் எதிர்ப்பு மருந்துகளை வழங்கியது இந்தியா! - ITN News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India supplied Kala-azar medicines to Sri Lanka! - ITN News.
article.articleSummary: On 7 October 2026, India donated medicines valued at about 52 million Sri Lankan rupees to Sri Lanka’s Health and Media Ministries to sustain kala-azar treatment services. The consignment, described as anti-tuberculosis medicines, was handed over by Indian High Commissioner Santosh Jha to Health and Media Minister Nalinda Jayatissa. Jayatissa noted kala-azar is not yet eradicated in Sri Lanka; 6,300 patients have been identified, with a potential total up to 9,000. Due to recent disruptions in the medicine supply chain, there was a short-term shortage; India supplied roughly 2,600 kilograms of medicines in a tight timeframe. The items were delivered to Sri Lanka aboard an Indian Air Force C-130J aircraft. Senior health officials from both countries attended the handover.

triage.headline_ja: インドがスリランカにカラアザール治療薬を提供！ - ITN News
triage.triage_reason: スリランカにおけるカラアザール治療継続のための医薬品供与という外交・人道支援の報道であり、新規の異常な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。また発生国スリランカは対象国リストに含まれない。
triage.notes: 記事はスリランカの既知のカラアザール（内臓リーシュマニア症）患者への医薬品供給に関する外交的支援の内容であり、インドは支援提供国であって発生国ではない。スリランカは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة تنظم برنامجًا تدريبيًا إقليميًا للدول الأفريقية لمكافحة الدرن والأمراض التنفسية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Health organizes a regional training program for African countries to combat tuberculosis and respiratory diseases.
article.articleSummary: Egypt's Ministry of Health and Population organized a regional training program for African countries to combat tuberculosis and respiratory diseases, including COVID-19 and other respiratory infections. Led by Health Minister Dr. Khaled Abdel Ghaffar and supported by JICA and the Egyptian Agency for Partnership for Development, the program aims to strengthen capacities of national health leaders and mid-to-senior staff to curb respiratory diseases and advance TB elimination per WHO strategies and universal health coverage. Since 2022, 77 participants from 28 African nations have been trained; the current session (Sept 27–Oct 22, 2026) includes 20 trainees from 12 countries, with Mozambique leading participation, followed by Ghana and Chad. Egypt’s National TB Program provides guidance for drug-sensitive and drug-resistant TB, including children, refugees, and HIV co-infection, alongside national strategic planning, AI tools, and visits to Egyptian reference centers. Sustainability measures include periodic reports and post-return field evaluations with JICA; WHO, the Egyptian Agency for Partnership for Development, and other partners attended the opening.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、アフリカ諸国向けに結核・呼吸器疾患対策の地域研修プログラムを実施
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はエジプト保健省主催の結核・呼吸器疾患対策に関する研修プログラムの紹介であり、特定の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核・呼吸器疾患対策能力強化のための研修プログラムに関する内容で、アウトブレイク報告ではない。発生地域にエジプト・チャド・モザンビークが含まれるが対象国リスト外。ガーナは対象国リストに含まれ研修参加国として言及されているため記載するが、疾病発生事例ではない。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة تنظم برنامجا تدريبيا للدول الأفريقية لمكافحة الدرن وأمراض التنفس - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Health organizes a training program for African countries to combat tuberculosis and respiratory diseases - Youm7
article.articleSummary: Egypt’s Ministry of Health and Population organized a regional training program to combat tuberculosis, COVID-19, and other respiratory infections in African countries. Under Dr. Khaled Abdel Ghaffar, the initiative is supported by Japan’s JICA and Egypt’s Agency for Partnership for Development (EAPD). It aims to strengthen leadership and mid-to-senior health cadres across Africa to curb respiratory diseases and advance TB elimination in line with WHO strategies and universal health coverage. Since 2022, 77 trainees from 28 African countries have participated; Mozambique, Ghana, and Chad are the top entrants. The current session runs Sept 27–Oct 22, 2026, with 20 trainees from 12 countries. Egypt’s National TB Program equips participants with knowledge and techniques for drug-sensitive and drug-resistant TB, TB/HIV coinfection, pediatric and refugee cases, and AI-driven planning, plus visits to Egyptian reference centers. Sustainability via periodic work reports and JICA post-return evaluations; WHO representatives attended the launch.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、結核・呼吸器疾患対策のためアフリカ諸国向け研修プログラムを実施 - ユーム7
triage.triage_reason: 実際の疾病アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、エジプトが主催する結核・呼吸器疾患対策の研修プログラムに関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核・COVID-19対策の能力構築研修（エジプト主催、JICA支援）に関するものであり、具体的な感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。対象国リストのうちガーナが訓練参加国として言及されているが、現地での発生事例ではない。

article.articleHeadline: ไทยมีศักยภาพพร้อมตรวจเชื้อ 'กาฬโรค' รู้ผลใน 24 ชั่วโมง
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thailand has the capacity to test for the plague, with results in 24 hours.
article.articleSummary: Thailand’s Department of Medical Sciences confirms readiness to diagnose plague in Thailand using biosafety level 3 facilities, enabling real-time PCR detection of Yersinia pestis with results in 24 hours. The lab can culture and confirm results via biochemical tests under quality and biosafety controls. This capacity supports surveillance, prevention, and control for patients under investigation in Thailand, in light of reports of plague incidents abroad and the risk of pneumonic plague transmission via respiratory droplets. No case counts are provided; the emphasis is on rapid, accurate domestic diagnostic capability.

triage.headline_ja: タイ、ペスト菌の検査能力を保有、24時間以内に結果判明
triage.triage_reason: タイ国内での実症例報告はなく、検査体制整備に関する発表のみ。海外でのペスト発生を受けた準備態勢の記事であり、現時点でタイ国内の実際の患者発生は確認されていないため経過観察とする。

article.articleHeadline: تدريب 77 متدربًا من 28 دولة أفريقية ضمن برنامج مكافحة الدرن وكوفيد-19 | مصراوي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Training of 77 trainees from 28 African countries as part of a tuberculosis and COVID-19 control program | Masrawy
article.articleSummary: Regional training program on tuberculosis control, COVID-19 and other respiratory infections brings together 77 African health trainees from 28 countries. Organized by Egypt's Ministry of Health and Population under Dr. Khaled Abdel Ghaffar, in partnership with Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) and the Egyptian Agency for Partnership for Development. Since 2022, the program has trained participants from 28 African nations, with Mozambique, Ghana and Chad most represented. The current cycle runs Sept 27–Oct 22, 2026, involving 20 trainees from 12 countries. The curriculum covers latest scientific and diagnostic approaches, including treatment protocols for drug-susceptible and drug-resistant TB, COVID-19, and other respiratory infections; management of special groups (children, refugees, HIV co-infection); development of national strategic plans; and integration of artificial intelligence tools, plus field visits to Egyptian reference centers. Sustainability is ensured through periodic post-training reporting and JICA-led field evaluations. Attendees included WHO, EAPD, and JICA; Japan’s support was acknowledged.

article.articleSummary: Egypt is leading an Africa-wide regional training program to combat tuberculosis (TB), COVID-19, and other respiratory infections, titled 'TB, COVID-19 and other respiratory infections in African countries.' Supported by Egypt’s Ministry of Health and Population, Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), and the Egyptian Agency for Partnership for Development (EPDA) of the Foreign Ministry, the program builds capacity of senior and mid-level health leaders across Africa. Since 2022, it has trained 77 participants from 28 African countries, with Mozambique, Ghana, and Chad as top contributors. The current session runs Sept 27–Oct 22, 2026, with 20 trainees from 12 countries. Training covers protocols for drug-susceptible and drug-resistant TB, management of children, refugees, and HIV co-infection, national strategic planning, AI tools, and visits to Egyptian reference centers. Sustainability is ensured through periodic reports and post-return field assessments with JICA. WHO, EPDA, and JICA attended the launch; gratitude extended to Japan and EPDA.

article.articleHeadline: В Китае удивили неожиданным заявлением из-за вспышки чумы в России: что происходит
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In China, people were surprised by an unexpected statement about the plague outbreak in Russia: what's happening.
article.articleSummary: Possible pneumonic plague case reported in Siberia, Russia, with China saying it remains in contact with Moscow on disease prevention and control. In Irkutsk Oblast, a 28-year-old employee of the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Scientific Research Institute died on October 2 from pneumonia of unknown origin. Roughly 200 potentially exposed contacts are under medical observation. Russian authorities (Rospotrebnadzor) report no plague pathogens detected in tests related to the deceased’s professional work, and Reuters notes no plague cases among contacts. No official confirmation of plague has been issued. The incident follows prior Sino-Russian cooperation on outbreak response, including a September joint training in Irkutsk focused on emergencies and cross-border infection control. The report does not mention any imported or exported plague cases. Current date context: 7 October 2026.

article.articleHeadline: จับตา! แล็บรัสเซียทำเชื้อหลุด กรมควบคุมโรค ยัน! ไทยเสี่ยงต่ำ-เฝ้าระวังเข้ม
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Watch out! A Russian lab's pathogen leak; the Department of Disease Control confirms Thailand is at low risk—tight surveillance.
article.articleSummary: A laboratory incident in Siberia, Russia, at the Institute for Plague Prevention of Asia and Siberia led to a pathogen leak, resulting in one worker’s death and the quarantine of over 200 close contacts. Initial descriptions suggested pneumonia of unknown origin; analyses indicate pneumonic plague caused by Yersinia pestis, the most severe form with a 50–60% fatality rate if untreated. Exposure occurred on 29–30 September 2026, with the fatality recorded on 2 October 2026; no wide community transmission has been reported. Thailand’s Department of Disease Control states Thailand is at very low risk and maintains tight surveillance. The outbreak appears confined to the lab incident, with no confirmed imported or exported cases; the pathogen is airborne and treatments are available. Global media coverage (Reuters, CNN, CNBC) underscores the concern while authorities stress containment and risk assessment.

triage.headline_ja: 警戒！ロシアの研究所で病原体が流出、疾病管理局は「タイのリスクは低いが厳重監視」と発表

article.articleHeadline: 到底是鼠疫嗎？俄羅斯實驗室人員死因說法不斷變化
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is it plague after all? The cause of death for Russian laboratory personnel keeps changing.
article.articleSummary: Daria Shipilova, 28, a laboratory technician at a Siberian anti-epidemic research institute near Irkutsk (Shelekhov), died after three days in hospital in late September/early October. Russian officials initially tied her death to plague, prompting hospital isolation, a mask mandate at a local aluminum plant, and the cancellation of a major Irkutsk public event; about 197 people were reported under medical observation. The adjacent Buryatia region later announced the death as plague, fueling fears of a laboratory leak. Rospotrebnadzor said she died of an undiagnosed pneumonia with no microbes linked to her work. Authorities and independent outlets provided conflicting updates; several posts were removed. The Irkutsk plague control institute plans an international plague-control conference in late October with scientists from China, Mongolia, and former Soviet states. WHO and ECDC are monitoring, and U.S. officials urged transparency. No confirmed plague cases have been established.

article.articleHeadline: 2.303 Ayam Mati Terpapar Flu Burung di Sinjai, Pemkab Turun Tangan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 2,303 Chickens Die After Contracting Bird Flu in Sinjai Regency, Regency Government Takes Action
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (bird flu) outbreak in Sinjai Regency, South Sulawesi, Indonesia, has killed 2,303 poultry in Sinjai Utara as of 5 October 2026. The first report surfaced on 29 September 2026, with 53 chickens dying in Talibunging, Lappa, followed by 25 deaths in Biringere. Infected birds showed pale to blue-black combs, lethargy, drowsiness, and shortness of breath. Regent Ratnawati Arif ordered the Dinas Peternakan dan Kesehatan Hewan (DPKH) to implement prevention and control measures, coordinating extension workers and veterinarians, and arranging disinfectant spraying and medications. A provincial team from South Sulawesi is set to visit Sinjai to bolster response and support supply of treatments. Authorities emphasize preventing transmission and rapid field response to curb the outbreak among poultry.

China and Russia have prior experience with joint infectious-disease response, including a September Irkutsk drill on emergency response and cross-border infection control. article.articleHeadline: EEUU llama a sus ciudadanos a dejar Rusia por posible brote de peste neumónica: Trump llamará a Putin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US urges its citizens to leave Russia over a possible pneumonic plague outbreak: Trump will call Putin.
article.articleSummary: On 7 October 2026, the U.S. Embassy in Moscow warned of a possible pneumonic plague outbreak in Russia and urged Americans to leave immediately, before a call between Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin. The alert cites a fatal suspected pneumonic plague case in Irkutsk and reported hospital quarantines, though Russian authorities deny an outbreak. The Kremlin urged calm and for citizens to rely on Rospotrebnadzor for information, denying hospital quarantines and saying the deceased had pneumonia of unknown etiology. U.S. travel advisories remain Level 4: Do Not Travel, with limited support outside Moscow. The case centers on the Irkutsk region and Shélejov; a 28-year-old female employee at the Institute of Plague Research of Irkutsk and the Far East died in Shélejov. Two theories are under study—infection in Thailand or a lab accident—though authorities deny the latter. ECDC and WHO monitor risk; Russia offers to assist the United States in fighting outbreaks.

article.articleHeadline: Andhra Guv Abdul Nazeer launches 77th TB seal sale campaign at Lok Bhavan
article.articleSummary: On October 7, 2026, Andhra Pradesh Governor Syed Abdul Nazeer launched the 77th Tuberculosis (TB) Seal Sale Campaign at Durbar Hall, Lok Bhavan, Vijayawada. The event framed TB as a persistent killer since Sir Robert Koch identified the causative organism in 1882, noting its medical, social, and economic toll. Nazeer urged a comprehensive response beyond treatment, including awareness, early diagnosis, prevention, nutrition, social support, and community participation. He highlighted India’s National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme and the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan, advocating a whole-of-government and whole-of-society approach to eradicate TB ahead of the UN SDG 2030 target. The TB Seal—a charitable stamp-like label sold to raise funds for prevention and patient care—originated in Denmark (1903) to aid bone tuberculosis. The programme was attended by TB Association leaders and dignitaries, such as Dr Arun Kumar Kanti Mohanty.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya confirmed the first Ebola case in its history — the patient died in Nairobi.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first Ebola case, with the patient dying in Nairobi. The deceased was a Kenyan citizen who had resided in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) for seven years, in a region affected by a major outbreak. Symptoms appeared about a month earlier; he was treated in Congo and flew to Kenya by air last weekend. After routine checks at Nairobi’s central airport, he was transported to a city hospital where he died two days later. Kenya’s Health Ministry identified 28 close contacts (family and healthcare workers) and 27 flight passengers/crew for monitoring. The DRC outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, and has caused more than 4,000 deaths this year, the second-deadliest on record; Uganda reported two deaths earlier and was later declared Ebola-free by WHO in August. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment yet, though four candidate vaccines are in development, with one in human trials since July.

article.articleHeadline: भारत में 1.2Cr. की मौत, घट गई आबादी, कहानी उस प्लेग की जिससे रूस में महिला मरी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In India, 12 million deaths, population declined, the story of the plague that killed a woman in Russia.
article.articleSummary: Russia’s Siberia plague scare follows the death of 28-year-old Darya Shipilova at Irkutsk’s Anti-Plague Research Institute on 2 October; officials have not confirmed plague, and around 200 contacts are quarantined as a precaution. The World Health Organization is monitoring, with no evidence of a large outbreak or imported cases. The article contrasts this with India’s history of plague: during the third pandemic (1896–1920) India suffered millions of deaths, including about 50.12 lakh between September 1896 and March 1907, and estimates of 1–1.2 crore (10–12 million) deaths through 1920. Population fell modestly between 1911 and 1921 (from 24.90 crore to 24.81 crore). Plague is bacterial, with bubonic form causing lymph node swelling and pneumonic form affecting the lungs and spreading via droplets. Today it is treatable with antibiotics; the current incident does not indicate a contemporary plague threat.

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Tracks Ebola Contacts After Nairobi Death
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first Ebola case after a Kenyan national who had recently travelled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo died in Nairobi, triggering an urgent containment response. The patient, ill for about a month, travelled via Uganda to Nairobi where he died. Authorities quarantined at least eight family members and 21 healthcare workers; 28 contacts were identified, including relatives and those who treated him. Tracing also covered 23 passengers and four crew members on the Uganda–Nairobi flight. Contacts will remain in isolation for 21 days and be released if negative. Uganda had reported 20 cases and two deaths earlier this year but was declared Ebola-free in August. The DRC’s 17th outbreak, declared 15 May, has over 8,300 cases and more than 4,000 deaths; WHO says the outbreak is far from over and could exceed 2014–2016 levels. The UN advised against travel restrictions.

article.articleHeadline: Што такое лёгачная чума і як яна распаўсюджваецца
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is pneumonic plague and how does it spread?
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague, the most dangerous form of plague, is a severe lung infection that can follow bubonic or septicemic disease. Symptoms include shortness of breath, chest pain and coughing up blood; untreated, it is highly lethal. Across bubonic, septicemic and pneumonic forms, annual cases total roughly 1,000–3,000, with bubonic most common. Central Africa accounts for a substantial share, but plague also occurs in Russia, India, China and the United States. Yersinia pestis persists in animal reservoirs—nearly 200 rodent species—across the Americas, Eurasia and Africa, so sporadic human cases persist. Transmission is via infected fleas or contact with animals; human-to-human spread through respiratory droplets is possible in close contact, especially if septicemic disease reaches the lungs. Diagnosis and vaccines, plus antibiotic resistance monitoring, require live-pathogen labs; incubation can be as short as 24 hours. Early antibiotics and post-exposure prophylaxis reduce mortality. A Russian case is under investigation; the U.S. is monitoring.

article.articleHeadline: Embaixada dos Estados Unidos alerta cidadãos para possível surto de peste na Rússia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. Embassy warns citizens of a possible plague outbreak in Russia.
article.articleSummary: On 7 October 2026, the U.S. Embassy in Moscow warned of a possible pneumonic plague outbreak in Russia, citing a suspected Irkutsk-region case that caused one death and prompted quarantines and hospital closures in Irkutsk. The United States maintains a Level 4 Do Not Travel advisory, urging Americans to depart immediately and noting limited aid outside Moscow. Trump plans to call Putin to discuss the situation. The ECDC is monitoring, while the WHO says Europe’s risk is very low. A 28-year-old woman who worked at the Irkutsk and Far East plague institute died in a Shelekhov hospital. Authorities weigh two scenarios: infection linked to a Thailand trip or accidental lab exposure; the latter is denied. Kremlin urges calm; Rospotrebnadzor says no direct exposure and tests did not detect Yersinia pestis; pneumonia of unknown origin is cited.

triage.headline_ja: 米国大使館、ロシアでのペスト流行の可能性について自国民に警告
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペスト疑い例による死亡・隔離・病院閉鎖が発生し、米国がレベル4渡航中止勧告を出すなど国際的関心が高く、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・渡航制限）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 事象発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。タイは感染源としての渡航歴の可能性に言及されているのみで、発生国ではないため除外。Rospotrebnadzorはペスト菌（Yersinia pestis）を検出せず、原因不明の肺炎としている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: NCDC reviews Ebola preparedness after Kenya confirms Bundibugyo virus case
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms an imported Bundibugyo Ebola case involving a Kenyan citizen who had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The patient traveled DRC → Kampala → Nairobi, developed symptoms after arrival, tested positive at Kenya’s National Virology Reference Laboratory and KEMRI, and died on October 5, with burial under Kenya’s safe-burial protocol. This marks Kenya as the fourth country linked to the outbreak, alongside the DRC, Uganda (outbreak declared over in August), and France (a June travel-related case). The DRC remains the epicenter with 7,890 confirmed cases and 3,799 deaths as of September 23, across 63 health zones in seven provinces (crude CFR 48.1%). Nigeria’s NCDC reports no Ebola case as of October 6 but warns of international importation risk, has conducted a national Ebola preparedness tabletop exercise, and issued traveller and health-worker guidance; travellers from affected areas should monitor 21 days, and health workers should maintain heightened suspicion. General hygiene measures recommended.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでブンディブギョ型エボラ感染確認を受け、ナイジェリアCDCがエボラ対策態勢を見直し
triage.triage_reason: DRCを震源とするエボラ流行（7,890症例・致死率48.1%）がケニア・フランスへ国際的に拡大しており、深刻性・異常性・国際拡大・渡航制限の全IHR基準に該当するため。

article.articleHeadline: DOH readies for Russia pneumonic plague
article.articleSummary: DOH monitors a suspected pneumonic plague case in Russia as of 7 October 2026, signaling readiness to respond in line with WHO guidance and International Health Regulations. The Philippine government states it has capacity to meet IHR requirements and directs the Bureau of Quarantine to screen travelers for travel history and health conditions, while implementing vector surveillance for rodents and rodent fleas in incoming cargo and vessels. Background context: in Irkutsk, a female staffer at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute of Siberia and the Far East died from pneumonia of undetermined origin, prompting authorities to quarantine one hospital facility and place nearly 200 people under medical observation. The update reflects ongoing international coordination and precautionary public health measures in response to a potential pneumonic plague exposure.

triage.headline_ja: DOH、ロシアの肺ペストに備え対応準備

article.articleHeadline: Russie : un cas de peste en Sibérie ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia: a case of plague in Siberia?
article.articleSummary: Potential plague case in Siberia, Russia, raises questions about transparency, as reported by the Irish Independent. The piece probes how contamination could occur if a laboratory technician was exposed while handling pathogenic material on money, asking which plague strain is involved, what biosafety failures occurred, and whether others have been exposed. It urges rapid, open disclosure and cautions against information suppression or media censorship. If the outbreak is natural and controlled, transparency should still be prioritized. The article contrasts with concerns about China’s handling of Covid, implying that secrecy can enable broader spread. Overall, it highlights ongoing uncertainty about a plague event in Siberia and the need for timely investigation, laboratory confirmation, and public disclosure regarding source and scope.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア：シベリアでペスト感染例か？

article.articleHeadline: الصين وروسيا تتحركان لاحتواء شبهة إصابة بالطاعون الرئوي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China and Russia move to contain a suspected case of pneumonic plague.
article.articleSummary: China and Russia are coordinating to contain a suspected case of pneumonic plague in Siberia. A Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson said Beijing and Moscow maintain close contacts and ongoing cooperation to prevent and control communicable diseases, including pneumonic plague. The development followed the death of a worker at a plague research institute in the Irkutsk region last week, with about 200 contacts placed under surveillance. The institute had completed a joint training with China over a month ago on outbreak response, including surveillance and control mechanisms for border areas. Although Irkutsk does not border China directly, it is a key transport hub connected to Chinese cities by air and rail. Mongolia’s health ministry said the overall risk is low, but monitoring continues and border controls with Russia are tightened.

triage.headline_ja: 中国とロシア、シベリアでの肺ペスト疑い事例封じ込めに向け対応
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究所職員の死亡例と約200人の接触者監視という重大事象であり、国境を越えた移動拠点での発生のため国際的拡大・渡航制限のリスクが高く、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州（対象国リスト外）。中国は協力対応国として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため、対象国リストに名前があっても除外した。モンゴル・ロシアも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: В России официально прокомментировали "вспышку чумы": что это было
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia officially commented on the "plague outbreak": what was that?
article.articleSummary: Russia rejects claims of a pneumonic plague outbreak in Siberia, asserting the Irkutsk Oblast incident involving a female anti-plague institute employee resulted from severe pneumonia and that the regional situation remains controllable. Rospotrebnadzor examined close contacts; most were found not to carry dangerous pathogens. Officials claim seasonal morbidity from colds in Priangarye is within normal bounds, with acute respiratory viral infections about 12.6% below a critical threshold, roughly 16,000 ARVI cases weekly, and no rising trend. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov criticized journalists for panicking and said Moscow has informed the World Health Organization to dispel a perceived global biosafety threat. The report also notes that China was the first to react to information about a possible pneumonic plague in Russian Siberia.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、「ペスト流行」について公式にコメント：実際は何だったのか
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストの疑い事例がロシア・イルクーツク州で報告され、政府・メディアともに高い関心を示しているため、公式否定にもかかわらずフルリスク評価での確認が望ましい。
