article.articleHeadline: Ebola case in Kenya puts region on alert
article.articleSummary: On 7 October 2026, Kenya confirmed its first imported case of Ebola virus disease in a Kenyan national who had spent seven years in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The traveller moved by road through Uganda before boarding a flight to Nairobi, where he was diagnosed with the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus disease. The case places the busy DRC–Uganda–Kenya travel corridor under heightened health surveillance and highlights the challenges East Africa faces in containing outbreaks in an increasingly mobile region.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ症例確認、地域に警戒
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（ブンディブギョ株）のDRCからケニアへの越境輸入症例であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、地域的拡大懸念と社会的関心の高まりが認められるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ケニアで確認された輸入症例だが、感染源はDRC在住歴による可能性が高く、DRCでの流行背景が示唆される。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。接触者追跡状況や二次感染の有無など続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Pneumonia da Sibéria. "Não há ingredientes para antever uma explosão de casos" - Renascença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Siberian Pneumonia. 'There is no basis for predicting a surge in cases' - Renascença.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonia of unknown origin in Siberia has caused the death of a young Russian scientist, with investigators examining a bacterium historically linked to plague. As of 2026-10-07, infectious-disease specialist Miguel Castanho says there is no basis for predicting a Covid-19-like surge, noting the known features and transmission of the suspected agent do not indicate rapid spread. The bacterium is highly dangerous yet treatable with conventional antibiotics if treatment starts promptly; it is not a multiresistant hospital pathogen or linked to livestock. Human-to-human transmission, while possible when the bacteria infect the lungs and are expelled in droplets, remains limited and less contagious than SARS-CoV-2 or influenza. Uncertainties remain whether this bacterium caused the death or if another pathogen is involved. Exposure hypotheses include a laboratory incident or travel to Thailand; neither is confirmed. Natural transmission often involves fleas carried by rats.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアの肺炎「症例急増を予測する材料はない」 - Renascença
triage.triage_reason: シベリアで原因不明の重症肺炎により死亡例が発生し、ペスト関連菌が疑われている異常事例であり、専門家コメントを伴いメディアでも取り上げられているため、情報の不確実性は高いもののフルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 発生国はロシア（シベリア）だが対象国リストに含まれない。タイへの渡航歴は曝露仮説の一つとして言及されているのみで確定情報ではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。原因病原体（ペスト関連菌の可能性）、感染経路、人-人感染の程度など多くの点が未確定であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: У Росії офіційно прокоментували "спалах чуми": що це було
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia officially commented on the 'plague outbreak': what was it?
article.articleSummary: Russia rejected claims of a pneumonic plague outbreak in Siberia, linking the Irkutsk Oblast death of a female employee at an anti-plague institute to severe pneumonia, not plague, with the region deemed under control. Rosstat? Rospr? The consumer watchdog (Rospotrebnadzor) reported examinations of close contacts found no dangerous pathogens in most isolated individuals. Officials assert Priangarye’s seasonal flu metrics are normal, with ARVI levels allegedly 12.6% below the critical threshold and about 16,000 weekly cases, showing no upward trend. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov criticized journalists for panic-mongering and noted Moscow has taken the issue to international audiences, informing the World Health Organization about the real state of affairs to dispel concerns about global biosafety. The piece also notes China officially reacted to reports of a potential pneumonic plague case in Siberia.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア当局が「ペスト流行」報道を公式に否定:実際は何だったのか
triage.triage_reason: シベリアでの肺ペスト流行疑惑をロシア当局が公式に否定し、重度肺炎と説明。深刻な公衆衛生影響は現時点で確認されていないが、対象国外の事案であり続報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: イベント発生地はロシア（イルクーツク州・モスクワ）であり、対象国リストに含まれない。中国は本件に『公式反応』を示したのみで発生国ではないため除外。ロシア当局はペスト流行を否定し、WHOにも情報提供済みとしているが、噂の出所や死亡例の詳細は不明瞭であり、続報の確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Что такое легочная чума и как она распространяется
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is pneumonic plague and how does it spread?
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague, the most dangerous form of plague, is a severe lung infection caused by Yersinia pestis that can develop from bubonic or septicemic plague. Symptoms include shortness of breath, chest pain, and coughing up blood, with a very short incubation (often 24 hours). Without timely diagnosis and antibiotics, mortality is high, though early antibiotic treatment is usually effective. Transmission occurs via infected fleas or contact with rodents, and human-to-human spread can occur through coughing droplets in close contact. The disease remains endemic among rodent populations across Africa, Asia, and the Americas, with annual human cases estimated at about 1,000–3,000 across all forms; bubonic is most common. Regions mentioned include Central Africa; cases have been reported in Russia, India, China, and the United States. Public health measures include surveillance, infection control, vaccine research, post-exposure prophylaxis, and quarantine. In Russia, analyses reportedly found no microorganisms linked to the patient’s professional activity, leaving the exact form uncertain.

triage.headline_ja: 肺ペストとは何か、どのように広がるのか
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生事例を報じる速報ではなく、肺ペストに関する一般的な解説記事であり、具体的な新規アウトブレイクの情報がないため見送りと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事は肺ペストの病態・感染経路に関する一般解説であり、ロシア・インド・中国・米国等は過去の事例への言及に留まり、具体的な現在進行中のアウトブレイクを示す情報はない。対象国リストに含まれる地域での新規・具体的発生情報は確認できないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: 57 contacts identified as 10 quarantined at Nairobi hospital
article.articleSummary: Kenya identified 57 contacts of its first confirmed Ebola case, with 10 quarantined at Nairobi's National Police Service Hospital and 47 remaining to trace. The imported case travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo; the patient died on October 6, 2026. Health authorities activated disease surveillance and designated five facilities to isolate and manage cases: Kenyatta National Hospital (8 beds, 5 ICU), Moi Teaching and Referral Hospital (50 beds), National Police Service Hospital (49 beds), Port Reitz Hospital (4 beds), Nairobi Hospital (133 beds, 45 high-dependency/ICU). Nairobi Hospital's isolation unit is separate and expandable. Temporary centres at Malaba and Kocholia; Alupe undergoing renovation. Gate 16 screening intensified for arrivals from DRC and nearby countries. Public urged to complete health declarations, seek care for symptoms or exposure, and call toll-free 719.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ナイロビの病院で10人が隔離、濃厚接触者57人を特定
triage.triage_reason: ケニア初のエボラ確定例（DRCからの輸入例、患者は死亡）であり、濃厚接触者57人のトレーシングと複数施設での隔離体制が構築されている。IHR基準に複数該当し、国際的関心の高い公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの対応（濃厚接触者トレーシング、隔離施設設置、国境スクリーニング強化）だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。患者はDRCから渡航した輸入症例であり、感染源国としてDRCを含めた。ケニア国内での二次感染の有無は記事からは不明。

article.articleHeadline: Is it safe to travel to Kenya? Ebola cases spark alerts in multiple African countries
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease drives an outbreak in East and Central Africa; WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on 17 May. Kenya confirmed its first imported Ebola case and death linked to the DRC outbreak. As of 3 October, the DRC reported 8,544 confirmed cases and 4,114 deaths; Uganda had 20 cases and two deaths in July, with one case in France. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids of symptomatic patients; Bundibugyo is the least common Ebola strain, with no licensed vaccines to treat it in 2026; early supportive care is lifesaving. Symptoms include high fever, headache, muscle pain, weakness, diarrhoea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and unexplained bleeding. Eastern DRC remains the center; Tanzania and Rwanda have not reported cases. Borders and airports, including Kigali, have screening. Travel advisories urge caution; risk outside outbreak areas is extremely low; WHO advises against broad travel restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア旅行は安全か？エボラ感染例が複数のアフリカ諸国で警戒を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行によりWHOがPHEICを宣言し、ケニア・ウガンダ・フランスへの国際的拡大が確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: DRCが流行の中心地。ケニア・ウガンダ・ルワンダ・タンザニア・フランス・モザンビークは言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOはPHEICを宣言済みで、広範な渡航制限は推奨していないが各国で渡航勧告・水際対策が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Kenya : un premier cas importé de la RDC, le patient décédé à Nairobi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kenya: a first imported case from the DRC, the patient died in Nairobi.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first imported Ebola case, in a Kenyan resident who had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo for seven years and died in Nairobi. The patient fell ill about a month earlier, sought care at several facilities, and on Oct 2 traveled by road to Kampala via Beni, then flew to Nairobi, arriving Oct 3 on a Jambojet flight. After arrival at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport (JKIA), he was isolated. Samples tested positive for Bundibugyo ebolavirus at the National Virology Reference Laboratory and the Kenya Medical Research Institute. He died Oct 5 and was buried Oct 6 under the national safe and dignified burial protocol for Ebola. Authorities are tracing 23 passengers and 4 crew from the flight and identifying 28 contacts. Kenya has been under maximum alert since May 2026; by Oct 6, it screened over 652,000 travelers, tested 267 suspect samples, and trained about 5,000 health workers. Kenya notified WHO on Oct 6, 2026. Fourth country to confirm Bundibugyo virus disease.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国からの輸入第1例、患者はナイロビで死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで続いているブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス病のアウトブレイクに由来する輸入症例がケニアで確認・死亡し、国際的拡大の懸念と接触者追跡（乗客・乗員・接触者）が必要な事案であるため。
triage.notes: 患者はDRC在住歴7年でDRC由来のブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスに感染、ケニア（対象国リスト外）で発症・死亡。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外し、感染源であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに計上。WHOには2026年10月6日に通知済み。航空便の乗客23名・乗員4名の追跡、接触者28名の特定が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉突破國境！肯亞爆首例死亡　患者竟闖過機場篩檢
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola breaches national borders! Kenya reports its first Ebola-related death as the patient slips through airport screening.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first Ebola-related death from Bundibugyo ebolavirus, an infection acquired in the Democratic Republic of the Congo after traversing Uganda to Nairobi. The patient, a Kenyan resident who had lived in DRC for seven years, fell ill about a month earlier and traveled by road to Uganda before flying to Nairobi, arriving October 3 at 1:10 pm at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport. He passed routine screening, was hospitalized, and developed fever, chills, severe fatigue, odynophagia, myalgia, and subcutaneous bleeding. Laboratory tests at Kenya’s National Virus Reference Laboratory and the Kenya Medical Research Institute confirmed Bundibugyo ebolavirus. He died October 5 at 23:30; burial followed Ebola safety protocols. At least 28 contacts have been identified, including 23 passengers and 4 crew from Jambojet flight 8523, with ongoing tracing. Kenya had strengthened airport and land-border screening, but questions remain about effectiveness after Uganda’s outbreak was declared over in August. In DRC, Bundibugyo Ebola has 8,544 cases and 4,114 deaths, with North Kivu and Ituri hotspots; no approved vaccines or therapies yet, four vaccines in development, one in human trials since July. MSF warns numbers may be higher and stresses cross-border vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが国境を越えた！ケニアで初の死亡例　患者は空港検疫をすり抜けていた
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がウガンダ経由でケニアに越境し死亡例・空港検疫突破・航空機接触者多数という国際的拡大の明確な兆候があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで継続中のブンディブギョ・エボラ流行がウガンダ経由でケニアへ越境した事例。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず、発生源であるDRCのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: Συνεχίζεται το θρίλερ στη Σιβηρία: Δεύτερος εργαζόμενος εργαστηρίου με πνευμονία άγνωστης αιτίας; Στο μικροσκόπιο του ΠΟΥ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The thriller in Siberia continues: A second lab worker with pneumonia of unknown etiology; Under the WHO's microscope.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 October 2026, the World Health Organization has asked Russian authorities for information about a second lab worker at a Siberian plague institute who developed pneumonia of unknown etiology, and for details to clarify the pneumonia's cause and the pathogen for public health actions. Russia's public health service said there have been no plague cases among those who had contact with the worker, who died last week. Plague is caused by Yersinia pestis and transmitted by fleas from small mammals; it has three forms—bubonic, septicemic, and pneumonic, the latter able to spread person-to-person via airborne droplets and potentially fatal if untreated. Globally, 2019–2025 reports show 3,847 suspected cases and 423 deaths across 10 countries, mainly in DRC and Madagascar; a 2017 Madagascar pneumonic outbreak affected over 2,400 people and 209 deaths. Siberia is cited as the site of the first known prehistoric plague outbreak in humans. Rapid response, including contact tracing and antibiotics for exposed individuals, remains crucial.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアの謎は続く：原因不明の肺炎を発症した2人目の研究所職員、WHOが調査中
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究所関連で原因不明の肺炎による死亡例が発生し、WHOがロシア当局に情報提供を求めている点で、重大性・異常性の両面でIHR基準を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価に進むべきと判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア（シベリア）のペスト研究所関連の原因不明肺炎であり、DRC・マダガスカルは過去の統計データとして言及されているのみで、現行の発生地域ではないため対象国リストには含めない。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: CAMPOS GERAIS REGISTRA CASOS DE SARNA HUMANA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campos Gerais reports cases of human scabies.
article.articleSummary: Campos Gerais, Minas Gerais, reported 14 cases of human scabies (10 children, 4 municipal school employees) as of Oct 7, 2026. Affected individuals were removed from activities; schools were cleaned and hygiene protocols implemented. Classes continue, and no suspension is planned. A meeting on Oct 6 between health, education, and sanitation officials assessed the situation and cautioned that counts may rise. Campos Gerais is the third Sul de Minas city to report scabies; Andradas has up to 39 suspected cases in two weeks, and Alfenas recorded four new cases over the weekend, raising the total from 318 to 322, with all four cases from the same family. Initially 16 cases were confirmed in three early-childhood units. Health and education teams continue monitoring and educating staff and families; surveillance teams will visit units. People with intense itching and skin lesions are urged to seek medical care.

triage.headline_ja: カンポス・ジェライス市で疥癬の人的症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は重症度・国際拡大リスクが低い疾患だが、複数市での拡大傾向と症例数増加が見られるため、地域での経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 疥癬は接触感染で重症化や国際的拡大のリスクは低いが、ミナスジェライス州南部の複数自治体（カンポス・ジェライス、アンドラダス、アルフェナス）で同時多発的に症例が増加しており、地域保健当局が監視を継続している。続報で感染拡大の規模や対応状況を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: กรมวิทย์ฯ ยันพร้อมรับมือ 'กาฬโรค' เปิดแล็บ BSL-3 ตรวจเชื้อรู้ผลภายใน 24 ชม.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Science says it is ready to tackle 'plague,' opening a BSL-3 lab for testing with results within 24 hours.
article.articleSummary: Yersinia pestis, the cause of plague, can be rapidly diagnosed in Thailand with a new BSL-3 facility capable of real-time PCR giving results within 24 hours, plus culture and biochemical confirmation under stringent biosafety and quality controls. The Department of Medical Sciences announced readiness to support surveillance, prevention, and control if suspected cases arise in Thailand, noting the pneumonic form can spread via respiratory droplets. Suspected cases should coordinate with the laboratory before specimen collection to ensure safety and preparedness. Sample types vary by clinical form: lymph node aspirates for bubonic plague; blood for septicemic plague; sputum or respiratory specimens for pneumonic plague; cerebrospinal fluid for neuroinvasive disease. Proper collection, packaging, and transport are emphasized. For inquiries or submission, contact the Center for Laboratory Surveillance and Coordination, Public Health Science Research Institute, Department of Medical Sciences at 0 2951 1485, 0 2951 9000 ext. 98340, LINE @769baxtr.

triage.headline_ja: 医科学局、『ペスト』対応に万全を期す BSL-3ラボ開設で24時間以内に検査結果判明
triage.triage_reason: 実際のペスト症例発生の報告ではなく、タイ政府が検査体制を強化したという準備態勢に関する発表であり、疑い例の発生は確認されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の症例報告ではなく、タイ医科学局による検査能力（BSL-3ラボ、PCR検査）の整備・広報に関する内容。タイ国内での具体的なペスト症例発生の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Jangan Sampai Kecolongan, DPRD DKI Minta Dinkes Gencarkan Skrining Influenza A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't Get Caught Off Guard, Jakarta DPRD Urges the Health Office to Ramp Up Influenza A Screening
article.articleSummary: Influenza A transmission in Jakarta has surged by 15%, prompting the DKI Jakarta DPRD to urge the provincial health office (Dinas Kesehatan DKI Jakarta) and regional general hospitals (RSUD) to stay vigilant and escalate screening. The call mandates comprehensive, periodic screening to detect transmission trends and keep Jakarta’s epidemiological status under control, with readiness to manage a potential patient surge. Authorities should ensure adequate stocks of medicines and personal protective equipment for healthcare workers before a possible uptick. The move also targets integrated surveillance to prevent outbreaks, especially as Influenza A activity has been reported in other regions beyond Jakarta. Public participation through healthy lifestyle choices—nutrition, rest, exercise, and daily activities— is encouraged to bolster immunity and reduce susceptibility.

triage.headline_ja: 油断は禁物、ジャカルタ特別州議会（DPRD）が保健局にインフルエンザAのスクリーニング強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: ジャカルタでインフルエンザA感染が15%増加し議会が警戒・対策強化を要請しているが、重症度や死亡例など深刻性を示す情報は不明であり、季節性インフルエンザの範疇を超える異常性も確認できない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザAの感染増加に対する行政対応の記事であり、重症度・死亡例・病原体の異常性に関する情報は記載なし。続報で重症度や地域拡大の情報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: AP Guv launches 77th TB Seal Sale Campaign to combat killer disease
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-07, Andhra Pradesh Governor Syed Abdul Nazeer launched the 77th Tuberculosis (TB) Seal Sale Campaign in Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, at Durbar Hall, Lok Bhavan. TB is described as a killer and a socio-economic challenge requiring more than treatment—emphasis on awareness, early diagnosis, prevention, nutrition, social support, and community participation. The event frames India’s fight against TB through the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme and TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan, aiming to eradicate TB ahead of the UN SDG 2030 target. The TB Seal is a charitable label to raise funds and public awareness; the concept originated in Denmark in 1903 to help children with bone TB. The campaign highlights ongoing national TB control efforts in India.

triage.headline_ja: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州知事、死の病に立ち向かう第77回結核シールセール キャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核啓発・募金キャンペーンの開始を報じる内容であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報は含まれない。
triage.notes: 記事は政府主催の結核啓発キャンペーン開始を報じる一般的な広報記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。デンマークは募金制度の起源として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Nord-Kivu : la société civile attend des explications sur l'utilisation de 150 000 dollars destinés à la sensibilisation contre Ebola | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | North Kivu: Civil society awaits explanations on the use of 150,000 dollars intended for Ebola awareness campaigns | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Funds for Ebola awareness in North Kivu are under scrutiny. The Ministry of Health sent $150,000 USD to the North Kivu MPs caucus to back Ebola sensitization as part of the outbreak response, triggering debate in Beni, Lubero, and Butembo about how the money was distributed among four constituencies. National deputy Jeanine Katasohire publicly confirmed the transfer and said she allocated $46,500 to Butembo for awareness activities. Civil society and political actors demand explanations from other deputies representing Beni-ville, Beni-territoire, and Lubero on the use of the amounts allotted to their constituencies. The controversy, amplified on social media, centers on destination and use of funds within the Ebola response, with discussions ongoing as of October 7, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州:市民社会がエボラ対策啓発用の15万ドルの使途説明を要求
triage.triage_reason: 記事はエボラ対応における資金使途を巡る政治・行政上の論争を扱っており、新規感染や公衆衛生上の異常事態に関する情報ではないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行そのものの新規発生・拡大に関する情報ではなく、既存の対応における資金配分を巡る政治的・社会的論争が主題。公衆衛生リスク評価の対象ではないが、資金不正利用が対応遅延を招く可能性があるため今後の動向は注視の余地あり。

article.articleHeadline: 《柳叶刀》子刊：感染也是致癌元凶！全球数据显示，12%新发癌症病例源自病原体感染，东亚负担近半_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Lancet sub-journal: Infections are also a cancer-causing culprit! Global data show that 12% of newly diagnosed cancer cases originate from pathogenic infections, East Asia bears nearly half the burden.
article.articleSummary: 2024 global cancers attributable to infections: about 2.3 million cases, 12% of all new cancers. Six pathogens account for most burden: Helicobacter pylori (~760,000; 4%), human papillomavirus (HPV) ~750,000 (4%), hepatitis B virus (HBV) ~360,000 (2%), Epstein–Barr virus (EBV) ~260,000 (1%), hepatitis C virus (HCV) ~160,000 (<1%), and Kaposi sarcoma–associated herpesvirus (KSHV) ~35,000 (<1%). East Asia bears roughly 990,000 infection-attributable cancers (42%), led by China for H. pylori- and HBV-related cancers. Mechanisms include: H. pylori–induced chronic gastritis driving non-cardia gastric cancer; HBV/HCV causing hepatocellular carcinoma via chronic liver injury and HBV integration; HPV (types 16/18) integrating with E6/E7 oncoproteins causing cervical cancer (universal) and some anal/oropharyngeal cancers; EBV contributing to most nasopharyngeal carcinoma and other gastric/lymphoid cancers. Vaccination and targeted screening/treatment offer cost-effective strategies to curb infection-related cancers.

triage.headline_ja: 『ランセット』系列誌：感染もがんの元凶！世界データで新規がん症例の12%が病原体感染に起因、東アジアが約半分を負担
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は感染症の急性アウトブレイクではなく、慢性感染とがんリスクに関する疫学研究の紹介であり、公衆衛生緊急事態性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 研究報告であり、特定の急性感染症イベントではないためトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: UK issues travel advisory after Kenya confirms first Ebola case
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first imported Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease case. A Kenyan citizen who had lived in the DRC travelled to Kampala and then Nairobi on Oct 3; hospitalised, isolated, tested positive, and subsequently died and was buried. The Ministry of Health identified 28 contacts (family and healthcare workers) and traced 23 flight passengers and four crew—plus a total of 57 contacts with 10 in quarantine. Public health actions include contact tracing, surveillance, border screening, and quarantines for at-risk individuals. The World Health Organization was notified on Oct 6. Kenya is the fourth country linked to the regional Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak. The UK FCDO issued travel advice on Oct 7, urging following Kenyan guidance and checking health requirements, with enhanced screening for travellers from Uganda, Ethiopia and DRC. The FCDO also flags security-based travel bans to parts of Mandera, Wajir, Garissa, and most of Lamu.

triage.headline_ja: 英国、ケニアで初のエボラ症例確認後に渡航勧告を発出
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで輸入性エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の初症例が確認され死亡、WHO通知および英国の渡航勧告発出に至っており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアにおける輸入症例（ケニアは対象国リスト外）。DRCは地域的アウトブレイクの発生源として言及されているが、本記事が描く具体的イベント（症例確認・死亡・接触者追跡）はケニアで発生しており、DRC国内での新規事象としては記述されていないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: EE.UU. avisa a sus ciudadanos sobre posible caso de peste en Siberia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States Warns Its Citizens About a Possible Case of Plague in Siberia
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague suspected in Irkutsk Oblast, Siberia, after the Oct 2 death of 28-year-old Daria Shipílova, a technician at the Irkutsk and Far East Institute for Plague Research, in Shélejov near Irkutsk. The U.S. embassy in Moscow issued a Level 4 travel warning for Russia, citing safety concerns and advising Americans to depart; officials are monitoring reports of a possible Yersinia pestis–driven pneumonic (the most severe form) infection, with guidance to seek immediate medical care for fever or respiratory symptoms. Two hypotheses are under investigation: infection acquired in Thailand, or an accidental laboratory exposure; Russian authorities deny a lab accident. Rospotrebnadzor reports the deceased died from pneumonia of unknown etiology; about 60% of contacts have tested negative to date, and no hospital quarantines have been noted. The situation is being treated with high-level diplomatic attention, but no confirmed outbreak has been established.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、シベリアでのペスト感染疑い事例について自国民に注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストによる死亡例が確認され、米国がロシアに対しレベル4の渡航警告を発令するなど、重篤性・異常性・渡航制限の観点でIHR基準を複数満たすため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 事例発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州（対象国リスト外）。タイでの感染可能性は仮説段階であり確定情報ではないため、verified_locationsには含めなかった。ロシア当局は実験室事故を否定しているが、原因究明中であり続報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Today's top news: Ethiopia, Ebola outbreak, Occupied Palestinian Territory
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains severe: as of 3 October, >8,500 confirmed cases and >4,100 deaths. Ituri and North Kivu account for >94% of new infections, with North Kivu among the hardest hit. Contact tracing stands at just under 68% (target 95%), complicating transmission interruption; movement restrictions on several major roads in North Kivu may hinder humanitarian access and response operations. In Haut-Uélé and Ituri, prevention and surveillance are being strengthened in high-risk mining communities. Kenya reports its first imported Ebola case, caused by Bundibugyo virus; rapid isolation and testing, plus measures including contact tracing, enhanced surveillance, and preparedness in 27 high-risk counties with identified isolation units and updated surveillance tools. The UN and partners emphasize continued cross-border surveillance, regional coordination, and readiness to stop transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 本日のトップニュース：エチオピア、エボラ出血熱の流行、パレスチナ占領地域
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は症例数・死亡者数ともに深刻で、接触者追跡率が目標を下回り、ケニアへの輸入例も確認されるなど国際的拡大リスクが高く、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: ケニアでの輸入症例が報告されているが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。接触者追跡率の低さ(68%、目標95%)と移動制限による人道アクセスの困難さが懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: Recomendaciones del Nodo de Epidemiología del Hospital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: Recommendations from the Hospital's Epidemiology Node
article.articleSummary: As of 7 October 2026, Hospital Justo José de Urquiza's Epidemiology Node reported two suspected dengue cases among students at Escuela N° 4 'Benigno Teijeiro Martínez'. The first patient is ambulatory and in good condition; the second required preventive hospitalization but has been discharged and is in excellent health. Laboratory results: one of the two suspects was officially ruled out yesterday, while the second case's sample was sent to Paraná for confirmatory testing; results are pending. In coordination with the Municipality, epidemiological blocking and area fumigation were carried out to protect neighbors and the school community. The Node calls for calm, discourages sharing unofficial rumors, and reiterates standard prevention: eliminate mosquito breeding sites and use repellent.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：病院疫学ノードからの勧告
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチン国内での2件の疑い例（うち1件は既に否定）に関する地域的な報告であり、対象国（ブラジル等）での発生ではなく、深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大の根拠も乏しい。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアルゼンチン（パラナ州エントレ・リオス州の病院）での小規模な疑い例であり、ブラジルは検体送付先として言及されているのみ。対象国リストに該当する発生国はないため verified_locations は空。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC Expresses Solidarity with Kenya and Calls for Stronger Regional Ebola Preparedness
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first imported Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease case and related death. The patient travelled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo to Uganda, spent a night there, then flew to Kenya; Kenyan authorities have identified 28 contacts and are tracing a further 23 passengers and crew who traveled with the patient. Africa CDC confirms rapid isolation and testing and pledges full support; Director-General Dr. Jean Kaseya will visit Kenya to assess needs. The outbreak in DRC remains driven by community transmission, with more than 70% of new cases detected in the community among unlisted contacts; Africa CDC urges village- and community-centered case finding and faster contact tracing. As of now, Africa CDC and partners have mobilised about US$2.9 billion, with calls for transparency on pledged resources. Regional preparedness, cross-border information sharing, lab readiness, and rapid response remain priorities.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、ケニアに連帯を表明し地域的なエボラ対策強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がウガンダ経由でケニアに初輸入され死亡例も発生。国際的拡大・コミュニティ感染継続・大規模国際支援動員という複数のIHR/WPRO基準に該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCはコミュニティ感染継続中の発生源国として含めた。接触者51名（28名特定、23名追跡中）の国際空路移動歴があり、越境拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: 48 con heo tại Vĩnh Long mắc bệnh, 21 con chết nghi bị dịch tả heo châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 48 pigs in Vĩnh Long infected, 21 dead suspected of African swine fever
article.articleSummary: Suspected African swine fever outbreak detected at a pig-farming household in Phú Quới Commune, Vĩnh Long Province, Vietnam. Of 48 fattening pigs, 21 have died, with 9 fatalities on Oct 5 and 12 on Oct 6; illness began Oct 2. The farm owner, Mr. Đặng Văn Sáu, reported abnormal deaths. Pigs have not been vaccinated against ASF. Local authorities collected samples and sent them to Chi cục Chăn nuôi và Thú y vùng VII for laboratory confirmation. While awaiting results, the Trạm Chăn nuôi và Thú y khu vực I, with UBND Phú Quới, has implemented containment measures, including zoned controls, enhanced biosecurity, and a ban on moving live pigs or pig products from the area. If tests confirm ASF, authorities plan to cull the entire herd (48 pigs) as per regulations. Related news notes two intermediaries charged in Can Tho for trading diseased pigs.

triage.headline_ja: ヴィンロン省で豚48頭が感染、21頭死亡、アフリカ豚コレラの疑い
triage.triage_reason: 単一農家での疑い例（未確定）であり、ASFは豚のみに感染する動物疾病でヒトへの公衆衛生リスクはない。地域当局により封じ込め措置が既に実施されている。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚コレラ（ASF）は豚のみに感染し、ヒトの健康に直接影響しない動物疾病。単一農家での疑い例で、検査結果待ちの段階。地域当局によりゾーニング、バイオセキュリティ強化、移動制限などの措置が既に実施されている。ベトナムではASFは定期的に発生しており異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: "Ebola takes the people children depend on and unravels their lives" - UNICEF
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists, with more than 1,900 children having lost one or both parents or caregivers or been separated since May. Ituri accounts for 1,581 affected children and North Kivu 322. As of 29 September, at least 2,076 children have confirmed Ebola and 1,162 have died. Children comprise just over one-quarter of confirmed cases and about one-third of deaths; among under-fives, seven in ten with confirmed Ebola have died, often before detection. Bunia is the outbreak's eastern epicentre, amid 4.4 million displaced people. UNICEF supports 12 nurseries near Ebola treatment centres in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu to care for exposed or orphaned children. Examples: Lina (seven months) lost her mother; Raphael (eight months) survived but lost eight relatives. Calls for a nursery at every treatment centre, essential health services, and more social workers; funding needs US$113.4 million, about one-third funded.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラは子どもたちが頼る人々を奪い、生活を崩壊させる」—ユニセフ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が継続し、多数の感染者・死者（致死率が高く特に5歳未満児で顕著）が発生しており、国際的な人道支援・資金ニーズも生じているため、フルリスク評価対象とする。
triage.notes: 既知の継続中のエボラ流行（Ituri、北キブ、南キブ）に関する人道的影響報告。致死率が高く特に乳幼児で深刻、資金不足（US$113.4百万のうち約1/3のみ充足）が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تسجل أول وفاة بإيبولا وتطلق حملة عاجلة لتتبع المخالطين
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records its first Ebola death and launches an urgent campaign to trace contacts.
article.articleSummary: Kenya records its first Ebola death and launches urgent contact tracing after a Kenyan who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo for seven years returned to Nairobi over the weekend. He was Kenya’s first confirmed Ebola case and died late Monday after treatment in several hospitals. Health authorities increased border screening and began monitoring for new cases and tracing contacts. The patient reportedly contracted the virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo about a month earlier, then traveled via Kampala, Uganda, to Nairobi, where he was isolated on arrival and later laboratory-confirmed positive. Ebola spreads through contact with body fluids (blood, vomit, semen) or contaminated surfaces and materials (bed linens, clothing). The outbreak began in mid-May in eastern Congo and, according to government data, has about 8,400 infections and more than 4,000 deaths, the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアが初のエボラ死亡例を記録、濃厚接触者追跡の緊急キャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で続く大規模エボラ流行（感染者約8,400人、死者4,000人超）がウガンダ経由でケニアに越境し初の死亡例が確認されており、国際的拡大・公衆衛生上の深刻性ともに極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は本来のエボラ流行発生地であるDRCおよびそこからの越境例（ケニア・ウガンダ経由）。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外したが、DRCでの継続的大規模流行が本事案の根本原因であり重要な背景情報である。

article.articleHeadline: Từ đường hô hấp đến trái tim: Mối nguy từ cúm, phế cầu và RSV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From the Respiratory Tract to the Heart: The Dangers of Influenza, Pneumococcus, and RSV
article.articleSummary: Influenza A infection in a 59-year-old woman with hypertension, dyslipidemia, and prior coronary artery disease with a stent in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, triggered sudden dyspnea and cardiac issues. She required respiratory support; ECG abnormalities, elevated troponin, and reduced left-ventricular function; influenza A was laboratory-confirmed. After treatment, symptoms and LV function improved. The case shows respiratory infections can worsen cardiovascular disease, with inflammation, fever, and increased metabolic demand raising early myocardial infarction risk, especially in atherosclerotic patients. RSV and pneumococcus are also concerns, as RSV can cause lower respiratory infections and hypoxemia in older adults with comorbidities, burdening the heart. Vaccination against influenza, pneumococcus, and RSV is part of a cardiovascular prevention strategy; timing should be individualized, with consideration of anticoagulant use and stability. The program was organized by Ho Chi Minh City University of Medicine and Pharmacy Hospital with Pfizer Vietnam; link provided.

triage.headline_ja: 呼吸器から心臓へ：インフルエンザ、肺炎球菌、RSVの危険性

article.articleHeadline: La OMS exige a Rusia más información sobre el supuesto caso de peste | BURGOSconecta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO demands more information from Russia about the alleged case of plague | BURGOSconecta
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization has requested more information from Russia under the International Health Regulations regarding an alleged pneumonic plague case in the Siberian Irkutsk region and a second pneumonia case involving an employee linked to a laboratory incident. Russia reports no pneumonic plague has been registered in Irkutsk and no high risk pathogens detected among contacts of Daria Shipilova, a worker at the regional plague institute who died of pneumonia after reportedly breaking a vial containing Yersinia pestis. The WHO director general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the risk is moderate to low in Irkutsk, low for Russia, and very low for Europe. CDC and ECDC are monitoring; China notes close information exchanges with Russia on prevention and control. About 200 people in Irkutsk have been tested.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、ロシアに対しペスト感染疑い例に関するさらなる情報提供を要求
triage.triage_reason: シベリア・イルクーツク州で実験室関連の肺ペスト疑い死亡例が発生し、WHOがIHRに基づき追加情報を要求しており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（対象国リスト外）。中国は情報共有パートナーとして言及されているのみで、感染事例の発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Dette er lungepest - og slik smitter det
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This is pneumonic plague - and this is how it spreads.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, is under scrutiny after a death at a pest‑research laboratory in Irkutsk, Siberia, Russia. The World Health Organization has requested more information; contacts have tested negative. Pneumonic plague is the most aggressive form and causes shortness of breath, chest pain, and a bloody cough. It can spread between people via respiratory droplets in close contact, though most global cases are bubonic (1,000–3,000) concentrated in Central Africa. The disease also occurs in Russia, China, India, and the United States. Yersinia pestis persists in animal reservoirs worldwide, carried by about 200 rodent species. Incubation can be as short as 24 hours; without rapid diagnosis and antibiotics, it is nearly always fatal, though early treatment is highly effective. It remains unclear whether the Russian lab worker was infected; tests show no organisms linked to the patient’s work. CDC and UK authorities are monitoring with low population risk.

triage.headline_ja: これは肺ペストだ ― その感染の仕組みとは
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの病原体研究所で死亡例が発生しWHOが情報提供を要請しているが、感染経路は不明で接触者の検査も陰性、CDC・英当局は集団感染リスクを低いと評価しており、続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 事例はロシア（イルクーツク州）の研究所関係者の死亡であり、対象国リストに含まれない。記事中で言及される中国・インド等は疫学的背景説明に過ぎず、本イベントの発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta máxima en Rusia por peste neumónica: ¿qué tan contagiosa es la enfermedad que causó la muerte de la científica Daria Shipilova?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia on High Alert Over Pneumonic Plague: How Contagious Is the Disease That Killed the Scientist Daria Shipilova?
article.articleSummary: Daria Shipilova, a 28-year-old researcher at the Institute of Plague Research of Irkutsk and the Far East, died last week in Shélejov, amid a suspected pneumonic plague case in Russia’s Irkutsk region. Russia has not confirmed pneumonic plague; authorities say autopsy yielded pneumonia of undetermined etiology and no colleagues sought medical care. Media reports cite possible lab accident or spilled sample, with another theory linking exposure during a trip to Thailand. The United States has begun sharing information with Moscow and issued an alert about a possible pneumonic plague outbreak; the WHO says the risk to Europe is very low. About 200 contacts have been quarantined and tested negative. Pneumonic plague stems from Yersinia pestis and spreads via respiratory aerosols, causing rapid fever, cough, and dyspnea; confirmation may involve immunohistochemistry and PCR, with strict contact isolation essential.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで肺ペストに最大級の警戒：科学者ダリア・シピロワの死を招いた病気はどれほど感染力が強いのか？
triage.triage_reason: 研究所職員の死亡を伴う肺ペスト疑い事例であり、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事例としてIHR基準2項目以上に該当するため、フルリスク評価に進めるべきと判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（イルクーツク州）であり対象国リストに含まれない。タイは曝露経路の一仮説として言及されているのみで、タイ国内での発生確認ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: La peste non è mai scomparsa: 2.646 casi confermati e 423 morti segnalati in sette anni
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The plague has never disappeared: 2,646 confirmed cases and 423 deaths reported over seven years.
article.articleSummary: Between 2019 and 2025, the plague (Yersinia pestis) caused 3,860 suspected and 2,646 confirmed human infections across six countries, with 423 deaths among suspected cases. The Democratic Republic of Congo and Madagascar accounted for 97.7% of confirmed cases, underscoring ongoing zoonotic reservoirs among small mammals, rodents, and fleas in Africa, Asia, and the Americas. Kenya, Uganda, China, and Mongolia reported confirmed infections as well. A separate US case in July 2025 in Coconino County, Arizona, resulted in death from pneumonic plague after exposure to ill cats; the patient presented with abdominal pain, chest pain, and dry cough, with radiographs showing pneumonia. Only postmortem results prompted plague testing and prompted contact tracing and antibiotic prophylaxis. The WHO emphasizes surveillance in areas where Y. pestis circulates; urbanization risks, and the Russian case remains under investigation. Plague remains present, not history.

triage.headline_ja: ペストは消えていない：7年間で2,646件の確定症例と423人の死亡が報告
triage.triage_reason: 2019〜2025年の累積統計に基づく振り返り的な記事であり、新規の急性アウトブレイクを示すものではないが、DRCや中国など複数の対象国で地方病的なペスト流行が継続していることから経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2019-2025年の累積統計を扱う総括的内容で、マダガスカル・ケニア・ウガンダ・モンゴル・米国・ロシアの症例も含まれるが、これらは対象国リスト外または個別の新規アウトブレイクとは言えないため除外。DRCと中国は確定症例報告国として対象国リストに含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: Balloon Juice - Plagues & Pandemics Update - October 7, 2026
article.articleSummary: FDA closes probe into a lettuce-linked cyclosporiasis outbreak after Cyclospora was detected in two samples from Mexican lettuce farms and processing facilities. In the United States, COVID-19 trends as of Sept 30, 2026 show infections growing in 19 states, declining in 8, and unchanged in 23, per CDC modeling. In the Democratic Republic of Congo’s North Kivu, the Ebola outbreak continues as the fastest-moving on record, with about 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths; a Kenyan citizen who had lived in Congo has become Kenya’s first confirmed Ebola case and death after returning to Nairobi. MSF reports 34% of Ebola patients treated in bare-bones facilities and notes a treatment center was burned amid the outbreak. Separately, reports of bubonic plague concerns in Siberia with a second death; WHO says no threat to the rest of the world.

triage.headline_ja: Balloon Juice - 疫病・パンデミック最新情報 - 2026年10月7日

triage.notes: 記事は複数疾病（サイクロスポーラ症＝米国・メキシコ、COVID-19＝米国、腺ペスト＝ロシア）をまとめた総覧記事だが、いずれも対象国リスト外。ケニアでの初症例確認は越境拡大の証左だが、ケニアも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず、DRCのみを計上した。

article.articleHeadline: Cuaca Tak Menentu, Ketua DPRD Medan Wong Chun Sen Imbau Masyarakat Waspadai Penyebaran Influenza A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unsettled Weather, Medan DPRD Chairman Wong Chun Sen Urges the Public to Be Vigilant Against the Spread of Influenza A.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A, including H1N1 and H3N2 subtypes, is a rising concern in Medan, North Sumatra, Indonesia, as of 7 October 2026. Medan City DPRD Speaker Wong Chun Sen Tarigan urged vigilance amid unsettled weather linked to increased reports of influenza-like illness. Hospitals report more patients with fever, cough, and malaise. Public health authorities are urged to strengthen surveillance via the City Health Office and community health centers (Puskesmas), and to escalate PHBS promotion down to neighborhood leaders. Key symptoms to watch: fever, muscle and joint pains, headache, fatigue, cough, sore throat, and runny nose. Vulnerable groups—children, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with comorbidities—deserve extra attention due to risk of complications. Prevent spread with handwashing, masking when ill or in crowds, and prompt medical care for severe symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 天候不順、メダン市議会議長ウォン・チュン・セン氏がインフルエンザA型の流行拡大に警戒するよう住民に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ様疾患の増加に対する地方議員の注意喚起であり、重篤な異常事態や国際的拡大の兆候は見られないが、サーベイランス強化が呼びかけられており経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Public Health Officers Issue Demands to Govt Over Ebola Response
article.articleSummary: Kenya faces its first reported Ebola case as public health officers issue four demands to the Ministry of Health to bolster the national response. Ongoing contact tracing identified 57 contacts; 10 people are in quarantine as of Oct 7, 2026. The suspected patient traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo via Uganda into Kenya, prompting concerns about border screening and adherence to international health regulations at border points. Officers warn of a weakened public health system and the risk of a COVID-19–like outbreak from an imported case. Demands include nationwide engagement of public health officers to end strikes and ensure full involvement; a whole-system Ebola and broader-epidemic response with defined roles for public health, laboratories, clinicians, nutritionists and other workers; expanded training for Ebola (about 4,791 healthcare workers trained so far, largely senior officials); specialized training for frontline staff in surveillance, detection and response; and ensuring adequate PPE to protect workers.

triage.headline_ja: 公衆衛生担当者、エボラ対応強化を求め政府に要求
triage.triage_reason: ケニア初のエボラ疑い症例が報告され、DRCからウガンダ経由での越境感染の懸念、接触者57人・隔離10人という拡大リスク、医療体制の脆弱性への懸念があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアにおけるエボラ疑い症例（DRCからウガンダ経由で入国）であり、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは感染源地域として言及されているが、実際の発生地点ではないため verified_locations には含めなかった。続報でケニアでの確定診断や対象国での症例発生が確認された場合は再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: PS Muthoni: Kenya managing imported Ebola case, no outbreak yet
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms one imported Ebola case, with no outbreak. The patient travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo and died on October 6, prompting intensified surveillance. Fifty-seven contacts have been identified; ten are in quarantine at Nairobi's National Police Service Hospital, while the remaining forty-seven are being traced to prevent further transmission. Authorities have activated nationwide surveillance, including heightened entry-point screening at 15 locations. Five facilities are designated to isolate and manage suspected and confirmed Ebola cases: Nairobi Hospital (133-bed isolation unit with 45 high-dependency/ICU beds), Kenyatta National Hospital (8 beds, 5 ICU beds), Moi Teaching and Referral Hospital (50 beds), National Police Service Hospital (49 beds), and Port Reitz Hospital (4 beds). Temporary isolation centers are at Malaba and Kocholia; Alupe is under renovation. Travellers are urged to complete health declaration forms and use the toll-free 719 line for guidance. The priority remains rapid contact tracing to prevent community transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア保健次官:ケニアは輸入エボラ症例を管理中、アウトブレイクはまだ発生せず
triage.triage_reason: DRCからの輸入エボラ症例でケニア国内初の死亡例が確認され、57名の接触者追跡と全国的なサーベイランス強化が行われており、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの輸入エボラ症例管理だが、感染源はDRCでのエボラアウトブレイクであるため、DRCを発生国として記載。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。続報でDRC国内の発生状況・ケニアでの二次感染有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: MSF warns Ebola spread in DR Congo's North Kivu province is 'out of control'
article.articleSummary: As of 7 October 2026, MSF warns Ebola in DR Congo's North Kivu is 'out of control.' The north-eastern region now accounts for nearly 40% of newly confirmed nationwide cases, with most infections arising from unknown transmission chains. About 75% of Ebola deaths occur in community settings—home or transit—before patients reach treatment facilities, heightening transmission risks. In Butembo, MSF's Ebola Treatment Centre coordinator notes fear and weak community engagement hinder people from seeking care. A local politician promoting prevention measures was killed after a radio appearance, underscoring security risks. The outbreak began in Ituri province to North Kivu's north and has spread to neighboring health zones and rural areas, with new hotspots emerging weekly. North Kivu facilities are stretched beyond capacity, driving patients to ordinary health centres. The outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo virus, described as among the deadliest in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: MSF、コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州でのエボラ拡大は『制御不能』と警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の感染拡大が制御不能と国際NGOが警告しており、未知の感染経路・コミュニティでの死亡多発・治安悪化など重大な公衆衛生上の懸念が複数確認されるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ流行で、イトゥリ州から北キブ州に拡大。医療施設の処理能力超過、地域社会での不信・治安悪化（防疫推進活動家の殺害）が報告されており、感染制御の著しい困難が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Vĩnh Long: Hàng chục con lợn chết nghi mắc dịch tả lợn châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vĩnh Long: Dozens of pigs died, suspected to have contracted African swine fever.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever is suspected in a 48-pig herd at a farm in Phú Quới Commune, Vĩnh Long Province, Vietnam. As of 07 Oct 2026, nine pigs died on 05 Oct and twelve more on 06 Oct, with rapid disease progression and high mortality across the herd. Veterinary authorities collected samples at Trạm Chăn nuôi và Thú y khu vực I to confirm infection; results are pending. The herd had not been vaccinated against ASF. Containment measures include enhanced biosecurity, disinfection, lime dusting, and movement restrictions—no sale or transport of diseased pigs or products from the area. If laboratory tests confirm ASF, culling of the entire suspected herd will be considered per regulations. No other species or locations are mentioned.

triage.headline_ja: ヴィンロン省:豚数十頭が死亡、アフリカ豚熱感染が疑われる
triage.triage_reason: 単一農場での豚48頭規模の疑い例であり、ASFはベトナムで既に流行が確認されている疾患であるため異常性は低く、ヒトへの公衆衛生影響もないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: ASFは動物疾患でありヒトに感染しないため、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。地域の家畜防疫上の問題として現地当局が対応中。

article.articleHeadline: Військова лабораторія РФ і вірус чуми: Хара попередив про пандемію
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia's Military Laboratory and the Plague Virus: Khara Warned of a Pandemic.
article.articleSummary: Irkutsk region, during the Soviet era, experienced a bubonic plague outbreak in a military biolab, later concealed by the KGB. An elderly doctor consulted imperial-era medical texts to treat patients, while dangerous materials from the facility were not properly disposed of; lab filters designed to destroy pathogens were discarded. The epidemic swept the region, killing several tens of people, and could have escalated into a pandemic. Diplomat Oleksandr Khara, director of the Center for Defense Strategies, warns that military laboratories housing drug-resistant pathogens pose extreme pandemic risks. He draws a parallel with the Wuhan laboratory linked to COVID-19, noting that initial concealment by Chinese authorities preceded a global problem.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア軍事研究所とペスト菌：ハラ氏がパンデミックの危険性を警告
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はソ連時代のイルクーツクでの歴史的なペスト流行とウハン研究所への言及を用いた政治的警告・論評であり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクに関する情報ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はソ連時代のロシア・イルクーツクでの歴史的なペスト流行、及び武漢研究所起源説への言及を用いた政治的論評であり、現在発生中の感染症イベントではない。対象国リストに含まれる中国への言及もCOVID-19起源説への比較としてのみで、現在の発生事例ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: मुंबईत मलेरिया-स्वाइन फ्लूचा वाढता धोका;
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Mumbai, the rising threat of malaria and swine flu.
article.articleSummary: In Mumbai during June–September 2026, malaria rose to 7,422 cases and swine flu (H1N1) to 504, signaling rising monsoon-related illness. Dengue decreased to about 2,941 cases; leptospirosis 286; gastroenteritis 2,994; chikungunya 66; and COVID-19 165 fewer than last year. Swine flu hotspots include Andheri East–West, Bandra West, Kandivali, Malad, and Vikroli–Pawai; leptospirosis increased in Santa Cruz East, Dahisar, Andheri, Chembur, and Matunga-Sion; gastroenteritis cases were higher in Kh... (Khar), Bandra, Govandi, Sakinaka, and Malad. A September health drive surveyed 1,122,433 homes, tested 5,251,598 residents, collected 63,837 blood samples, and held 342 health camps. Vector-control inspected 38,028 potential malaria sites (6,310 with Anopheles); dengue inspections reached 1,044,555 sites with 23,407 Aedes breeding sites identified. Awareness urged caution for at-risk groups amid changing climate and humidity.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイでマラリアと豚インフルエンザの脅威が増大
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のモンスーン関連疾患（マラリア・豚インフルエンザ）の増加だが、既存の公衆衛生対応（調査・媒介生物対策）が実施されており、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はムンバイ（インド）における季節性感染症（マラリア、豚インフルエンザ、デング熱、レプトスピラ症等）の発生状況を報告するもので、地方自治体による監視・対策活動（住宅調査、媒介生物対策）が既に実施されている。フィリピンやドイツの地名はBluedotの発生地域に含まれるが、記事内容とは無関係のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes dan Pemkot Jaktim integrasikan deteksi dini TBC lewat CKG
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Health and the East Jakarta City Government integrate early TB detection through CKG.
article.articleSummary: The Indonesian Ministry of Health and Jakarta Timur's government have integrated early tuberculosis (TB) detection with the Free Health Check (CKG) program in East Jakarta, combining TB tracing with general health screening. In Cililitan, Kramat Jati, at Masjid Hikmatul Ilmi, RW 02, monitoring of integrated TB tracing and CKG emphasizes on-site, holistic health services to speed TB diagnosis and ensure complete treatment. Services include CKG-based checks (blood pressure, lipid profile, glucose) and portable X-ray screening for symptomatic TB, with active TB tracing and follow-up care. A focal locus targets 100 contacts or at-risk individuals for screening. The initiative, supported by the Ministry of Health, Jakarta Timur Health Office, and local Puskesmas, aims to reduce transmission in East Jakarta and expand CKG access to schools, offices, places of worship, and public events such as Pekan Raya Jakarta (PRJ).

article.articleHeadline: Lanka's TB Battle Gets Indian Lifeline
article.articleSummary: India hands over three tonnes of essential anti-tuberculosis medicines to Sri Lanka to bolster TB treatment and control efforts in Colombo, delivered September 28 aboard an Indian Air Force C-130J. High Commissioner Santosh Jha and Sri Lankan Health Minister Nalinda Jayatissa announced the consignment, with External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar framing it as support for Sri Lanka's public health system. The aid is part of broader bilateral assistance, including healthcare infrastructure. On September 16, construction began on a new two-storey Accident and Emergency Unit at Mannar District General Hospital, funded by a 600 million Sri Lankan rupees Indian grant, with foundation-laying attended by President Anura Kumara Dissanayake, Jayatissa, and Jha. The facility aims to improve timely emergency care during the critical 'golden hour' and strengthen people-centered health services in Sri Lanka.
