triage.notes: 記事は結核の発生状況そのものではなく、インドからスリランカへの医薬品援助および病院建設支援に関する内容。スリランカ・インドともに対象国リストに含まれるが、疾病発生地としての言及はないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Haut-Uele : ouverture d'une session de formation des acteurs des médias - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Haut-Uele: opening of a training session for media professionals - ACP
article.articleSummary: Training session for media professionals on Ebola response opened in Isiro, the capital of Haut-Uele Province in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, on 7 October 2026. The event was opened by Dr. Fines Mola, interim head of the provincial health division, who stressed that Haut-Uele—after Ituri—has been affected by the Ebola outbreak, threatening communities with deaths and disruption. The goal is to empower journalists and media outlets to explain what Ebola is, how to protect oneself and others, and to disseminate riposte messages to all social layers. The health official noted that the outbreak is a community problem requiring collective awareness. The launch took place in the meeting room of the Diocesan Procuracy of Isiro-Niangara, in the presence of partners and leaders responsible for the response’s communication pillars, including the WHO and UNICEF.

triage.headline_ja: オート・ウエレ州でのエボラ出血熱:メディア関係者向け研修セッションが開幕 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は既知の継続事案であり、本記事はメディア研修という広報活動を報じるのみで新規症例数や感染拡大の具体情報がないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 既知のDRCエボラ流行（イトゥリ州・オート・ウエレ州）に関する広報・啓発活動の記事。新規感染状況や症例数の更新情報はなし。既存のRRA対象イベントの可能性が高く、既に評価済みであれば重複トリアージとなる点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério reforça alerta contra risco de surto de sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry reinforces warning against the risk of a measles outbreak.
article.articleSummary: 52 imported measles cases in 2026 in Brazil, distributed as São Paulo (41), Amazonas (10), and Rio de Janeiro (1), prompting heightened surveillance and vaccination actions to prevent reintroduction of sustained transmission. The Ministry of Health intensified sanitary alert after global measles spread and the United States’ largest outbreak in 35 years. Active case finding and a vaccination bloc are being deployed to protect the national elimination status. Brazil maintains measles-free status, reconquered with PAHO in 2024, and continues preventive strategies to uphold high immunization coverage and rapid responses to imported cases. The focus remains on preventing reintroduction of the virus into Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、麻疹アウトブレイクのリスクに対する警戒を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで輸入麻疹症例52件が確認されているが、持続的な国内伝播は報告されておらず排除状態は維持されている。今後の拡大動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ブラジルは2024年にPAHOから麻疹排除認定を再取得しており、現在は輸入症例の監視・ワクチン接種強化対応中。持続的な国内伝播や重症例の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Tăng cường công tác phòng chống bệnh sốt xuất huyết, tay chân miệng, dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Strengthen the prevention and control of dengue fever, hand, foot and mouth disease, and rabies.
article.articleSummary: From January to September 2026, Dong Nai Province’s Department of Health and its CDC intensified preventive medicine activities, strengthening surveillance, outbreak response, and vaccination for dengue fever, hand-foot-mouth disease, and rabies. The Expanded Immunization Program reached 14 of 15 targets; newborn hepatitis B vaccination within 24 hours stood at 95.5%. Data cleaning progressed, with over 1.79 million vaccination records cleaned (71.2% completion). For the final quarter, the Dong Nai CDC will emphasize early detection and rapid response to cases and outbreaks, prioritizing dengue, hand-foot-mouth disease, and rabies, while sustaining immunization, non-communicable disease management, environmental monitoring, and maternal–child health. Communications, testing, and standardized data updates will be expanded to ensure data quality and interoperability. Nine-month trends show dengue infections down but deaths up; hand-foot-mouth cases increased; rabies caused three deaths.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱・手足口病・狂犬病の予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の死亡増加、手足口病の症例増加、狂犬病による死亡3例が報告されているが、通常の行政レポート的内容であり社会的関心の高まりは不明なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ドンナイ省における定例の保健当局報告。デング熱死亡増加、手足口病増加、狂犬病死亡3例という具体的な懸念点はあるが、地域的な通常業務報告の域を出ない。

article.articleHeadline: കോംഗോയിൽ എബോള ബാധ കുട്ടികളെ സാരമായി ബാധിക്കുന്നു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infection severely affects children in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri and North Kivu) severely impacts children. UNICEF reports more than 1,900 children have been orphaned or separated since May, with numbers from UNICEF-operating areas possibly underestimating true totals. The crisis is driven by conflict and displacement; about 4.4 million people are internally displaced, increasing risk for street children. Among those infected, over one-fourth are children; among deaths, roughly one in three are children, and under-five mortality is about 70%. These dynamics reflect severe vulnerabilities, including children being left without caregivers as parents fall ill or die. UNICEF has opened child-protection centers near treatment facilities to shield children from neglect and abuse during the outbreak."

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染が子どもたちに深刻な影響を与えている
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部（イトゥリ、北キブ）で継続中のエボラ流行が子どもに深刻な影響を及ぼしており、致死率・重症度が高く、人道危機（紛争・避難民）による感染拡大リスクも存在するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 既知のエボラ流行の継続報道だが、紛争・避難民（440万人）による脆弱性拡大と子どもの高い死亡率（5歳未満で約70%）が強調されており、人道支援ニーズが高い。UNICEFによる子ども保護対応も実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Маленький укус вызвал критические последствия: отдых во Вьетнаме привел к экстренной госпитализации
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A small bite caused life-threatening complications: A trip to Vietnam led to emergency hospitalization.
article.articleSummary: A Russian tourist was hospitalized during a vacation in Da Nang, Vietnam, after an insect bite. Mash Telegram channel reports she was diagnosed with dengue fever, a viral illness common in tropical and subtropical regions. The bite occurred while she was sleeping; dengue is transmitted by infected mosquitoes, not via person-to-person contact. Her condition deteriorated with a fever of 39–40°C, severe joint and muscle pains, and lack of relief from standard fever reducers. After medical evaluation and laboratory testing, dengue fever was confirmed. She is currently under medical supervision and receiving treatment. This is not isolated; a Ryazan resident returning from Vietnam also developed dengue after a similar mosquito exposure. Dengue symptoms include high fever, malaise, myalgia, and sometimes rash or lymphadenopathy. Southeast Asia travel precautions emphasize mosquito bite prevention to reduce risk.

triage.headline_ja: 小さな虫刺されが重大な結果を招いた：ベトナム旅行が緊急入院につながる
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム渡航者個人のデング熱感染事例であり、デング熱は同地域の風土病として既知であるため、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ロシア人旅行者2名の個別症例報告であり、ベトナムでのデング熱流行拡大や異常事態を示す情報はない。ロシア（リャザン）は帰国後の発症であり発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 11歲長期病患女童染流感併發嚴重肺炎　情况嚴重 (19:24) - 20261007
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 11-year-old girl with a chronic illness contracts influenza and develops severe pneumonia; condition serious (19:24) - 20261007
article.articleSummary: As of 7 October 2026, Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection reported a severe pediatric influenza case: an 11-year-old girl with a chronic condition diagnosed with influenza A (H1) and developing severe pneumonia, currently in the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit at Queen Mary Hospital. Symptom onset: cough Sept 29, fever Sept 30; by Oct 3 she had dyspnea and vomiting and was hospitalized. Lab tests confirmed influenza A (H1). No travel during the incubation period; she had not received the 2026/27 seasonal flu vaccine. A household contact had mild upper respiratory symptoms recently and recovered. Over the past 5 days, three severe pediatric influenza cases were reported. Since school reopening in September, the Center notes about 370 school influenza-like illness outbreaks affecting around 2,200 individuals. Public health officials urge vaccination and strict personal and environmental hygiene, predicting influenza activity will remain high in the coming weeks.

triage.headline_ja: 11歳の長期疾患を持つ女児がインフルエンザに感染し重症肺炎を併発、容体は深刻（19:24）- 20261007
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1)による小児重症例だが、既知の季節性株であり国際的拡大や渡航制限リスクは低い。学校での流行拡大状況は注視が必要。
triage.notes: 香港での季節性インフルエンザA(H1)による重症小児例。過去5日間で3件の重症小児例、学校でのインフルエンザ様疾患集団発生約370件（約2200人）が報告されており、季節性流行の拡大状況として経過観察が望ましい。香港はChina (1814991)に含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Đánh giá tình hình ổ dịch sốt xuất huyết tại thôn Phố Thiều, xã Triệu Sơn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Assessment of the dengue fever outbreak situation in Phố Thiều hamlet, Triệu Sơn commune
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak in Phố Thiều hamlet, Triệu Sơn commune, Thanh Hóa Province, Vietnam. First case on 16 September 2026. By 6 October, 13 cases diagnosed; no severe disease or deaths; 9 discharged. Thanh Hóa CDC dispatched a task force to monitor, assess, and support local control. Vector control from 21–25 September sprayed insecticide in 33 households within 200 m of the index case. From 26–30 September, spraying covered all 561 households in Phố Thiều, with measures extended to neighboring Sơn Hà and Dân Lý. Early October recorded 2 additional cases on 3–4 October; 5–6 October had no new cases. Surrounding areas appeared clean with no standing water, but transmission persisted, so containment not yet confirmed. Recommendations: continue “4 at the spot” measures, bolster communication, surveillance, periodic vector investigations, and monitor 51 households (171 people) in high-risk area; expand surveillance to Sơn Hà and Dân Lý to detect cases.

triage.headline_ja: トリウソン村フォティウ集落におけるデング熱流行状況の評価
triage.triage_reason: 小規模なデング熱クラスター（13例、重症・死亡なし）で地域CDCが対応中だが、感染拡大の懸念が残り封じ込め未確認のため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: ベトナム・タインホア省の局地的デング熱アウトブレイク。地元CDCが対応中で、重症例・死亡例なし。デング熱は同地域で季節的に発生する既知の媒介感染症であり、異常性は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : 8 665 cas confirmés d'Ebola et 4 178 décès
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: 8,665 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,178 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues across seven provinces and 64 health zones. As of 5 October 2026, 8,665 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,178 deaths, yielding a case fatality rate of 48.2%. Contact tracing coverage stands at 80.4%. The response includes ongoing surveillance and case management, with 890 patients currently isolated or hospitalized and 2,259 recoveries reported, including 24 new recoveries in the last 24 hours. Vaccination campaigns are progressing, especially in Tshopo and Bas-Uele provinces, though the article does not provide vaccination totals. Health authorities urge the public to report symptoms or suspected cases via emergency number 151. The situation remains active, with the response continuing in all affected provinces and zones.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ確定症例8,665件、死亡4,178人
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.2%の大規模エボラアウトブレイクが7州64保健ゾーンに拡大継続中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 既知の大規模エボラ流行の継続報告。症例数・死亡数が極めて多く、ワクチン接種や接触者追跡など対応継続中。既存のRRA更新対象として扱うべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Bunia : les écoles sollicitent un appui en kits de prévention - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Bunia: Schools Seek Support in the Form of Prevention Kits - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, spurs school authorities to seek preventive support. In Bunia, school principals and the parents’ committee, during a training on Ebola prevention, pressed for materials to curb transmission, notably handwashing kits and enhanced parental awareness. The session emphasizes equipping schools to serve as prevention hubs for students, staff, and local communities. Stéphane Bauma, head of the Caleb school complex, warned that while training is essential, supplying and maintaining handwashing kits poses logistical challenges. He also raised concerns about vaccination in schools, noting that insufficient parental sensitization could provoke resistance, with fears of parents forcibly taking children to receive vaccines. The program aims to bolster school leadership and parent committee knowledge on prevention measures and to position schools as community awareness channels for Ebola control.

triage.headline_ja: ブニアでのエボラ出血熱：学校側が予防キットの支援を要請 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州ブニアで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する報道であり、エボラは国際的に重大な公衆衛生リスクを伴う疾患であるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事自体は学校での予防キット支援要請に関するものだが、背景にブニアでの継続的なエボラ感染が存在することを示唆しており、ワクチン接種への抵抗感など社会的懸念も報告されている。感染者数・死亡者数など具体的な疫学データは記事に記載されていないため、詳細はフルリスク評価で確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Death Tests Kenya's Border Screening and Disease Defenses
article.articleSummary: An Ebola-infected Kenyan man moved undetected for weeks, traveling through several cities in the Democratic Republic of Congo, before making a roughly nine-hour road journey from Beni to Uganda’s capital Kampala, where he spent a night. On Oct. 3, he boarded a Jambojet flight, prompting renewed scrutiny of Kenya’s border screening and disease defenses as authorities trace potential exposure. The incident highlights cross-border risk posed by travelers and tests surveillance at entry points amid ongoing Ebola monitoring in Kenya, the DRC, and Uganda. Published Oct. 7, 2026. The report emphasizes the importance of timely travel-history assessment and international coordination to reduce importation risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラによる死亡がケニアの国境検疫と感染症対策の限界を露呈
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ感染者が検疫をすり抜け複数国（DRC、ウガンダ、ケニア）を移動し死亡した事例であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 感染者はDRC（ベニ）発でウガンダ（カンパラ）を経由しケニアで発症・死亡。ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染経路が複数国にまたがる点がIHR国際拡大リスクの根拠。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya ramps up Ebola screening at JKIA for travellers from ten African nations
article.articleSummary: Kenya has intensified Ebola screening at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport (JKIA) Gate 16 for travelers arriving from ten East and Central African countries (DR Congo, Uganda, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Angola, Zambia, Rwanda, Burundi, South Sudan, Central African Republic) after confirming Kenya's first imported Bundibugyo strain Ebola case. All flights from these nations will be routed to Gate 16 for enhanced health checks, declaration forms, and port health monitoring. In response, five temporary isolation centres are being prepared near the Uganda border, including Malaba Health Centre, Busia Border, Kocholia, and a Busia County district hospital, slated for completion within two weeks. The ministry is upgrading the toll-free health hotline in partnership with the Digital Health Agency and telecom operators, while urging the public not to overload the service. No details on symptomatology or infection source beyond the imported case are provided.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、10のアフリカ諸国からの渡航者に対しJKIAでのエボラ検疫を強化
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで輸入性エボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の初症例が確認され、空港での検疫強化・隔離施設設置など公衆衛生対応が取られており、IHR基準に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアにおける輸入エボラ症例とそれに伴う空港検疫強化である。DRC・ザンビア等は渡航者の出発国として言及されているのみで、当該国での発生を示す記述はないため対象国リストには含めなかった。ケニア自体は対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ölümcül virüs dünyayı harekete geçirdi! Çin, Rusya'daki vakayı yakın takibe aldı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly virus mobilizes the world! China keeps a close eye on the case in Russia.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 October 2026, a staff member at the Irkutsk Region’s Plague Institute in Siberia died after being suspected of pneumonia of unknown etiology, with reports of pneumonic plague surfacing. Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor said special measures were implemented for the institute’s staff following the pneumonia of unknown etiology diagnosis. On 2 October, Irkutsk Governor Igor Kobzev announced an extraordinary meeting of the regional sanitary-epidemiological commission regarding a person suspected of an especially dangerous infection. Social media circulated claims of pneumonic plague. China’s Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Ciakun said Beijing is in close cooperation with Russian health authorities on prevention and control of communicable diseases. The article notes there is no land border between China and the Irkutsk Region.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的なウイルスが世界を動かす！中国、ロシアでの症例を注視
triage.triage_reason: シベリア・イルクーツク州のペスト研究所職員が原因不明肺炎（肺ペスト疑い）で死亡し、特別措置・緊急会議が実施されるなど異常性・重症度が高く、中国を含む国際的関心も高まっているため。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア・イルクーツク州（Bluedotの発生地域リストにRussiaとChinaが含まれるが、対象国リストにRussiaは含まれず、Chinaは記事主題ではなく単に監視・協力の立場のため除外）。確定診断ではなく疑い例の段階であり、続報での確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Rusia oculta datos de la peste en Siberia desatando una ola de rumores
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia hides data on the plague in Siberia, unleashing a wave of rumors.
article.articleSummary: Plague suspicion in Irkutsk, Siberia, following the death of lab worker Darya Shipilova of the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute around October 2. Official cause: pneumonia of undetermined etiology; no pathogens linked to her work detected. About 200 people are under surveillance and quarantine, with 189–197 contacts reported; most tests negative. Independent outlets describe broader quarantines across Irkutsk hospitals and isolation of at least 60 staff at the institute. WHO assesses regional public health risk as low to moderate; Russia low and Europe very low, with readiness to assist. U.S. and EU authorities monitor; Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan border controls tightened; Mongolia and parts of China cited as nearby plague foci. No confirmed plague case has been established.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアがシベリアのペスト関連データを隠蔽、噂の渦を巻き起こす
triage.triage_reason: シベリアの抗ペスト研究所職員の死亡を巡り、ロシア当局の情報隠蔽疑惑と近隣国（カザフスタン・キルギス）の国境管理強化という異常かつ国際的波及の兆候があり、IHR基準で複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべきと判断。
triage.notes: イベント発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストに含まれない。中国はペストの『近隣流行地』として言及されているのみで、記事の主題となる発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。確定診断（ペスト）は未確立で、死因は『原因不明の肺炎』とされている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: 【新聞第一線】70導彈撲烏 胡塞險炸客機 俄鼠疫驚現劇本？ | 伊朗 | 沙特 | 普京
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News Frontline: 70 missiles strike Ukraine; the Houthis threaten to blow up a passenger aircraft; Russian plague appears in the script? | Iran | Saudi Arabia | Putin
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-07, NTDT reports a sudden outbreak of pneumonic plague in Russia, prompting urgent U.S. Embassy evacuation and triggering international health concerns. The segment links the event to broader crises, noting a prior China–Russia joint exercise and heightened geopolitical tensions. The report describes the pneumonic plague claim around 11:20 in the broadcast but provides no laboratory confirmation or official health authority statements, nor details on cases or fatalities. It underscores potential travel and diplomatic implications as authorities respond to the perceived health threat. The program also covers sensational topics (biochemical fears, Wuhan-script echoes), but the disease-focused element centers on Russia’s alleged pneumonic plague outbreak and evacuations.

triage.headline_ja: 【ニュースフロントライン】70発のミサイルがウクライナを攻撃；フーシ派が旅客機爆破を脅迫；ロシアでペストが出現？台本か？｜イラン｜サウジアラビア｜プーチン
triage.triage_reason: ロシアでの肺ペスト発生という主張は公式機関による確認や検査データがなく、地政学的な扇情的報道の一部として扱われている。対象国リストにも該当国がなく、信頼性が低いため見送りと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事は政治的・地政学的文脈の中でロシアの肺ペスト発生を取り上げているが、公式な健康当局の発表や検査確認がなく、信憑性が低い。対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya : un décès lié à Ebola, surveillance renforcée
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya: a death linked to Ebola, enhanced surveillance.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed the death of an Ebola patient who arrived from the Democratic Republic of Congo, the country’s first imported, confirmed Ebola case. As of October 6, authorities had tested 267 samples across five laboratories; only the deceased patient tested positive. No evidence of local transmission has been detected, though authorities are tracing travelers who shared the same flight and monitoring close contacts and healthcare workers involved in care. Enhanced surveillance is underway with strengthened entry-point screening and designation of multiple hospitals to manage suspected or confirmed cases. Rapid response and surveillance teams have been mobilized. The government cautioned that the death alone does not confirm local transmission and ongoing investigations and testing could shift the situation, with new guidelines issued for facilities and exposed individuals as contacts are followed and results come in.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア：エボラ関連の死亡例、監視体制を強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国からの輸入エボラ症例によるケニア初の死亡が確認され、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際的拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 死亡例はケニアで発生したが、感染源はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）の既知のエボラ流行であるため、DRCを実際の発生国として記載。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。現地感染の証拠は確認されていないが、接触者追跡・空港スクリーニング強化など対応が進行中であり、続報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Tailandia vigila posible caso de peste sin confirmar aún si la fallecida viajó al país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thailand monitors a possible plague case; whether the deceased traveled to the country has not yet been confirmed.
article.articleSummary: Thailand monitors a possible pneumonic plague case after the death of a Russian woman in Siberia; there is no official confirmation she traveled to Thailand. The Thai Department of Disease Control (DDC) says it is verifying reports with the World Health Organization. In Russia, theories about the origin—infection in Thailand after a return or a lab incident—are not supported by official sources. Thai health and foreign ministries say they have no information confirming the woman’s passage through Thailand and will update when available. After a preliminary assessment, Thailand regards the import risk as low, noting the incident in Russia is confined to a specific area. The United States has issued a travel alert about a possible pneumonic plague in the Irkutsk region; Moscow has urged ignoring rumors. Rospotrebnadzor has confirmed only a death from pneumonia of undetermined etiology; no contacts have fallen ill, and some Irkutsk hospitals reportedly placed in quarantine. No travel restrictions are being tightened in Thailand at this time.

triage.headline_ja: タイ、死亡したロシア人女性がタイを訪れたか未確認のまま、肺ペストの可能性のある症例を監視
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストの疑い例（ロシア・イルクーツク州での死亡）に関連し、国際的な渡航歴の確認作業とWHOへの照会が行われており、IHR基準（重大性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）を2つ以上満たすためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 確定例はロシア（イルクーツク州）での死亡であり、対象国リストに含まれない。タイは渡航歴の有無を確認中で、現時点で確定例はないため、対象国としての実発生は確認されず、verified_locationsは空配列とした。続報でタイ国内の確定例が報告された場合は再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya's Ebola Case Spurs Regional Health Preparedness Measures
article.articleSummary: An imported Bundibugyo Ebola case in Kenya was confirmed on 6 October 2026 in a Kenyan citizen who travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo. The patient’s route was DRC → Kampala, Uganda → Nairobi, where he was isolated and contact tracing began. Nigeria’s Centre for Disease Control is assessing risk and urging travellers from affected areas to monitor health for 21 days. Uganda says the country remains Ebola‑free, noting the patient transited Entebbe airport for under 24 hours with a normal departure temperature, with ongoing surveillance. MSF reports close coordination with Kenya’s Ministry of Health and regional support, including an Ebola simulation/training centre in Kajiado County that has trained 355 professionals, 84 Kenyan health workers, in PPE and infection prevention. Preparedness efforts extend to Mombasa’s Port Reitz Hospital and Busia County on the Kenya–Uganda border, emphasizing community engagement. The DRC outbreak has infected over 8,200 and caused 4,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアのエボラ症例が地域的な保健備え対策を促進
triage.triage_reason: DRCの大規模エボラ流行（感染者8,200人超、死者4,000人）を背景に、国境を越えた輸入症例がケニアで確認され、複数国（ウガンダ、ナイジェリア等）が警戒・対応を強化しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 輸入症例の発生国はケニア、経由国はウガンダだが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため除外。流行の震源地であるDRCのみを対象国として記載。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго число погибших от Эболы превысило 8,6 тыс. человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DR Congo, the Ebola death toll surpassed 8,600 people.
article.articleSummary: As of October 7, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 8,665 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,178 deaths (case fatality 48.2%). The outbreak remains active across seven provinces and 64 affected districts, with 890 patients in isolation or hospital care and 2,259 recovered. Vaccination progress is noted, particularly in the Tshopo and Lower Uele provinces, signaling ongoing public health interventions. The country’s public health institute, cited by Report, confirms sustained response measures in affected areas. Authorities have stated the epidemic is fully under control, though response activities continue to prevent further transmission. These figures reflect updates from the health ministry’s communications regarding this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ死者数が8,600人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（症例8,665人、死亡4,178人、致死率48.2%）が7州64地区に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 既知の大規模エボラ流行の継続報道。致死率48.2%と高く、7州64地区に拡大中。当局は「完全にコントロール下」としているが、対応活動は継続中であり、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Ebola case exposes gaps in border screenings
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first Ebola case linked to DR Congo's Bundibugyo outbreak; a Kenyan national who travelled overland from Beni, Congo, to Kampala, Uganda, before flying to Nairobi, where he died two days after arrival. He exhibited fever, chills, muscle pain and bleeding beneath the skin. The May-closed Congo–Uganda border and porous crossings allowed multi-country transit; Ugandan authorities declared Ebola-free in late July, but border gaps persist. Kenyan authorities say he travelled via three Ebola-affected Congo provinces and may have used medication to mask symptoms; he was screened at Entebbe with normal temperature and at Nairobi with temperature checks and digital forms. 57 contacts identified, 10 quarantined; a dedicated screening gate was set up at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport. The Congo outbreak is the worst on record, with over 8,000 infections and more than 4,000 deaths; Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no known treatment or vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアのエボラ症例、国境検疫の不備を露呈
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中の過去最悪規模のエボラ流行（感染者8000人超、死者4000人超）がウガンダを経由してケニアに国境を越えて拡大し、死亡例も発生しているため、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、国境を越えた拡大事例として引き続き注視が必要。DRCのBundibugyo株エボラ流行は過去最悪規模で、治療薬・ワクチンが存在しない点が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: У Китаї відреагували на спалах чуми в Росії
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China responded to an outbreak of plague in Russia.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 October 2026, China officially acknowledged reports of a probable pneumonic plague outbreak in Russia’s Irkutsk Oblast. A 28‑year‑old employee of the Irkutsk Anti‑Plague Institute died; about 200 people who may have had contact with her were hospitalized for medical observation. Earlier, Irkutsk region and a joint Russia–China emergency‑response drill on infectious disease outbreaks concluded, with discussions on cross‑border surveillance and control. Irkutsk Oblast lies north of Mongolia and does not border China, though Irkutsk city is a major transport hub with regular air and rail links to Chinese cities. Mongolia’s Health Ministry called the related risk low on 7 October, pledging continued monitoring. Kremlin and Rospotrebnadzor deny a dangerous disease; unconfirmed local‑media reports suggested a lab vial containing Yersinia pestis, while official Russian authorities cite pneumonia of unknown etiology. Plague is caused by Yersinia pestis and includes bubonic, septicemic, and pneumonic forms (the latter airborne).

triage.headline_ja: 中国、ロシアでのペスト感染拡大に反応
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州で肺ペストの疑い例による死亡者が発生し、約200人が観察対象となるなど公衆衛生上の深刻な影響があり、国境を越えた交通拠点であることから国際的拡大リスクも懸念される。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア連邦イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストに含まれない。中国・モンゴルは反応を示しているのみで発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。ロシア当局は『原因不明の肺炎』と説明し、ペスト（Yersinia pestis）関与は未確認情報に基づく。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria advierte del "riesgo de importación" de contagios de ébola tras el caso de Kenia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria warns of the "risk of importation" of Ebola infections following the Kenya case.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD), Bundibugyo strain, prompts Nigeria’s NCDC to warn of international importation risk after Kenya reported its first imported case. The Kenyan patient, a citizen who had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) for seven years, died Monday night in a Nairobi hospital after a route from the DRC via Kampala, Uganda, to Nairobi (arrived Oct 3). Kenyan authorities identified dozens of contacts and are tracing passengers and crew from the flight. Nigeria has no confirmed cases but is reviewing preparedness measures amid the evolving regional situation. Since May, DRC’s outbreak has become the second deadliest globally, with 8,665 cases and 4,178 deaths. Uganda declared the end of its outbreak on Aug 26, reporting 20 infections (15 imported from DRC) and two deaths. Bundibugyo has no specific treatment; two vaccines are in human trials and may take months. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、ケニアでのエボラ症例を受け「輸入リスク」を警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5月以降8,665例・4,178人死亡という大規模流行が続いており、ケニアへの国際的な感染拡大（輸入症例）が確認され、ナイジェリアも警戒を強めているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニア（輸入症例）およびナイジェリア（警戒）だが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。流行の発生源であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。ウガンダも流行関連国だが対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dans le Haut-Uélé : un cumul de 364 cas confirmés présenté à Isiro - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Haut-Uélé: a cumulative total of 364 confirmed cases presented in Isiro - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak persists in Haut-Uélé, Northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with a cumulative 364 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, 173 deaths, and 146 recoveries in the province as of October 6, 2026, presented in Isiro (capital). In a briefing, Dr. Fines Mola, interim provincial health division chief, urged continued adherence to barrier measures to stop transmission and asked the media to intensify engagement to counter rumors and the infodemic on social networks. Journalists were briefed on Ebola’s history, transmission, and prevention to support response efforts and help prepare ground for response teams. The overarching message is that the outbreak remains active and requires ongoing community involvement to halt propagation in the region.

triage.headline_ja: オート・ウエレ州のエボラ出血熱：イシロで累計364例の確定症例が報告される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的なアウトブレイクで364例の確定症例、173例の死亡が報告されており、致死率が高く公衆衛生上重大な影響があるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率約47.5%（173/364）と高く、保健当局が地域メディアを通じて流言対策・コミュニティ関与の強化を呼びかけている。アウトブレイクは継続中であり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 肯亞現伊波拉死亡病例　男子連跨三國掀邊境防疫漏洞 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya reports an Ebola death case; man crosses three countries, exposing gaps in border disease-prevention measures
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports a fatal Ebola case traced to a traveler from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), who crossed Uganda into Kenya. The man, who had lived in DRC for seven years, developed Ebola-like symptoms—fever, chills, muscle pains, and subcutaneous bleeding—about a month before arriving in Nairobi, and died two days after hospital admission. He traveled from DRC by air, crossed into Uganda (Kampala) overnight, then flew to Nairobi, passing through Entebbe and Nairobi airports where infrared temperature checks and digital health declarations were used; experts note these measures can be circumvented by antipyretics and honest reporting. DRC faces a severe Bundibugyo virus strain outbreak with over 8,000 infections and more than 4,000 deaths; there is no known cure or vaccine. Kenya has identified 57 contacts, with 10 isolated, and has added a dedicated screening channel at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport as authorities trace exposures to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ死亡例、男性が3カ国を跨いで移動し国境検疫の抜け穴露呈
triage.triage_reason: DRCで8,000人超の感染・4,000人超の死亡という大規模なエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続中であり、国境を越えた人の移動により致死例がケニアで確認されるなど国際的拡大が実証されている重大事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでのエボラ死亡例だが、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは流行の震源地として記事内で詳細に言及されており（8,000人超感染、4,000人超死亡、ワクチン・治療法なし）、対象国として含めた。治療薬・ワクチンがない点、ヒトーヒト感染の国境越え拡大が確認されている点から緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: В Китае отреагировали на вспышку чумы в России
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China Responds to Plague Outbreak in Russia.
article.articleSummary: China issued its official response to reports of a possible pneumonic plague outbreak in Irkutsk Oblast. Spokesperson Guo Jiakun said China and Russia maintain close cooperation in preventing and combating infectious diseases, especially plague. The situation followed the death of a 28-year-old employee of the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute, with nearly 200 people potentially exposed and hospitalized for medical surveillance. The institute recently completed joint emergency-response exercises with China on monitoring and cross-border disease spread. Irkutsk Oblast lies north of Mongolia and does not border China, though Irkutsk has regular links to Chinese cities. Mongolia’s Health Ministry on Oct 7 said outbreak risk is low and will monitor. Kremlin and Rospotrebnadzor deny a dangerous disease; officials cite pneumonia of unknown etiology, while unconfirmed local reports mention a broken vial with Yersinia pestis. Pneumonic plague is the most dangerous form and spreads by droplets; at least 60 staff quarantined.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、ロシアでのペスト流行に対し公式反応
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州で肺ペストの疑いがある死亡例と約200人の曝露・隔離が発生しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストに含まれない。中国・モンゴルは反応・監視を表明しているのみで発生地ではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。ロシア当局は『不明病因の肺炎』と説明し、Yersinia pestis検出は未確認情報とされている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: EUA alertam para possível surto de peste pneumónica na Rússia e pedem aos cidadãos que abandonem o país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US warns of a possible pneumonic plague outbreak in Russia and urges citizens to leave the country.
article.articleSummary: US Embassy in Moscow warns of a potential pneumonic plague case in Russia’s Siberia after a death in Irkutsk region. Conflicting reports cite possible Yersinia pestis involvement and hospital quarantines, while Russian authorities deny detection of the plague bacterium and say the death stems from pneumonia of unknown origin. Independent outlets reported quarantines, but officials deny them; Rospotrebnadzor states tests show no plague. The case centers on a woman who worked at a laboratory in Irkutsk; hypotheses include infection during travel to Thailand or a laboratory accident, though the latter is rejected by authorities and families. The US warns citizens to depart Russia; Level 4 travel advisory remains in place, with limited American assistance outside Moscow. WHO and EU/EC monitor; European health risk deemed very low. US officials urge Moscow for transparency; Trump plans to discuss the issue with Putin.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、ロシアでの肺ペスト発生の可能性を警告し、自国民に国外退避を要請
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州での肺ペスト疑い死亡例に対し、米国が渡航警告（レベル4）と国民退避要請を出すなど国際的反応が強く、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・渡航制限）に該当するため。ただしロシア当局は感染を否定しており情報は錯綜している。
triage.notes: 事例はロシア・イルクーツク州で発生しており、対象国リストに該当国なし。タイへの渡航歴が感染源仮説として言及されているが、タイ国内での発生ではないため verified_locations には含めない。ロシア当局はペスト菌検出を否定し、原因不明の肺炎と説明しており、情報の確度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : un premier cas importé confirmé au Kenya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Kenya confirms first imported case.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first imported Ebola case of Bundibugyo lineage. A Kenyan national from the Democratic Republic of Congo fell ill in eastern DRC, transited via Uganda, and arrived in Nairobi on 3 October; he was isolated promptly and died on 5 October, with burial on 6 October per Ebola protocols. Kenya, with WHO support, identified 28 contacts and is tracing 23 passengers and 4 crew from the patient’s flight; entry screening and epidemiological surveillance have been strengthened. Since May, Kenya has screened more than 652,000 travelers, analyzed about 267 suspected samples, and trained around 5,000 health workers. Kenya becomes the fourth country with Bundibugyo-linked Ebola, after the DRC, Uganda, and France; WHO says no travel or trade restrictions are recommended. In the DRC, outbreaks persist in Ituri and Nord-Kivu (8,544 cases, 4,114 deaths as of 3 Oct). UNICEF notes over 1,900 affected children and funds 12 nurseries near Ebola treatment centers across Ituri, Nord-Kivu and South Kivu; total needs are $150.8 million, with $40.1 million mobilized.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ケニアで初の輸入症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ系統）がコンゴ民主共和国で継続流行中であり、ケニアへの国際的な症例輸入が確認されたため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し緊急のリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダ・フランスでの症例確認は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。主たる流行地であるDRC（Ituri、Nord-Kivu、South Kivu州）のみを対象国として記載。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: Brasil intensifica ações face a avanço nos EUA e nas Américas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: Brazil steps up actions in response to the spread in the United States and the Americas.
article.articleSummary: Measles spread in the United States and the Americas prompts Brazil to intensify actions. As of October 5, 2026, Brazil reports 52 imported measles cases (41 in São Paulo, 10 in Amazonas, 1 in Rio de Janeiro) but remains free of endemic transmission. The United States has the highest annual measles burden in over 35 years, with >90% of infections among unvaccinated or vaccination-unknown individuals. In the Americas, most confirmed measles cases in 2026 are in the United States, Guatemala, Mexico, Peru and Canada, per PAHO. Brazil conducted four vaccination mobilizations in 2026, delivering 3.8 million doses in São Paulo and 192,000 in Amazonas. First-dose MMR coverage reached 93.10% nationally in 2025. The response includes case finding, investigations, contact tracing, dose-zero for 6–11 months, and vaccine blocks, with focus on São Paulo and the Brazil-Colombia-Peru tri-border region. Vaccine is free via SUS; surveillance aims to prevent imported cases from causing transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹：米国およびアメリカ大陸での拡大を受け、ブラジルが対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 米国を中心にアメリカ大陸で麻疹が35年ぶりの高水準で拡大しており、ブラジルも輸入症例が増加・対策強化中であり、政府・社会的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内の輸入麻疹症例（52例、地方流行は未発生）と、米国・アメリカ大陸全体での麻疹拡大への対応強化を主題としている。米国・グアテマラ・メキシコ・ペルー・カナダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。スペイン領カナリア諸島も対象国外。

article.articleHeadline: La peste neumónica, en el foco de la OMS, EEUU y China: "Solicitamos más información para aclarar las causas"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The pneumonic plague, in the focus of the WHO, the United States and China: "We are requesting more information to clarify the causes."
article.articleSummary: Death of a 28-year-old worker at the Institute for Antipest Research in Irkutsk and the Far East raises international concern over a possible pneumonic plague in Irkutsk Oblast, Russia. The deceased died on Oct 2 after severe pneumonia; while Russian media cited a possible laboratory exposure, official confirmation of Yersinia pestis has not been issued. The WHO activated International Health Regulations and requested more information from Moscow; contacts identified were monitored and tested, with no high-risk pathogens detected. The organization says questions remain about the pneumonia's cause and a second employee with pneumonia of undetermined origin. The United States issued a health alert on Oct 6, urging adherence to local guidance and noting limited consular help outside Moscow. China says it maintains close cooperation with Russia on disease prevention and control. Pneumonic plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, transmits via respiratory droplets and can be fatal without early antibiotic treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 肺ペスト、WHO・米国・中国の注目の的に：「原因解明のため追加情報を要請」
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州の研究所関連とみられる肺ペスト疑い死亡例に対し、WHOがIHRを発動し追加情報を要請。米国も健康アラートを発出し、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高まっているためフルRRAへの移行が適切。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア連邦イルクーツク州・モスクワであり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。中国・米国は本事例への対応・関与国として言及されているのみで、発生国ではない。Yersinia pestisの確定診断は未公表であり、原因・感染経路（実験室曝露の可能性）は依然不明。

article.articleHeadline: How airlines could help contain Russian plague using lessons from past outbreaks
article.articleSummary: Potential pneumonic plague death in Russia linked to the Irkutsk Antiplague Research Institute highlights airlines as frontline in detecting and containing outbreaks. Airlines support passive passenger surveillance and emerging wastewater testing, with plans for airport air sampling. U.S. authorities have used Do Not Board orders and extended quarantines, such as a 42-day quarantine for 18 Americans from a Dutch Andes hantavirus outbreak, and Congo Ebola-related entry limits, including 21-day rules for travelers from Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. No direct Russia–U.S. flights; routing via hubs like Istanbul is possible, and restrictions could target recent Russian travelers if outbreak grows. The CDC has expanded plane wastewater testing since the JFK 2022 pilot; Qantas and the University of Queensland propose global genomic surveillance via aircraft wastewater; Emory cautions wastewater may be late for fast-spreading pathogens. Plague is rarely contagious until severe illness.

triage.headline_ja: 航空会社がどのようにロシアのペスト流行を過去の流行の教訓を活かして抑え込めるか
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの抗ペスト研究所関連で肺ペストによる死亡の可能性が報告されており、重篤性・異常性が高く、航空機を介した国際拡散リスクや渡航制限の議論も行われているため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア（イルクーツク）での肺ペスト疑い死亡例であり、対象国リストにロシアは含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。DRCのエボラ関連渡航制限は過去の政策事例として言及されているのみで、現在進行中のDRC国内イベントの主題ではないため除外した。情報が限定的（『潜在的な死亡』のみで確定症例数・感染経路の詳細不明）であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: กรมวิทย์ฯ ยันพร้อมรับมือ 'กาฬโรค' เปิดแล็บ BSL-3 ตรวจเชื้อรู้ผลใน 24 ชม.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Medical Sciences Reaffirms Readiness to Handle the Plague; Opens BSL-3 Lab with Test Results in 24 Hours
article.articleSummary: On 7 October 2026, Thailand's Department of Medical Sciences reaffirmed readiness to manage plague, amid reports of pneumonic plague in laboratories abroad. It notes a Biosafety Level 3 (BSL-3) lab capable of detecting Yersinia pestis, the plague agent, by real-time PCR with results within 24 hours. The facility can culture isolates and confirm them with biochemical tests, under stringent quality control and biosafety standards, with experienced personnel and effective equipment. Plague, particularly pneumonic plague, is severe and requires rapid diagnosis and care because it can spread between people via respiratory droplets. The statement emphasizes Thailand's ability to support surveillance, prevention, and control of plague and to provide timely diagnostics for suspected cases within the country.

triage.headline_ja: 医学科学部がペスト対応の準備完了を再確認。BSL-3ラボを開設し、24時間以内に検査結果を取得
triage.triage_reason: タイにおけるペスト（特に肺ペスト）への検査態勢強化に関する報道。重症度とヒト-ヒト感染リスクは高いが、実際の症例発生報告ではなく、海外の報告に対する検査準備体制の整備に関する発表であり、現段階では情報が限定的。
triage.notes: 本記事はタイ国内での実症例の発生報告ではなく、政府の診断・検査能力強化の発表である。『海外の研究所からの肺ペスト報告』への対応体制構築に関する内容。実際の確定症例や患者発生情報が記載されていないため、継続的な情報収集が必要。タイは検査体制が整備されており、現段階での管理可能性は高いと判定される。

article.articleHeadline: DOH monitoring Russia plague, Malacañang says
article.articleSummary: Russia reports plague outbreak; Philippines DOH closely monitoring per WHO guidance as of Oct. 7, 2026. In Siberia, a researcher died on Oct. 2 from pneumonia of unknown etiology; Russian health officials placed about 200 close contacts under medical observation. The WHO stated none of those monitored have contracted the plague. The Philippine Palace said DOH is following WHO recommendations and will take further actions as needed; President Marcos Jr. is in Singapore for a working visit. There is no indication of imported/exported cases or laboratory-confirmed human cases in the Philippines. The situation remains under surveillance; officials emphasize that current monitored contacts have not developed plague symptoms, and public reassurance is being provided.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアのペスト感染をDOHが監視中、マラカニアン宮殿が発表
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・シベリアで研究者がペスト疑いの肺炎で死亡し、約200名の接触者が監視下にあるなど、WHOも関与する国際的な公衆衛生事案であり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価への移行が適当。
triage.notes: 実際の発生国はロシア（対象国リスト外）。フィリピンはWHO勧告に基づき監視を行っているのみで、国内での確定症例や輸入症例の報告はない。シンガポールは大統領の訪問先として言及されているのみで、感染症事案とは無関係。

article.articleHeadline: 美發外交照會要俄說明鼠疫疑雲 川普、普廷將通話
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. issues a diplomatic note demanding Russia explain the suspected plague; Trump and Putin to hold talks.
article.articleSummary: US issues a diplomatic note to Russia demanding clarification on a suspected plague linked to an unexplained pneumonia death at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute in Siberia. Washington says Russia has provided only limited information and failed to disclose details, violating international health reporting obligations, while the State Department notes ongoing official information sharing with other nations. President Trump plans a forthcoming telephone discussion with President Putin; Secretary of State Rubio says the information from Russia remains limited and calls for greater transparency. The episode intersects with concerns over Russia’s biological programs under the Biological Weapons Convention, amid historical concealment of outbreaks such as the 1979 Sverdlovsk (now Yekaterinburg) anthrax incident. The Irkutsk institute has previously conducted a bilateral outbreak-response drill with China; Kremlin spokesman Peskov says Rospotrebnadzor has supplied all necessary information.

triage.headline_ja: 米、ロシアに外交照会を発し『疑わしいペスト』の説明を要求、トランプ氏とプーチン氏が電話会談へ
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの抗ペスト研究所での原因不明肺炎死をめぐり米露間で外交問題化しており、国際的関心・政治的関心が極めて高く、情報開示の不透明性や生物兵器条約関連の懸念もあるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア（イルクーツク、スヴェルドロフスク/エカテリンブルグ）での事案であり、対象国リストに該当する発生国は確認されない。中国は過去の共同訓練の文脈で言及されているのみで、実際の発生地ではないため除外。詳細な症例情報・感染経路等は不明であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria, Swine Flu Cases Rise in Mumbai During Monsoon; Dengue and Gastro Cases Decline
article.articleSummary: During Mumbai’s June–September 2026 monsoon, malaria rose to 7,422 cases (up from 5,144 last year) and swine flu to 504 (from 71), while dengue declined to 2,941 (from 3,356) and gastroenteritis to 2,194 (from 2,639). Leptospirosis fell to 286 (from 549); chikungunya to 66 (from 509); COVID-19 to 165 (from 678). The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) undertook mosquito-control drives, cleanliness campaigns, and public-awareness initiatives to curb monsoon-related illnesses. For Ganesh festival, medical camps recorded 84,208 attendees and 5,130 blood samples for malaria testing, with treatment provided as needed. Health-awareness materials were distributed through Ganesh mandals, aided by jingles on malaria and dengue prevention. The report notes no details on imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイでモンスーン期にマラリアと豚インフルエンザの症例が増加、デング熱と胃腸炎は減少
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の疾病動向報告であり、BMCによる対策も実施済みで公衆衛生上の深刻な異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 毎年のモンスーン期における定例的な感染症動向報告であり、地方自治体（BMC）による既存の対策（防蚊活動、啓発活動、医療キャンプ）が機能している。マラリア・豚インフルエンザは増加したが、デング熱・レプトスピラ症・チクングニア熱・COVID-19は減少しており全体として深刻な公衆衛生危機とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Trump pide a los estadounidenses que abandonen Rusia ante la alerta por un posible brote de peste
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trump urges Americans to leave Russia amid alert for a possible outbreak of plague.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 October 2026, the United States warns Americans to leave Russia amid a possible pneumonic plague outbreak in Irkutsk in Siberia. A 28-year-old investigator at the Institute of Plague Research of Irkutsk and the Far East died in Shélejov; Russian officials say the death was due to pneumonia of unknown origin and deny any plague cases or hospital quarantines. Two exposure routes discussed: travel to Thailand or a laboratory incident involving a pathogen tube; authorities have denied the lab accident hypothesis. The Kremlin urges calm; Rospotrebnadzor reports no emergency and says no high-risk pathogens among identified contacts. The WHO seeks more data to confirm the cause and epidemiological links, while the EU’s ECDC monitors. The CDC and U.S. embassy note limited ability to assist, as Trump plans a call to Putin.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ氏、ペスト発生の可能性による警戒を受け、米国民にロシアからの退避を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: シベリア・イルクーツクでの肺ペスト疑い死亡例を受け、米国がロシア退避勧告を発出するなど国際的な政治・社会的関心が急激に高まっており、IHR基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: イベントの主要発生地はロシア（イルクーツク）であり、対象国リストに含まれない。タイへの渡航歴は感染経路の仮説の一つとして言及されているのみで、タイ国内での発生を示すものではないため verified_locations には含めない。ロシア当局は感染拡大や緊急事態を否定しており、WHO・ECDCが情報確認中。続報次第でリスク評価の更新が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉突破国境 肯雅爆首例死亡 | 中國報 China Press
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola crosses borders; Kenya reports its first death
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first Ebola death, with Bundibugyo ebolavirus confirmed in a Kenyan man who died on Oct 5 after presenting with fever, chills, severe fatigue, sore throat, myalgia and subcutaneous bleeding. Samples were tested by the Kenya National Virus Reference Laboratory and the Kenya Medical Research Institute, confirming infection. The patient had traveled via Uganda after Congo’s outbreak, not directly from the DRC, raising questions about border screening efficacy; Kenya had strengthened entry checks at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport Gate 16 since May, screening 65,258 travellers and testing 267 specimens, with only this case positive. At least 28 contacts have been identified, including family, healthcare workers, and 23 passengers plus 4 crew from the same Jambojet flight; investigations span airports, land borders, and care facilities. Meanwhile, the Congo epidemic—driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus—has 8,544 cases and 4,114 deaths, with North Kivu as a hotspot; vaccines are in development, one entering human trials in July. MSF warns undercounting is possible; border surveillance and rapid tracing are emphasized for outbreak containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが国境を越える：ケニアで初の死亡例を報告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ(DRC)由来のエボラ(ブンディブギョ型)がウガンダ経由でケニアに越境し死亡例と多数の接触者（航空機乗客含む）が確認されており、IHR4基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダは本イベントの発生国として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは流行の震源地として記事内で明確に言及されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: UK issues travel advisory after Kenya confirms first case
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first imported Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease case: a Kenyan citizen who had lived in the DRC. The patient travelled DRC → Kampala, Uganda → Nairobi on Oct 3; at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport he was hospitalized, isolated and laboratory-confirmed positive by the National Virology Reference Laboratory and the Kenya Medical Research Institute. The patient died; burial under Ebola protocols planned. Kenya says there is no outbreak, only an imported case. Health authorities have identified 28 direct contacts and traced 23 passengers plus four crew on the Entebbe–Nairobi flight; quarantine arrangements are under way. Kenya has screened over 652,000 travellers and tested 267 samples; 4,971 healthcare workers trained in Ebola prevention and case management. The UK updated travel guidance on Oct 7, urging adherence to local health authorities; enhanced screening may occur for travellers from Uganda, Ethiopia and the DRC; no blanket travel ban. WHO notified under IHR; Kenya is the fourth country linked to the regional Bundibugyo Ebola situation; DRC and Uganda previously reported cases. Security-related restrictions on Mandera, Wajir, Garissa and Lamu remain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ケニアで初症例確認を受け英国が渡航勧告を発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべてに該当する可能性が高く、複数国にまたがるブンディブギョ型エボラウイルス病の地域流行拡大と、英国による渡航勧告という国際的対応が確認されたため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアで確認された輸入エボラ症例（渡航歴はDRC→ウガンダ→ケニア）だが、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは地域流行の発生源国として既に症例報告があり対象国リストに該当するため含めた。ケニア国内では現時点でアウトブレイクではなく単一輸入症例とされている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Qu'est-ce que la peste pulmonaire étudiée dans le laboratoire de Sibérie et comment se propage-t-elle ?n el que falleció una trabajadora
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is the pneumonic plague studied in the Siberian laboratory, and how does it spread? In which a worker died.
article.articleSummary: WHO has requested additional information from Russia after the death of a Siberian laboratory worker studying plague. The exact cause is unknown, but authorities say those exposed to the technician tested negative for pneumonic plague. Pneumonic plague is the most severe form of Yersinia pestis infection; bubonic and septicemic forms exist, with pneumonic potentially developing from the other types. Symptoms include respiratory distress, chest pain, and a cough often blood-tinged. Global annual cases are about 1,000–3,000, with bubonic predominance; reservoirs include rodents across Africa, Eurasia and the Americas, including Russia, India, China and the United States. Transmission can occur via infected fleas or handling infected animals, and human-to-human spread via coughing droplets in close contact. Incubation can be as short as 24 hours; early antibiotic treatment is highly effective. In Russia, it remains unclear if the deceased had pneumonic plague; tests found no microorganism linked to the patient’s work.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアの研究所で研究されていた肺ペストとは何か、どのように感染するのか？ある職員が死亡した事例について
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・シベリアの研究所における単一の死亡事例であり、肺ペスト感染は確定診断されておらず、濃厚接触者の検査も陰性。対象国（アジア・アフリカ・中南米諸国）での発生ではなく、国際的拡大の兆候もない。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの研究所職員の死亡に関するもので、中国・タイ・インド・米国等は単にペストの自然宿主が存在する地域として一般的に言及されているに過ぎず、実際の発生国ではない。対象国リストに該当する実発生事例は確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: 衞生防護中心錄得1宗兒童感染流感的嚴重個案 - 香港商報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Centre for Health Protection records one severe pediatric influenza case
article.articleSummary: One severe pediatric influenza case was reported in Hong Kong on Oct 7, 2026. An 11-year-old girl with a chronic condition developed cough on Sept 29, fever on Sept 30, and dyspnea with vomiting on Oct 3, leading to admission at Queen Mary Hospital. Tests confirmed influenza A(H1) with severe pneumonia; she remains in the pediatric intensive care unit in a critical condition. No travel during incubation. A household contact recently had a mild upper respiratory infection and has recovered. Since late June, Hong Kong’s flu season has been active, with A(H1) predominant. In the season, 23 severe pediatric influenza cases have been recorded: 16 recovered, 4 stable, 1 severe, 1 critical, and 1 death. About 370 school outbreaks have affected around 2,200 people. Vaccination began Sept 17, with 140+ schools conducting outreach; completion is expected by mid-December. Parents are urged to vaccinate and monitor children; maintain hygiene and ventilation.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生防護センター、小児インフルエンザの重症例1件を記録
triage.triage_reason: 香港における季節性インフルエンザA(H1)の重症小児例報告であり、IHR基準には該当しないが、重症度・学校アウトブレイクの持続性などWPRO基準の一部に該当するため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本件は香港の季節性インフルエンザサーベイランスの定例報告であり、A(H1)が season優勢株。重症小児例は23例中1例が危篤、1例死亡と記録されているが、これは地域内の既知の季節性流行パターンであり、新規性・国際拡大リスクは低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: 俄鼠疫研究員猝死罩疑雲 中方僅簡短表態
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sudden death of Russian plague researcher shrouded in suspicion; China only issues a brief statement.
article.articleSummary: Two deaths at Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute in Siberia raise alarms about pneumonic plague in Russia. A 28-year-old employee, Daria Shipilova, died Oct 2 from an illness described as unknown pneumonia; a second lab worker died Oct 6 with a similar clinical picture. As of Oct 7, 2026, officials say no plague cases confirmed yet, but concerns persist over a possible laboratory exposure. The incident follows a cross-border infectious-disease drill Aug 24–27 in Fuyuan, Heilongjiang, China, attended by the institute's director, Sergei Balakhonov. The WHO has asked Russia for data; the United States urged transparency. Neighbouring countries Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, and Mongolia tightened screening to prevent spread, while China has not disclosed concrete protective measures. Speculation links this to lab leaks and bioweapons research, underscores calls for transparency.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアのペスト研究員が急死、疑惑に包まれる中、中国側は簡単な声明のみ
triage.triage_reason: ロシアのペスト研究所職員2名が原因不明の肺炎で死亡し、肺ペストの可能性が疑われている。WHOがデータ提供を要請し、近隣複数国が検疫を強化するなど国際的な懸念が急速に高まっている。
triage.notes: 事案発生地はロシア・イルクーツクであり、対象国リストに含まれない。黒竜江省（中国）は8月の国境を越えた訓練参加の文脈で言及されているのみで、中国国内での感染事例発生の記述はないため verified_locations には含めない。続報でロシアの確定診断や中国での感染拡大が報告されれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkot Jaktim perluas pelacakan TBC lewat CKG hingga 778 lokasi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East Jakarta City Government expands TB tracing through CKG to 778 locations.
article.articleSummary: East Jakarta’s government expands tuberculosis (TB) tracing through free health checks (CKG) to 778 locations in 2026. By October 7, 2026, TB tracing had been conducted at 437 loci, screening 38,328 participants, including at RW 02, Cililitan. The program targets close contacts of TB patients, household contacts, and other high-risk groups, and is integrated with CKG to broaden community screening in Jakarta Timur. In the Kramat Jati area, about 100 people are slated for screening in the current tranche, with more than 60 already present. If TB is suspected, health workers will perform sputum tests and additional diagnostics. For contacts without symptoms, TB preventive therapy (TPT) is offered to prevent progression to active disease, with emphasis on adherence. Residents are encouraged to participate in screening and use TB/CKG services to enable early case finding and reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 東ジャカルタ市、無料健診（CKG）を通じて結核追跡を778カ所に拡大
triage.triage_reason: 通常の公衆衛生活動（既存の結核対策プログラム拡大）であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による既存の結核スクリーニング・予防プログラムの拡大に関する定期報道であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Índice de dengue em Divinópolis segue estável; Alto das Oliveiras é o bairro com maior risco - Portal MPA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue incidence in Divinópolis remains stable; Alto das Oliveiras is the neighborhood with the highest risk - Portal MPA.
article.articleSummary: Divinópolis, Brazil — The 3rd LIRAa 2026 (September) reports a Building Infestation Index (IIP) of 2.5%, unchanged from May, leaving the city at medium dengue epidemic risk and under alert. Of 5,941 properties surveyed in 169 neighborhoods, 152 had Aedes aegypti breeding sites; the prior survey covered 5,470 with 138 sites. Residential properties account for 89% of foci, vacant lots 11% (vs 93%/7% previously), underscoring resident participation as critical. Nordeste region rose to high risk at 4.8%; others: Norte 3.4%, Sudeste 2.2%, Central 2.1%, Sudoeste 1.6%, Oeste 1.3%. The top foci neighborhoods: Alto das Oliveiras (50%), JA Gonçalves (33.3%), Dr. José Thomaz (18.2%), Mar e Terra (14.3%), Itacolomi (13.6%), Jardim Alterosa (13.3%), Danilo Passos I (10.3%). Breeding sites mainly in movable containers (43.8%) and removable containers (39.8%); weekly home inspections and source removal recommended.

triage.headline_ja: ディヴィノーポリスのデング熱指数は安定、アルト・ダス・オリヴェイラス地区がリスク最高
triage.triage_reason: 蚊の繁殖指数（IIP）に関する定例調査報告であり、指数は横ばいで「安定」と明記され、異常な流行拡大や重症例の報告もないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による蚊媒介指数(LIRAa)の定例モニタリング報告。症例数や重症度に関する情報は含まれておらず、デング熱の流行状況自体の評価は困難。

article.articleHeadline: 登革熱防疫無假期 首要避免蚊咬 | 中華日報|中華新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever Prevention Has No Holidays; The Top Priority Is Avoiding Mosquito Bites.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever remains a top public health priority during Taiwan’s Oct 9–11 National Holiday. Nationwide, as of Oct 6, 2026 there are 182 confirmed dengue cases: 12 locally acquired and 170 imported, with most infections tied to Vietnam, Indonesia and the Philippines. Travelers to dengue-affected regions should wear light-colored long-sleeve clothing and use government-approved mosquito repellents. In Tainan City, the Dengue Prevention Center reports 1,583 cumulative dengue case reports as of Oct 2, with hotspots at homes (49.09%), construction sites (14.47%), vacant lots (12.15%), businesses (6.04%), and temples (5.16%). Positive breeding sources are mainly containers such as barrels, jars, urns, and pots (53.4%). Symptoms include fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgia/arthralgia, rash, nausea, and vomiting; individuals with suspected dengue should seek prompt medical care and disclose travel/activity history. Violations of vector-control regulations are fined NT$3,000–NT$15,000 under the Infectious Disease Control Act.

triage.headline_ja: 登革熱防疫無假期　首要避免蚊咬
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における登革熱の定例的な防疫広報記事であり、新規性や異常性、重大な公衆衛生上の脅威は認められない。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれない。ベトナム・インドネシア・フィリピンは輸入症例の感染経路として言及されているのみで、記事の主題はそれらの国での発生ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Gripe aviária coloca 68 propriedades sob monitoramento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian Influenza Puts 68 Properties Under Monitoring.
article.articleSummary: Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) has been confirmed in backyard poultry in Selbach, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, triggering monitoring of 68 properties within a 3-km radius. Diagnostics from the Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense (LFDA-SP) were confirmed on October 5, after samples collected October 1 were sent to the OIE reference laboratory. Authorities will visit all 68 properties and conduct sanitary education to rapidly detect new cases and curb spread. This follows a July backyard outbreak in Coqueiros do Sul, in the state’s northwest. Backyard flocks, not commercial farms, are implicated; Brazil and OIE criteria keep commercial poultry status as free of HPAI. Guidance urges not to touch or aid sick or dead birds, report respiratory or neurological signs, and notify authorities or use the e-Sisbravet system. Meat and eggs remain safe when properly cooked; no human infections linked to food.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザにより68農場が監視対象に
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの裏庭養鶏でHPAIが確認され監視体制が敷かれているが、商業養鶏場は清浄維持、人への感染報告もなく、現時点でフルRRAに進む緊急性は低い。動物衛生事案として続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 本事案は家禽（動物）における事例であり、人への感染は報告されていない。商業養鶏場はHPAIフリーの地位を維持。7月にも同州で裏庭養鶏の発生歴あり、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Kenya: 5 hospitals designated to treat patients as govt expands isolation capacity
article.articleSummary: Kenya designates 241 Ebola beds across five facilities to handle Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) after confirming its first imported Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease case in a Kenyan national who had lived in the DRC, with officials stressing there is no outbreak. The five hospitals—Kenyatta National Hospital, Moi Teaching and Referral Hospital, National Police Hospital, Port Reitz Hospital, and The Nairobi Hospital—collectively allocate 241 beds for Ebola patients, Nairobi Hospital alone 130 beds, Moi 50, National Police 49, KNH 8, Port Reitz 4. The government plans to expand capacity to 22 isolation and treatment units from 15. The patient traveled by road to Kampala before flying to Nairobi on Oct 3, was isolated on arrival, and was confirmed positive by the National Virology Reference Laboratory and KEMRI; he subsequently died. Kenya has intensified border surveillance at JKIA and land borders; 652,000 travellers screened, 267 samples tested. 57 contacts identified, 10 traced and quarantined. Early detection, isolation, and contact tracing remain central. Public urged to stay vigilant; toll-free 719.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱確認、政府が隔離能力拡大のため5病院を指定
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで輸入エボラ出血熱症例が確認され患者が死亡、国境を越えた移動歴があり国際的拡大リスクがあるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCに居住歴を持ちウガンダ経由でケニアに入国後発症・死亡。実際の発生・対応国はケニアだが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。DRCは感染源国として言及されているのみで、同国内での流行描写はないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: واشنطن والصحة العالمية تطالبان موسكو بتفاصيل إضافية وشفافة بشأن مرض الطاعون
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Washington and the World Health Organization call on Moscow for more detailed and transparent information about the plague.
article.articleSummary: On 7 October 2026, the United States formally asked Russia for additional information about the death of a 28-year-old researcher at Irkutsk’s plague institute in Siberia, amid reports of possible pneumonic plague following a laboratory incident involving a broken test tube. About 200 potentially exposed individuals are under quarantine or medical surveillance. Russian authorities say the cause of death is not yet confirmed and deny online claims of special plague-control measures. The World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said Russia informed WHO that no plague cases have been recorded in the Irkutsk region; an outbreak investigation and preventive measures are in place, with contacts monitored and tested. WHO requests more details to clarify acute pneumonia etiology and reports of a second pneumonia case. China and Mongolia are monitoring; cross-border cooperation continues. Plague can be bubonic or pneumonic, the latter being highly transmissible.

triage.headline_ja: 米国とWHO、モスクワに対しペストに関するより詳細で透明性のある情報提供を要求
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクのペスト研究所で研究者が死亡し肺ペストの可能性が指摘される異常事態であり、約200人が検疫・監視下に置かれ、WHOが追加情報を要求するなど国際的関心が高いため、フルリスク評価に進むべき案件と判断。
triage.notes: 事象発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストに該当する国ではない。中国・モンゴルは国境を越えた監視・協力を行っているのみで、発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Krebs: Diese 5 Erreger lösen die meisten Infektions-Tumore aus - so schützen Sie sich
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cancer: These 5 Pathogens Cause Most Infection-Related Cancers — How to Protect Yourself.
article.articleSummary: In 2024, infections were linked to about 2.3 million cancers worldwide, roughly 12% of total new cancer cases, according to an IARC study in The Lancet Oncology. Five pathogens account for most infection-related cancers: viruses (including human papillomavirus, HIV, and hepatitis B virus among the nine proven oncogenic viruses), one bacterium (Helicobacter pylori), and three parasites (Opisthorchis viverrini, Clonorchis sinensis, Schistosoma haematobium). Regional patterns vary: low- and middle-income countries bear about 77% of these cancers; East Asia has high burden due to H. pylori and HBV, while sub-Saharan Africa shows substantial HPV-related cancers. In Western Europe, roughly 5% of new cancers are infection-related. Germany recorded 29,000 such cancers in 2024, led by H. pylori (9,700) and HPV (11,000). HPV is the primary cause of most cervical cancers and major anogenital cancers. Plasmodium falciparum malaria is considered likely linked to Burkitt lymphoma. IARC calls for stronger protection measures, including vaccination (notably HPV).

triage.headline_ja: がん：感染起因性腫瘍の大半を引き起こす5つの病原体―その予防法
triage.triage_reason: IARCによる感染症とがんリスクに関する疫学的レビュー記事であり、急性の公衆衛生上の緊急事態や新規アウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は感染症に起因するがんの疫学的統計・啓発情報であり、特定国でのアウトブレイクイベントではない。地理的情報（中国・ドイツ）は統計例示に過ぎず、対象国リストにおいても特定アウトブレイクとしての該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya's First Ebola Burial at Lang'ata Raises Questions Over WHO Protocol Adherence
article.articleSummary: Kenya conducted its first confirmed Ebola burial at Lang'ata Cemetery after a 40-year-old patient, who had arrived from the Democratic Republic of the Congo via Uganda, died on 6 October 2026. The burial occurred with health precautions, but observers flagged deviations from WHO safe‑and‑dignified burial guidelines. PPE compliance appeared uneven: one official wore a full hazmat suit while another wore only shirt, trousers, gumboots and a face mask; WHO requires full PPE with coveralls, impermeable apron and double gloves. Only two officials were present after the body was lowered, and one wore thinner gloves. WHO also requires family consent and full disclosure to relatives, which reports suggest was not provided; however, the body was disinfected before wrapping and transported as per guidelines, and the hazmat worker disposed of PPE on site and decontaminated the vehicle. Debates over protocol adherence follow Kenya's inaugural Ebola burial.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア初のエボラ埋葬、ラングアタで実施――WHOプロトコル順守に疑問の声
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国由来の患者がケニアで死亡し、国境を越えた感染拡大の懸念とWHO安全埋葬プロトコルからの逸脱が確認されており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCから発病・感染し、ウガンダ経由でケニアに入国後死亡。ケニアとウガンダは対象国リスト外のため除外。DRCは患者の感染源国として記載されているため含めた。埋葬時のPPE不備や家族への説明不足など、WHOプロトコル逸脱が複数報告されている点が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: Brasil intensifica ações face a avanço nos EUA e nas Américas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: Brazil Intensifies Actions in Response to the Spread in the U.S. and the Americas.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks in the Americas prompt Brazil to strengthen response. In the United States, the country reports the highest annual measles caseload in more than 35 years, with over 90% of cases occurring in people who are unvaccinated or have unknown vaccination status. Across the Americas, PAHO data show that the United States, Guatemala, Mexico, Peru, and Canada account for more than 95% of confirmed measles cases in 2026. Brazil reported 52 imported measles cases as of October 5, 2026: 41 in São Paulo, 10 in Amazonas, and 1 in Rio de Janeiro. To curb transmission, health teams conduct active case-finding, epidemiologic investigations, contact tracing, and vaccination blockade; vaccination campaigns are intensified in public spaces and high-traffic areas. Brazil's 2019 outbreak exceeded 20,000 cases and led to loss of measles elimination certification after more than 12 months of transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹：ブラジル、米国およびアメリカ大陸での感染拡大を受け対策を強化

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai malaria cases rise 144%, H1N1 cases jump 709% this monsoon, BMC data shows
article.articleSummary: Malaria in Mumbai rose 144% this monsoon (June–September) to 7,422 cases from 5,144 last year, while H1N1 (swine flu) jumped 709% to 504 cases from 71. Dengue declined marginally to 2,941 compared with 3,356 last monsoon; Covid-19 cases stood at 165 this monsoon. The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) conducted wide surveillance across 52.51 lakh residents in 11.22 lakh households, collecting 63,837 blood samples and running 342 camps. Mosquito breeding spot inspections reached 6,310 identified after examining 10.44 lakh spots; fogging covered 45,266 buildings and 6.98 lakh slum households; 5,903 rats were killed. Officials warn water stagnation in household AC ducts and construction sites sustains mosquito breeding; dengue may persist as monsoon ends. October heat could raise gastroenteritis risk from food- and waterborne infections.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイのマラリア症例が144%増加、H1N1症例はこの雨季に709%急増とBMCデータが示す
triage.triage_reason: 季節性感染症（マラリア・H1N1）の症例数が前年比で大幅増加しているが、重症度や死亡者数の情報がなく、国際的拡大の兆候もないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ムンバイ市当局(BMC)による定期的な監視データに基づく報道で、H1N1症例の709%増加という数値は顕著だが、重症度（入院率・死亡率）に関する情報が記事中に明記されていない。デング熱はむしろ減少傾向。地域限定的な季節性変動である可能性が高く、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には至らないと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Kenia fortalece su capacidad hospitalaria tras el caso de ébola importado de RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya strengthens its hospital capacity after the imported Ebola case from the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Kenya strengthens its hospital capacity after an imported Ebola case from the DRC was detected in Nairobi. Health Minister Aden Duale said there is no outbreak, only an imported incident, after a 40-year-old Kenyan died in a hospital where an isolation unit—built during COVID-19 and repurposed for Ebola—serves as a quarantine area. The 57 contacts include relatives, healthcare workers, and a flight crew who carried the patient from Kampala, Uganda, to Nairobi; about 30 people are under quarantine with ongoing tracing. Five hospitals (four in Nairobi, one in Mombasa) are designated to manage potential cases; five more near the Uganda border will be used for temporary isolation of suspected cases. Border and airport screening at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport targets travelers from DRC, Uganda, Tanzania. The DRC’s outbreak has caused 8,865 cases and 4,178 deaths; Uganda’s outbreak was declared over in August with 20 cases, 15 imported from DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、DRCからの輸入エボラ症例を受け病院対応能力を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCの大規模エボラ流行（8,865症例・4,178死亡）由来の輸入症例がケニアで死亡例を出し、ウガンダ経由での国際的拡大、接触者追跡・隔離・空港検疫など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアでの輸入症例への対応だが、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは流行源として具体的な症例・死亡者数が言及されており対象国として含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo exige alerta no Brasil diante do aumento de casos nas Américas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles prompts alert in Brazil amid rising cases in the Americas.
article.articleSummary: Measles imported cases rise in Brazil, with 52 cases reported by early October 2026: 41 in São Paulo, 10 in Amazonas, and 1 in Rio de Janeiro. Brazil remains free of endemic measles transmission, but Health Ministry has intensified surveillance, case finding, epidemiological investigations, and vaccination in high-risk areas to prevent sustained transmission. The surge follows broader Americas activity, led by the United States, Guatemala, Mexico, Peru, and Canada; the United States has the year's highest caseload in over three decades, with most patients unvaccinated. Brazil lost elimination status in 2019 after more than 20,000 cases, but was revalidated in November 2024. From 2023–2025, 85 confirmed cases and no deaths were reported. Vaccination coverage improved: MMR dose reached 93.10% nationally in 2025, 94.39% in São Paulo. Four campaigns in 2026, including a 6–11 month dose zero, with SUS providing free vaccines; border surveillance strengthened at the Brazil-Colombia-Peru frontier.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹、米州での症例増加を受けブラジルで警戒呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでの麻疹輸入症例が増加し、米州全体での流行拡大を背景に政府が監視・ワクチン接種を強化しており、地域拡大リスクと行政的関心の高さからフルリスク評価が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルにおける輸入麻疹症例の増加と対応強化を主題としており、米国・グアテマラ・メキシコ・ペルー・カナダは地域的背景として言及されているのみで、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。死亡例はなく、ワクチン接種率も高水準（全国93.1%）であるため重症度は限定的と評価。

article.articleHeadline: آنچه درباره "طاعون ریوی" می‌دانیم
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What we know about pneumonic plague.
article.articleSummary: Following the suspected death of a plague research laboratory worker in Siberia, the World Health Organization has urged Russia to provide more information about the case amid media speculation. It remains unclear what caused the illness; authorities say tests on contacts have been negative for pneumonic plague. Pneumonic plague is a severe lung infection and the deadliest plague form; it can follow bubonic or septicemic plague and presents with shortness of breath, chest pain, and coughing up blood. Global plague incidence is about 1,000–3,000 per year, mostly bubonic in Africa, with sporadic cases in Russia, India, China, and the United States. The bacterium Yersinia pestis persists in rodent populations; transmission occurs via infected fleas or contact with animals, and human-to-human spread can occur via respiratory droplets in close contact. Early diagnosis and antibiotics are critical; delays raise mortality. In Russia, officials report no microbes detected in those exposed.

triage.headline_ja: 肺ペストについて私たちが知っていること
triage.triage_reason: シベリアの研究所職員の疑わしい死亡例についてWHOがロシアに追加情報を求めているが、接触者検査は陰性であり、確定情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア・シベリアでの研究所職員の疑わしい肺ペスト死亡例に関する一般的解説記事であり、対象国（インド・中国等）は過去の散発例として言及されているのみで、本件の発生国はロシア（対象国リスト外）であるためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: 或受產志賀毒素大腸桿菌污染　食安令回收一批法國進口芝士
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: May be contaminated with Shiga toxin-producing Escherichia coli (STEC); a food-safety order recalls a batch of French-imported cheese.
article.articleSummary: Shiga toxin-producing Escherichia coli (STEC) contamination risk leads to a recall of a French-imported cheese in Hong Kong. The Centre for Food Safety (CFS) of the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department warns the public not to eat Camembert Bertrand Crémier 250g, imported from France by Repertoire Culinaire Hong Kong Limited. The batch is 232511, with best before date October 17, 2026. The alert was triggered after a European Union rapid alert notification (RASFF) indicated possible STEC contamination. The importer has halted the sale and shelf display of the affected batch and initiated a recall, per the CFS instruction. Preliminary investigations show the importer had previously imported the affected batch. The recall is ongoing according to the center’s guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 志賀毒素産生性大腸菌（STEC）汚染の恐れ、食品安全センターがフランス産チーズを回収
triage.triage_reason: EU RASFFの警告を受けた予防的な製品回収措置であり、現時点で実際の感染者報告はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: フランス産チーズの回収事例であり、記事の主題は香港（中国）での予防的な食品回収措置。感染者発生の報告はなく、フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Новий "Ухань"?: США закликали РФ розкрити правду про витік чуми в Іркутську
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New "Wuhan"?: The United States called on Russia to reveal the truth about the plague outbreak in Irkutsk.
article.articleSummary: Plague outbreak detected in Irkutsk Oblast, Russia, after a deadly laboratory leak, prompting the United States to urge Russia to disclose more information to the world. U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio told reporters at a press conference that several agencies—both in the United States and internationally—are monitoring the situation and that transparency is essential for a proper global response. He compared the incident to the early Wuhan outbreak and said Russia should share more data so countries can respond appropriately. The report notes concerns about a lab-origin infection but provides no confirmed case counts or lab details. The coverage attributes the statements to Rubio and references Ukrainian outlets TSN and Contracts.UA.

triage.headline_ja: 新たな「武漢」か？：米国、イルクーツクでのペスト流行に関する真実開示をロシアに要求
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクでの研究所由来とされるペスト流行が報じられているが、確定症例数や詳細情報は不明であり、対象国（中国等）は比較対象として言及されているに過ぎず実際の発生地ではないため、続報を注視する段階と判断する。
triage.notes: 本イベントはロシア（イルクーツク州）での研究所起源とされるペスト流行に関する報道であり、中国（武漢）は過去の事例との比較として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地ではない。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。確定症例数・検査詳細等の一次情報が不足しており、今後の公式発表を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: RS confirma novo caso de gripe aviária em aves de criação doméstica em Selbach
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RS confirms a new case of avian influenza in domestic poultry in Selbach.
article.articleSummary: Rio Grande do Sul confirms a new case of Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) in backyard poultry in Selbach, Alto Jacuí region. Confirmation followed analysis by the Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense (LFDA-SP) and was released on Monday, Oct 5. The Secretariat of Agriculture, Livestock, Sustainable Production and Irrigation (Seapi) has activated containment, with the Official Veterinary Service surveying 68 neighboring properties within a 3-km radius and advising the public to avoid contact with sick or dead animals and to report suspected cases immediately. Samples were sent to the World Organisation for Animal Health (OMSA) reference laboratory for confirmation. Seapi states there is no risk to consuming meat or eggs from affected birds. Notifications can be made to the Inspetoria de Defesa Agropecuária or via WhatsApp at (51) 98445-2033.
