article.articleHeadline: Quênia confirma primeiro caso de ebola; homem morreu após tratamento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya confirms first Ebola case; man died after treatment.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first Ebola case after a man who traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo died following treatment. Based on clinical presentation and DRC travel history, clinicians suspected viral hemorrhagic fever; samples tested positive for Ebola at the National Reference Laboratory for Virology and at the Kenya Medical Research Institute laboratory. The patient received supportive care but died last night. About 28 contacts, including family and health workers, have been identified; authorities are locating 23 passengers and four crew members from the same flight. Safe and dignified burial arrangements are planned for today. The WHO has been notified under the International Health Regulations. Since May, the DRC outbreak began, Kenya has screened 652,584 travelers and tested 267 samples across five Ebola labs, with this being the only positive result.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアが初のエボラ症例を確認。治療後に男性が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準に複数該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際拡大リスク）し、WHOにも通知されていることから、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの初症例確認だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であり継続中のアウトブレイクが発生しているDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。国際便乗客・乗員の追跡、652,584人のスクリーニング実施など、国際的拡大の懸念が強い事案。

article.articleHeadline: Главные новости дня | вторник: Эбола, чума, Пакистан, Черное море
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Top News of the Day | Tuesday: Ebola, Plague, Pakistan, the Black Sea
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first Ebola case caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The patient, a Kenyan citizen who had resided in the Democratic Republic of Congo, sought care in DR Congo facilities before flying to Nairobi, where he was isolated; he died the night of 5 October. In Irkutsk region, Russia, a medical laboratory worker died on 2 October from severe pneumonia; WHO assesses the potential for plague as unconfirmed and risk as low for Irkutsk, low for Russia overall, and very low for Europe. The UN Secretary-General visited Pakistan, stressing Pakistan’s diplomatic role and the importance of the Islamabad Memorandum (June 17) leading to a temporary ceasefire, urging an end to the conflict through diplomacy. UNDP Administrator Alexander De Croo warned about attacks on grain-carrying ships in the Black Sea, noting they jeopardize global food supplies and contravene international law, with consequences beyond the region. Published 7 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 今日の主要ニュース | 火曜日：エボラ、ペスト、パキスタン、黒海

article.articleHeadline: Peste pneumónica. O que é, os riscos e como se transmite esta infeção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumonic plague. What it is, the risks and how this infection is transmitted.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague under investigation after death of researcher Darya Shipilova at a Russian laboratory; in Siberia, people placed in quarantine; circumstances of death unknown. WHO considers Europe’s outbreak risk 'very low'. Infectious disease expert Piero Olliaro describes pneumonic plague as a severe pulmonary infection causing shortness of breath, chest pain and coughing up blood. The bacterium Yersinia pestis persists in animal reservoirs across the globe, with about 200 rodent species; reservoirs found in the Americas, Eurasia and Africa. Human infection occurs via infected flea bites or contact with an infected animal; in the pneumonic form, human-to-human transmission is possible through respiratory droplets, though requires close contact. Surveillance, infection-control measures, and effective antibiotics limit impact. Antibiotics can treat pneumonic plague, especially if started early; high-risk exposure may warrant post-exposure prophylaxis or quarantine. Some experts note historical links to Black Death; ongoing lab work aims to improve diagnostics, vaccines, and new antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: 肺ペスト。それは何か、リスクは何か、どのように感染するのか
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はロシアの研究所で発生した研究者の死亡事例を契機とした肺ペストに関する一般的な解説記事であり、対象国（タイ等）での発生を裏付ける記述がないため対象外とする。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア・シベリアでの研究者死亡例を契機とした肺ペストの一般解説で、タイを含む対象国での発生は言及されていない。発生地域リストのThailand/Spain/Africaはサマリー上の主題と一致せず除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue-vírust azonosítottak egy Veszprém megyei férfinél
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue virus identified in a man from Veszprém County.
article.articleSummary: Dengue virus identified in a man from Veszprém County, Hungary. The patient, who had stayed in India during the incubation period, represents an imported dengue infection. Dengue fever is mosquito-borne and typically presents with high fever, headache, muscle and joint pains, and rash. In the same reporting week (Sept 21–27), a general school in Veszprém County experienced a mass gastroenteritis outbreak; six individuals were tested, with calicivirus detected in three cases, and investigators noted possible foodborne transmission. The bulletin also recorded two mpox cases in Hungary that week: a 45-year-old man in Komárom-Esztergom County and a 27-year-old man in Pest County, neither vaccinated against mpox. No fatalities were reported. Clinicians should consider travel history for febrile patients.

triage.headline_ja: ヴェスプレーム県の男性からデング熱ウイルスが検出
triage.triage_reason: インド渡航歴のあるハンガリー人男性の輸入デング熱単発例であり、対象国での発生事例ではなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響も認められない。
triage.notes: 本事例はインド渡航歴のある男性のハンガリー国内における輸入デング熱症例であり、インド国内での発生事例ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。同記事で言及されているmpox症例もハンガリー国内のものでインドとは無関係。

article.articleHeadline: Tödlich innerhalb weniger Tage: Was die Lungenpest so gefährlich macht
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly within a few days: What makes pneumonic plague so dangerous.
article.articleSummary: As of October 7, 2026, a fatal pneumonic plague case following a laboratory accident in a plague lab in Siberia, Russia has drawn WHO attention. Pneumonic plague is caused by Yersinia pestis and is the most virulent form, involving the lungs; globally 1,000–3,000 plague cases annually across all forms, with most bubonic cases in Madagascar and the DRC; cases also occur in Russia, India, China, and the United States. Pneumonic form progresses rapidly: fever, chills, headaches, weakness, and cough with chest pain, shortness of breath, sometimes with watery or bloody sputum; symptoms typically appear 1–3 days after infection, sometimes within 24 hours. Transmission is human-to-human via respiratory droplets, mainly with close contact; lab exposure is a possible pathway. Treated with antibiotics (streptomycin, gentamicin, doxycycline, ciprofloxacin) for 10–14 days; early treatment within 24 hours is critical. Isolation and close-contact prophylaxis are used; there is no widely available vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: 数日で致死：肺ペストがこれほど危険な理由とは
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・シベリアの研究所事故による肺ペスト死亡例にWHOが注目しており、致死性の高い感染症であることと予期せぬ事故による発生という異常性からIHR基準を2つ満たすため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 本事例の主たる発生地はロシア（シベリアの研究所）であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。記事中のマダガスカル、DRC、インド、中国、米国への言及は、ペストの世界的な発生状況に関する一般的・背景的な記述であり、本記事が報じる具体的な事案（研究所事故による死亡例）の発生地ではない。続報でロシア国外への伝播や対象国での関連事例が確認された場合は再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: Brasil intensifica ações face a avanço nos EUA e nas Américas -- Política Distrital agora é PDNews, notícias sobre Política e Saúde do DF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: Brazil intensifies actions in response to the spread in the United States and the Americas -- Política Distrital is now PDNews, news about Politics and Health in the Federal District.
article.articleSummary: Measles: Brazil intensifies monitoring as US and Americas face rising cases. On Oct 7, 2026, Brazil’s Health Ministry boosted alert and risk surveillance after a surge in the United States and other regions. Brazil reports 52 imported cases as of Oct 5, 2026—41 in São Paulo, 10 in Amazonas, 1 in Rio de Janeiro—yet remains free of endemic transmission. The United States has the highest annual measles burden in over 35 years, with more than 90% of cases in unvaccinated or vaccination-history-unknown individuals. OPAS notes that in 2026 the US, Guatemala, Mexico, Peru, and Canada account for over 95% of confirmed regional cases. Public health actions include active case finding, epidemiological investigation, contact tracing, and ring vaccination; campaigns in 2026 delivered over 3.8 million doses in São Paulo and about 192 thousand in Amazonas, with dose zero for 6–11 months in outbreak zones. Between 2023–2025 Brazil recorded 85 confirmed cases, no deaths; 2025 first-dose MMR reached 93.10% nationwide (São Paulo 94.39%; Amazonas 89.54%).

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹:ブラジル、米国・米州における拡大を受け対策強化 -- Política DistritalはPDNewsに名称変更
triage.triage_reason: 米国を含む米州で麻疹症例が35年ぶりの高水準となり、ブラジルも52例の輸入症例を確認し監視を強化しており、国際的拡大と異常事態の2基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: ブラジル国内は輸入症例のみで地域流行(endemic transmission)は確認されておらず死亡例もない。米国・グアテマラ・メキシコ・ペルー・カナダが米州症例の95%以上を占めるが、これらは対象国リスト外のため記載せず。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya's first Ebola case: Ten people quarantined as screening concerns grow
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first Ebola case after a patient who died in Nairobi traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo, prompting quarantine of ten contacts and tracing of 57 more. The patient moved from Buta to Kisangani, flew to Beni, drove through Uganda, then flew to Nairobi. Ebola spreads via contact with infected bodily fluids. The DR Congo outbreak began in May and involves the Bundibugyo species, which has no approved vaccine or treatment (trials underway). Kenya says more than 650,000 travellers have been screened and 267 samples tested; four hospitals, including Nairobi Hospital, are designated for Ebola care. Border screening gaps and fever checks are limited, with medications possibly masking symptoms. Uganda reports it remains Ebola-free (WHO– Uganda free in August). DR Congo has recorded over 4,000 deaths this year, making it the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア初のエボラ症例：検疫強化の中、10人が隔離される
triage.triage_reason: DRCで続くエボラ流行（死者4000人超）がウガンダ経由でケニアに越境し初症例が発生。国際的拡大・渡航制限・公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニア初症例だが、感染源・アウトブレイク本体はDRC（対象国）であるため含めた。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。ワクチン・治療法未承認のBundibugyo種であり、国境検疫の限界が指摘されている点も懸念材料。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: स्वाइन फ्लू चा उद्रेक वाढला
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu outbreak on the rise
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) outbreak persists in Nashik city and district, with total swine flu cases rising to 359 and 11 deaths as of September 2026. In September alone, 192 new cases were reported; July had 21 and August 119. Mortality increased from July–August (5 deaths) to September (6 deaths). Of the 11 fatalities, 3 occurred within municipal limits and 8 in rural areas; currently 27 patients are hospitalized. Transmission is via respiratory droplets from coughing and sneezing, with higher monsoon humidity sustaining viral activity. Earlier in the year, January–June saw only 7 cases, with a surge beginning in July. Dengue cases in Nashik reached 182 by late September, with 56 (Jan–Jul), 45 (August), and 81 (first four weeks of September). Health authorities have issued caution and urged vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: 豚インフルエンザの流行が拡大
triage.triage_reason: インド・ナーシク地域でH1N1症例が急増（9月だけで192件、死亡11名）、同時にデング熱も流行しており、WPRO基準の複数項目（異常性・重症度・曝露継続・流行しやすさ）に該当し、保健当局も注意喚起を行っている。
triage.notes: 季節性のH1N1流行だが、症例数の急増（7月21件→8月119件→9月192件）と死亡者数の増加傾向、さらにデング熱の同時流行が確認されており、地域保健システムへの負荷が懸念される。国際的な拡大リスクは低いが、国内での継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: MSF Reaction to the announcement of the 1st Ebola case reported in Kenya - Kenya
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first Ebola case and death in Nairobi; MSF coordinates with the Ministry of Health and partners in the response. Since the regional outbreak in DRC and Uganda began, MSF has been supporting Kenya’s preparedness. In June 2026, MSF opened an Ebola simulation and training center in Kajiado County near Nairobi to train staff deploying to DRC; facility replicates an Ebola Treatment Center and trains on PPE use, infection prevention and control, and emergency response; 355 professionals trained, including 84 Kenyan healthcare workers. In July, Mombasa County Department of Health, with MSF, established an Ebola training center at Port Reitz Sub-County Hospital to bolster preparedness. More recently, in Busia County on the Kenya–Uganda border, MSF assists MoH with isolation and management of suspected cases and IPC measures. MSF emphasizes community engagement learned from DRC where >8,200 infected and 4,000 died. MSF has been in Kenya for almost 40 years.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで報告された第1例目のエボラ症例発表に対するMSFの反応 - ケニア
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで初のエボラ出血熱症例・死亡が確認され、DRC・ウガンダの地域流行と関連する越境感染拡大の懸念があるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアにおける初のエボラ症例確認であり、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため該当なし。DRC・ウガンダは地域アウトブレイクの背景情報として言及されているのみで、本記事の主題イベントの発生国ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni : huit patients guéris, dont un nouveau-né de 29 jours qui a perdu sa mère
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: eight patients cured, including a 29-day-old newborn who has lost his mother.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Beni, North Kivu (DRC) sees eight recoveries, including a 29-day-old newborn whose mother died, with discharged patients marking a hopeful turn in the response on 7 October. The case highlights note that rapid care can save lives, with the newborn receiving intensive pediatric treatment. Despite progress, the epidemiological picture remains worrisome: a provincial response bulletin dated 6 October reports nine new confirmed Ebola cases in 24 hours across Beni health zone (Beni-ville, Biena, Kalunguta). Beni totals rise to 404 cases with 295 deaths; Nord-Kivu province tallies 1,796 confirmed cases and 1,086 deaths (case fatality 61%). There are 457 active cases and over 14,267 contacts under surveillance. The data show ongoing transmission and the need for continued vigilance and community cooperation to interrupt transmission chains.

triage.headline_ja: ベニのエボラ出血熱：8人の患者が回復、母親を亡くした生後29日の新生児も含む
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州ベニで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが拡大しており（累計404例・295死亡、州全体で1796例・1086死亡、致死率61%）、24時間で9例の新規確診例が報告されるなど深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威が継続している。
triage.notes: 致死率61%、457例の活動性症例、14,267人の接触者監視中であり、継続的な地域伝播が示唆される。既に国際的に注視されている既知のアウトブレイクであるため、続報のモニタリングとフルRRAでの詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : Ebola laisse plus de 1 900 enfants orphelins ou séparés de leurs parents
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ebola leaves more than 1,900 children orphaned or separated from their parents.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has left more than 1,900 children orphaned or separated from their parents, according to a UNICEF report released today. As of 28 September 2026, 1,581 children in Ituri and 322 in North Kivu are recorded as orphans or separated, a figure UNICEF cautions is likely an undercount and limited to areas where it works with provincial social services. In Bunia, seven-month-old Lina survived Ebola while her mother died; fear of contagion can hinder relatives from taking over caregiving. UNICEF supports twelve creches near treatment centers to care for affected children and monitor for symptoms, calling for one additional creche per center. The agency has mobilized $40 million of the $113 million needed for the DRC response.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ出血熱により1,900人以上の子どもが孤児または親と離別
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ流行が継続しており、2000人近い子どもへの人道的影響と国際支援（$113百万のうち$40百万動員）が必要な状況であり、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 既知のDRCエボラ流行（イトゥリ州・北キブ州）の継続報道で、感染拡大そのものよりも人道的影響（孤児・離別児童）とUNICEFの資金ニーズに焦点を当てた記事。既存流行の進捗確認としてフルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: Peste in Siberia, voci su un secondo caso. Pressing sulla Russia per chiarire cosa sta accadendo (di L. Gironacci)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Plague in Siberia, rumors of a second case. Pressure on Russia to clarify what is happening (by L. Gironacci).
article.articleSummary: Death of Darya Shipilova, a 28-year-old laboratory technician at Irkutsk Research Institute in central Siberia, occurred the night of 1–2 October after hospital admission on 29 September for pneumonia. Media initially speculated pneumonic plague linked to a September 25 incident involving a broken vial, but Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor confirmed pneumonia of unknown etiology as the cause and said samples showed no pathogens related to her work. Roughly 200 close contacts were isolated or medically observed; tests among contacts showed no plague cases. The World Health Organization characterized the public health risk as low and is seeking clarifications under the International Health Regulations, while monitoring laboratory results and contact tracing. China is cooperating with Moscow; the United States and other countries are pressing for more information. Kremlin officials urge reliance on Rospotrebnadzor amid high international attention and ongoing questions about the first death and potential second case rumors.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアでのペスト、二例目の噂。ロシアに状況説明を求める圧力（L. Gironacci記事）
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの研究所職員が原因不明の肺炎で死亡し、当初は肺ペストとの関連が疑われた。WHOがIHRに基づき説明を求め、中国・米国も情報提供を求めるなど国際的関心が高まっているため、フルリスク評価に進めるべき事案と判断。
triage.notes: 事案はロシア・シベリア（イルクーツク）で発生しており、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。中国は協力国として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため除外。ロシア当局は原因をペストではなく原因不明肺炎と発表し、接触者からもペスト陰性であるため、WHOは公衆衛生リスクを低いと評価しているが、国際的な透明性への懸念が続いている。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde reforça alerta de monitoramento e vacinação contra o sarampo no país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Reinforces Alert for Monitoring and Vaccination Against Measles in the Country
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak prompts Brazil to escalate surveillance and vaccination. Amid a regional spike in measles cases, especially in the United States, which reports the highest activity in over 35 years and where over 90% of infections are among unvaccinated or with unknown vaccination status, 2026 data show that 95% of confirmed cases in the Americas occur in the US, Guatemala, Mexico, Peru, and Canada. In Brazil, 52 imported measles cases were recorded by October 5, with São Paulo accounting for 41, Amazonas 10, and Rio de Janeiro 1; the country retains its status as free from endemic transmission. Health authorities intensified active case finding, epidemiological investigation, contact tracing, and reactive vaccination in affected areas. Four national immunization campaigns this year have delivered over 3.8 million doses in São Paulo and about 192 thousand in Amazonas; a zero-dose policy for infants 6–11 months was adopted. The measles vaccine (triple viral) remains freely available across the public SUS system.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、国内での麻疹監視とワクチン接種に関する警戒を強化
triage.triage_reason: 米州地域で麻疹の異常な増加（米国で35年来最高）が見られ、ブラジルでも輸入症例が52件に増加し保健当局が監視・ワクチン接種体制を強化しているため、地域的拡大リスクと異常性の観点からIHR基準を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルにおける輸入麻疹症例（サンパウロ41件、アマゾナス10件、リオデジャネイロ1件）と、米国・グアテマラ・メキシコ・ペルー・カナダを含む米州地域全体の麻疹流行拡大を報告。ブラジル自体は地方流行フリーの地位を維持しているが、輸入例増加に伴い監視・ワクチン接種体制を強化している。対象国リストに含まれるのはブラジルのみ。

article.articleHeadline: KUCO demands nationwide Ebola preparedness audit after Kenya's first imported case
article.articleSummary: Kenya's first imported Bundibugyo Ebola case, a Kenyan who travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo via Uganda and arrived in Nairobi on Oct 3, has died during treatment. The case, confirmed as Bundibugyo Ebola, prompts the Kenya Union of Clinical Officers (KUCO) to demand a nationwide Ebola preparedness audit across all 47 counties and major ports of entry, assessing staffing, PPE, isolation facilities, laboratory capacity, and referral systems. KUCO says surveillance and border controls, including routine screening and cross-border travel, reveal gaps in identifying, isolating, and protecting health workers. The union demands full transparency about the patient’s movements, screening, transport, contacts, and clinical management, and urges resolution of frontline staffing disputes to restore capacity. It calls for strengthened airport and land-border surveillance and inclusion of frontline representatives in preparedness teams.

triage.headline_ja: KUCO、ケニア初の輸入エボラ症例を受け全国的なエボラ対応体制の監査を要求
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）感染者がウガンダ経由でケニアに入国後死亡した事例であり、国際的な越境伝播と公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCはエボラ感染者の渡航元として記事の主題に直接関連するため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola creates new hot spots in Congo as responders describe 'chaotic' response - WTOP News
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo's North Kivu has spawned hot spots with more than 8,500 cases and over 4,000 deaths, making it the fastest-growing and deadliest Congo Ebola outbreak. North Kivu now accounts for about 40% of confirmed cases, up from 24% at the end of August. More than 70% of new infections derive from outside known contacts, while at least 60% of deaths occur outside treatment centers. The Bundibugyo virus, with no approved vaccine or treatment, drives the outbreak; North Kivu’s case fatality rate is 58%, the highest among Congo’s seven affected provinces, and the disease has spread to half of its 34 health zones. Contact tracing remains a major challenge—only 23% of expected contacts have been traced—amid population movements, conflict, mistrust, and misinformation. A village-centered approach with local leaders in tracing, burials, and isolation is urged. Kenya reported its Ebola case, a traveler from Congo who died in treatment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが新たなホットスポットを形成、対応者は『混沌とした』対応と証言
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ（北キブ州）のエボラ流行は8,500例・4,000人以上の死亡で過去最大規模かつ最も致死的、致死率58%、接触追跡率わずか23%、ケニアへの越境感染も発生しており国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただし越境感染の事実は国際拡大リスク評価に反映した。ワクチン・治療薬未承認のブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスが原因で、紛争・不信感・誤情報が対応を困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: NCDC enyela ndị Nigeria ntuziaka dịka ọrịa a gburula otu onye na mba Kenya - BBC News Ìgbò
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: NCDC has issued guidelines to Nigerians as the disease has killed one person in Kenya - BBC News Igbo
article.articleSummary: NCDC issues guidelines as Ebola claims a life in Kenya. The deceased is a Kenyan national who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo and traveled to Nairobi via Uganda. Kenyan authorities confirmed the case as Bundibugyo Ebola, a strain not easily detected. Kenya has identified 28 contacts, including 23 travellers and four airline crew, as investigations continue. The NCDC urges Nigerians to practise strict hand hygiene, avoid contact with blood or bodily fluids of an ill person, and not touch the body or corpse of the deceased. Returnees from Ebola-affected areas should monitor for 21 days and seek care immediately if symptoms appear, notifying clinicians of travel history. Nigeria is monitoring Ebola activity in Kenya, DR Congo, and elsewhere, coordinating with international partners to stay prepared; Ebola has caused over 4,000 deaths in DR Congo this year.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ケニアで1人死亡、ナイジェリアCDCが国民にガイドラインを発行
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、複数国にまたがる感染拡大（DRC由来、ケニアでの死亡例、航空機乗客・乗務員との接触者28名）が確認されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの死亡例とナイジェリアの対応だが、両国とも対象国リストに含まれないため除外。一方、DRCは感染源国として明記され、今年4000人以上の死者が出ているとされており、対象国として含めた。ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアでの状況は対象国外のため地理情報には反映されないが、国際的拡大の文脈として重要。

article.articleHeadline: Trump pide a sus ciudadanos que abandonen Rusia ante la alerta por peste neumónica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trump urges his citizens to leave Russia amid a pneumonic plague alert.
article.articleSummary: An alert for a possible pneumonic plague in Russia prompts the U.S. Embassy in Moscow to urge citizens to leave the country 'as soon as possible.' The warning follows the Oct 2 death of a 28-year-old researcher at the Institute of Plague Research of Irkutsk and the Far East, attributed by Russia to pneumonia of unknown etiology. Russia denies a second death; officials say to rely on Rospotrebnadzor communications. Hypotheses include exposure to Yersinia pestis during travel to Thailand or a lab accident, though safety protocols are reported as followed. More than 90% of the deceased’s contacts have been tested, with almost 5,000 tests yielding no hazardous pathogens. The WHO seeks rapid, transparent information; Moscow reports no recent plague cases in Irkutsk or dangerous pathogens among contacts. High-level talks continue, with Trump planning a call with Putin to address the case.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ氏、肺ペスト警報を受けロシアにいる自国民に避難を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペスト（Yersinia pestis）疑いによる死亡例と米国大使館の退避勧告、WHOの情報要求があり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大懸念・渡航制限）に該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（Irkutsk/Moscow）であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空。タイへの渡航歴は曝露仮説として言及されているのみで、タイ国内での発生ではないため除外した。ロシア当局は追加の危険病原体検出を否定しており、情報の透明性・人-人感染の有無については不明な点が多い。

article.articleHeadline: 一批法國進口芝士或受產志賀毒素大腸桿菌污染　當局籲勿食用
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A batch of French-imported cheese may be contaminated with Shiga toxin-producing Escherichia coli; authorities urge not to eat.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 October 2026, Hong Kong's Center for Food Safety urged the public not to eat a batch of French-imported pre-packaged Camembert cheese, Camembert Bertrand Crémier 250g, due to potential contamination with Shiga toxin-producing Escherichia coli. The warning follows a Rapid Alert System for Food and Feed (RASFF) notification from the European Union about possible STEC contamination and ongoing product recalls. The importer, Repertoire Culinaire Hong Kong Limited, is identified as having imported the affected batch. The importer has voluntarily stopped sales and removed the products from shelves and is conducting a recall; the Center has notified the industry and will continue to monitor the situation and take appropriate actions. No illnesses reported in the article.

triage.headline_ja: フランス産チーズの一部がシガ毒素産生性大腸菌に汚染されている可能性、当局が摂取を控えるよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: フランス産チーズのSTEC汚染懸念による予防的リコール事案であり、香港での患者発生報告もなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: EUのRASFF通知を受けた香港での予防的な食品リコール事案。フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。患者発生の報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ruto orders heightened Ebola surveillance
article.articleSummary: After the arrival and death of a Kenyan citizen who contracted Ebola in DR Congo, an imported case, President William Ruto said Kenya is adequately prepared and has implemented public health interventions. Contacts—those who traveled with the patient, medical staff at Nairobi Hospital, and family members—have been identified for monitoring. The Ministry of Health issued guidelines for safe conduct in public spaces, and the Government will keep the public informed while elevating Ebola surveillance to the highest level. Kenya reports sufficient facilities nationwide to manage any incidences. The remarks were made during the handover/dedication of the Raila Amolo Odinga Mausoleum in Kang'o ka Jaramogi, Bondo, Siaya County, on Wednesday.

triage.headline_ja: ルト大統領、エボラ出血熱の監視強化を指示
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラに感染したケニア人の輸入症例が確認され死亡、国境を越えた伝播とIHR基準の複数該当（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大・渡航制限リスク）が認められるためフルRRAへ進む。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの輸入症例対応だが、感染源はDRCであるため同国を発生地域として記載。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Jhansi News: CMO Dr Shishir Puri Inspects Communicable Disease Control Campaign | Jhansi News: संचारी रोग नियंत्रण अभियान का निरीक्षण, सीएमओ डॉ. शिशिर पुरी ने जनसहभागिता पर दिया जोर
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jhansi News: Inspection of the Communicable Disease Control Campaign, CMO Dr. Shishir Puri emphasized public participation.
article.articleSummary: Jhansi, Ward 16, Maseehaganj, Sipri Bazaar: In the communicable disease control campaign, Chief Medical Officer Dr. Shishir Puri inspected the ward, stressing active public participation and interdepartmental coordination to curb mosquito-borne diseases. He urged regular surveillance of waterlogged areas, drains, and mosquito breeding sites, with anti-larval activities and insecticide spraying as needed. From 12 October 2026, ASHA and Anganwadi workers will launch a house-to-house Dastak campaign to raise awareness and collect fever-related information for testing and treatment. Citizens were asked not to let water accumulate and to regularly clean coolers, pots, tires, and other water-holding containers. Fever patients should visit nearest health center for testing and treatment. The Malaria Department reviewed activities in sensitive wards; a door-to-door survey checked breeding sites and applied anti-larvicide. Larvae were found in two houses' water tanks and coolers and destroyed; notices issued to owners.

triage.headline_ja: ジャンシーニュース:伝染病対策キャンペーンの視察、CMOシシル・プリ医師が住民参加を強調
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防的公衆衛生活動（ルーチンの媒介蚊対策キャンペーン）の報告であり、異常な流行や重症例の急増等の報告はない。
triage.notes: 記事は通常の予防的サーベイランス・媒介対策活動（Dastakキャンペーン）を報じるもので、具体的な症例数や異常な流行拡大の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: China says it maintains cooperation with Russia on infectious diseases, including plague
article.articleSummary: China said it maintains close cooperation with Russia on infectious diseases, including plague, after the death of a Russian laboratory worker in Irkutsk raised questions about possible pneumonic plague. Foreign Ministry spokesman Guo Jiakun emphasized ongoing collaboration with Russian authorities. The World Health Organization said it was following the case, in which a Russian employee of the Irkutsk Scientific Research Anti-Plague Institute died on Oct. 2 after developing severe pneumonia; the pathogen had not been officially confirmed. Russian authorities conducted an epidemiological investigation, noting the illness began as community-acquired pneumonia; tests reportedly found no pathogens of dangerous infectious diseases among contacts. WHO, replying Oct. 3, offered support. Preliminary risk assessment indicated a public health risk to the general population as low, with Irkutsk region risk described as moderate to low, Russia overall low, and the European region very low.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、ロシアとの感染症協力(ペストを含む)の継続を表明
triage.triage_reason: 記事はロシア(イルクーツク)での研究所職員の死亡例に関する中国の外交的コメントであり、対象国（中国等）での実際の発生事例ではない。WHOのリスク評価も低いとされている。
triage.notes: 実際の発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストに含まれない。中国は外交的声明を行っているのみで、イベントの発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。WHOの予備リスク評価では公衆衛生リスクは全体的に低いとされている。

article.articleHeadline: AIIMS Delhi, Union Bank Launch TB Genotype Research Project
article.articleSummary: New Delhi: AIIMS New Delhi and Union Bank of India launched a tuberculosis research project funded through Union Bank’s CSR initiative. The study, 'Comprehensive Study of Genotype and Phenotype of Mycobacterium tuberculosis Along with Its Clinical Impact', aims to profile the genotype and phenotype of Mycobacterium tuberculosis and examine how these traits shape clinical outcomes. Launched on October 6 at AIIMS, the project was announced by AIIMS Director Prof Nikhil Tandon and Union Bank of India Delhi Zone General Manager H K Das, with support from the Union Bank Social Foundation Trust. The collaboration seeks clinically relevant evidence on the relationship between genetic/phenotypic characteristics and TB management, to inform optimal patient care and contribute to TB elimination efforts. The partnership highlights the role of academic-bank collaborations in addressing major public health challenges.

triage.headline_ja: AIIMSデリー、ユニオン銀行が結核の遺伝子型研究プロジェクトを開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核に関する研究プロジェクトの発足を伝えるものであり、アウトブレイクや症例急増等の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報ではない。
triage.notes: 研究プロジェクト発足の広報記事であり、感染症の発生・流行に関する情報ではないため、対象国の発生地域としては計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: طاعون ریوی چیست؟ بیماری‌ای که بدون درمان می‌تواند مرگبار باشد
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is pneumonic plague? A disease that can be fatal if left untreated.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague is a severe lung infection and the deadliest form of plague; bubonic and septicemic forms exist. Pneumonic plague may occur after other forms or by direct inhalation. Symptoms include shortness of breath, chest pain, and coughing up blood. Annual global cases vary from about 1,000 to 3,000, with most cases bubonic and many in Africa; cases also reported in Russia, India, China, and the United States. Transmission primarily via infected fleas; human-to-human spread through respiratory droplets requires close contact; septicemic plague can progress to pneumonic form. Incubation can be as short as 24 hours; without timely treatment it's often fatal, but antibiotics are effective when started early; prophylaxis after exposure may be advised. In Russia, authorities say the deceased laboratory worker’s cause is under investigation, and tests on contacts showed no evidence of infection with the pneumonic form.

triage.headline_ja: 肺ペストとは何か？治療しなければ致死的となりうる疾患
triage.triage_reason: 記事はペスト一般の解説記事であり、特定の国・地域における新規アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、トリアージ対象のシグナルとは言えない。
triage.notes: 記事は肺ペストの一般的な医学解説で、ロシアでの実験室作業員の死亡事例に触れているが詳細な発生状況や対象国での具体的アウトブレイク情報はなく、対象国リストに該当する具体的な新規発生国は特定できない。

article.articleHeadline: Premier cas d'Ebola au Kenya : dix personnes placées en quarantaine, les inquiétudes concernant le dépistage s'accentuent.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First Ebola case in Kenya: ten people placed in quarantine, concerns about screening intensify.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first Ebola case after a man who died in Nairobi. Ten contacts are in quarantine and authorities are tracing 57 more linked to the patient, who traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo via Buta to Kisangani, then flew to Beni, entered Uganda by road, and flew to Nairobi, dying there on Monday. The infection is Bundibugyo Ebola virus, a rare strain with no vaccine or approved treatment. The DRC outbreak began in May and has caused more than 4,000 deaths this year; Uganda had cases and was declared Ebola-free by WHO in August. Kenyan health authorities, with CDC Africa, are investigating and strengthening screening at airports and borders; over 650,000 travelers have been screened and 267 samples tested. Four hospitals, including Nairobi, are designated for care; plans to convert a Nanyuki center were suspended. Authorities urge calm; some screening gaps and medicines may have masked symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア初のエボラ症例：10人が隔離、検疫体制への懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: DRCで続く大規模エボラ流行（死者4,000人超）に関連し、国境を越えてケニアで初の症例・死亡が確認され、接触者57人超の追跡調査が進行中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニア初症例だが、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であるDRCの継続的流行（2026年5月開始、死者4,000人超）が明示的に言及されているためDRCのみ検証対象国として記載。

article.articleHeadline: Da peste à covid e ao ebola: entenda as diferenças entre as doenças
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From Plague to COVID and Ebola: Understand the Differences Between the Diseases.
article.articleSummary: Death of a 28-year-old researcher at a Siberian plague institute raises awareness of pneumonic plague in Irkutsk, though authorities deny confirmed infection by Yersinia pestis. Plague has three forms: bubonic, septicemic, and pneumonic—the latter being the only form that can spread directly from person to person via respiratory droplets. Transmission occurs from fleas to humans or via inhalation of respiratory particles from an infected person or animal. Incubation can be as short as 24 hours; untreated disease is rapidly fatal, while early diagnosis and antibiotics are effective. The term plague remains historical, but the bacterium persists in animal reservoirs across Africa, Asia, and the Americas; 2019–2025 WHO data show most human cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Madagascar. COVID-19 is caused by SARS-CoV-2 (viral); Ebola is a separate virus transmitted via blood/fluids, though vaccines and treatments exist.

triage.headline_ja: ペストからコロナ、エボラまで:病気の違いを理解する
triage.triage_reason: 記事は疾病の違いを説明する解説記事であり、具体的な発生イベントの報告ではない。シベリアでの研究者死亡は感染未確認であり、新規の公衆衛生上の懸念を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は病気の一般解説であり、DRCとマダガスカルは過去のWHOデータ引用（2019-2025年）として言及されているのみで、本記事の主題イベントではない。シベリア(ロシア)の研究者死亡は感染未確認かつ対象国リストに含まれないため、具体的な発生国としてはDRCのみを参考情報として記載するが、実質的なイベント発生とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية وأمريكا تطالبان روسيا بتفاصيل عن معهد أبحاث الطاعون بـ "إيركوتسك"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization and the United States call on Russia to provide details about the Plague Research Institute in Irkutsk.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-07, the United States urged Russia to provide additional information about the death of a 28-year-old researcher at the Irkutsk Plague Research Institute in Siberia, amid international calls for transparency over a possible pneumonic plague exposure after a lab incident reportedly caused a broken test tube. About 200 people may have been exposed and are under quarantine or medical surveillance. Russian authorities have not yet determined the cause of death and denied online claims of special plague-control measures. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said Russia reported no recent plague cases in Irkutsk region, and an epidemiologic investigation, preventive and surveillance measures, and monitoring of contacts are underway. The WHO seeks additional data to clarify the pneumonia that led to death, identify the disease agent, and assess reports of a second pneumonia case of unknown etiology, all under International Health Regulations. China and Mongolia are closely monitoring the situation; pneumonic plague is highly transmissible via the respiratory route, requiring early treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関と米国、ロシアに対し「イルクーツク」のペスト研究所に関する詳細の提供を要求
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクのペスト研究所研究員の死亡事例を巡り、WHOがIHRに基づく調査を開始し米国も情報開示を要求するなど国際的関心が高く、肺ペストの高い伝播性から公衆衛生上のリスクも懸念されるため。
triage.notes: 事象の発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり対象国リストに含まれない。中国・モンゴルは状況を注視しているとの記載のみで、発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Mysterieuze dood van laboratoriummedewerker in Siberië leidt tot paniek over mogelijke pestuitbraak - wat is er over bekend?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mysterious death of a laboratory worker in Siberia sparks panic over possible plague outbreak — what is known?
article.articleSummary: A 28-year-old researcher, Daria Sjipilova, at an anti-plague institute in Irkutsk (Russia) dies after a brief hospital stay in Shchelkovo, with initial reports claiming she accidentally broke a vial containing Yersinia pestis on Sept 25, though this is unverified. By Oct 2, officials attributed the death to pneumonia of unknown origin and said no plague-related organisms were found in her body; about 200 people were quarantined amid growing fear. Residents reported decontamination at her building with a strong-smelling disinfectant, fueling rumors of a virus. The case has sparked concern over censorship and public panic. Plague (Yersinia pestis) has three forms—pneumonic, bubonic, septicemic—with pneumonic plague capable of human-to-human transmission but historically rare. WHO records ~4,000 cases and 423 deaths in six years, with outbreaks mainly in Madagascar and the Democratic Republic of Congo. Russia maintains an anti-plague monitoring system with Cold War–era roots and links to bioweapons programs.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアの研究所職員の謎の死、ペスト流行の可能性をめぐりパニックが広がる――何がわかっているのか？
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの研究所職員の死因が当初ペスト菌感染と噂されたが、当局はペスト菌は検出されず原因不明の肺炎と発表しており、事実関係が未確定。公衆の関心・隔離措置はあるが、感染症としての確証がなく続報待ちの状態。
triage.notes: 本事例はロシア（シベリア・イルクーツク州）で発生しており、対象国リストに該当しない。記事中のDRCおよびマダガスカルへの言及は過去のペスト流行統計の文脈であり、現在進行中の発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。ペスト菌の検出は否定されており、死因は『原因不明の肺炎』とされている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Caso de ébola en Kenia pone de manifiesto las deficiencias en los controles fronterizos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola case in Kenya highlights deficiencies in border controls.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports an Ebola case linked to the Congo Bundibugyo outbreak, highlighting border gaps as the virus crosses Africa. A Kenyan national, identity undisclosed, arrived in Nairobi with fever, chills, muscle pain and hemorrhages and died two days later. He traveled by road from Beni, in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, to Kampala, Uganda, spent a night there, then flew to Kenya; the Congo–Uganda border has been closed since May. Uganda declared itself Ebola-free by late July, but officials warn border porosity complicates containment. Kenya identified 57 contacts, including 10 quarantined, and opened a dedicated clearance gate at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport for arrivals from Congo. The Congo outbreak is the largest on record, with more than 8,000 cases and over 4,000 deaths; Bundibugyo has no approved treatment or vaccine. Early symptoms are hard to detect; infrared thermometers measure surface temperature, risking missed fevers.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでのエボラ症例、国境管理の不備を浮き彫りに
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ（ブンディブギョ株）由来の大規模流行（8,000例超、4,000人超死亡）がウガンダを経てケニアへ越境し死亡例が発生、国際的拡大と渡航・国境管理上の懸念が強く、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。発生源であるDRCのみを計上。本件は越境伝播と国境管理の脆弱性が主題であり、DRCでの流行状況（ワクチン未承認株、致死率高）がリスクの核心。

article.articleHeadline: Roche Diagnostics Provides Molecular Testing Instruments To Institut National De Santé Publique To Support Ebola Testing Capacity In The Democratic Republic Of Congo
article.articleSummary: Roche Diagnostics supplied two molecular testing instruments—LightCycler and Magna Pure—to the Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP) in the Democratic Republic of Congo to bolster Ebola response capacity led by the Ministry of Health. The instruments will be preconfigured and deployed after training of local laboratory staff, with Bunia slated for validation testing. This delivery follows Roche’s June announcement of a Research Use Only PCR test targeting Bundibugyo virus. The partnership aims to strengthen local testing capacity and obtain regulatory validation before shipping additional tests. The Bundibugyo virus RUO test is restricted to research use and not for diagnostic procedures. The effort supports ongoing Ebola surveillance and outbreak response in the DRC, though the article does not report case counts.

triage.headline_ja: ロシュ・ダイアグノスティックス、コンゴ民主共和国における国立公衆衛生研究所のエボラ検査能力強化のため分子検査機器を提供
triage.triage_reason: エボラ対応能力強化に関する供給支援の記事であり、新規症例数や発生規模等の具体的な疫学情報が記載されていないため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はロシュによる検査機器提供という支援活動が主題であり、進行中のエボラ発生状況（症例数等）については言及がない。既存の流行対応強化の一環とみられるため、新規シグナルというより継続的な対応の一部として経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: NCDC Reviews Ebola Risk To Nigeria After Kenya Confirms Imported Case
article.articleSummary: Following Kenya’s confirmation on 6 October of an imported Bundibugyo Ebola case, Nigeria's NCDC reviewed the risk and preparedness amid the Democratic Republic of Congo's Bundibugyo outbreak. The Kenyan patient, who had lived in the DRC, traveled from the DRC to Kampala, then to Nairobi where he was isolated and tested positive; he subsequently died. Nigeria has no confirmed Ebola case as of 6 October 2026. NCDC notes cross-border importation risk via travel and population movement. Preparedness measures include detection, isolation/referral, testing, infection control, contact tracing, risk communication, and protecting healthcare workers; a National Ebola Preparedness Tabletop Exercise was conducted. Nigerians are urged to practice hand hygiene, avoid contact with bodily fluids and bushmeat, seek care if unwell after travel, and report exposure, relying on official sources. Authorities will monitor Kenya, DRC and others and adjust measures.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアが輸入エボラ症例を確認後、ナイジェリアNCDCが対ナイジェリア・エボラリスクを再評価
triage.triage_reason: DRCで続くブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱の流行がケニアへの輸入症例（死亡例含む）として国境を越えて拡大しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで継続中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ型）流行であり、ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCが発生源国として該当。

article.articleHeadline: Zambia : Chongwe Attributes High Number Of Cholera Cases To Poor Sanitation
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Chongwe District, Zambia, as of 2026-10-07, driven by inadequate clean water and poor sanitation. Ngwerere area accounts for 21 of 31 confirmed cases; Meanwood Kwamwena reports four cases amid unfinished structures lacking water supply and toilets, raising concerns about open defecation. District Health Office attributes transmission to drawing unclean water from shallow wells despite efforts to improve supply. Health officials have implemented surveillance and preventive measures, including water disinfection and testing in shallow wells, hotspot areas, and public places such as markets; distribution of chlorine; and community sensitization on hygiene and using clean water. The District Health Office will engage homeowners in Meanwood Kwamwena and seek broader stakeholder support for a coordinated cholera response to prevent further spread, per Chongwe administration leadership.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア：チョングウェ、コレラ患者数の増加を不衛生な環境に起因と説明
triage.triage_reason: ザンビア・チョングウェ県で水系感染症であるコレラの集団発生が継続しており、衛生環境の悪さにより感染拡大の恐れがあるため、WPRO基準に複数該当しフルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 31例中21例がNgwerere地区に集中。浅井戸からの汚染水摂取が感染経路とされ、地区保健当局は外部の利害関係者支援を求めている。死亡者数や重症度の詳細は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'da ebola alarmı! Can kaybı 4 bin 178'e yükseldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert in Congo! Death toll rises to 4,178.
article.articleSummary: EBOLA OUTBREAK IN THE DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF THE CONGO: As of 7 October 2026, the outbreak spans 7 provinces across 64 districts, with 8,665 laboratory-confirmed cases and 4,178 deaths; 2,259 recoveries; case-fatality rate 48.2%; and 80.4% contact-tracing. In the last 24 hours, 24 more patients recovered. It began in a village near the Ebola River, the river giving the disease its name; Ebola was first identified in 1976. In eastern Ituri province, 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths preceded the 15 May declaration. The circulating Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant has no approved treatment or vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ警報！死者数4,178人に増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCで7州64地区に拡大する大規模エボラ流行（確定例8,665人、死者4,178人、致死率48.2%）であり、承認済み治療薬・ワクチンがない変異株が流行していることから、重篤性・異常性・国際拡大リスクともに高い。
triage.notes: 致死率48.2%、承認された治療薬・ワクチンがないBundibugyo変異株による大規模流行。7州64地区に拡大しており、国際的な支援ニーズが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Αναφορές για δεύτερο πιθανό θάνατο από πανώλη στη Ρωσία - Η διεθνής κοινότητα ζητά εξηγήσεις
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Reports of a second possible death from plague in Russia - The international community asks for explanations.
article.articleSummary: Reports of a second possible death from plague in Russia prompted international alerts as the World Health Organization (WHO) asked Moscow for rapid, transparent updates. In Siberia, Darya Sipilova, a 28-year-old employee of the Irkutsk Institute for Anti-Plague Protection (Siberia and the Far East), died in hospital from pneumonia, with investigators exploring a possible link to Yersinia pestis. Russia’s authorities have not confirmed plague among her contacts; about 200 people were quarantined, with roughly 60% released from monitoring. The Kremlin says it has provided WHO with relevant information, while Moscow’s Rospotrebnadzor has dismissed media reports as false. WHO seeks clarification on the pneumonia’s cause, the pathogen driving public-health actions, and reports of a second unknown pneumonia case. Based on unofficial information, the public-health risk appears low. Plague persists in Africa, former Soviet states, South America, and Asia, with most cases recently in the DRC and Madagascar.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでペストによる死亡とみられる2例目の報告 - 国際社会が説明を要求
triage.triage_reason: ペスト対策研究所職員の原因不明肺炎死亡とロシア当局の情報開示を巡りWHOが説明を要求しており、国際的な関心・懸念が高いためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア（シベリア、イルクーツク）での疑いペスト関連死亡例であり、対象国リストに該当なし。DRC・マダガスカルは『最近の症例が多い地域』としての一般的背景言及のみで、本記事の発生事例ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Какая главная опасность трихинеллеза
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is the main danger of trichinellosis?
article.articleSummary: Trichinellosis is an infection transmitted through undercooked meat; without proper treatment it can be fatal. The condition can cause serious complications such as myocarditis (heart inflammation), pneumonia, and possible involvement of the central nervous system. Modern medicine can cure the infection, though treatment carries significant side effects. In Russia, an imported case of melioidosis was reported in a woman returning from Thailand; she was hospitalized in a severe condition. The patient reportedly contracted the tropical infection during excursions, including a farm visit with elephants, and experts debated whether it could trigger an outbreak in Russia. Separately, academician Vitaliy Zverev described symptoms associated with pneumonic plague: high fever, malaise, influenza-like signs, pulmonary hemorrhages, and coughing up blood.

triage.headline_ja: トリヘレラ症（旋毛虫症）の主な危険性とは
triage.triage_reason: トリヘレラ症・肺ペスト症状に関する一般的な医学解説記事であり、タイでの単発の輸入メリオイドーシス症例（ロシアで発症）が触れられているのみで、対象国における実際のアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はトリヘレラ症・肺ペストの一般的医学解説と、タイ旅行歴のあるロシア人女性の単発輸入メリオイドーシス症例を紹介する内容。対象国（タイ）での地域的アウトブレイクは報告されておらず、ロシアは対象国に含まれないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Detectado possível caso de peste na Rússia, mas calma! - Meio Bit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Possible Case of Plague Detected in Russia, But Stay Calm!
article.articleSummary: Possible case of plague in Irkutsk, Russia, linked to Yersinia pestis; authorities have not confirmed infection. A 28-year-old researcher, Darya Shipilova, died of severe pneumonia after arriving at the Siberian Institute of Anti-Plague Research in Irkutsk on Sept 29, 2026, with death reported between Oct 1–2. About 200 people are under observation, with at least a dozen patients isolated and several hospitals in quarantine. Neighbouring countries Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, and Tajikistan have activated border protocols, while the US and EU monitor the situation with low alarm. The article emphasizes historical context of plague, noting pandemics in the 19th–20th centuries and the Black Death, and that today plague is controlled with antibiotics and vaccines; a 2025 pneumonic plague death occurred in Arizona, and Brazil has had no new cases since 2005. No official confirmation yet; calm but cautious vigilance advised.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでペストの可能性がある症例を検出、しかし落ち着いて！
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの抗ペスト研究所関連で研究者が肺ペスト疑いで死亡し、約200人が観察下に置かれ複数病院が隔離される等、重大性・異常性・国際的懸念（近隣国境管理発動）が認められるためフルリスク評価に進めるべき。
triage.notes: 発生国ロシアおよび近隣中央アジア諸国（カザフスタン、キルギス、ウズベキスタン、タジキスタン）は評価対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。記事中のブラジル・米国アリゾナへの言及は過去事例の引用であり、本イベントの発生国ではないため除外。公式確認はまだ得られていない段階であり、続報による確定情報の収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'ndeki Ebola salgınında ölü sayısı 4 bin 178'e yükseldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll in the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 4,178.
article.articleSummary: Across the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola outbreak now spans seven provinces and 64 districts, with 8,665 confirmed cases and 4,178 deaths; recoveries total 2,259, giving a case fatality rate of 48.2% and a contact-tracing rate of 80.4%. In the last 24 hours, 24 more patients recovered. Ebola, a hemorrhagic fever, was first identified in 1976 in Nzara, Sudan, and Yambuku, DRC, and is named after the Ebola River. A large West Africa outbreak (2013–2016) infected about 30,000 people and killed over 11,000. In Ituri province (eastern DRC) there were 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths before the outbreak was declared on May 15. The Bundibugyo Ebola variant has no approved treatment or vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、死者数4,178人に増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱が7州64地区に拡大し、致死率48.2%と高く、承認された治療薬・ワクチンがないバリアントであるため、IHR・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域にBurundi、Sudan、Angolaが含まれるが、記事はDRC国内の流行拡大（7州64地区）に焦点を当てており、他国での発生は言及されていないため除外。Nzara(Sudan)とYambuku(DRC)は1976年の歴史的初発見地としての言及のみ。Bundibugyo変異株は既存のワクチン（Ervebo等）がZaire型用であり本変異株には未承認である点が特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Why we must advocate for proper care on the frontlines of the Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak declared 15 May in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. Named after a Ugandan district where it was first identified in 2007, Bundibugyo has historically caused case fatality of 30–50%. By 23 September, DRC reported 7,890 cases and about 3,799 deaths (rough CFR ~48%). There is no licensed vaccine or cure; two of four candidate Bundibugyo vaccines are in clinical trials, along with several post-exposure drugs. Frontline care in the DRC is led by ALIMA intensivist Richard Kojan. Ebola symptoms—fatigue, fever, headaches, bleeding, severe diarrhea and vomiting—often progress to circulatory shock and multi-organ failure. Challenges include lack of vaccines for filoviruses, weak health systems, late outbreak detection, diagnostic delays, and PPE-intensive red-zone care that hampers continuous monitoring in full facilities. The piece also asks what the CUBE is and how it affects treatment.

article.articleHeadline: Santé en RDC : Le point sur l'épidémie d'Ebola avec plus de 8 600 cas confirmés - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health in the DRC: Update on the Ebola outbreak with more than 8,600 confirmed cases - Mali Actu
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has 8,665 laboratory-confirmed cases and 4,178 deaths as of 5 October 2026, per a situation update from the Ministry of Communications. The outbreak covers seven provinces and 64 health zones. Key indicators: 890 patients in isolation or hospitalised; 2,259 recoveries, including 24 in the last 24 hours. Case fatality rate is 48.2%, and contact follow-up stands at 80.4%. The response and vaccination campaign continue across the affected areas, with vaccination progressing particularly in Tshopo and Bas-Uélé; detailed vaccination counts were not released. Authorities urge the public to report any symptoms or suspected cases via emergency number 151.

article.articleHeadline: W.H.O. Discourages Travel Bans After Kenya Reports First Ebola Death Linked to Current Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first Ebola Bundibugyo death linked to the Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak, involving a Kenyan citizen who traveled DRC → Uganda → Nairobi after developing symptoms about a month ago. Entry into Kenya occurred despite airport screening; the patient sought care and died on Monday. Kenya has identified 28 contacts to monitor for 21 days and 23 passengers from the Jambojet flight are being traced. The Bundibugyo strain is driving the current DRC outbreak; four countries (DRC, Uganda, France, Kenya) have identified cases, with no indication of sustained spread in Uganda or France. As of Sept 23, WHO documented 7,890 cases and 3,799 deaths across the outbreak. WHO advises against travel or trade restrictions; Africa CDC and WHO are deploying resources to Kenya. Kenyan health workers and authorities face calls for stronger screening and protection measures.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、ケニアが現行流行に関連する初のエボラ死亡例を報告した後、渡航制限に反対を表明
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべてに該当する可能性が高く、エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がDRCからウガンダ・フランス・ケニアへ国際的に拡大し死亡例も発生しているため、フルリスク評価に進むべき重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC発のエボラ流行がケニアへ拡大した事例。ケニア・ウガンダ・フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外したが、国際的拡大の文脈として重要。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Peste, tularemia o legionela? El epidemiólogo Joan Caylà destapa las claves de bioseguridad y el secretismo en Siberia tras la muerte de una científica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Plague, tularemia or Legionella? Epidemiologist Joan Caylà reveals the keys to biosafety and secrecy in Siberia after the death of a scientist.
article.articleSummary: Death of Daria Shipilova, 28, a worker at a plague research institute in Irkutsk, Siberia, after rapidly progressive pneumonia raises questions about Yersinia pestis involvement. Russian authorities initially described an unknown-origin pneumonia; data remain insufficient for a definitive cause. Epidemiologist Joan Caylà emphasizes differential diagnoses including plague, tularemia, anthrax, and Legionella, noting that lab confirmation and epidemiological history (working with Yersinia pestis or rodent exposure) are critical. Reports mention a broken test-tube with live bacteria; if plague pneumonic, transmission could be direct between humans and outbreaks could be rapid. WHO risk assessment: moderate–low for Irkutsk, low for Russia, very low for Europe; all contacts identified and monitored; none symptomatic. Globally, plague remains enzootic in animal populations; recent outbreaks reported in Madagascar, DRC, Peru; sporadic cases in China, Mongolia, and the US. Rapid antibiotic prophylaxis and surveillance are key.

triage.headline_ja: ペスト、野兎病、それともレジオネラ症か？疫学者ホアン・カイラ氏がシベリアでの科学者死亡を受けバイオセキュリティの要点と秘密主義を明らかにする
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクのペスト研究所職員が原因不明の急速進行性肺炎で死亡し、試験管破損によるバイオセーフティ違反の疑いがあるなど異常性が高く、肺ペストであればヒト-ヒト感染拡大のリスクも指摘されているためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 主題はロシア・イルクーツクの研究所職員死亡事例だが、ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。マダガスカル・DRC・ペルー・中国・モンゴル・米国への言及は世界的なペスト流行状況の背景説明であり、本イベントの発生国ではないため除外した。WHOはイルクーツク中〜低リスク、ロシア低リスク、欧州は非常に低リスクと評価し、接触者は全員モニター下で無症状とされている。

article.articleHeadline: 사상 첫 에볼라 확진자 나온 케냐, 확산방지 비상
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya reports its first Ebola patient; emergency measures to curb the spread.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first Ebola virus disease case and death, triggering emergency measures as of Oct 7, 2026. President William Ruto convened the National Security Council to assess the situation and broaden response. The government quarantined eight relatives of the deceased and 21 healthcare workers who treated him, with daily symptom monitoring; contact tracing was expanded to 27 airline passengers who shared his flight, with public health actions implemented. Kenya has been monitoring Ebola since May after outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. Hospitals designated for Ebola treatment include Nairobi’s Kenya National Hospital, National Police Hospital, and Nairobi Hospital, with regional isolation facilities established. The patient, a Kenyan who had lived in DRC for seven years, traveled by land to Uganda and flew into Nairobi on Oct 3, dying on Oct 5 after testing positive. Experts criticized border screening and lax control; calls to trace contacts in Uganda followed. This marks Kenya’s first confirmed Ebola case.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで史上初のエボラ確定患者、拡散防止へ緊急事態
triage.triage_reason: ケニア初のエボラ確定例・死亡が発生し、国家安全保障会議招集、航空機同乗者27名の接触者追跡など国際的拡大リスクが高く、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアにおける初のエボラ確定例であり、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。DRC・ウガンダでの過去の流行は背景情報として言及されているのみで、本記事の主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : la Croix-Rouge réceptionne trois motos pour la riposte contre Ebola à Bafwasende - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: The Red Cross receives three motorcycles for the Ebola response in Bafwasende - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Three motorcycles, including a triporteur, were delivered to the Bafwasende Red Cross committee in Kisangani’s northeast region of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Tshopo Province) to bolster the Ebola virus disease (EVD) response. The vehicles, sourced from Ituri and arranged by Red Cross leadership, will enhance field mobility across the vast Bafwasende territory, which borders Ituri—the epicentre of the current 17th Ebola outbreak. Red Cross volunteers will focus on community sensitisation and the safe and dignified burials (EDS) component of the response. The article does not report any case or death counts. This equipment boost reflects ongoing decentralized public health efforts in northeastern DRC to curb transmission and support frontline responders. Published 2026-10-07.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州：赤十字がバフワセンデでのエボラ対応のためバイク3台を受領 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中の第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する現地対応強化の報告であり、疾病の重篤性・国際拡大リスクからフルリスク評価の対象とすべきと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事自体は新規症例・死亡数を報告しておらず、既存の第17次エボラ流行への資機材支援（バイク配備）に関するロジスティクス報告。アウトブレイク自体は既知のため、続報での症例動向の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Inside Russia's 'anti‑plague' lab as forgotten site lists deadly germ research
article.articleSummary: As of 7 October 2026, claims of a pneumonic plague accident at Irkutsk’s Antiplague Research Institute of Siberia and the Far East triggered illness and death in 28-year-old technician Darya Shipilova. The alleged incident involved a test tube containing live Yersinia pestis; Shipilova reportedly died days later. Authorities deny a leak, citing pneumonia of unknown etiology and tests finding no pathogens linked to her work. The institute, part of Rospotrebnadzor, monitors dangerous infections across Siberia and the Far East and lists plague among studied pathogens (alongside cholera, anthrax, brucellosis, tularemia, arboviruses). It employs 95 researchers and was founded on 5 June 1934 to track natural plague reservoirs in rodents and fleas across Siberia and Mongolia. The site notes international activities with Mongolia and China and promotes the 18th CIS conference on preventing plague import/spread on 21–22 October 2026. Biosecurity experts warn of dual-use risks.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの『抗ペスト』研究所の内部―忘れられた施設が危険な病原体研究をリストアップ
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの研究所で肺ペスト疑いによる技師の死亡が報じられ、当局は否定しているものの、致死性病原体の管理・バイオセキュリティに関する社会的関心が高いため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 事件はロシア（イルクーツク）で発生したとされ、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。中国・モンゴルは研究所の国際協力先として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地ではない。当局は漏洩を否定しており、死因は未確定（原因不明の肺炎とされる）。デュアルユースリスクへの専門家の警告があり、続報・公式発表の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: How airlines could help contain Russian plague using lessons from past outbreaks
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague death in Russia—potentially linked to a lab technician at the Irkutsk Antiplague Research Institute of Siberia and the Far East—highlights airlines as an informal frontline for detecting and containing infectious diseases. Plague is rarely contagious until severe illness, but a wider outbreak remains plausible if undetected. Airlines perform passive passenger surveillance and there is growing interest in flight- and airport-based measures, including wastewater testing and planned air sampling. CDC-led plane wastewater testing began as a JFK pilot in 2022 and has expanded to other domestic airports; a Qantas-University of Queensland proposal envisions worldwide aircraft wastewater genomic surveillance for early warning, though experts warn it could be too late for fast-spreading pathogens. Historical U.S. actions include 42-day quarantines for 18 Americans from a Dutch Andes hantavirus cruise and Do Not Board or 21-day incubation-based entry measures for travelers linked to Congo Ebola and Uganda/South Sudan outbreaks. Direct Russia–U.S. flights are limited, but hub routes remain a concern.

triage.headline_ja: 航空会社はいかにしてロシアのペストを封じ込めることができるか：過去のアウトブレイクからの教訓
triage.triage_reason: 本事例はロシア・イルクーツクの研究所関連と見られる肺ペスト死亡例であり、対象国（CEPR監視対象の11か国）に該当する発生は確認されない。ヒト-ヒト感染拡大の明確な証拠もなく、航空機を介した将来的な対策議論が主題であるため、現時点でのピックアップは見送る。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアでの研究所関連の肺ペスト死亡例を背景に、航空機・空港での検疫・下水サーベイランスなど過去の事例（オランダ発ハンタウイルス、コンゴ・ウガンダのエボラ）を紹介する内容。対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）における現在進行中の発生は確認されず、DRC・ウガンダは過去の参考事例として言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Tchomia : un chef coutumier propose d'impliquer directement les zones de santé - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Tchomia: a traditional chief proposes to directly involve the health zones - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 7 October 2026 in Tchomia, Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, Yves Kahwa Panga, chief of the Bahema Banywagi chiefdom in Djugu territory, proposed that Ebola response authorities involve health zones directly in interventions. He argued this would bring actions closer to communities, especially in enclaved, hard-to-reach areas, since health zones already work with traditional leaders and have community relay networks to disseminate prevention messages. Direct involvement, without intermediaries, could align resources with on-the-ground needs and facilitate collaboration with customary authorities. He also noted logistical resource constraints hampering the Tchomia response. The report centers on Ebola in Tchomia and calls for adjusting operational structure to leverage health zones' community networks.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱対応:伝統首長がトショミアで保健圏の直接関与を提案
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク対応に関する報道であり、エボラは重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威かつ国際的拡大リスクを伴う疾患であるためIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行そのものの新規発生情報ではなく、既存の対応体制改善に関する地元指導者の提言。ロジスティクス資源不足による対応の困難さが指摘されており、継続中のアウトブレイクであることが示唆される。既知の進行中アウトブレイクとしての文脈確認が必要。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Virus Super Flu H3N2, Dinkes Madiun Minta Warga Lakukan Hal Ini
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be on the lookout for the H3N2 Super Flu Virus, Madiun Health Office Urges Residents to Do This
article.articleSummary: Influenza A(H3N2) subclade K, nicknamed the 'super flu,' is under watch in Indonesia, with Madiun City's Health Office reporting no local cases yet. Dinkes-PPKB Kota Madiun urges people to reinforce health protocols and hygiene practices, especially handwashing before meals, after activities, and before touching the face. National monitoring shows the circulating virus remains seasonal influenza, with no reports of severe illness, ventilator use, or deaths. Prevention remains essential, as dry air and lower humidity can facilitate transmission, alongside maintaining immune health. Local healthcare facilities are prepared to manage influenza cases per standard procedures. While vigilance is advised, authorities emphasize this is still a seasonal pattern, not a pandemic, and no cases have been confirmed in Madiun so far.

triage.headline_ja: H3N2スーパーフルウイルスに警戒を、マディウン保健局が住民に注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: H3N2「スーパーフル」の警戒情報だが、マディウン市では症例未確認であり、全国的にも季節性インフルエンザの範囲内で重症例報告なし。現時点でピックアップ基準には達しないが継続監視が望ましい。
triage.notes: 記事は『super flu』という俗称による注意喚起であり、実際の症例や重症化事例は報告されていない。当局はパンデミックではなく季節性パターンと説明。続報で感染拡大や重症例の有無を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: No travel restrictions after Kenya Ebola case
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms a single imported Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease case, announced on 6 October by Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale. The patient fell ill in the Democratic Republic of Congo, travelled to Uganda, and flew to Nairobi on 3 October, where he was isolated at Nairobi Hospital and died on 5 October. The Ministry of Health identified 28 contacts (family and health workers) and is tracing 23 passengers and four crew members from the same flight, with quarantine measures underway for those at risk. The case has been notified to WHO under International Health Regulations; WHO advises against travel restrictions on Kenya, Uganda, or the DRC. Kenya has maintained a heightened Ebola alert since the outbreak began in May. ATTA notes Ebola is not airborne and stresses continued monitoring; Kenya, Uganda and Rwanda remain open to international travellers.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアのエボラ症例、渡航制限なし
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の輸入症例でWHOへIHR通報済み、死亡例・接触者追跡・隔離措置があり、DRCでの進行中アウトブレイクに関連するため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 症例はケニアで確認・死亡したが、感染地はDRCであり、5月以降続くDRCのエボラアウトブレイクに関連する輸入症例。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ചി​ക്ക​ൻ​പോ​ക്സ് പ​ട​രു​ന്നു; കൊ​ച്ചി കു​സാ​റ്റ് ക്യാ​മ്പ​സ് അ​ട​ച്ചു | Deepika | The Largest Read Malayalam Internet Daily | Online News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chickenpox spreads; Kochi's CUSAT Campus shut down.
article.articleSummary: Cochin University of Science and Technology (CUSAT) campus in Kochi, Kerala, has closed due to a chickenpox outbreak. In response to the spread, classes were moved entirely online and hostels shut. Several days of fever and malaise were reported among students, and two students have been laboratory-confirmed with chickenpox. After initial online shifts in the School of Engineering, authorities expanded closures as cases increased. The campus closure also leads to postponement of the upcoming student union elections, with a new date to be announced. The report notes heightened vigilance on campus. No deaths are reported. The outbreak is currently centered at the CUSAT campus in Kochi, with two confirmed cases and ongoing monitoring of the wider student body.

triage.headline_ja: 水痘が拡大；コーチのCUSATキャンパスが閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: 水痘は既知の疾患で国際的拡大や重篤性のリスクは低く、大学内の限定的アウトブレイクでIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当しない。
triage.notes: 死亡例なし、確認症例は2名のみ。大学の自主的措置として学級閉鎖・オンライン化が行われているが、公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi Records 98 Dengue Cases In First Week Of October, 2026 Tally Reaches 695 - The Logical Indian
article.articleSummary: Delhi’s 2026 dengue activity remains high in October: 98 new dengue cases in the first week (week ending Oct 3) raise the annual tally to 695. In the same week, malaria is 23 cases (annual total 266) and chikungunya 2 cases (annual total 29). No dengue or malaria deaths have been reported in 2026. September recorded 286 dengue and 124 malaria cases, marking monthly highs. The Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) notes continued vector-control efforts: over 3.18 crore household visits and breeding detected in more than 1.89 lakh homes; 132,172 legal notices, 20,882 prosecutions, penalties totaling Rs 29.70 lakh. Transmission persists post-monsoon under warm, humid conditions, so risk remains as monsoon ends. Preventive guidance includes eliminating standing water, mosquito protection indoors, and seeking medical care for high fever and related symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: デリーで10月第1週にデング熱98件、2026年累計695件に到達
triage.triage_reason: デリーで例年みられる季節性デング熱・マラリアの流行で死亡例報告なく深刻度は限定的だが、ベクター媒介感染症の継続的発生状況として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 死亡例は報告されておらず、MCDによるベクター対策が継続的に実施されている季節性流行。モンスーン明けの感染持続が懸念されるため経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: شمار قربانیان ابولا در جمهوری دموکراتیک کنگو به 4 هزار و 178 نفر رسید
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 4,178.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 8,665 confirmed cases and 4,178 deaths since May 15, with 2,259 recoveries. The outbreak spans 64 districts across 7 provinces, CFR 48.2%, and 80.4% of identified contacts are being followed. In the last 24 hours, 24 more patients recovered. The circulating Bundibugyo Ebola strain has no approved treatment or vaccine. Ebola was first identified in 1976 in Sudan and the DRC; the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak caused over 11,000 deaths.
