triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ死者数が4,178人に達した
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例8,665件、死者4,178人（致死率48.2%）に達する大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクであり、7州64地区に拡大、承認された治療薬・ワクチンがないため深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事中のスーダン・アンゴラへの言及は1976年の初発見に関する歴史的記述であり、現在のアウトブレイクの発生地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。承認されたワクチン・治療薬がないBundibugyo株による深刻な流行であり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola stvara nova žarišta u Kongu, odgovor na terenu opisan kao haotičan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola creates new hotspots in Congo, with the on-the-ground response described as chaotic.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo creates new hotspots with little patient support. More than 70% of new cases occur outside known contacts, and at least 60% of deaths happen outside treatment centers. North Kivu has become the epidemic’s new epicenter, now about 40% of all newly confirmed cases, up from 24% at the end of August. MSF’s Stephanie Hoffmann calls the field response chaotic, citing poor coordination and limited actors. The Bundibugyo-virus outbreak—the deadliest in Congo—has no approved vaccine or treatment; government data report more than 8,500 cases. Kenya reported its first case, a man arriving from Congo who died in treatment. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya highlights contact tracing challenges (only 23% of expected contacts found). WHO notes shortages of staff and supplies at North Kivu centers; the CFR there is 58%, highest among seven provinces, with spread to half of 34 health zones.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが新たな感染集積地を形成、現地対応は『混沌』と評される
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(Bundibugyoウイルス)がワクチン・治療薬のないまま拡大し、ケニアへの越境例も発生。致死率58%、接触者追跡率23%と対応能力の限界が示されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただし国際的拡大の証拠として本文に記載。

article.articleHeadline: ചിക്കൻപോക്സ് വ്യാപനം; കൊച്ചി കുസാറ്റ് ക്യാമ്പസ് അടച്ചു, എല്ലാ ക്ലാസുകളും ഓൺലൈനിലേക്ക് മാറ്റി
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chickenpox outbreak; Kochi CUSAT campus closed, all classes moved online.
article.articleSummary: Chickenpox outbreak forces closure of the Kochi CUSAT campus on 7 October 2026. Following confirmed chickenpox cases, the Cochin University of Science and Technology campus in Kochi shut down the campus, moved all classes online, and closed hostels. Union elections have been postponed with a new date to be announced. In the days prior, several students reported fever and malaise, prompting heightened precautions. Two students were confirmed positive for chickenpox, after which classes for students in the School of Engineering were moved online. With renewed illness among students, campus authorities closed the facility to prevent further spread and safeguard housing facilities. No details on infection source or imported/exported cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 水痘の流行拡大；コチのCUSATキャンパスが閉鎖、全授業がオンラインに移行
triage.triage_reason: 水痘は一般的な既知の感染症であり、局地的な大学キャンパスでの小規模発生であるため、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生上の脅威とは考えにくい。
triage.notes: 水痘（Varicella）は一般的に既知の感染症であり、ヒト-ヒト感染は起こりうるが重症度は低い。大学単位での局地的対応であり、国際的な懸念事項には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 'I got so scared': Nairobi residents worried after Kenya's first Ebola death
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease, first confirmed death in Kenya, after a 40-year-old Kenyan businessman returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC)—where the Bundibugyo-strain outbreak has produced over 8,000 cases since May. The patient fell ill about a month ago, was treated in DRC, then travelled overland to Kampala before flying to Nairobi on Oct 3; he died on Monday. Kenyan authorities have identified 28 contacts (family and healthcare workers); none have tested positive so far. WHO data as of Oct 2 report 4,082 deaths among 8,463 cases linked to the DRC outbreak, with no vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo. Kenya, which has never before reported an Ebola case, urges calm and vigilance as authorities implement measures to mitigate spread.

triage.headline_ja: 『本当に怖くなった』：ケニア初のエボラ死亡例を受け、ナイロビ住民に不安広がる
triage.triage_reason: ケニア史上初のエボラ死亡例であり、DRCの大規模流行（8,463症例・4,082死亡）由来の国境を越えた伝播事例であるため、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニア初のエボラ死亡例だが、感染源であるDRCの大規模流行（8,463症例、4,082死亡、Bundibugyo株）の具体的な最新統計が記載されているため、DRCを発生国として含めた。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Strikes Kenya, 1 Dead, 10 Quarantined - Taarifa Rwanda:
article.articleSummary: Ebola strike in Kenya: 1 death, 10 contacts quarantined. The victim, who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo for 11 years, traveled from Beni, DRC to Kisangani, then to Beni, Uganda, and boarded a Jambojet flight to Nairobi, arriving Oct 3. He developed fever, chills, and bleeding under the skin and was isolated at Nairobi Hospital; he died, Kenya’s first Ebola-linked death. Ten contacts have been quarantined. President William Ruto says surveillance and rapid response teams are on the ground, leveraging systems adopted after the DR Congo outbreak in May. Authorities report more than 650,000 travellers screened and 267 samples tested; the article provides no lab-confirmation details. Key locations: Beni, Kisangani, Buta (DRC); Uganda; Nairobi, Kenya."

triage.headline_ja: エボラがケニアを襲う、1人死亡、10人が隔離 - タアリファ・ルワンダ
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで初のエボラ関連死亡例が発生し、DRC・ウガンダを経由した国際的な渡航歴を伴う輸入症例であるため、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 患者はDRC在住歴11年でDRC(ベニ)→ウガンダ経由でケニア(ナイロビ)に入国後発症・死亡。発生自体はケニアで確認されたものであり、DRCは患者の出身地・経由地としての言及にとどまり、DRC国内での新規発生報告はないため、対象国リストに該当するケニアは非対象国、DRCは主題の発生地でないため verified_locations は空とした。検査確定の詳細は記事内になく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya, 10 persone in quarantena dopo la prima vittima da virus ebola - Medicina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya, 10 people in quarantine after the first Ebola virus victim - Medicine
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports the first Bundibugyo strain Ebola death, with 57 contacts identified and 10 quarantined as of 2026-10-07. The deceased arrived in Nairobi on 2026-10-03 from Uganda aboard a Jambojet flight and died in hospital after testing positive for Ebola. Authorities have intensified entry screening and ongoing contact tracing, cautioning that the number of contacts may rise. The World Health Organization advises against broad travel or trade restrictions with Kenya, Uganda, and the Democratic Republic of Congo, underscoring the importance of early diagnosis, isolation, and contact tracing. The Congo outbreak, from which the Kenyan case was imported, has surpassed 8,000 cases and 4,000 deaths. Imported cases highlight cross-border transmission risks and the need for coordinated surveillance and public health response.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラウイルスによる最初の死亡者後に10人が隔離
triage.triage_reason: DRCで拡大中のエボラ（8,000例超・4,000人超死亡）がウガンダ経由でケニアに越境輸入され死亡例が発生、接触者57人・隔離10人と国際的拡大リスクが明確なため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの輸入症例だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは感染源となっている進行中のアウトブレイク（8,000例超・4,000人超死亡）として具体的データとともに主題的に扱われているため含めた。ウガンダも対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Rusia emite nueva declaración sobre la alarma de peste que tiene en alerta al mundo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia issues a new statement about the plague alert that has the world on high alert.
article.articleSummary: Russia confronted media coverage of reports of a second suspected pneumonic plague case in Siberia, calling most reporting 'false information.' The United States, the World Health Organization, and the European Union urged Moscow to act transparently. The WHO director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus asked for clarification about reports that a second employee has pneumonia of unknown origin. Daria Shipilova, 28, a staff member at the Irkutsk Institute for the Fight Against Plague, reportedly died of plague, with media alleging a broken test tube could have caused pneumonic transmission; up to 200 contacts were quarantined. President Vladimir Putin’s spokesman said only statements from Russia's Rospotrebnadzor should be trusted and that Moscow had informed the WHO. China said there are close exchanges with Russia on disease prevention and control; the US CDC is monitoring the case.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、世界を警戒させているペスト警報について新たな声明を発表
triage.triage_reason: シベリアでの肺ペスト疑い死亡例とWHO・米・EUの透明性要求など、深刻性と異常性の両面でIHR基準に2つ以上該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（シベリア・イルクーツク州）であり、対象国リストには含まれないためverified_locationsは空。中国はロシアとの情報交換に言及されているのみで、発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: РУСИЈА И КИНА ВЕЖБАЛЕ ВНЕСУВАЊЕ ЧУМА И "БОЛЕСТ ИКС" Вежбата се одржала еден месец пред случајот со чума во Иркутск - plusinfo.mk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia and China practiced introducing plague and 'Disease X'. The exercise took place one month before the plague case in Irkutsk - plusinfo.mk.
article.articleSummary: Russia–China conducted a cross-border infectious-disease exercise Aug 24–27, 2026 in Fuzhou, Fujian, near the Russian border, involving 300 health and epidemiology personnel, 19 Chinese teams. Three scenarios: (1) identification of an unknown tick-borne disease dubbed 'Disease X' with sampling, metagenomic sequencing, disinfection, surveillance, and cross-border risk assessment; (2) simulated importation of bubonic plague with information exchange, pathogen identification, risk assessment, and coordinated use of mobile anti-epidemic laboratories; (3) a major flood requiring sanitary protection and emergency medical response. The exercise aimed to validate rapid deployment of mobile labs and coordinated response between Russia's Rospotrebnadzor and Chinese authorities. Sergei Balakhonov, director of Irkutsk's Plague Institute, attended as a speaker. Local media report 28-year-old Daria Shipilova fell ill and died Oct 2 from pneumonia of unknown origin; three hospitals and 200+ people were quarantined; no plague pathogen found among contacts. China and Russia stated ongoing communication on infectious diseases, including plague.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアと中国がペストと「疾病X」の国境越え侵入を想定した合同演習を実施。演習はイルクーツクでのペスト疑い症例の1か月前に行われた
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は中露共同の感染症対応演習（ペスト・疾病Xの模擬シナリオ）であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクではない。イルクーツクでの死亡例もペスト病原体は検出されておらず、確認された実際の発生事例は存在しない。
triage.notes: 記事は中露共同演習（模擬シナリオ）と、ロシア・イルクーツクでの原因不明肺炎による死亡例（ペスト病原体陰性）を扱った陰謀論的な報道。中国で実際のペスト発生は報告されておらず、ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。続報があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: Brasil intensifica ações face a avanço nos EUA e nas Américas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: Brazil intensifies actions in response to the surge in the U.S. and the Americas.
article.articleSummary: Measles in Brazil prompts intensified public health actions as the country counters surges in the United States and the Americas. In 2026, four large vaccination mobilizations in São Paulo state (including the capital, Guarulhos, São Bernardo do Campo, Santo André) and Amazonas delivered over 3.8 million and about 192,000 doses respectively, alongside active case finding, epidemiological investigations, contact tracing, and vaccine blocking. Brazil remains free of endemic measles transmission despite imported cases; PAHO/UNICEF report 85 confirmed cases from 2023–2025 with no deaths. First-dose measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) coverage reached 93.1% nationwide in 2025, 94.4% in São Paulo, and 89.5% in Amazonas. Since 2023, overall vaccination coverage increased across the 16-dose child calendar, and vaccines are provided free through the Unified Health System (SUS). In the Brazil–Colombia–Peru tri-border region, intensified measures include vaccination, active searching, sampling, contact follow-up, and vaccine blockade with federal support.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹:ブラジル、米国およびアメリカ大陸での感染拡大を受け対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルは麻疹の地域内伝播が確立していない状態を維持しており、死亡例もないが、米州全体での増加を受けた予防的対策強化が報じられており、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ブラジルは2023-2025年で85例の輸入症例のみで死亡なし、地域内伝播はない。ワクチン接種率も高水準（全国93.1%）。記事はコロンビア・ペルーとの国境地帯での対策にも言及しているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Tangsel Perkuat Pemantauan Penyebaran Influenza A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Tangerang Strengthens Surveillance of the Spread of Influenza A
article.articleSummary: Eight laboratory-confirmed Influenza A cases were detected in South Tangerang City between August 19 and September 15, 2026, prompting strengthened surveillance. The cases were identified through Sentinel Influenza-Like Illness (ILI) reporting at Puskesmas Serpong 1 and logged via the New Alla Record app. Specimens were tested at the Jakarta Public Health Laboratory; all patients presented ILI symptoms, including fever of 38°C or higher, cough, runny nose, and sore throat. The Early Detection and Response System recorded 256 ILI cases in week 36, but officials note ILI is a syndrome caused by various viruses and does not automatically indicate Influenza A. Surveillance will continue through health facilities, especially primary care clinics, with enhanced cross-sector coordination. Mayor Benyamin Davnie urged calm and urged people with respiratory symptoms to seek medical evaluation; monitoring will remain ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: 南タンゲラン市、インフルエンザA型の拡大に対する監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性インフルエンザA型の検出事例であり、重症度や異常性を示す情報はないが、継続的な監視対象として経過観察する。
triage.notes: 確認された8例は季節性インフルエンザA型の通常範囲内と考えられ、ILI症例数の増加も複数ウイルスに起因する可能性が指摘されている。市当局は冷静な対応を呼びかけており、現時点で重大な公衆衛生上の脅威とは判断されない。

article.articleHeadline: Surgen nuevos focos de ébola en Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola Outbreaks Emerge in Congo.
article.articleSummary: New Ebola outbreaks are emerging in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in North Kivu, now representing about 40% of new confirmed cases, up from 24% in August, amid conflict-driven movement and weak on-the-ground response. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus (for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment), has surpassed 8,500 cases and 4,000 deaths as of 7 October 2026, making it the fastest-growing and deadliest in the country. Case-fatality in North Kivu is 58%, the highest among seven affected provinces, with transmission extending to about half of Congo’s 34 health zones. Contact tracing remains limited (about 23%), and at least 70% of new infections involve people not among known contacts; more than 60% of deaths occur outside treatment centers. Kenya reported its first Ebola case—a traveler from Congo who died in treatment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで新たなエボラ出血熱の感染集団が発生
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株、ワクチン・治療薬なし）が8,500例・4,000人超の死者を記録し致死率58%と深刻化、ケニアへの越境感染も確認されたためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニアでの症例はコンゴからの渡航者による輸入例であり、対象国リストにケニアが含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Campinas registra três novos casos de gripe - Portal Veloz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas reports three new cases of influenza - Portal Veloz.
article.articleSummary: Campinas reports three new cases of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) caused by influenza this week, bringing 2026 SRAG totals to 380 cases and 34 deaths. In 2025, the city recorded 561 SRAG cases and 69 deaths from influenza, with 54 deaths among the unvaccinated. Vaccination is available for everyone from 6 months of age at 69 health centers; no appointment is required. The vaccine protects against influenza A (H1N1 and H3N2) and B this year and can be administered with other vaccines in the National Immunization Schedule. Preventive measures include hand hygiene, well-ventilated spaces, hydration, a healthy diet, and wearing a mask when symptomatic. From March 28 to October 5, Campinas administered 382,210 influenza vaccine doses, including 177,132 to the defined target groups (elderly 129,892; children 6 months to under 6 years 39,318; pregnant 7,922). Access expanded to all ages from June 1; more details at the city vaccination site.

triage.headline_ja: カンピーナスでインフルエンザの新規3症例を記録 - Portal Veloz
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザによる通常の公衆衛生報告であり、ワクチン接種推進の広報的内容。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1/H3N2）による重症急性呼吸器症候群（SRAG）の年次報告であり、既知の疾患・既存の対策（ワクチン接種）で管理されている。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列とする。

article.articleHeadline: Возможную вспышку чумы в России обсуждают по всему миру, а Трамп даже собрался позвонить по этому поводу Путину. Неужели все так серьезно? Объясняем коротко, почему повода для паники нет -- Meduza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A possible plague outbreak in Russia is being discussed worldwide, and Trump even planned to call Putin about it. Could it be that it's really that serious? We explain briefly why there's no reason to panic — Meduza.
article.articleSummary: Possible plague outbreak in the Russian Federation draws global attention after a researcher at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute died; authorities have not confirmed plague, but if confirmed it would be Russia’s first such case since 2016. US President Trump plans to call Vladimir Putin; the EU health-security committee will discuss; Mongolia and China have asked Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor for more information. WHO has requested data on Irkutsk Oblast and assesses the risk as low for Russians and very low for Europeans, reflecting limited human-to-human transmission. Contacts of the deceased scientist are quarantined; antibiotics are effective when started early, and vaccination is available in Russia. The main concern is lack of clear official Russian communications; Tedros emphasized the need for transparent information exchange. US officials cite limited data; the State Department is considering a diplomatic note.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでのペスト発生疑いが世界中で議論に、トランプ大統領はプーチン氏に電話をかける予定 — パニックになる理由がない理由を簡潔に説明（Meduza）
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクでペスト（疑い）による研究者の死亡例が発生し、2016年以来のロシア国内初症例の可能性があり、トランプ米大統領やWHO、EU、モンゴル・中国を含む国際的な注目を集めているため、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を満たしPICKUPと判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（イルクーツク州）であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空。中国・モンゴルはロシアに情報提供を求めている立場であり、発生国ではないため除外。WHOはロシア国民へのリスクを低、欧州へのリスクを非常に低いと評価しているが、公式情報の不透明さが懸念材料とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Indonezia introduce controale sanitare la frontieră din cauza ciumei din Rusia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indonesia introduces health checks at the border due to the plague from Russia.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia tightens border health checks due to plague linked to Russia after the death of a laboratory worker at Irkutsk's Institute for Research in Siberia and the Far East; nearly 200 people exposed are monitored. WHO has not issued a travel/vigilance notice; Indonesia intensifies screening at airports and seaports, including Bali, with health declarations, symptom screening, arrival risk assessments, and rodent and flea surveillance. Symptomatic arrivals (fever, cough, shortness of breath) may be referred to specialized infectious disease hospitals for isolation and treatment. As of 2026-10-07, Russian authorities say all contacts identified; no symptoms among them. Russian investigation is considering pneumonic plague as cause of death; Rospotrebnadzor reports Irkutsk region and Irkutsk/Shelekhov remain stable, no urgent handling concerns in the institute or pathogens in samples. Risk of wider spread is deemed low; pneumonic plague is not easily transmitted and is treatable with antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア、ロシアでのペスト感染を受けて国境での衛生検査を導入
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染事例はロシア（イルクーツク）の研究所職員1名の死亡であり対象国外。インドネシアは予防的な国境検疫強化を実施しているのみで、対象国内での発生は確認されていない。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア（イルクーツク州）であり対象国リストに含まれない。インドネシア（バリ含む）は国境での予防的スクリーニング強化を実施しているのみで、インドネシア国内での感染事例は報告されていないため verified_locations は空配列とする。ロシア当局は接触者全員を特定済みで症状なし、拡大リスクは低いと評価されている。

article.articleHeadline: Монголия затяга контрола по границата с Русия заради чума
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mongolia Tightens Border Controls with Russia Over Plague.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 October 2026, Mongolia tightened border controls with Russia after reports that a Siberian laboratory worker died from plague. Mongolia’s health ministry ordered enhanced border health surveillance, while risk is currently deemed low with ongoing monitoring to prevent potential transmission. Border points in Selenge Province continue operating but under intensified health checks. Russian authorities report the deceased as a 28-year-old laboratory technician; the cause is listed as pneumonia and undetermined, with no epidemiological risk to the population observed by Russian health authorities. The situation is epidemiologically relevant due to Irkutsk Oblast’s capital receiving many visitors from China traveling to Lake Baikal. China and Russia claim close cooperation in infection prevention. The World Health Organization is cooperating with Russian authorities; initial risk assessments are low for Russia and very low for Europe.

triage.headline_ja: モンゴル、ペストを懸念してロシアとの国境管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・シベリアでの研究員のペストによる死亡を受け、モンゴルが国境での健康管理を強化しており、IHR基準の「異常・予想外」及び「渡航制限」の2項目に該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべきと判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（イルクーツク州）および国境対応を取るモンゴルであり、中国は観光客経由の文脈的言及のみで発生地ではないため、対象国リストに該当する国はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo: Kampf gegen ein Virus - und für Akzeptanz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Outbreak in the Congo: The Fight Against a Virus - and for Acceptance.
article.articleSummary: 8,603 people infected with Bundibugyo virus Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 4,148 deaths and 2,235 recovered (case fatality 48.2%). About a quarter of cases are under 18, and mortality for under-5s is 61%. The outbreak, officially ongoing since May, is the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record, smaller than West Africa's 2014–2016 epidemic (over 11,000 deaths, ~28,000 infections). Seven provinces are affected with dispersed hotspots, complicating containment. Initially no vaccines; since July, trials include Ervebo, a vaccine for a different Ebola type. MSF highlights funding shortfalls, high costs of PPE and supplies, armed conflict, and public mistrust as major barriers. Contact tracing is insufficient, hindering transmission interruption. Worst-case risk includes spread to Kinshasa. A Congo-based worker who traveled via Uganda to Nairobi, Kenya, died of Bundibugyo virus, illustrating cross-border transmission. Aid funding cuts, including USAID, complicate the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行：ウイルスとの戦い、そして受容を得るための戦い
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上2番目に大きいエボラ(ブンディブギョ種)流行が継続中で致死率48.2%、ケニアへの越境感染例も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: ケニア(Nairobi)・ウガンダは越境感染事例の文脈で言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。資金不足（USAID削減含む）や接触追跡の不備が懸念材料として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Peste pneumônica: entenda a doença que causou alerta na Rússia e por que o risco de epidemia é baixo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumonic plague: understand the disease that caused an alert in Russia and why the risk of an epidemic is low.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, is in focus after the death of Russian lab technician Daria Shipilova in Irkutsk. The infection, unlike bubonic form, spreads by droplets and causes a rapidly progressing pneumonia. Incubation is 1–3 days, sometimes as short as 24 hours; symptoms include shortness of breath and a cough with blood-tinged sputum. Prompt antibiotics are critical, ideally started within the first 15 hours after symptom onset, even before lab results. Russia says Shipilova died of pneumonia of undetermined origin and found no pathogens linked to her work; the WHO has asked Moscow for clarification. Risk assessments place Irkutsk at moderate-to-low risk, Russia at low, and Europe at very low. The disease historically circulated via rats and unsanitary conditions, but current large outbreaks are unlikely; Brazil reports natural plague foci in the Northeast and Teresópolis, Rio de Janeiro.

triage.headline_ja: 肺ペスト：ロシアで警戒を引き起こした疾患の正体と、流行リスクが低いとされる理由
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクで検査技師が原因不明の肺炎で死亡し肺ペストが疑われているが、ロシア当局は病原体未検出と発表し、WHOが説明を求めている段階で確定情報が不足している。リスク評価も低〜非常に低いとされ、現時点でIHR基準の複数該当は確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア（イルクーツク）での死亡例であり、対象国リストに該当する国（ブラジル等）は歴史的な自然発生地の紹介として言及されているのみで、現行の発生事例ではないため verified_locations には含めていない。ロシア自体は対象国リストに含まれていない。続報でWHOの調査結果・病原体確定情報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: QR-CODE GAP: Did Kenya's Ebola screening system fail the test?
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first imported Bundibugyo Ebola case in a Kenyan citizen who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo for seven years, prompting scrutiny of border screening. A traveler arriving from DRC said she saw stationary temperature checks but no QR-code health screening at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport (JKIA), unlike QR-based screening experienced in DRC and Ethiopia. The report highlights uncertainty whether Kenya's QR-code system was operational on the day, raising questions about the consistency of border surveillance for passengers from Ebola-affected areas. Separately, Uhai, an AI health assistant for Ebola information, was tested to screen travelers; it moved to a screening prompt after a generic pass request, underscoring concerns about risk-information capture timing. Ebola incubation is 2-21 days, and digital screening is an additional surveillance layer, not a substitute for clinical assessment, lab testing, or contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: QRコードの欠落：ケニアのエボラ検疫システムは機能しなかったのか？
triage.triage_reason: DRCで続いているエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の症例がケニアに輸入され、国境検疫の不備が指摘されており、国際的な感染拡大と公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの輸入エボラ症例とその検疫体制の不備だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であるDRCでの継続的なエボラ流行が背景にあるためDRCのみを記載。ケニア国内の症例自体はDRCの流行の波及事例として国際的拡大のリスクを示す重要な情報。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya tightens JKIA Ebola controls, sets dedicated gate for travellers from 10 African countries
article.articleSummary: Kenya tightens Ebola controls at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport (JKIA) after confirming the country's first imported Bundibugyo Ebola case, with a fatality in Nairobi. A dedicated Gate 16 will process travellers from 10 higher-risk African countries—DR Congo, Uganda, Burundi, Rwanda, Ethiopia, South Sudan, Angola, Central African Republic, Zambia, and Tanzania—for enhanced screening. Travellers must provide verified health information and disclose medicines taken in the prior month. Health declaration forms will also be required from departing passengers to maintain a departure health status record. Kenyan authorities urge reduced physical contact and revival of COVID-era precautions, such as avoiding handshakes and hugs. The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention commended Kenya's response, while surveillance at the main international gateway aims to prevent additional transmission as authorities work to manage the imported case.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、ジョモ・ケニヤッタ国際空港（JKIA）でエボラ対策を強化、アフリカ10カ国からの渡航者向け専用ゲートを設置
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスによる輸入症例・死亡例が確認され、空港での渡航者スクリーニング強化や専用ゲート設置など国際的対応が取られており、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアにおける輸入エボラ症例とその空港対応であり、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていない。スクリーニング対象として挙げられた10カ国（DRC、ザンビア含む）は渡航者監視の対象国であり、実際の発生国として明記されていないため verified_locations には含めなかった。
