article.articleHeadline: Novo caso de gripe aviária é confirmado em aves de subsistência no RS - BelosF7
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New case of avian influenza confirmed in backyard poultry in Rio Grande do Sul - BelosF7
article.articleSummary: New highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) case confirmed in backyard poultry in Selbach, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, on Oct 5, 2026. Diagnosis by the Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense in Campinas (LFDA-SP), OMSA reference. Investigation followed mortality notified Oct 1. The Rio Grande do Sul State Official Veterinary Service will conduct surveillance in 68 properties within a 3-km radius, plus veterinary outreach and community education. Under OMSA rules, backyard poultry confirmation does not change Brazil’s sanitary status for commercial poultry production and does not trigger export suspensions. Alerts include respiratory problems, neurological signs, and sudden high mortality. Suspect cases should be reported to the nearest Inspectorate of Agricultural Defense or via WhatsApp (+55 51 98445-2033). People should avoid contact with sick, injured, or dead birds. Chicken meat and eggs remain safe to eat; the infection is not transmitted by consumption.

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデ・ド・スル州で新たな鳥インフルエンザ感染例（自給自足養鶏）が確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・リオグランデ・ド・スル州の自給自足(バックヤード)養鶏における高病原性鳥インフルエンザの一例であり、人への感染報告はなく、輸出停止等の貿易制限も発生しないことが明記されている。既存のサーベイランス体制下での通常の対応事例と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は家禽（バックヤード飼育）における鳥インフルエンザの発生報告であり、人への健康影響や国際的な拡大リスクの記載はない。OMSA基準により商業養鶏の衛生ステータスに変更はなく、輸出停止も発生しない旨が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : l'OMS salue les efforts du gouvernement provincial dans la riposte contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: WHO praises the provincial government's efforts in the Ebola response - ACP.
article.articleSummary: On 7 October 2026, the World Health Organization praised the Tshopo provincial government in North-East Democratic Republic of Congo for its Ebola response, following a meeting with the provincial governor in Kisangani. The WHO noted that a previously blocked issue—housing a treatment center—has been resolved, and a standardized Ebola Treatment Center is now in place. The delegation commended the province's leadership and stated that the response pillars remain operational in Tshopo. The WHO also aims to establish a permanent sub-office in Kisangani to sustain public health activities, particularly epidemic response, and requested a building in line with seat agreements signed with the Congolese state. No further outbreak details or case counts are provided.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州：WHOがエボラ対応における州政府の取り組みを称賛 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は本質的に重篤・異常な感染症であり、WHOが州政府の対応を評価する記事であることから継続的な監視が必要と判断される。ただし本記事自体に新規症例数等の疫学情報はない。
triage.notes: 本記事はエボラ対応の進捗報告（治療センター設置、WHO支所設立計画）であり、新規症例数や発生状況の詳細は含まれていない。既存のエボラ流行対応の一環として継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: الطاعون.. 3 أنواع للمرض وأعراض خطيرة وطرق العدوى والوقاية | صحة ومرأة | النهار
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Plague: 3 Types of the Disease, Serious Symptoms, Modes of Transmission, and Prevention | Health and Women | An-Nahar
article.articleSummary: Yersinia pestis causes plague and, as of 2026-10-07, remains rare but treatable with antibiotics when detected early. Three forms exist: bubonic plague, usually from flea bites or contact with infected animals, causing painful swelling of lymph nodes called buboes in the neck, armpit, or groin; septicemic plague, when bacteria reach the bloodstream and can progress from untreated bubonic disease, with high fever, severe weakness, abdominal pain, vomiting and diarrhea, bleeding, and blackening of extremities; and pneumonic plague, which infects the lungs and can spread between people via respiratory droplets, making it the most transmissible form if not treated promptly. Common symptoms include fever, chills, severe headache, muscle pain, fatigue, and swollen lymph nodes. Madagascar and Democratic Republic of the Congo report human cases, with limited cases in United States in western areas. Prevention includes flea control, avoiding contact with ill animals, safe handling of dead animals, and isolating pneumonic cases.

triage.headline_ja: ペスト：病気の3つの種類、深刻な症状、感染経路と予防法 | 健康と女性 | アル・ナハール
triage.triage_reason: ペストに関する一般的な健康教育記事であり、特定の新規アウトブレイクの詳細情報（症例数、死亡数、発生時期等）が不足しているため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 本記事はペストの一般的な医学解説記事であり、マダガスカル・コンゴ民主共和国・米国での症例報告に言及しているが、具体的な新規アウトブレイクのデータ（症例数、発生時期、死亡数等）は示されていない。対象国リストに含まれないマダガスカルと米国は除外し、コンゴ民主共和国のみをverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Ülkeyi ele geçiren salgın: Her geçen gün ağırlaşıyor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The epidemic that has seized the country: Worsening with each passing day.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has intensified, with 8,665 confirmed cases and 4,178 deaths across 7 provinces and 64 regions since the May 15 declaration in Ituri province. So far, 2,259 people have recovered; the case-fatality rate is 48.2% and the contact-tracing rate 80.4%. In the last 24 hours, 24 more patients recovered. Ebola, the viral hemorrhagic fever named after the Ebola River near the outbreak site, has a long history in Africa, including 1976 first identifications in Nzara, Sudan and Yambuku, DRC, and a 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak that infected about 30,000 and killed over 11,000. The initial signs appeared in May in eastern Ituri province with 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths before the eruption was declared. The circulating variant is Bundibugyo Ebola, for which no approved treatment or vaccine exists.

triage.headline_ja: 国を席巻する感染症：日に日に深刻化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が7州64地域に拡大し、8,665症例・4,178死亡（致死率48.2%）と深刻化。ワクチン・治療薬未承認であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき案件。
triage.notes: 発生地域に含まれるYambuku（1976年初発見地）、Nzara/Sudan（1976年初発見地）、Muyinga/Burundi、Angolaは歴史的言及または関連国情報であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクはDRC国内（Ituri州を起点に7州へ拡大）に限定されるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。致死率48.2%、ワクチン・治療薬未承認のブンディブギョ株という点で特に深刻度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Cum se transmite ciuma, care sunt simptomele și cum se tratează?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How is the plague transmitted, what are the symptoms, and how is it treated?
article.articleSummary: Plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, remains a concern with sporadic activity in the Americas, Africa and Asia. In Siberia, a laboratory worker died of pneumonic plague; another death with compatible symptoms occurred nearby, prompting WHO investigation. The ECDC reports limited information, no secondary cases, and no evidence of sustained human-to-human transmission yet. Transmission to humans is via fleas from infected rodents; pneumonic plague spreads through respiratory droplets. Forms include bubonic plague (2–6 days to onset; swollen nodes; 40–70% mortality if untreated), primary pneumonic plague (1–3 days; chest pain, thick mucus, respiratory failure; death within 24 hours), and septicemic plague (2–6 days; bloodstream infection; nearly always fatal without antibiotics). No vaccine; antibiotics are treatment. Suspected or confirmed pneumonic cases should be isolated and contacts monitored. Endemic regions include Madagascar, Democratic Republic of Congo, and Peru; cases are a few thousand. EU emphasizes rodent and flea control and surveillance in high-risk areas.

triage.headline_ja: ペストの感染経路、症状、治療法は？
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はペストの一般的な解説記事であり、ロシア（シベリア）での死亡例を背景に紹介しているが、対象国（DRC等）は流行地域としての一般的言及に留まり、具体的な新規アウトブレイクの報告ではないため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はペストに関する一般的な医学解説で、シベリアでの検査技師の死亡例（WHO調査中）を主な話題としているが、ロシアは対象国リストに含まれない。DRC・マダガスカル・ペルーは『流行地域』としての一般的背景情報であり、現時点での新規アウトブレイクの主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Trump confirma que hablará 'muy pronto' con Putin sobre el posible brote de peste neumónica en Rusia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trump confirms he will speak with Putin 'very soon' about the possible outbreak of pneumonic plague in Russia.
article.articleSummary: Trump says he will speak with Putin 'very soon' about a possible pneumonic plague outbreak in Irkutsk region, Siberia, following the death of Daria Shipilova, 28, a researcher at the Institute of Plague Research in Irkutsk and the Far East. No confirmed case has been reported; US State Department officials are in touch with Moscow, and the WHO is requesting information to assess real risks. WHO’s initial risk estimates place Irkutsk as moderate to low, Russia overall as low, and Europe as very low. The article cites hypotheses including infection during a trip to Thailand or a laboratory accident involving pathogens. Reports of quarantines for up to 200 contacts are unconfirmed; authorities deny hospital-wide lockdowns. Rospotrebnadzor calls a circulating document about stricter measures false; Irkutsk officials say the death was pneumonia of indeterminate origin, with no confirmed pneumonic plague cases yet. Investigations continue.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ氏、ロシアでの肺ペスト発生疑惑についてプーチン氏と『近く』話すと確認
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストの疑い死亡例が報告され、米露首脳やWHOが注目しているが、確定症例はなく情報が不十分なため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 事件の主な発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり対象国リストに含まれない。タイは感染経路の仮説として言及されているのみで、発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。確定症例はまだ報告されておらず、WHOはリスクを『中〜低』と評価している。

article.articleHeadline: Kenia bestätigt ersten Ebola-Fall und ersten Ebola-Todesfall
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya confirms first Ebola case and first Ebola death.
article.articleSummary: Kenya has confirmed its first imported Ebola case from the Democratic Republic of Congo, with the patient dying Monday in Nairobi. The Kenyan citizen flew from the DRC via Uganda to Kenya. After developing symptoms of hemorrhagic fever, he was isolated and treated at Nairobi Hospital; a lab test confirmed Ebolavirus infection. Authorities have placed the country on heightened alert. Twenty-eight contacts have been identified, including family members and healthcare workers; an additional 23 passengers on the same Ugandan flight are being traced. Contacts will be isolated for 21 days and released if tests are negative. The deceased will be buried within 24 hours under protective measures. Ituri in Congo is the outbreak center; since late August, this Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak has led to cases in four countries (DRC, Kenya, Uganda with 20 cases, France with 1). No approved vaccine or therapy; vaccine and treatment studies are ongoing in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、初のエボラ症例と初のエボラ死亡例を確認
triage.triage_reason: DRC発の輸入エボラ症例がケニアで死亡し、複数国（DRC、ウガンダ、フランス）に拡大していることから、IHR基準の深刻性・異常性・国際拡大の3項目が該当するため。
triage.notes: アウトブレイクの中心はDRCのイトゥリ州であり、ケニア・ウガンダ・フランスは輸出症例として報告されているが、これら3か国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: ചിക്കൻപോക്സ് പടരുന്നു; കുസാറ്റ് ക്യാമ്പസും ഹോസ്റ്റലുകളും അടച്ചു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chickenpox spreading; Kusat Campus and hostels closed.
article.articleSummary: Chickenpox cases forced the temporary closure of Kochi Science and Technology University (KUSAT) campuses and hostels. To curb transmission, the university shifted all classes online. College Union elections have been postponed, with a revised date to be announced. Cases were first identified in the School of Engineering, and subsequently more students developed fever and other chickenpox symptoms. The closure aims to halt spread on campus and in hostels. The report provides no exact case or death counts, no lab confirmation details, and no information on infection source or imported/exported status. No further locations are specified beyond the Kochi campus. These measures reflect urgent campus-level public health action in response to a varicella outbreak as of 7 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 水痘が拡大；コーチン科学技術大学（KUSAT）のキャンパスと寮が閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: 単一大学キャンパス内での水痘（既知の感染症）流行であり、国際的拡大や重症化のリスクは低いが、学内での感染拡大対応として一定の社会的関心があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 水痘は既知の感染症でワクチンもあり、大学寮という閉鎖環境での集団感染。重症度や死亡者数の情報はなく、地域的な公衆衛生対応として大学独自の措置（オンライン授業移行、選挙延期）がとられている。

article.articleHeadline: Trabajadores de Salud en kenya exigen protección contra el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Healthcare workers in Kenya demand protection against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak intensifies in Kenya as healthcare workers demand protection after the country records its first Ebola death. In Nairobi on October 6, Kenyan Health Minister Aden Duale confirmed the deceased is a Kenyan who contracted the virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The union’s general secretary, Dr. Divji Atellah, urged doctors, nurses, and dentists to be prioritized as the frontline, not the weak link, and called for rigorous contact tracing and adequate health facility preparedness. Authorities are tracing 23 passengers and four crew members from the same flight for possible quarantine to prevent further transmission. The World Health Organization reports over 4,000 Ebola fatalities globally as of October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアの医療従事者、エボラ出血熱への対策を要求
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国由来のエボラ感染によりケニアで初の死亡例が確認され、国境を越えた感染拡大と検疫対応が報告されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ただし感染源であるコンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラアウトブレイクが背景にあり、同国を発生国として記載。飛行機乗客27名の接触者追跡や検疫措置が実施されており、国際的拡大のリスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Peste in Siberia? La Russia smentisce ma Washington non rischia: cittadini Usa invitati alla fuga - Il Tempo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Plague in Siberia? Russia denies it but Washington is not at risk: U.S. citizens urged to flee
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague fears surface in the Irkutsk region of Siberia, Russia, after a 28-year-old female researcher at the Institute of Plague Research for Irkutsk and the Far East dies on 2 October from a pneumonia of unknown origin. Close contacts include two with COVID-19 and two with rhinovirus; initial media speculation tied exposure to plague to a recent trip to Thailand or a broken pathogen vial. Russian health agency Rospotrebnadzor denies any incident with handling pathogens and deems the situation epidemiologically 'calm' with over 90% of tests of contacts completed and nearly 5,000 laboratory analyses finding no dangerous pathogens. The WHO confirms it has been assured by Russia that no recent plague cases or high-risk agents have been detected among contacts but seeks more information per the International Health Regulations. The U.S. embassy in Moscow urges Americans to leave Russia; Putin-Trump call anticipated.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアでペスト流行？ロシアは否定するもワシントンはリスクを取らず、米国民に退避を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究所の研究者が原因不明の肺炎で死亡し、WHOがIHRに基づき追加情報を要請、米大使館が自国民に退避勧告を出すなど国際的関心が高く、IHR基準の複数該当が見込まれるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 事件はロシア・イルクーツク州で発生しており、対象国リストに該当する国（タイなど）は旅行歴の憶測として言及されているのみで、実際の感染確認国ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。ロシア当局は検査結果を否定しているが、WHOや米大使館の対応から国際的な懸念が継続している点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: 5โรคหน้าฝน -โรคที่มากับน้ำท่วม รู้ทันอาการ ลดเสี่ยงป่วยหนัก
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five rainy-season diseases — flood-related illnesses: know the symptoms to reduce the risk of severe illness.
article.articleSummary: Thailand’s floods heighten health risks from five rainy-season diseases: dengue fever (Aedes mosquitoes), leptospirosis (bacteria from animal urine in floodwater), diarrhea and food poisoning (water- and food-borne), influenza and other respiratory infections, and skin infections after prolonged water exposure. Dengue features abrupt high fever, headache, myalgia, and may include abdominal pain or vomiting; alarming signs after fever subsides require care, and aspirin/ NSAIDs should be avoided. Leptospirosis presents with fever, headache, calf/back muscle pains, red eyes, and nausea; report floodwater or mud exposure to clinicians. Diarrhea/food poisoning cause cramps, diarrhea, and vomiting with dehydration risk; use oral rehydration and seek care if dehydration worsens or stools are blood-tinged. Respiratory infections cause fever and cough; skin infections arise from immersion and can progress if untreated. Protective actions include frequent handwashing, wearing boots and gloves, covering wounds, and rinsing off after water exposure. Guidance from ViMUT Hospital Phaholyothin, Bangkok.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季の5つの疾患―洪水に伴う病気：症状を知り、重症化リスクを減らす
triage.triage_reason: 洪水時期の一般的な健康注意喚起記事であり、特定の集団感染やアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 病院による一般的な健康啓発記事であり、具体的な発生数・症例数の報告はない。季節性の注意喚起情報のため、イベントとしてのシグナル性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya quarantines ten contacts after first Ebola fatality and intensifies border screening
article.articleSummary: Kenya quarantines ten contacts after first confirmed Ebola case, with 57 more traced in Nairobi linked to a patient who died after arriving from Democratic Republic of the Congo. The man travelled from Buta through Kisangani and Beni in the DRC, then to Uganda before entering Kenya, where he died in hospital and was buried according to health safety guidelines. Health officials reported the patient had been ill for about a month, raising questions about border screenings that reportedly missed symptoms. The DRC outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has affected more than 8,000 people and killed over 4,000 since May, with no approved vaccine or treatment. Kenya has intensified surveillance at airports and borders, screening over 650,000 travellers and designating four hospitals as Ebola centres. Authorities warn of possible symptom-masking via medication and urge improved self-reporting. Uganda and Tanzania maintain Ebola-free status; WHO confirms Uganda Ebola-free since August.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、初のエボラ死亡例確認後に接触者10人を隔離、国境検疫を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCで8000人超が感染し4000人超が死亡する大規模エボラ流行が進行中で、国境を越えてケニアに感染者が到達するなど国際的拡大リスクが明確であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの輸入症例対応だが、実際の流行発生地はDRC（ブンディブギョ株、5月以降8000人超感染・4000人超死亡）。ケニア・ウガンダ・タンザニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCでの流行自体が本シグナルの核心であり、越境拡大が確認されている点が重大。

article.articleHeadline: 收假回家后这三件事你做对了吗？南宁疾控提醒→
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After returning home from the holiday, did you do these three things correctly? Nanning CDC reminds you.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-07, the Nanning Center for Disease Prevention and Control urges residents returning from the National Day holiday to take three actions: clear standing water, eliminate adult mosquitoes, and prevent bites, followed by a 14-day self-health monitoring. Dengue fever and chikungunya fever—mosquito-borne diseases transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes—have up to a 14-day incubation, so risk persists after travel. First, perform a home mosquito check: remove standing water from balconies, planters, containers, air-condition drip pans, and other receptacles; if larvae are found, drain outdoors to dry and wipe interior walls. Second, kill adult mosquitoes with approved insecticides, coils, or electric devices, and close doors/windows during spraying. Third, prevent bites: ensure screens are intact, sleep under nets, wear light clothing, and apply repellents containing DEET, pyrethroid, or picaridin; avoid peak biting times and protect vulnerable groups. If fever or rash appears, seek prompt medical care with travel and exposure history; do not use NSAIDs before dengue is ruled out, and maintain precautions and inform family.

triage.headline_ja: 休暇から帰宅後、この3つのことを正しく行いましたか？南寧疾病予防管理センターからの注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 公衆衛生当局による一般的な予防啓発情報であり、具体的な症例数や流行の急増を示す記述がないため、現時点でピックアップの基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は南寧市CDCによる休暇後のデング熱・チクングニア熱予防に関する啓発情報であり、実際の発生拡大や症例急増を報告するものではない。具体的な症例数、流行状況の記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: दिल्ली में कहर बरपा रहा डेंगू-मलेरिया, अब तक इतने लोग बने शिकार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue and malaria ravage Delhi; so far this many people have fallen victim.
article.articleSummary: Dengue and malaria remain a Delhi, India concern despite the receding monsoon. In the first week of October 2026, Delhi reported 98 new dengue cases, bringing 2026 totals to 695, and 23 new malaria cases, with malaria total at 266. September was a record month, with 286 dengue and 124 malaria cases, while August reported 90 dengue and 53 malaria cases. Common early symptoms include sudden high fever, body and joint pains, and thrombocytopenia; both diseases are mosquito-borne, with Aedes mosquitoes spreading dengue. Post-monsoon standing water in containers, tanks, pots, and other receptacles fuel breeding. No dengue or malaria deaths have been reported in 2026 so far. Public health measures by MCD include fogging, larval surveillance, and door-to-door inspections; domestic breeding checkers surveyed over 3.18 crore homes, finding mosquito breeding in more than 1.89 lakh residences.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでデング熱とマラリアが猛威を振るう、これまでの患者数
triage.triage_reason: デリーの季節性デング熱・マラリア流行であり、死亡例なく、既存の公衆衛生対策（防疫・幼虫調査等）が実施されている通常の季節報告のため、特段の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 毎年のモンスーン後に見られる季節性のデング熱・マラリア流行の定例報告。死亡例なし、MCDによる防疫措置（燻蒸、幼虫調査、戸別点検）が実施されており、特段の国際的懸念や緊急対応の必要性は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: آنچه درباره "طاعون ریوی" می‌دانیم/علائم طاعون ریوی
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What We Know About "Pneumonic Plague" / Symptoms of Pneumonic Plague
article.articleSummary: As of 7 October 2026, a laboratory worker in Siberia died under unclear circumstances linked to plague research, prompting the WHO to request more information from Russia after widespread media speculation. Russian officials say testing of contacts to the researcher shows no pneumonic plague, though the cause remains under investigation. Pneumonic plague, the deadliest form of Yersinia pestis infection, causes shortness of breath, chest pain, and coughing blood; it can be primary or follow bubonic or septicemic plague. Human-to-human transmission occurs via respiratory droplets in close contact; flea bites and animal exposure remain common sources. Global annual cases total about 1,000–3,000, with most bubonic and many in Central Africa; sporadic cases have been reported in Russia, India, China, and the United States. Early antibiotics are highly effective; post-exposure prophylaxis or quarantine may be advised for high-risk contacts.

triage.headline_ja: 「肺ペスト」について分かっていること／肺ペストの症状
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究に従事していたシベリアの研究者が原因不明で死亡し、WHOがロシアに追加情報を要請するなど社会的・政治的関心が高まっているため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断した。
triage.notes: 事件はロシア・シベリアの研究施設で発生した死亡例であり、記事中で言及されるインド・中国・米国・中央アフリカは世界的なペスト発生状況の一般的背景情報であり、対象国リストにおける具体的な現行イベントの発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: SUA, avertisment pentru cetățenii din Rusia: Posibil focar de ciumă pneumonică. "Părăsiți țara imediat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. warns citizens in Russia: Possible outbreak of pneumonic plague. "Leave the country immediately."
article.articleSummary: Possible pneumonic plague outbreak in Russia's Irkutsk region prompts U.S. travel advisories. Reports from Irkutsk indicate a suspected pneumonic plague case that resulted in death; authorities say quarantines and hospital closures occurred in Irkutsk city. A 28-year-old employee of the Irkutsk Plague Research Institute died in a hospital near Irkutsk; two hypotheses are being explored: infection during a recent trip to Thailand, or an accidental laboratory exposure. Rospotrebnadzor denies that the deceased had contact with Yersinia pestis, attributing death to pneumonia of unknown origin. Kremlin officials say many media reports are false, including hospital quarantines. The World Health Organization assessed the European public health risk as very low. The U.S. Embassy in Moscow reiterates that Level 4 travel alert remains in effect for Russia and urges Americans to depart immediately; U.S. government assistance may be limited outside Moscow. No confirmed cases abroad.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、ロシア在住の自国民に警告：肺ペスト発生の可能性『直ちに国外へ退避を』
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストという重篤かつ異常な疾患の疑い例が報告され、米国が渡航中止勧告（レベル4）を発出するなど渡航制限に発展しているため、IHR基準のうち『異常性』と『渡航・貿易制限』の2項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 事案はロシア・イルクーツク州で発生した疑い例であり、タイでの感染曝露は仮説の一つに過ぎず確定情報ではないため、対象国リストには該当なしと判断した。ロシア当局はペスト菌感染を否定しており、情報が錯綜している点に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: أطباء بلا حدود تحذر من خروج تفشى إيبولا عن السيطرة شرق الكونغو الديمقراطية - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders warn of the Ebola outbreak getting out of control in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On 7 October 2026, Doctors Without Borders (MSF) warned that the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo’s North Kivu is spiraling out of control. The region accounts for roughly 40% of the country’s newly confirmed Ebola cases, with outbreaks appearing weekly and most new infections arising from undefined transmission chains. MSF notes that 75% of Ebola fatalities occur in local communities, where many people do not access treatment centers, increasing onward transmission. Stephanie Hofmann, MSF’s Ebola treatment center coordinator in Butembo, said new cases mainly stem from unidentified transmission chains and that the outbreak has spread from the city to surrounding rural areas lacking services. Hospitals are overwhelmed, and MSF urges a rapid expansion of Ebola treatment capacity and community engagement to overcome fear and underreporting.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団、コンゴ民主共和国東部でのエボラ出血熱流行が制御不能になりつつあると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクの3項目が該当し、MSFが制御不能化を警告する重大なエボラ流行であるためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: MSFによると北キブ州の症例の多くが未確認の感染経路から発生し、都市部から農村部への拡大や医療アクセス不足による地域社会内での死亡（致死例の75%）が指摘されており、感染拡大・制御困難性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ruto vows stronger measures to contain Ebola after Kenya confirms first case
article.articleSummary: Ebola confirmed in Kenya on Oct 7, 2026, after a Kenyan traveler from the Democratic Republic of Congo contracted the virus, resulting in the deceased patient. A contact tracing effort identified and isolated 23 medical personnel who treated him at a Nairobi hospital, as well as his family members with whom he had contact. President William Ruto announced intensified surveillance and preparedness measures, with the Health Ministry issuing guidelines on conduct in public spaces to curb transmission. Authorities are expanding contact tracing, isolation, and surveillance, with further updates expected in coming hours and days. Kenya asserts it has adequate facilities nationwide to respond if needed and urges calm as responders monitor for any additional cases and raise surveillance to the highest level.

triage.headline_ja: ルト大統領、ケニア初のエボラ症例確認後、抑制強化を誓う
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大・渡航制限リスク）に該当し、DRCからケニアへの越境エボラ症例として国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアでの初症例確認だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であるDRCは対象国リストに含まれるため記載。今後のWHO・CDC等の続報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Mongolia orders surveillance on Russia border after plague death
article.articleSummary: Mongolia orders health surveillance on its Russia border on Oct 7 after a plague-related death of a laboratory technician in Siberia. The deceased, a 28-year-old woman at a plague research institute in Irkutsk region (north of Mongolia), died reportedly on Oct 2; Russian authorities cited pneumonia with an undetermined cause and said there are no epidemic risks. Mongolia’s Ministry of Health stated the current risk is low but instructed ongoing precautionary measures and border health monitoring in Selenge Province, where crossings continue to operate normally. China’s foreign ministry on Oct 6 said Beijing and Moscow maintain close cooperation on plague prevention and control. The Irkutsk region capital receives many visitors from China en route to Lake Baikal, highlighting cross-border movement, though no broader outbreak is reported beyond Russia at this time.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでのペスト関連死亡を受け、モンゴルがロシア国境での監視を指示
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの研究所技師のペスト関連死亡は異常事態であり、モンゴル保健当局・中国外務省も反応するなど社会的・政治的関心が高いため、フルRRAでの精査が望ましい。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（イルクーツク州）とモンゴル（国境監視対応）であり、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない。中国は外交的コメントのみで発生国ではないため除外。対象国リストに該当なしのためverified_locationsは空配列。

article.articleHeadline: Russia plague scare: 200 quarantined, 5,000 tests, no confirmed cases, no epidemic risk; -- latest updates | Today News
article.articleSummary: On 7 October 2026, Russia’s health regulator said there is no epidemic risk in Siberia after the death of 28-year-old Darya Shipilova, a worker at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute, from pneumonia of unknown origin. Initial plague fears—potential pneumonic plague after a lab incident—were rejected as no plague infection has been detected and no recent plague cases in Irkutsk region. About 200 people were quarantined or observed; ~90% released and nearly 5,000 tests found no dangerous pathogens. Shipilova had been vaccinated and was considered immune to the institute's pathogens; the pneumonia's cause remains undetermined. The WHO seeks more information and has mobilized experts; risk is moderate-to-low in Irkutsk, low for Russia, very low for the WHO European region. No confirmed plague among contacts; reports of a second employee with pneumonia exist. Border crossings in Selenge province remain normal with health monitoring; China remains in close contact.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアのペスト騒動：200人隔離、5000件検査、確定症例なし、流行リスクなし――最新情報
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究所職員が原因不明の肺炎で死亡し肺ペストの懸念が生じたこと、WHOが情報収集・専門家派遣を行っていることから社会的関心と国際的な注目度が高く、フルリスク評価が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州およびモンゴル・セレンゲ県の国境監視情報であり、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない。中国は国境監視・連絡を継続しているとの言及のみで、感染発生国としての記載はないため verified_locations には含めなかった。ペスト感染自体は否定されており、原因不明の肺炎として続報が注目される。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : l'association des femmes juristes appelle au maintien de la vigilance face à Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: The Association of Women Lawyers Urges Continued Vigilance in the Face of Ebola - ACP.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 October 2026, Ituri Province in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo remains vigilant for Ebola virus disease (EVD) despite a recent drop in cases. In Bunia, Me Espérance Masika, coordinator of the Association of Women Lawyers of Congo (Afejuco), urged continued vigilance to prevent a rebound. Communities are asked to maintain regular handwashing, promptly report suspected cases to community relay points, and seek early care at health facilities. Do not touch the body of a deceased person at home. Masika noted that the current downward trend reflects adherence to preventive measures, but should not be mistaken for the epidemic’s end. The message emphasizes sustaining barrier precautions and community-led surveillance to prevent new transmission chains while the outbreak continues.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州：女性法律家協会、エボラ出血熱への警戒継続を呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続中であり、症例減少にもかかわらず地域団体が警戒継続を呼びかけている。致死率の高いエボラであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事は既知のエボラアウトブレイクの継続状況・注意喚起に関する内容であり、新規症例急増等の報告ではないが、エボラという疾患の重大性からPICKUPと判断。続報で症例数・地域拡大の有無を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : le dialogue communautaire renforcé aux points de contrôle d'Ebola à Mambasa - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: strengthened community dialogue at Ebola checkpoints in Mambasa - ACP
article.articleSummary: Four Ebola sanitary checkpoints in Mandima, Mambasa territory, Ituri province, Congo, have intensified community outreach to strengthen the response to Ebola virus disease. Beyond health screening, the checkpoints are expanding awareness and dialogue with travelers and host communities to boost acceptance of public health measures. Dr Théophile Ponde, provincial coordinator of the National Border Health Program (PNHF) in Ituri and head of the checkpoints pillar, emphasized that collaboration with community relays remains key to local buy-in, reducing hesitancy and building trust. The checkpoints also enable rapid identification of people with symptoms or risk factors and prompt referral to appropriate care in suitable facilities. The initiative positions checkpoints as surveillance, prevention, and community engagement tools in the Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州：マンバサのエボラ検問所でコミュニティ対話を強化 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重篤な感染症であり、コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州での継続的な対応活動（検問所でのコミュニティ対話強化）が報告されている。政府機関（国境保健プログラム）の関与が確認でき、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクのある疾患であるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラ対応活動（検問所でのコミュニティエンゲージメント）に関する報告であり、新規症例数や感染拡大の具体的データは記載されていない。既知の継続中アウトブレイクである可能性が高く、最新の症例動向については追加情報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: First Ebola case revives debate over Nanyuki quarantine centre
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease case in Laikipia County. A Kenyan national who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo traveled to Kampala by road and flew into Nairobi on October 3, was isolated at The Nairobi Hospital, and died. Authorities identified 28 contacts, now monitoring 57, as more than 652,000 travelers are screened at entry points to curb spread. The case revives debate over the 50-bed Ebola quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base, with residents asking if it would serve Kenyans if Ebola reaches Nanyuki or Laikipia, or remain for foreign nationals. Health officials describe the incident as imported, not a countrywide outbreak. Kenya has 241 beds across five facilities for Ebola response (Nairobi Hospital 130; Moi 50; National Police Hospital 49; Kenyatta National Hospital 8; Port Reitz 4) and plans to raise isolation units from 15 to 22, emphasizing early detection, isolation, treatment and contact tracing with WHO and Africa CDC support.

triage.headline_ja: 初のエボラ症例、ナニュキ検疫センターを巡る議論が再燃
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで初のエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）症例が確認され死亡、接触者57人を追跡中であり、国際的な拡大懸念と公衆衛生上の重大性からIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 患者はDRC在住歴があり、ウガンダ経由でケニアに入国したが、記事の主題はケニアでの初症例対応であり、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。DRCは渡航歴としてのみ言及され、発生国としての主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: L'angoisse monte au Kenya après un premier décès dû à Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anxiety grows in Kenya after the first Ebola-related death.
article.articleSummary: First Ebola-related death reported in Kenya as of 2026-10-07. A Kenyan national who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo died after returning home; he fell ill in DRC, passed through Uganda, and flew to Kenya where he was hospitalized. The DRC declared in May its 17th Ebola outbreak, the largest and deadliest in its history, with over 4,000 deaths reported. Since Ebola emerged in the 1970s, about 15,000 deaths have occurred in Africa. Kenyan officials identified 28 contacts including family and health workers; none tested positive yet. Authorities are tracing 23 other passengers and four crew members from the same flight, with potential quarantine measures planned for those at risk. The outbreak raises fears of local transmission in Kenya amid concerns about preparedness and government response.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで初のエボラ関連死亡例、不安が高まる
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラアウトブレイク(4000人以上死亡)が続く中、感染者がウガンダ経由でケニアに渡航し死亡したことで国境を越えた感染拡大が確認され、IHR基準を複数満たす重大な公衆衛生事案である。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの初のエボラ関連死亡例だが、感染元であるDRCの大規模アウトブレイク(17回目、4000人超死亡)が背景として明確に述べられているためDRCを verified_locations に含めた。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。航空機同乗者28名の接触者調査、検疫措置検討中で今後の続報が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Кения съобщи за първи случай на ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya reports the first case of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first confirmed Ebola case. A Kenyan citizen who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo for seven years traveled by road from Beni, DRC to Kampala, Uganda, spent one night there, then flew from Entebbe to Nairobi. He was already symptomatic on arrival—fever, chills, muscle pains, and subcutaneous bleeding—and died two days later after being taken to hospital. Ugandan authorities noted his temperature was normal at Entebbe airport, suggesting he may have taken medication masking fever. Temperature screening at airports has limitations. Kenya has identified 57 contacts, with 10 under quarantine and ongoing tracing for others; a dedicated screening point exists at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport for arrivals from Congo and related outbreak countries. The Congo Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, is the worst on record, with more than 8,000 cases and over 4,000 deaths, and no approved specific treatment or vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアが初のエボラ症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで続く過去最大規模のエボラ流行（8000例超、死者4000人超）がウガンダ経由でケニアに越境拡大し初の輸入症例・死亡例が発生。国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻さからIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの初症例確認だが、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため除外。感染源であり継続中の大規模流行地であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。症例は空路での国際移動歴があり、潜在的な航空機内曝露・接触者追跡が国際的関心事となっている。

article.articleHeadline: PUTINOV ČERNOBIL? Rusi tvrde da kod njih nema kuge. Prije mjesec dana s Kinezima su u Irkutsku vježbali izbijanje zaraze
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Putin's Chernobyl? The Russians claim there is no plague in their country. A month ago, in Irkutsk, they practiced a disease outbreak drill with the Chinese.
article.articleSummary: In Irkutsk, Russia, a 28-year-old employee of the Institute for the Fight Against Plague died in late September after developing severe pneumonia of unknown origin. Russian authorities (Rospotrebnadzor) say there is no confirmed link to Yersinia pestis and no laboratory accident at the institute. About 200 potential contacts are under medical surveillance with hospital isolation measures in place; a second institute worker with pneumonia of unclear origin is also being monitored. A month earlier, Russia and China held a joint outbreak-response drill in Irkutsk focusing on monitoring and containing infectious diseases, including plague, near border areas. The World Health Organization reports no confirmed plague transmission in Siberia and regards the international risk as very low. U.S. officials have urged greater transparency as investigations continue, amid discussions comparing the incident to past secrecy concerns.

triage.headline_ja: プーチンのチェルノブイリ？ロシアは自国にペストはないと主張。1ヶ月前、イルクーツクで中国と感染症流行対応訓練を実施していた
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究所職員が原因不明の重症肺炎で死亡し、約200人の接触者が隔離・監視下に置かれるなど公衆衛生対応が大規模である一方、原因究明や透明性に懸念があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 事案はロシア・イルクーツク州で発生しており、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。中国は合同訓練の相手国として言及されているのみで、感染事例の発生国ではないため除外。ペスト菌（Yersinia pestis）との確定的な関連性は当局により否定されているが、研究所関係者の原因不明肺炎死亡および多数の接触者隔離という事実から、透明性・情報開示に関する国際的懸念が生じている。

article.articleHeadline: Qué hay detrás de la enfermedad que encendió las alarmas en Rusia: la peste negra nunca desapareció y su forma más peligrosa puede matar en 24 horas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What lies behind the disease that raised alarms in Russia: the Black Death never disappeared, and its deadliest form can kill within 24 hours.
article.articleSummary: Yersinia pestis remains endemic in humans across multiple countries, with pneumonic plague posing the fastest, most dangerous form due to inhaled respiratory droplets. Pneumonic plague can arise from progression of bubonic or septicemic infection or direct inhalation, enabling person-to-person spread in close contact. After exposure, the incubation can be as short as 24 hours, with early symptoms of fever, headache, and weakness, quickly followed by severe pneumonia, chest pain, and a productive or bloody cough. Without treatment, pneumonic plague can be fatal within 18–24 hours. Antibiotics such as gentamicin or fluoroquinolones are recommended on suspicion, for about 10–14 days; early treatment within 24 hours yields high recovery. Most cases (2019–2025) occurred in Madagascar and the Democratic Republic of Congo; the United States averages seven human cases per year, mainly bubonic in rural West. No routine vaccine exists; emphasis on diagnosis, isolation, and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで警戒を引き起こした疾病の正体とは:黒死病は消えていなかった、その最も危険な形態は24時間で死に至ることも
triage.triage_reason: 特定の新規アウトブレイクを報じるものではなく、ペスト(肺ペスト含む)に関する一般的な解説記事。過去5年間の症例動向に言及しているが、具体的な新規発生や急増の報告はないため、フルRRAに進めるほどの緊急性は不明。
triage.notes: 記事は疾病解説が主体で、ロシアでの具体的な発生詳細や、マダガスカル・DRCでの最新の新規症例に関する具体的データは本文に記載がない。マダガスカルは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは過去の症例多発地域として言及されているが新規発生報告ではない。米国も対象国外のため除外。続報の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : des dispositions pour activer les cours à distance en cas d'Ebola dans les écoles - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: Measures to Activate Distance Learning in the Event of Ebola in Schools - ACP
article.articleSummary: Distance learning measures are prepared in Kisangani, Tshopo province, Democratic Republic of Congo, to be activated if an Ebola case is detected in a school, ensuring continuity of learning for the 2026-2027 calendar (222 school days). Alain Mwimbi Mwimbi, provincial EPS-INC director for Tshopo 1, said contingency steps exist to switch to remote instruction when needed. Awareness campaigns are ongoing among pupils, teachers, and educational staff to reinforce prevention and sanitary measures. Governor Paulin Lendongolia supplied 600 Thermoflash devices and 2,400 hydroalcoholic gels to bolster protection for students and staff, prioritizing schools in health zones already affected by Ebola. The distance-learning plan includes notebooks with three-month lesson sequences; once activated, students continue learning at home under supervision of families and designated personnel. As of 7 October 2026, Tshopo reports 51 confirmed Ebola cases, with authorities maintaining surveillance to curb spread while preserving school activities.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州：学校でのエボラ発生時に遠隔授業を導入するための措置 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国チョポ州で確認エボラ症例51件が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は学校における遠隔授業の予防措置が中心だが、チョポ州で51件の確認エボラ症例が報告されていることから、疫学的状況の確認が必要。国際的拡大や渡航制限に関する情報は記事中にないため不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Advises Against Travel Bans After Kenya Reports First Ebola Death Linked to Congo Outbreak - [your]NEWS
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first Bundibugyo virus disease (Ebola) death on 5 October 2026 after a Congolese resident who had lived in the DRC for seven years traveled through Uganda and flew into Nairobi on 3 October while ill. The patient tested positive at the National Virology Reference Laboratory and the Kenya Medical Research Institute and died the night of 5 October, with burial on 6 October under infection-control protocols. Symptoms included fever, chills and bleeding beneath the skin. The case underscores limits of entry screening, with reports he passed through Entebbe and Nairobi airports while symptomatic or after fever masking. Kenya traced 28 contacts (23 passengers and 4 crew from the same flight); eight relatives and 21 healthcare workers were quarantined. The outbreak centers in eastern Congo (Bundibugyo virus); no licensed vaccine or specific treatment exists, with care focused on supportive measures. As of September 2026, WHO cited 7,890 cases and 3,799 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ由来のエボラ感染でケニア初の死亡例確認後も渡航制限に反対を表明
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）がウガンダ経由でケニアまで国際的に拡大し、死亡例が確認された。WHOが渡航制限について言及するなど国際的関心・対応が既に発生しており、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ・ケニアも含まれるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。アウトブレイクの起点はDRC東部（ブンディブギョウイルス）。記事中の症例数（7,890例、死亡3,799例）は非常に高く、通常のブンディブギョウイルス流行規模と乖離があるため、数値の正確性について続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: EEUU pide a sus ciudadanos abandonar Rusia ante posible brote de peste neumónica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. urges its citizens to leave Russia amid possible pneumonic plague outbreak.
article.articleSummary: U.S. Embassy in Moscow urges Americans in Russia to leave immediately amid reports of a suspected pneumonic plague case in the Irkutsk region that has prompted hospital quarantines and closures and a death. The advisory notes limited U.S. government assistance outside Moscow and hints at possible additional travel restrictions. The alert coincides with a planned call between President Trump and President Putin to discuss the situation. The ECDC and WHO are monitoring, with the WHO estimating a 'very low' health risk for Europe. Media report a 28-year-old woman, an employee of the Institute of Plague Research of Irkutsk and the Far East, died in a hospital in Shélejov; hypotheses include infection after travel to Thailand or an accidental lab breach, which authorities deny. The Kremlin urges calm; Rospotrebnadzor says the death was due to pneumonia of unknown etiology and denies hospital quarantines; Russia offers to help combat outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、肺ペスト発生の可能性を受けてロシアからの自国民退避を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペスト疑い症例による死亡・病院隔離が報告され、米国が自国民に退避勧告を出すなど国際的関心・渡航制限の可能性が高く、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（イルクーツク州）であり、対象国リストに含まれない。タイへの渡航歴は感染経路の仮説として言及されているのみで、タイ国内での発生ではないため verified_locations には含めない。WHOはヨーロッパへのリスクを『非常に低い』と評価しているが、米国の渡航勧告・米露首脳協議など国際的関心が高いため注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: വിദ്യാർഥികൾക്ക് കൂട്ടത്തോടെ ചിക്കൻ പോക്സ്, കുസാറ്റ് ക്യാമ്പസ് അടച്ചു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chickenpox outbreak among students; Kusattu Campus closed.
article.articleSummary: Chickenpox outbreak forces Kusattu Campus in Kochi to close as varicella spreads among students. Two students in the School of Engineering were laboratory-confirmed with chickenpox, prompting a campus-wide precautionary response. Consequently, all classes are now online, and student hostels have shut down. Over the past several days, many students reported fever and malaise, triggering heightened vigilance on campus. With continued transmission to additional students, authorities have closed the campus and postponed the union elections, with a new date to be announced. The report notes laboratory confirmation for two cases and describes additional infections without specific counts. Measures emphasize online instruction and dormitory closures to curb spread while the outbreak is investigated.

triage.headline_ja: 学生の間で水痘が集団発生、コーチン科学技術大学(CUSAT)キャンパスを閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: 水痘は国内でよく見られる疾患であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威や渡航・貿易制限のリスクは低い。大学単位での予防的対応であり、重症例の報告もない。
triage.notes: 大学内での局所的な水痘集団発生。感染者数は少数（確認2名、他に未確定数）で、重症例の報告なし。地域の教育機関レベルの対応にとどまり、公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya races to trace all contacts after first Ebola death, WHO official says
article.articleSummary: Kenya's first Ebola death, the Bundibugyo strain, marks an imported case from the Democratic Republic of Congo. The local man, who had lived in DRC, fell ill there, flew into Nairobi via Kampala on 3 October, and died in Nairobi on 5 October. Authorities have identified contacts to prevent community spread: about 10 relatives are cooperating and under quarantine; 21 hospital staff, lab nurses and other personnel who treated him are being monitored, with decisions to quarantine Nairobi Hospital staff. The government is tracing roughly 23 passengers and four crew members from the Entebbe–Kampala flight. WHO, with UN agencies and Africa CDC, is supporting Kenya, DRC and Uganda with surveillance, screening and contact tracing. Transmission is via bodily fluids; emphasis on hygienic practices, rapid care seeking; incubation period 2–8 days, so the coming days are critical to identify and quarantine contacts to avert community spread.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで初のエボラ死亡例、WHO当局者が全接触者の追跡を急ぐと発言
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がケニアに持ち込まれ死亡例が発生、国境を越えた接触者追跡とWHO支援が行われており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。症例はDRCで発病・DRC在住者の輸入例であり、DRCでの本流行が本質的な発生国であるため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Un vecino blinda su frontera, China entra en escena y sospechan de un segundo caso de peste neumónica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A neighbor seals its border, China enters the scene, and they suspect a second case of pneumonic plague.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague is being investigated in Siberia after the death of Daria Shipilova, a 28-year-old staff member at the Irkutsk Institute for the Fight Against Plague. An initial quarantine of roughly 200 people was enacted. Reports of a second employee with pneumonia of undetermined origin have not been confirmed. China says it is cooperating with Russia on plague prevention and control; the WHO has sought explanations from Moscow, while the Kremlin asserts information has been provided and cautions against media reports. The United States has formally requested more information, with the CDC stressing no current evidence of a broader threat to the United States. Mongolia announced border surveillance despite a low overall risk. The assessed risk is moderate to low for Irkutsk, low for Russia, and very low for Europe, with emphasis on timely, transparent information sharing under the International Health Regulations.

triage.headline_ja: 隣国が国境を封鎖、中国も関与し、肺ペストの2例目感染が疑われる
triage.triage_reason: シベリア（ロシア）で肺ペストにより研究所職員が死亡し約200人が隔離、WHOがロシアに説明を求め、米国・モンゴル・中国が対応するなど国際的関心が高く、IHR基準の複数該当が認められる。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州（シベリア）であり、対象国リストに該当しない。中国は協力・監視対応の文脈で言及されているのみで、発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: تحذيرات من انتشار إيبولا عن السيطرة شرق الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warnings of Ebola spreading out of control in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Doctors Without Borders warns that the Ebola virus disease outbreak in North Kivu, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, is spiraling out of control, with North Kivu accounting for about 40% of the country’s newly confirmed cases. The outbreak is marked by new foci emerging weekly and most cases arising from transmission chains that remain unidentified. Stephanie Hofmann, MSF’s Ebola Treatment Center coordinator in Butembo, says the bulk of new infections come from unknown transmission chains, and about 75% of Ebola deaths occur in local communities—people at home without access to treatment or transit centers. This pattern heightens transmission risk, as deaths at home can expose relatives. The report stresses the need for stronger community engagement and health education, since fear of Ebola drives people to hide infections or avoid care. Initially centered in Butembo, nearby health zones now report confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ出血熱が制御不能に拡大との警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱が制御不能に拡大し、感染経路不明の症例が多数を占め、新たな発生地域も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 国境なき医師団（MSF）が発信源であり、感染経路不明の症例が多数、家庭内死亡が75%を占めるなど、地域社会での感染拡大リスクが高い状況。新たな健康区域への拡大も報告されており、継続的な監視と迅速なリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Arrivals from 10 African countries face enhanced Ebola screening at JKIA's Gate 16
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) preparedness intensified at Kenya's JKIA Gate 16 for arrivals from 10 high-risk African countries—DRC, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, South Sudan, Ethiopia, Angola, Zambia, Tanzania and CAR. As of 7 Oct 2026, Kenya reports an imported EVD case with no outbreak. The patient traveled about 3,000 km by air and road before arrival; 57 contacts are being traced and isolated/monitored. More than 4,000 national healthcare workers have been trained in Ebola preparedness. Gate 16 screening, potential exit screening, and online health declarations aim to reduce congestion and improve screening. Ebola spreads by close contact, not aerosols; hygiene measures are urged. Africa CDC commends Kenya’s response and coordinates with WHO, monitoring movements from DRC and Uganda to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: 10カ国のアフリカ諸国からの到着者がJKIA第16ゲートでエボラ出血熱の強化スクリーニングを受ける
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の輸入症例がケニアで確認され、接触者57名の追跡・隔離が行われているほか、国際的な渡航制限措置（強化スクリーニング）が実施されており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニア（非対象国）での輸入症例とJKIAでの渡航者スクリーニング強化。ザンビア等はスクリーニング対象国として列挙されているのみでアウトブレイク発生地ではない。DRC・ウガンダへの移動監視が言及されており、DRCが実際の感染源国として示唆されるため対象国リストに含めた。ウガンダは対象国リストに無いため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Megjelent a majomhimlő két magyar megyében is: friss jelentést adott ki a népegészségügyi központ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox has appeared in two Hungarian counties as well: the National Public Health Center has issued a recent report.
article.articleSummary: Two new mpox infections were registered in Hungary, according to the National Public Health Center's weekly report covering Sept 21–27. A 45-year-old man in Komárom-Esztergom County and a 27-year-old man in Pest County tested positive; neither had mpox vaccination. Mpox spreads by close physical contact and commonly presents with fever, lymphadenopathy, and skin lesions. In Veszprém County, a school outbreak affected more than 200 people: of 679 individuals, 204 were ill (200 pupils, 4 staff); symptoms included vomiting, diarrhea and fever, with four hospitalizations. Hygiene measures and disinfection were intensified. The same report noted a dengue fever case in Veszprém County: a 31-year-old man, likely imported from India. These data highlight concurrent enteric and vector-borne concerns alongside mpox in Hungary during Sept 21–27, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ハンガリーの2県で猿痘（Mpox）が確認：国立公衆衛生センターが最新報告を発表
triage.triage_reason: 発生国はハンガリーであり対象国リストに含まれず、インドは渡航歴としての言及のみで発生地域ではないため、対象国としての評価対象外と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はハンガリー国内の公衆衛生報告（mpox2例、学校での胃腸炎様集団発生、インド渡航歴のあるデング熱輸入例）を扱っており、対象国（India等）はイベント発生国ではなく感染者の渡航歴としてのみ言及されているため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: No Confirmed Ebola Case In Nigeria, NCDC Says After Kenya Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Nigeria's NCDC reports no confirmed Ebola case as of October 6, 2026, after Kenya confirmed an imported Bundibugyo virus case linked to the DRC outbreak. The Kenyan patient, who had lived in the DRC, traveled via Kampala to Nairobi, where he was isolated, tested positive, and died. Kenya has begun contact tracing. Nigeria is reviewing its risk and preparedness, maintaining measures including early detection, isolation and referral, laboratory diagnosis, infection prevention and control, contact tracing, risk communication, and protection of health workers. A National Ebola Preparedness Tabletop Exercise has been conducted. Nigerians are urged to maintain hand hygiene, avoid exposure to blood and body fluids, sick or dead wild animals or bushmeat, seek prompt care after travel to affected areas, and report exposure. Healthcare workers should maintain high suspicion and isolate suspected cases promptly; travellers should monitor 21 days after leaving affected areas. Monitoring continues for Kenya and DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、ケニアでのエボラ出血熱発生後も確定症例なしとNCDCが発表
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がケニアに越境輸入され死亡例が発生、国際的拡大が確認されたためIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCが感染源として記事主題に含まれるためverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Confirms First-Ever Ebola Death Following Returnee From DRC | Daily Dispatch
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first Ebola death after a Kenyan man who had lived in the DRC died following his return. He fell ill about a month earlier and had been treated in the DRC, then traveled overland to Kampala and flew to Nairobi on Oct 3. Lab confirmation identified infection with the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus, part of a DRC outbreak that began mid-May and has spread to seven northern and eastern provinces; as of Oct 2, WHO recorded 4,082 deaths among 8,463 cases. Symptoms included fever, chills, fatigue, muscle pain, painful swallowing, sore throat, and bleeding under the skin at injection sites. Authorities listed 28 contacts; only one test has been positive so far, with quarantine planned for 23 passengers and four crew from the same flight. A safe, dignified burial was arranged.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、DRCからの帰国者による初のエボラ死亡例を確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の大規模エボラ流行（8,463例、4,082死亡）がケニアに国際的に伝播し、国境を越えた渡航者経由での感染拡大リスクが顕在化しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、記事の主題であるエボラ死亡例はDRCからの帰国者による越境感染事例であり、DRCでの大規模アウトブレイク（7州に拡大、WHO報告でCFR約48%）が背景にある重要イベント。航空機同乗者28名の接触者調査・隔離対応が進行中であり、国際的な感染拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: กรมวิทย์ฯ ยันพร้อมรับมือกาฬโรค! เปิด BSL-3 ตรวจหาเชื้อ Yersinia pestis รู้ผลใน 24 ชั่วโมง
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Medical Sciences reiterates readiness to tackle the plague! Opens BSL-3 to detect Yersinia pestis, with results in 24 hours.
article.articleSummary: Thailand’s Department of Medical Sciences reiterates readiness to detect and manage plague (Yersinia pestis) by operating a Biosafety Level 3 (BSL-3) laboratory for rapid diagnostics. In response to overseas reports of Y. pestis, the agency emphasizes capabilities to diagnose pneumonic plague quickly via Real-time PCR with results in 24 hours, plus culture and biochemical confirmation under international standards, backed by expert staff and advanced equipment. Given the high-risk nature of the pathogen, specimen collection, packaging, and transport must follow strict biosafety measures, and health facilities are urged to coordinate with the laboratory before sending samples to receive safety guidance. For inquiries or testing arrangements, contact the Center for Surveillance and Coordination of Laboratory Operations, Public Health Sciences Institute, Department of Medical Sciences, Thailand, at 02-951-1485, 02-951-9000 ext. 98340, or LINE ID @769baxtr.

triage.headline_ja: 医科学局、ペスト対応に万全の態勢と強調！BSL-3施設でYersinia pestis検査、24時間以内に結果判明
triage.triage_reason: タイ国内での実際のペスト症例発生は報告されておらず、海外での発生報告を受けた検査体制・準備態勢に関する広報的な内容であるため、シグナルとしての実質的な公衆衛生イベントは確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事はタイ国内での実際のペスト発生ではなく、海外での発生報告を受けた検査体制の準備・広報に関する内容。具体的な症例地・患者数等の情報はなく、タイ自体の発生国としての位置づけは確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni : 8 malades guéris quittent le Centre de traitement
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: 8 recovered patients leave the treatment center.
article.articleSummary: Eight Ebola patients have been discharged from the Ebola Treatment Center in Beni on October 7, 2026, including a one-month-old infant. The recoveries come four days after ten other patients were discharged, boosting hope for communities affected by the outbreak. The medical director of Beni’s General Reference Hospital stressed that Ebola remains a reality in the region but is not a fatality; chances of recovery improve with early detection and prompt care. The recovered patients thanked the care teams and urged residents to trust treatment facilities and cooperate with response efforts to halt transmission of the disease. Continued vigilance remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: ベニのエボラ出血熱：治療を終えた8人の回復患者が退院
triage.triage_reason: DRCベニで継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する最新情報であり、重症度が高く地域社会への曝露が続いているため、既存のエボラ対応状況の一環としてフルRRAでの経過確認が妥当。
triage.notes: 本記事はベニでのエボラ治療センターからの退院報告であり、既知の継続的アウトブレイクの経過報告。新規性は低いが、エボラの高い致死性と地域内曝露継続のためモニタリング継続が望ましい。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Five times deadly pathogens escaped laboratories
article.articleSummary: A review (2000–2024) identified 712 laboratory-acquired infections and 17 deaths. Five incidents illustrate containment failures: California (2012)—a 25-year-old microbiologist dies of meningococcal disease (Neisseria meningitidis) after biosafety breaches in routine work; CDC, Atlanta (2014)—dozens exposed when anthrax was inadequately inactivated, and separately H5N1 material shipped to another lab; no illnesses or deaths reported. France (2019)—a technician dies from variant Creutzfeldt–Jakob disease (prions), likely from a 2010 needlestick; prions resist standard sterilisation. Lanzhou, China (2019–2020)—improperly disinfected vaccine factory waste gas released aerosolised Brucella, infecting more than 10,000 and reaching the wider community. Irkutsk, Russia (2026)—a 28-year-old anti-plague institute worker dies of severe pneumonia; plague link remains unproven and investigation ongoing. These cases underscore the need for strict biosafety procedures and transparent reporting to prevent spillovers.

triage.headline_ja: 過去に実験室から流出した致死性病原体の5つの事例
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2000〜2024年の実験室関連感染事故に関する回顧的レビュー記事であり、新規または進行中の感染症アウトブレイクを報告するものではないため、現時点でのシグナルとしての対応は不要。
triage.notes: 記事は過去の実験室内感染事例（米国カリフォルニア、CDCアトランタ、フランス、中国蘭州、ロシア・イルクーツク）を振り返る特集記事。中国・蘭州のブルセラ症集団感染（2019-2020年、1万人以上感染）は既に終結した過去の事例であり、新規発生ではないため経過観察の対象ともしない。

article.articleHeadline: País vecino de Rusia enciende sus alarmas y anuncia medidas de "vigilancia sanitaria" tras presunto fallecimiento por peste neumónica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A neighboring country of Russia raises the alarm and announces "public health surveillance" measures after a presumed death from pneumonic plague.
article.articleSummary: Presumed death from pneumonic plague in Siberia triggers cross-border vigilance as Mongolia declares 'sanitary surveillance' at its border with Russia (Selenge province). A 28-year-old woman who worked at a plague-research institute in Irkutsk region reportedly died; Russian authorities say the death was due to pneumonia with indeterminate cause and warn there is no epidemic risk. Rospotrebnadzor reports that over 90% of contacts have been followed and no infections detected; media reports of a second suspected case are labeled misinformation. Mongolia says border crossings continue normally with added surveillance. The case has drawn responses from the United States (Trump planning a call with Putin) and the Secretary of State (Rubio) urging transparency, echoed by the World Health Organization; China stresses cooperation. The pneumonic form is highly contagious and potentially fatal if untreated, per WHO.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの隣国が警戒態勢を強化、肺ペストによる死亡疑いを受けて『衛生監視』措置を発表
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストによる死亡疑い事例が発生し、モンゴル・ロシア国境での衛生監視強化、米露首脳間のやり取りやWHOの関与など国際的な注目を集めており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 事例はロシア（イルクーツク州、研究所関係者）とモンゴル（国境警戒）で発生しており、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。中国は協力姿勢を示したのみで発生国ではないため除外。
