article.articleHeadline: Oxford Launches Phase I Ebola Vaccine Trial in Uganda
article.articleSummary: Phase I trial in Masaka City, southwestern Uganda, launched Oct 6, 2026, evaluates safety and immunogenicity of the ChAdOx-based Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine candidate (ChAdOx BDBV) in healthy adult volunteers. Led by Prof. Eugene Ruzagira at the MRC/UVRI & LSHTM Uganda Research Unit, the Uganda study follows a first-in-human Phase I trial in the United Kingdom and is funded by CEPI as part of a global effort to develop vaccines for Ebola virus species with no licensed vaccines. ChAdOx BDBV uses the same vaccine technology as the Oxford/AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine. Serum Institute of India has manufactured and stockpiled about 620,000 doses; SII supplied 300 vials to the UK and around 3,000 investigational doses for Uganda. Uganda has contained local Bundibugyo virus disease transmission, while regional efforts address the Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak. If early results are favorable, CEPI aims to advance late-stage trials for emergency use authorization or licensure.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォード大学、ウガンダでエボラワクチンの第I相試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はエボラワクチン候補（ChAdOx BDBV）の第I相臨床試験開始を報じるものであり、新規の感染症アウトブレイク発生情報ではないため、シグナルトリアージ対象外と判断する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダでのワクチン臨床試験開始であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは進行中のエボラアウトブレイクへの言及があるため参考として記載したが、詳細情報（症例数・死亡者数等）はなく背景情報に留まる。インドはワクチン製造国としての言及のみで発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Tirunelveli Corporation slaps fine on houses that are breeding spots for dengue mosquito
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever breeding spots were found in houses on Karaiyiruppu Rice Mill Street, Ward 2, Thatchanallur Zone, Tirunelveli Corporation; residents were fined. The anti-dengue drive has been intensified across four zones ahead of the Northeast monsoon. Inspectors check water tanks and storage points in homes, schools, colleges, hospitals, construction sites, and other premises, issuing notices and fines for breeding grounds. Construction-site owners risk temporary suspension of permissions for non-compliance. Fumigation was completed in wards 5, 15, 17, 21, 26 and 27; a special drive covered Railway Colony Ration Shop Street (Ward 29) and Railway Quarters after fever cases there. In BBC Colony and construction sites in Ward 43, Melapalayam Zone, breeding grounds were destroyed and notices issued. Residents are asked to segregate waste; sanitary workers will not collect unsegregated waste during inspections. The aim is a fever-free Northeast monsoon.

triage.headline_ja: ティルネルヴェリ市当局、デング熱蚊の繁殖地となっている住宅に罰金を科す
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性デング熱対策・行政取り締まりに関するルーチン記事であり、異常な流行拡大や重症化の報告はなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 地域行政によるデング熱予防・清掃キャンペーンの通常業務報告であり、感染症危機シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Gevallen van longpest" in Russisch lab: opgeklopt fake news of risico op nieuwe pandemie?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of pneumonic plague in a Russian lab: hyped fake news or risk of a new pandemic?
article.articleSummary: Cases of pneumonic plague reported in a Russian laboratory raise questions about hype versus real pandemic risk. The article centers on the Russian lab claim and frames the issue as a debate over whether this indicates a genuine outbreak with potential for wider spread or is inflated misinformation; no specific case counts, dates, laboratory confirmation, or infection source are provided in the excerpt. The discussion sits alongside broader tech topics, including US–China views on AI, Meta’s camera-free smart glasses, AI sensations of pain, and attempts to read burnt Herculaneum scrolls, but the infectious-disease focus remains the pneumonic plague claim and its public-health implications. Podcast credits and journalist names are listed. Published 2026-10-07.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの研究所での肺ペスト症例：誇張されたフェイクニュースか、新たなパンデミックのリスクか？
triage.triage_reason: ロシアの研究所における肺ペスト症例が報じられているが、具体的な症例数・確認情報・感染源が一切示されておらず、フェイクニュースの可能性も指摘されているため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの研究所での肺ペスト報告を巡る真偽論争を扱っており、確認された症例や公式発表は記載されていない。発生地域として挙げられた米国・ロシア・中国はいずれも記事の主題と直接関連せず、対象国リストにも該当国なし（中国の言及はAI関連の別トピックであり感染症事象とは無関係）。情報不足のため、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ചിക്കൻപോക്സ് വ്യാപനം; കൊച്ചി കുസാറ്റ് ക്യാമ്പസ് അടച്ചു, എല്ലാ ക്ലാസുകളും ഓൺലൈനിലേക്ക് മാറ്റി. ഹോസ്റ്റലുകൾക്കും പൂട്ടുവീണു. യൂണിയൻ തെരഞ്ഞെടുപ്പും മാറ്റി
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chickenpox outbreak; Kochi KUSAT campus closed, all classes moved online. Hostels shut. Union elections postponed.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-07, a chickenpox outbreak at Kochi's KUSAT campus prompted immediate containment: the campus and hostels were closed, with all classes shifted online and union elections postponed pending a new date. Laboratory-confirmed chickenpox has been reported in two School of Engineering students; in the days prior, several campus residents experienced fever and malaise, triggering precautionary measures. The authorities announced that the union elections would be rescheduled and a new date would be communicated later. The article indicates ongoing transmission on the campus and the lockdown of in-person activities, with online learning continuing for affected students while the situation is monitored.

triage.headline_ja: 水痘の流行；コーチ・クサット（KUSAT）キャンパスを閉鎖、全授業をオンラインに移行。寮も閉鎖。組合選挙も延期
triage.triage_reason: 水痘はよく知られた風土病であり、単一キャンパス内での限定的な集団発生で国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響も見られない。
triage.notes: 水痘（Varicella）はワクチンで予防可能な一般的な小児・若年成人感染症であり、キャンパス内での限定的な流行であるため、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には該当しない。大学当局による自主的な予防措置（キャンパス閉鎖、オンライン授業移行）が取られているが、外部支援の必要性は示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Here's how countries are reacting to death at Russian plague lab
article.articleSummary: A 28-year-old laboratory technician at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute in Siberia died on Oct 2 after severe pneumonia; cause undetermined and independent confirmation of pneumonic plague has not been established. Moscow says there is no epidemic risk and no outbreak. The United States formally requested information from Russia, with Secretary of State Rubio and President Trump urging transparency. The World Health Organization also sought additional data, including reports of a second employee with pneumonia of undetermined cause, and offered technical assistance. The European Union urged timely, transparent reporting and reliable epidemiological/microbiological findings, coordinating with the ECDC. Nearby states reacted: Lithuania warned of possible transit restrictions if pneumonic plague is confirmed; Mongolia increased border health surveillance, though border crossings in Selenge Province were operating normally. China remains in close contact but did not flag a public health threat. No independent confirmation of plague or outbreak."

triage.headline_ja: ロシアのペスト研究所での死亡事案に対する各国の反応
triage.triage_reason: ロシアの抗ペスト研究所職員が肺炎で死亡し肺ペストの疑いが持たれている。確定診断は未了だが、米・EU・WHO・近隣国が情報開示や渡航制限の可能性に言及するなど国際的関心が極めて高く、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 事案はロシア（イルクーツク）で発生しており、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当国なし。中国は『密接に連絡を取っている』との記述のみで発生国ではないため除外。肺ペストの確定診断は未了（cause undetermined）であり、続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Não há restrição de consumo ou impacto de mercado", diz secretário sobre caso de gripe aviária no RS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There is no restriction on consumption or market impact, says the secretary about a case of avian influenza in Rio Grande do Sul.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza was confirmed in domestic birds in Selbach, northern Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. Within 24 hours, official sanitary teams visited 68 properties within a three-kilometer radius of the affected area and conducted community education to prompt reporting of suspected cases to the State Secretariat of Agriculture. Secretary Márcio Madalena stressed that the confirmed diagnosis reinforces prevention measures but does not pose risks to consumption or imply a market impact, noting that previous outbreaks affecting markets involved commercial poultry, whereas this case arises in subsistence farming. Depopulation of about 60 birds at the affected property has been completed. Communication to the World Organisation for Animal Health will be sent in the standard report format. Officials also discussed potential links between El Niño–related rainfall, wild migratory birds, and virus transmission, emphasizing monitoring of water and wild birds.

triage.headline_ja: 「消費制限や市場への影響はない」とRS州の鳥インフルエンザ症例について担当官が発言
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・リオグランデドスル州の家禽（自給自足農家）での鳥インフルエンザ確認事例であり、ヒト感染や公衆衛生上のリスクは報告されておらず、当局も市場への影響なしと説明している。
triage.notes: 家禽（自給自足農家）での動物例であり、ヒトへの感染報告なし。WOAHへの標準報告のみ予定されており、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: NCDC Issues Ebola Alert After Kenya Confirms Imported Case
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed an imported Ebola case linked to the Bundibugyo virus, triggering an alert from the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) on 6 October 2026. The case is connected to an ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Nigeria reports no Ebola cases to date but has intensified national surveillance and preparedness in collaboration with government agencies and partners. Public health guidance emphasizes regular hand hygiene, avoidance of contact with blood or body fluids of sick individuals, and prohibition on handling or consuming raw or poorly cooked bushmeat, plus avoiding contact with sick or dead wild animals. Anyone with Ebola-suggestive symptoms or potential exposure should seek immediate care at recognized health facilities. The situation highlights continued vigilance and early reporting to detect and manage any Nigerian or cross-border cases. Ebola spreads via direct contact with the blood or body fluids of infected persons or animals.

triage.headline_ja: NCDC、ケニアでの輸入症例確認を受けエボラ警戒を発令
triage.triage_reason: DRCで continuing するエボラ（ブンディブジョウイルス）アウトブレイクがケニアへ越境輸入され、ナイジェリアも警戒態勢に入るなど国際的拡大の兆候があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで継続中のエボラアウトブレイクに起因するケニアへの輸入症例とナイジェリアの警戒対応。ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Races to Trace Ebola Contacts After First Death, WHO Says
article.articleSummary: Kenya records its first Ebola death from an imported Bundibugyo strain linked to the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The victim, a local man who had lived in DRC, became ill there, flew to Nairobi via Entebbe on 3 October, and died in Nairobi on Monday. WHO Kenya Representative Dr. Neema Rusibamayila Kimambo said decisive days lie ahead to prevent community transmission. Contact tracing has identified about 10 relatives in direct contact who are cooperating and under quarantine, along with 21 health workers who treated him, including lab nurses, now being quarantined. The government is coordinating with the airline to trace roughly 23 passengers and four crew on the Entebbe–Kampala flight. The case is characterized as imported, with emphasis on rapid tracing and quarantine to halt potential spread as the DRC outbreak in the east continues.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、初のエボラ死亡例後に接触者追跡を急ぐ ― WHOが発表
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来の輸入エボラ症例によるケニアでの死亡例が確認され、航空機搭乗者・医療従事者を含む多数の接触者追跡が進行中であり、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念がある。
triage.notes: 主症例はケニアで確認されたが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であり継続中のアウトブレイクが言及されているDRCのみを対象国として記載。

article.articleHeadline: Viral Dugaan Keracunan Makanan di Resto, Pemkot Bandung Turun Tangan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Viral Suspected Food Poisoning at a Restaurant, Bandung City Government Steps In.
article.articleSummary: Bandung, Indonesia – A suspected food poisoning incident at 88 Soul, a Korean-style restaurant inside a Bandung mall, prompted city officials to investigate. Social media claims suggested hundreds of diners experienced nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and diarrhea, but Bandung Mayor Muhammad Farhan said the number is not yet confirmed and the investigation is ongoing. The Bandung City Health Department (Dinkes) and the Food Security and Agriculture Agency (DKPP) have inspected the venue, assessing storage conditions, separation of wet and dry ingredients, utensil cleanliness, and handling of cleaning chemicals. Authorities will continue active surveillance, coordinate with hospitals to verify patient identities and medical diagnoses, and determine any legal action based on findings. The restaurant is temporarily closed while sterilization and cleaning proceed, with the goal of maintaining safe, hygienic conditions for residents and visitors.

triage.headline_ja: レストランでの食中毒疑いが拡散、バンドン市政府が対応に乗り出す
triage.triage_reason: 単一レストランでの食中毒疑い事案であり、感染症というよりは食品安全事案。人数未確定で続報を要する段階。
triage.notes: 食中毒疑いで、感染症アウトブレイクではなく食品安全事案に分類される可能性が高い。被害者数や原因物質（病原体か毒素か）が未確定のため経過観察とする。

article.articleHeadline: Gevallen van longpest" in Russisch lab: opgeklopte geruchten of risico op nieuwe pandemie?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumonic Plague Cases in a Russian Lab: Sensationalized Rumors or Risk of a New Pandemic?
article.articleSummary: Headline notes pneumonic plague cases in a Russian lab, but the article mainly surveys AI policy and technology topics. It states that the Trump–Xi meeting produced no AI agreements and questions how China views artificial intelligence and its potential risks. The piece also covers Meta’s camera-free smart glasses, the possibility of AI that can feel pain, and whether the charred scrolls of Herculaneum might still be readable. It promotes the daily DS Vandaag news podcast, listing journalists Dominique Deckmyn, Pieter Van Dooren, and Jasper Abrahams, with audioproduction by Joris Van Damme and music by Brecht Plasschaert. Published 2026-10-07. The body provides no concrete plague data; the plague topic appears only in the headline, with no infectious-disease details.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの研究所で肺ペスト症例:誇張された噂か、新たなパンデミックのリスクか?
triage.triage_reason: 見出しに肺ペストが言及されているが、記事本文はAI政策・技術関連の話題が中心で、感染症に関する具体的情報が全く含まれていないため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによれば、肺ペストに関する具体的な感染症データは本文に一切含まれておらず、見出しのみの言及で実質的な疑義情報がない。発生地域としてBluedotが付与したロシア・米国・イタリア・中国等は本文内容と無関係であり、対象国リストとの一致も確認できないため verified_locations は空とする。続報があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: BBC World Service - Focus on Africa, Ebola reaches Kenya. What's the response?
article.articleSummary: Kenya allocates $538 million to its Ebola response after confirming its first case, linked to the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The funds will bolster surveillance, contact tracing, and other measures to prevent further transmission as eastern DRC continues to report cases. Liberia is featured in a companion segment examining what happens to hundreds of chimpanzees used in decades of medical experiments once researchers end programs. The report explores welfare and disposition of lab animals left behind when scientists no longer need them, alongside broader public health insights. Presenter Blessing Aderogba introduces the Focus on Africa program for BBC World Service, with producers Victor Chege and Charles Gitonga, among others.

triage.headline_ja: BBCワールドサービス『フォーカス・オン・アフリカ』エボラ熱がケニアに到達、その対応は？
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクがケニアへ拡大し初症例が確認されたため、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際的拡大）が複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアでの初症例確認とDRCでの継続流行を主題としているが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。リベリアの segment はチンパンジー実験動物の福祉に関する別テーマであり、エボラ発生国として関連しないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Mongolia orders 'surveillance' on Russia border after reported plague death
article.articleSummary: Plague threat prompts Mongolia to order border health surveillance with Russia after a reported plague death of a laboratory technician in Siberia's Irkutsk region. As of 2026-10-07, Mongolia's Health Ministry says the current risk level is low but has instructed agencies to maintain precautionary measures and continuous surveillance. Border crossings in Selenge Province continue to operate, with health screening in place. The deceased is a 28-year-old woman employed at a plague research institute in Irkutsk, whose death was reported last Friday; Russian authorities downplay the event, citing pneumonia and an undetermined cause, and saying there is no epidemic risk. The Irkutsk capital attracts visitors from China heading to Lake Baikal; China and Russia emphasize cooperation on plague prevention and control. No confirmed plague outbreak reported in Mongolia or Russia.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア国境での伝染病による死亡報告を受け、モンゴルが'監視'を指示
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの検疫研究所職員が死亡し原因が不明（肺炎とされるがペスト研究施設での発生のため異常性あり）。モンゴル保健省が国境監視を指示するなど政府の関心が高まっており、WPRO基準の異常性・重症度に該当するためピックアップとする。
triage.notes: 死亡例はロシア・イルクーツクのペスト研究所職員で、ロシア当局は死因を肺炎・原因不明とし流行リスクを否定。モンゴルは予防的に国境監視を強化したが、モンゴル・ロシアとも対象国リストに含まれず、中国は観光客の往来のみでイベント発生国ではないため verified_locations は空とした。続報で確定診断・感染拡大の有無を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Китай вперше прокоментував спалах чуми в росії - Bloomberg
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China has for the first time commented on the plague outbreak in Russia - Bloomberg
article.articleSummary: As of 7 October 2026, Russia reports a possible pneumonic plague outbreak in Irkutsk Oblast. China issued its first official response, stressing continued Sino–Russian cooperation on infectious disease prevention and noting joint drills with the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute and cross-border monitoring discussions; Irkutsk remains a transport hub linking to China by air and rail. The Kremlin and Rospotnadzor deny a dangerous disease is present; the official cause of a laboratory worker’s death is pneumonia of unknown origin, though unconfirmed reports allege she broke a vial containing plague bacteria. The United States issued warnings, with President Trump saying he would call Putin and the U.S. Embassy in Moscow issuing a medical alert urging Americans to depart. Secretary of State Rubio urged Moscow to be transparent about the death. Local media removed plague references; Baikal officials cautioned against travel to Shelekhov, later deleted; REN TV deleted plague posts.

triage.headline_ja: 中国がロシアでのペスト流行について初めてコメント - ブルームバーグ
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州で肺ペスト疑いの死亡例が発生し、米国が渡航警告・大使館退避勧告を出すなど国際的反応が広がっており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（イルクーツク州・モスクワ）であり対象国リストに含まれない。中国は本件に関してコメントを発表しているのみで発生国ではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。ロシア当局は公式には危険な疾病の存在を否定しており、情報の透明性に疑義がある点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: "إيبولا" يتفشى في الكونغو الديمقراطية والسلطات تعلن وفاة أكثر من 4 آلاف شخص وإصابة 8665
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and authorities report more than 4,000 deaths and 8,665 infections.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reach 8,665 cases and 4,178 deaths since the start of the outbreak, according to the National Institute of Public Health. In the last 24 hours, 62 new cases and 30 deaths were reported, with 24 recoveries, bringing totals to 8,665 cases and 4,178 deaths. France will increase aid to the DRC in 2026 to 23 million euros to support Ebola response, announced by Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot. In September, the DRC government unveiled a 180 day emergency plan with funding needs around 1.3 billion dollars. A new Ebola strain named Bundibugyo lacks any licensed vaccine or treatment, complicating control efforts. Ebola is a highly virulent virus transmitted through contact with blood or bodily fluids, reinforcing ongoing containment and public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で拡大、当局が4000人以上の死亡と8665人の感染を発表
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が大規模（感染8665例、死亡4178例）に拡大しており、ワクチン・治療法のない新株（ブンディブギョ株）が流行していることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際支援も動いているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: フランスは資金援助国であり発生国ではないため対象国リストから除外。新株（ブンディブギョ株）にワクチン・治療法がない点は特に注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Mongolia ordena "medidas de supervisión sanitaria" en la frontera con Rusia por posible brote de peste
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mongolia orders "health surveillance measures" at the border with Russia amid a possible plague outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-07, Mongolia ordered sanitary surveillance measures along its border with Russia amid a possible pneumonic plague outbreak in Irkutsk after the WHO stated it is closely monitoring the death of a Russian laboratory worker. The Interior Ministry said the risk is currently low, but precautionary surveillance must be implemented at border zones and agencies should remain vigilant. Border crossings continue to operate normally with enhanced sanitary oversight. The U.S. CDC said it is monitoring the case closely. China cited ongoing exchanges about the incident, noting reports that no high-risk pathogens were found among contacts. Russian authorities insist there is no contagion risk. The situation underscores cross-border health concerns linked to a suspected pneumonic plague case involving a Russian laboratory worker and prompts heightened border surveillance despite low reported risk.

triage.headline_ja: モンゴル、ロシアとの国境で「衛生監視措置」を命令 ― ペスト流行の可能性を受けて
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクでの研究所職員の肺ペスト死亡例を受け、WHO・CDC・中国・モンゴルが相次いで監視・国境対応を行っており、国際的関心と拡大リスクの両面で基準に該当するためフルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 事象の発生地はロシア（イルクーツク）であり、モンゴル・中国・米国は監視・国境対応の文脈でのみ言及されている。対象国リストにロシア・モンゴルは含まれず、中国は発生国ではなく情報共有の立場のため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Le virus Ebola crée de nouveaux foyers en République démocratique du Congo | L'actualité
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus creates new hotspots in the Democratic Republic of the Congo | L'actualité
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 7, 2026, North Kivu is the new Ebola epicenter in the Democratic Republic of Congo, accounting for about 40% of confirmed cases, up from 24% in August. The outbreak, declared in May, has surpassed 8,500 cases, the fastest-growing and deadliest in the DRC’s history. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or approved treatment. About 70% of new infections involve people with no known contact to a case; only 23% of potential contacts have been traced. North Kivu’s case-fatality rate is 58%, the highest among seven provinces, with the disease spreading to half of the province’s 34 health zones; in nine zones, more than half of confirmed cases have died. Kenya has reported its first Ebola case—a traveler from DRC who died. Response is chaotic, with shortages of staff and supplies; MSF and WHO stress the need for village-led contact tracing, safe burials, and isolation to end transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスがコンゴ民主共和国で新たな感染拡大地を生み出す｜L'actualité
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模・最悪の致死率を示すエボラ流行が拡大し、ワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株による国際伝播（ケニアでの死亡例）も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ケニアでの症例はDRCからの渡航者の輸入例であり、ケニア国内での持続的発生ではないためverified_locationsには含めず。ケニアは対象国リストにも含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: TRUMP PREVÉ LLAMADA CON PUTIN POR POSIBLE BROTE DE PESTE NEUMÓNICA EN RUSIA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trump Foresees a Call With Putin Over a Possible Outbreak of Pneumonic Plague in Russia.
article.articleSummary: Possible pneumonic plague outbreak reported in Siberia, Russia, triggering high-level talks as of 2026-10-07. A 28-year-old employee at the Institute of Plague Research in Irkutsk and the Far East died in a hospital in Shélejov; investigators consider exposure during a recent trip to Thailand or a lab accident involving pathogen tubes. The U.S. State Department confirms ongoing consultations with Moscow since last week, including health specialists. Washington issued a Sunday alert about a potential pneumonic plague outbreak in that Siberian region; Russian Liudi Baikala reported quarantines at several Irkutsk hospitals while authorities assess origin and scope. EU's ECDC monitors; WHO says Europe risk is very low. President Trump says a call with Vladimir Putin will occur 'very soon,' with more details expected midweek; U.S. Secretary of State Rubio urged transparency.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ氏、ロシアでの肺ペスト発生の可能性を巡りプーチン氏との電話会談を予定
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクでの肺ペスト死亡例と米露間の高官協議が報じられており、IHR基準（重大性・異常性・国際的拡大懸念）に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand等）には含まれない。タイは感染源調査における渡航先候補として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Rusia niega segunda muerte por peste... pero OMS exige aclarar fallecimiento de científica con neumonía
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia denies a second death from the plague... but the WHO demands clarification of the death of a female scientist with pneumonia.
article.articleSummary: Russia rejects reports of a pneumonic plague outbreak in Siberia and denies a second plague death; the WHO demands transparent information to clarify the death of a 28-year-old female scientist who died Oct 2 at a hospital in Shélejov near Irkutsk, after working at the Institute of Plague Research of Irkutsk and the Far East. Rospotrebnadzor attributes the death to pneumonia of unknown etiology; two COVID-19 and two rhinovirus cases have emerged among contacts. Theories include acquisition during a trip to Thailand or a lab accident, but Russia denies any incident and says safety protocols were followed; the patient was vaccinated and had strong immunity. Russia reports the Irkutsk region remains epidemiologically calm, with over 90% of contacts tested and about 5,000 tests showing no dangerous pathogen. WHO calls for rapid, transparent sharing under International Health Regulations to assess risk.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、ペストによる2人目の死亡を否定…しかしWHOは肺炎で死亡した女性科学者の件の説明を要求
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究所勤務者の原因不明肺炎による死亡とWHOによる透明性要求があり、IHR基準の深刻性・異常性・国際的波及懸念が複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 事象の発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストに含まれない。タイへの渡航歴は感染経路の一仮説として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Palace: DOH monitoring Russia plague case, assures public of readiness | Samuel P. Medenilla
article.articleSummary: Death of Darya Shipilova, 28, a lab technician at a plague research institute in Siberia, Russia, is under investigation for suspected exposure to plague. The Philippines Department of Health (DOH) is closely monitoring the case and following WHO recommendations to allay public fears of a potential pandemic. WHO says the public-health risk remains low at this stage, while Russian authorities verify whether the death was caused by pneumonic plague. No outbreaks or confirmed human-to-human transmission linked to this case have been reported. DOH emphasizes readiness and ongoing monitoring, with experts reviewing infection source and awaiting laboratory confirmation status. The incident underscores vigilance for plague and the importance of laboratory safety in preventing zoonotic exposures.

triage.headline_ja: 大統領府：保健省、ロシアのペスト症例を監視、国民に備えを保証
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・シベリアで研究所職員1名がペストの疑いで死亡し調査中だが、WHOは公衆衛生リスクを低いと評価しており、確定診断やヒト-ヒト感染の証拠はまだない。フィリピンは監視対応のみで実際の症例発生国ではないため、続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 実際の発生国はロシアであり、ロシアは対象国リストに含まれない。フィリピンは監視のみで国内発生ではないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。確定診断・感染源・感染拡大状況について情報不足のためWATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya quarantines 10 after first-ever Ebola death | News.az
article.articleSummary: First Ebola death in Kenya; ten people quarantined after contact with the patient; authorities tracing 57 additional contacts of the Kenyan patient who travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo and died in a Nairobi hospital Monday. This marks Kenya's first Ebola infection; Africa CDC notes potential screening gaps as the patient had travelled through northern DRC (Buta to Kisangani to Beni), Uganda, then Nairobi, with symptoms possibly masked by medications. Ebola transmits via contact with bodily fluids. The outbreak in DRC began in May and is linked to the Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists, though trials are underway. Africa CDC and Congolese authorities are investigating; Kenyan health officials to meet with them. Kenya has heightened surveillance at airports and border crossings, urging the public not to panic. The patient was buried Tuesday per safety guidelines.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで初のエボラ死亡例、接触者10人を隔離
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行（ブンディブジョ株）に関連し、ケニアで初の輸入症例・死亡例が発生。複数国境を越えた伝播と57人の接触者追跡が確認され、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの輸入症例だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であるDRCの進行中アウトブレイクをverified_locationsに含めた。ウガンダも対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: A pesquisadora que transformou décadas de laboratório na primeira vacina 100% brasileira contra a dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The researcher who turned decades of laboratory work into the first fully Brazilian dengue vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Butantan-DV, the world's first and only single-dose dengue vaccine developed entirely in Brazil by Instituto Butantan, began distribution in the country in recent weeks. Led by Neuza Frazzati, the program targets Brazil’s dengue burden, a disease responsible for more than 18,000 deaths since 2000 and about 25 million infections. The vaccine, designed to protect against all four dengue serotypes, shows about 75% effectiveness against the disease and over 90% protection against severe dengue and hospitalizations, based on a study involving more than 16,000 participants followed for years. The rollout prioritizes individuals aged 15–59, expected to reach them by the second half of 2026. Frazzati’s background includes earlier innovations in rabies vaccines using cell culture (Vero cells) and decades of vaccine development; her team achieved lyophilization to improve stability for nationwide transport.

triage.headline_ja: 数十年の研究室での成果をブラジル初の100%国産デング熱ワクチンへと結実させた研究者
triage.triage_reason: 新規デングワクチンの開発・配布に関する科学・医療成果の紹介記事であり、新たな公衆衛生上の脅威や異常な感染拡大を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン開発の成果を紹介する内容であり、デング熱の新規アウトブレイクや狂犬病の発生報告ではないため、感染症イベントとしてのトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: दूध पीने वालों को सताया डर, पहुंचे डॉक्टर के पास; फिरोजाबाद में पागल कुत्ते के काटने से आक्रामक हुई गाय - firozabad cow ferocious after wild dog bite rabies scare
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Milk-drinkers plagued by fear; they went to a doctor; in Firozabad, a cow became aggressive after a rabid dog bite.
article.articleSummary: Two months after a rabid dog bite on a pet cow in Dhiraura (Dhirpurā) village, Nagla Singhi area, Toondla, Firozabad district, the animal developed aggression. For this period, the cow’s milk had been consumed by the family and a milkman. On Wednesday around 12:00 PM, the owner Brijesh Kumar and relatives, along with the milkman, sought care at a community health center and all received anti-rabies vaccines. Deputy Chief Veterinary Officer Satyendra Kumar Nigam of Toondla advised that thoroughly boiling the milk before drinking eliminates rabies risk and urged people to consult a veterinarian rather than panic.

triage.headline_ja: 牛乳を飲んだ人々に恐怖、医師のもとへ；フィロザバードで野犬に噛まれた牛が狂暴化

article.articleHeadline: 巧合？ 洩露鼠疫的研究所8月參與中俄防鼠疫演練 | 俄羅斯鼠疫 | 伊爾庫茨克防鼠疫研究所 | 鼠疫洩露
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Coincidence? The institute that leaked plague participated in the China-Russia anti-plague drill in August | Russian plague | Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute | Plague leak
article.articleSummary: Plague outbreak reported in Russia’s Irkutsk region. At the Irkutsk Plague Research Institute in Shelekhov, a female researcher broke a vial containing Yersinia pestis on September 25; she developed severe pneumonia and died on October 2. Russian authorities say the situation is not serious, while Chinese media have largely downplayed the event. A China–Russia cross-border infectious-disease emergency drill was held August 24–27 in Fuyuan City, Heilongjiang near the Russian border; 19 health-emergency teams from Heilongjiang, Jilin, and Liaoning participated, with Sergei Balakhonov, director of the Irkutsk Institute, in attendance. Following the drill, Fuyuan City Party Secretary He Dahai disappeared from public view, fueling online speculation of arrest or infection. U.S. President Trump commented on plague control challenges (Oct 5); Mongolia reported plague deaths in western Gobi in July. WHO 2019–2025: 10 countries, 3,860 suspected, 2,646 confirmed, 423 deaths; China 19 confirmed, Mongolia 17.

article.articleSummary: Ruushka, gobolka Irkutsk, magaalada Shelekhov, ayaa la karantiilay isbitaallo dhowr ah iyo xarumo caafimaad kadib dhimashada shaqaale shaybaar la xiriira cudurka sambabada—pneumonic plague. In kasta oo aan la xaqiijin sababta geerida, warbaahinta iyo baraha bulshada ayaa sheegaya cudurka oo sii faafaya; ilaa 200 qof ayaa la karantiilay. Daria Shipilova, 28 jir, ayaa 29-kii Sebtembar 2026 loo wareejiyay isbitaal, laba maalmood ka dibna geeriyootay. Saddex isbitaal Irkutsk iyo hal xarun dhalmo ayaa la karantiilay saddex toddobaad. 4 Oktoobar 2026, ilo madax-banaan ayaa sheegay in halis sare loo qabo in cudurka kala qaado, laakiin fursadda faafis weyn gudaha magaalada ayaa hoos u dhacday sababtoo ah xiriirradii hore la karantiilay. Ilaha cudurka ayaa laga yaabaa Thailand iyo Buryatia iyo in tuubooyinka tijaabada la jebiyay, balse mas’uuliyiinta ma haystaan xaqiijinta rasmiga ah.

article.articleHeadline: Quênia e OMS fortalecem resposta rápida após confirmação de caso de ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya and WHO strengthen rapid response after confirmation of an Ebola case.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms an Ebola case in Nairobi, with 57 contacts identified and 10 in quarantine; border surveillance intensified and a reinforced response under way. The patient, a Kenyan citizen residing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, arrived via Uganda, developed symptoms on arrival, was hospitalized, and died after laboratory confirmation of Ebola. No additional infections have been reported; WHO is assisting with controls. Healthcare workers, airport staff, and hospital contacts are under strict observation. To ensure readiness, Nairobi hosts 133 isolation beds in a dedicated Ebola unit, with five facilities designated for case management (Kenyatta National Hospital, Moi Teaching and Referral Hospital, National Police Service Hospital, Port Reitz Hospital) and capacity to expand. Temporary centers at Malaba and Kocholia; Alupe under renovation; screening focuses on travelers from DR Congo, Uganda, Tanzania, Angola, Rwanda, and South Sudan. Public urged to seek care if symptomatic.

triage.notes: 確定症例はケニア（対象国外）で発生しているが、患者はDRC在住でDRCからの渡航歴があり、感染源はDRCのエボラ流行に関連している可能性が高いためDRCを関連国として記載。ケニア国内での感染拡大は現時点で報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: EEUU lanza una alerta por el posible caso de peste neumónica en Rusia: "Deben abandonarlo de inmediato"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States issues a warning about a possible case of pneumonic plague in Russia: "They must abandon him immediately."
article.articleSummary: Possible pneumonic plague case in Irkutsk region, Siberia, Russia, after the death of a 28-year-old woman who worked at the Institute of Plague Research for Irkutsk and the Far East (reported Oct 2). Pneumonic plague is caused by Yersinia pestis and can spread via coughing; authorities say there is no confirmed outbreak and describe pneumonia of unknown etiology with no plague infection, while Rospotrebnadzor denies hospital quarantines. Independent Russian channels claim quarantines in Irkutsk hospitals, but the Kremlin rejects these, urging reliance on official data. Two possible origins are proposed: infection during a recent trip to Thailand or an accidental laboratory incident; the latter is disputed by authorities and family. The U.S. Embassy in Moscow is monitoring the situation and has reiterated a Level 4 travel advisory for Russia, advising Americans to leave the country; US assistance to citizens in Russia may be limited outside Moscow. President Trump plans a call with Putin to discuss the case, with ongoing intelligence discussions.

article.articleHeadline: WHO Backs Kenya's Ebola Response After First Imported Case
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 7, 2026, Kenya confirmed its first imported Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) case, a Kenyan national who had resided in the Democratic Republic of the Congo for seven years, with the patient dying in a Nairobi hospital on Monday night. WHO, working with the Kenyan government, is intensifying control measures, focusing on case investigation, contact tracing, and enhanced surveillance across 27 high-risk counties. Key actions include screening at risk entry points, risk communication, and community engagement. Kenya has identified and assessed isolation units, trained case managers, and updated Ebola surveillance tools; WHO and partners have delivered about 1,000 Ebola tests and 1,000 personal protective equipment kits to high-risk counties. The priority is rapid, coordinated action to prevent further spread. WHO advises against travel or trade restrictions with the DRC, Uganda, or Kenya based on current information.

article.articleHeadline: Leucose e tripanossomose ameaçam produtividade da pecuária leiteira
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leukosis and Trypanosomiasis Threaten Dairy Cattle Productivity
article.articleSummary: On Oct 7, 2026, at the SBSBL dairy cattle symposium in Chapecó, Brazil, experts highlighted bovine enzootic leukosis (EBL) and bovine trypanosomiasis as major threats to dairy productivity. EBL is globally widespread; in the United States, herd prevalence is about 90%, with up to 40% of cows testing positive, while Brazil lacks a consolidated national diagnosis but shows high herd-level presence. The infection is largely subclinical yet causes significant economic losses through reduced milk yield, poorer reproductive performance, and weakened immunity, since the virus infects lymphocytes. Transmission mainly occurs via blood, making handling practices crucial: avoid sharing syringes, use individual vaccination or medication equipment, and ensure colostrum from disease-negative cows and pasteurized milk for calves. Gloves should be individual as well. article.articleHeadline: RDC - Nord-Kivu : Cartographie des capacités de prise en charge de la maladie à virus Ebola( MVE BDB ) au 29 septembre 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC - North Kivu: Mapping of capacities to manage Ebola virus disease (MVE BDB) as of September 29, 2026.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) capacity mapping in North Kivu, DRC, as of 29 September 2026, records 43 facilities across 19 health zones, with a total capacity of 407 beds (149 for confirmed cases, 258 for suspected). Twelve Ebola Treatment Centers provide 261 beds (64% of total, 85% of confirmed beds). The largest concentration is in Beni, Butembo and Katwa, hosting 22 facilities and 286 beds, about 70% of capacity. There is a critical need to strengthen patient referral circuits and assess needs in 15 health zones without facilities. Gaps persist: 17 structures (59 beds) lack partner support. The Mabalako center requires upgrading; the MONUSCO facility in Goma, with 19 beds, remains in final phase. Priorities include mobilizing partners, tracking center openings, documenting bed occupancy, and completing missing data; improving child-friendly spaces to enhance care quality.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The 'Russian Plague' Triggers Panic; Presidential Office Urges the Public Not to Worry.
article.articleSummary: Russian plague rumors spark concern in the Philippines as Malacañang says the government is closely monitoring reports and the Department of Health is actively assessing the situation with WHO guidance. Deputy Presidential Spokesperson Claire Castro said health authorities have been in contact with the DOH, which is monitoring developments and prepared to act to allay public fear. As of 2026-10-07, no case counts, symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or infection source are reported in the briefing. The remarks were made at a press conference at the Philippine Embassy in Singapore during President Marcos’ five-day working visit. The government stresses ongoing surveillance and adherence to WHO advice, and notes there are no details on imported or exported cases in the article. Public reassurance and cautious monitoring are prioritized pending any confirmed developments.

article.articleHeadline: Casos de sarampo seguem subindo nas Américas e Brasil reforça alerta interno
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles cases continue to rise in the Americas, and Brazil reinforces its internal alert.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases rise in the Americas, with the United States reporting the highest totals over 35 years; over 90% of infections are among unvaccinated people or those with unknown vaccination status. US, Guatemala, Mexico, Peru, and Canada account for over 95% of confirmed cases in 2026, per PAHO. By Oct 5, Brazil had 52 imported cases: 41 in São Paulo, 10 in Amazonas, 1 in Rio de Janeiro. To curb transmission, health teams conduct active case finding, epidemiological investigations, contact monitoring, and vaccination blocks, with intensified vaccination in public spaces. Brazil remains free of endemic measles circulation despite imported cases. 2025 first-dose MMR coverage reached 93.10% nationwide (São Paulo 94.39%; Amazonas 89.54%). Four campaigns in 2026 delivered over 3.8 million doses in São Paulo and about 192k in Amazonas. In tri-border area Brazil-Colombia-Peru, response includes vaccination, case investigation, sampling, contact tracing, and vaccination blocks, with federal support.
